每寻访<color=#060606>%1$d次</color>后，可额外获得一个<color=#060606>%2$s</color>，次数不限。

Acquire a bonus <color=#060606>%2$s</color> for every <color=#060606>%1$d</color> headhunting attempts performed. There is no limit to this.

LUA_GACHA_ITEM_INSTRUCTION_DESC_POTENTIA.cn:
累计寻访<color=#060606>%1$d次</color>后，可额外获得一份<color=#060606>%2$s</color>，次数不限。该奖励将在满足条件后自动发放。

使用流光庆时信物补给，可从<color=#060606>莱万汀的信物/洁尔佩塔的信物/艾尔黛拉的信物/骏卫的信物</color>中任选一个信物获取。
LUA_GACHA_ITEM_INSTRUCTION_DESC_POTENTIA.en:
After a total of <color=#060606>%1$d headhunting attempts</color>, you get 1 bonus <color=#060606>%2$s</color>. There are no limits to this bonus. This reward will be automatically sent once the criteria are met.

Use the Shimmering Moment Token Supply to choose and acquire 1 token from the following: <color=#060606>Laevatain's Token / Gilberta's Token / Ardelia's Token / Pogranichnik's Token</color>.

LUA_GACHA_ITEM_INSTRUCTION_DESC_SEL_CHAR.cn:
累计寻访<color=#060606>%1$d次</color>后，可额外获得一份<color=#060606>%2$s</color>，当前寻访仅限一次。在此之后，每寻访<color=#060606>240次</color>，可额外获得一份<color=#060606>流光庆时信物补给</color>，次数不限。上述奖励将在满足条件后自动发放。

使用流光庆时调用凭证，可从6星干员<color=#060606>莱万汀/洁尔佩塔/艾尔黛拉/骏卫</color>中任选一位干员调用。使用流光庆时信物补给，可从<color=#060606>莱万汀的信物/洁尔佩塔的信物/艾尔黛拉的信物/骏卫的信物</color>中任选一个信物获取。
LUA_GACHA_ITEM_INSTRUCTION_DESC_SEL_CHAR.en:
After a total of <color=#060606>%1$d headhunting attempts</color>, you get 1 bonus <color=#060606>%2$s</color> (this bonus is given only once for the headhunting banner). After that, for every <color=#060606>240</color> headhunting attempts, you get 1 bonus <color=#060606>Shimmering Moment Token Supply</color>. There are no limits to this bonus. The aforementioned rewards will be automatically sent once the criteria are met.

Use the Shimmering Moment Designation Permit to select and acquire 1 of the following 6★ operators: <color=#060606>Laevatain / Gilberta / Ardelia / Pogranichnik</color>. Use the Shimmering Moment Token Supply to select and acquire 1 of the following tokens: <color=#060606>Laevatain's Token / Gilberta's Token / Ardelia's Token / Pogranichnik's Token</color>.

LUA_GACHA_ITEM_INSTRUCTION_DESC_TESTIMON.cn:

寻访情报书在满足条件后自动获得。在下一个特许寻访开启时，寻访情报书将自动转化为对应特许寻访的专有寻访凭证×10，此寻访凭证将在对应寻访结束后失效。

However, these HH permits will also expire once that banner ends.

a1m16d1_desc_002.en: The Endministrator has talked to Zuo Guyan to learn more about his investigation. Chen Qianyu happens to be nearby. Ask her what she is trying to do.

a1m16d1_desc_003.cn: 左顾言提供了巡卫侦察用装置的图纸，管理员将其改进成了息壤龙泡泡，并决定使用集成工业系统进行生产。
a1m16d1_desc_003.en: The Endministrator has received the watchguard drone blueprints from Zuo Guyan and improves it to the Xiranite Chubby Lung drone. The Endministrator then decides to produce it with the AIC Factory.

a1m16d1_desc_004.cn: 息壤龙泡泡的生产完成了，前去与左顾言讨论之后的行动。
a1m16d1_desc_004.en: Xiranite Chubby Lung production has been completed. Meet with Zuo Guyan and discuss the next step.

a1m16d1_desc_005.cn: 向左顾言说明了息壤龙泡泡的功能后，管理员开始批量生产息壤龙泡泡。
a1m16d1_desc_005.en: After telling Zuo Guyan how the Xiranite Chubby Lung works, the Endministrator begins preparing the drones for mass production.

a1m16d1_desc_006.cn: 在熟悉的地方遇见了意料之外的熟人，他似乎正在寻找着什么东西。
a1m16d1_desc_006.en: You run into a familiar yet unexpected acquaintance who seems to be looking for something.

a1m16d1_desc_007.cn: 等待息壤龙泡泡采集更多数据后，再前往查看情况如何。
a1m16d1_desc_007.en: Wait for the Xiranite Chubby Lung to gather more data, then go and check the situation.

a1m16d2_desc_001.cn: 距离生产出来的息壤龙泡泡被放置在野外已经过去了一段时间。从左顾言那里了解调查的进展。
a1m16d2_desc_001.en: Some time has passed since the field deployment of the mass-produced Xiranite Chubby Lungs. Ask Zuo Guyan for updates to his investigation.

a1m16d2_desc_002.cn: 从左顾言处得知，彦宁和白霜解决了息壤龙泡泡中探测模块存在的问题。查看异常数据调查组的消息，了解这次升级的具体情况。
a1m16d2_desc_002.en: From Zuo Guyan, you learn that Tianshi Yan Ning and Bai Shuang have solved the detection module issues of the Xiranite Chubby Lungs. Read the Baker toasts in the Anomalous Data Investigation Group for details of this upgrade.

a1m16d2_desc_003.cn: 龙泡泡的足迹已经遍布了这片土地，但真相真的会如此简单地揭下它那神秘且致命的面纱吗？
a1m16d2_desc_003.en: The Chubby Lung has traveled to every corner of this land. Will the truth unveil its mysterious yet lethal mask?

a1m16d3_desc_001.cn: 自息壤龙泡泡升级完毕后，关于异常数据的调查继续进行了一段时间。异常数据调查组中有了新的消息，了解发生了什么。
a1m16d3_desc_001.en: Investigation of the anomalous data has continued for a while after upgrading the Xiranite Chubby Lung. Members in the Anomalous Data Investigation Group in Baker chat have posted new toasts. Read them to learn what is going on.

a1m16d3_desc_002.cn: 与左顾言和陈千语交流后，推测出了异常数据的真相。前往天王坪，与他们会合。
a1m16d3_desc_002.en: After discussing the incident with Zuo Guyan and Chen Qianyu, the Endministrator deduces the actual cause of the anomalous data. Go to Sky King Flats and meet up with them.

a1m16d3_desc_003.cn: 管理员已经集齐了所有线索，准备把事件的真相公之于众。
a1m16d3_desc_003.en: The Endministrator has gathered all the clues and is about to reveal the truth to everyone.

a1m16d3_desc_004.cn: 龙泡泡终会带领我们冲破迷雾，真理的曙光必将重新照耀这片大地。真相已经近在咫尺，一举推翻那面墙壁吧，管理员！
a1m16d3_desc_004.en: The Chubby Lungs will lead us through the fog and let the light of truth grace this land once more. The truth is within reach. Time to push through the barrier, Endministrator!

a1m16d3_desc_005.cn: 在了解了与息壤龙泡泡升级相关的情况后，继续提交重息壤龙泡泡或息壤龙泡泡，获取援助成果券。
a1m16d3_desc_005.en: After learning of the Xiranite Chubby Lung upgrades, keep submitting Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lungs and Xiranite Chubby Lungs to earn Fruits of Altruism Certs.

a1m2_desc_001.cn: 终末地为派遣到四号谷地的干员准备了拓荒环境生存训练，寻找克拉拉教官，参加训练。
a1m2_desc_001.en: Endfield has prepared a Frontiers Survival Training for operators dispatched to Valley IV. Find Instructor Klara and participate in the training.

a1m2_desc_002.cn: 前往四号谷地，完成已解锁的拓荒环境生存训练。
a1m2_desc_002.en: Go to Valley IV and complete the Frontiers Survival Training that has been unlocked

a1m2_desc_003.cn: 前往四号谷地寻找克拉拉教官，完成终极训练。
a1m2_desc_003.en: Go to Valley IV, find Klara, and complete the ultimate training session.

a1m3_desc_001.cn: 工人之家的小女孩卡莉想要见管理员一面。前往工人之家，了解具体发生了什么。
a1m3_desc_001.en: A girl named Carly living in the Worker Dorms wants to meet the Endministrator. Go to the place and find out what is going on.

a1m3_desc_002.cn: 帮卡莉完成故事书后，和卡莉聊一聊。
a1m3_desc_002.en: You helped Carly complete her storybook and decided to have a chat with her.

a1m3_desc_003.cn: 卡莉想要画一本让大家开心的故事书。帮助她完成故事书。
a1m3_desc_003.en: Carly wants to draw a storybook that makes everyone happy. Help her complete the book.

a1m4_desc_001.cn: 前往枢纽区基地，与后勤干员赛尔乔·莱昂交谈。
a1m4_desc_001.en: Go to the Hub Base and talk to Logistics Operator Sergio Leon.

a1m4_desc_002.cn: 体验影拓丰碑，挑战大地的弃子中的任意关卡。
a1m4_desc_002.en: Experience the Umbral Monument and challenge any stage in Those Forsaken by the Land.

a1m5_desc_001.cn: 查看罗曼发来的消息，确认发生了什么事。
a1m5_desc_001.en: Read Roman's message to verify the situation.

a1m5_desc_002.cn: 罗曼发来了求助信息。前往生态种植区，向他了解具体情况。
a1m5_desc_002.en: Roman sent you a Baker toast for help. Go to the Eco-Farm and talk to him to learn about the situation.

a1m5_desc_003.cn: 罗曼想到了新的节日美食。前往生态种植区，向他了解具体情况。
a1m5_desc_003.en: Roman has some ideas about new holiday food. Go to the Eco-Farm and get the details from him.

a1m5_desc_004.cn: 罗曼有些话想和管理员说。前往生态种植区，与他交谈。
a1m5_desc_004.en: Roman has something to say to you. Go to the Eco-Farm and talk to him.

a1m6d1_desc_001.cn: 收到了陈千语的消息，查看并回复。
a1m6d1_desc_001.en: Read Chen Qianyu's message and give her a reply.

a1m6d1_desc_002.cn: 根据陈千语提供的定位信息，前往武陵居民区。
a1m6d1_desc_002.en: Follow Chen Qianyu's nav point and reach the Wuling City Residential Area.

a1m6d1_desc_003.cn: 使用射流无人机，清理污渍。
a1m6d1_desc_003.en: Use the jet drone to clean the stains.

a1m6d1_desc_004.cn: 居民区的污渍都清理完成了，与环卫职工老俞交谈。
a1m6d1_desc_004.en: Every stain in the Residential Area has been cleaned. Talk to Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu.

a1m6d2_desc_001.cn: 依照约定，前往生态实验站附近帮助环卫职工老俞。
a1m6d2_desc_001.en: Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to the Ecological Research Station as promised.

a1m6d2_desc_003.cn: 驮兽的清洁工作完成，与环卫职工老俞交谈。
a1m6d2_desc_003.en: Burdenbeast clean-up is complete. Talk to Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu.

a1m6d3_desc_001.cn: 依照约定，前往材料研究所附近帮助环卫职工老俞。
a1m6d3_desc_001.en: Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to the Institute of Materials Science as promised.

a1m6d3_desc_002.cn: 登上浮块，完成息壤堰的清洁工作。
a1m6d3_desc_002.en: Step on the levitating platform and clean up the Xiranite Dam.

a1m6d3_desc_003.cn: 息壤堰的清洁工作完成，但环卫职工老俞似乎有些心事。
a1m6d3_desc_003.en: You cleaned up the Xiranite Dam but Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu seems troubled.

a1m6d4_desc_001.cn: 依照约定，前往方兴衢附近帮助环卫职工老俞。
a1m6d4_desc_001.en: Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to Fangxing Avenue as promised.

a1m6d4_desc_002.cn: 将龙泡泡上的污渍清理干净。
a1m6d4_desc_002.en: Rinse and wash the stains off the Chubby Lungs.

a1m6d5_desc_001.cn: 环卫职工老俞发来消息，她需要管理员的帮助。
a1m6d5_desc_001.en: Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu toasted a message. She needs the Endministrator's support.

a1m6d5_desc_002.cn: 帮助环卫职工老俞，追踪可疑的脚印。
a1m6d5_desc_002.en: Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu track the mysterious footprints.

a1m6d5_desc_003.cn: 陪同环卫职工老俞寻找脚印的来源。
a1m6d5_desc_003.en: Keep Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu company and find out who made the footprints.

a1m6d5_desc_004.cn: 从老俞的孙子那里了解事情的真相。
a1m6d5_desc_004.en: Learn about the truth from Auntie Yu's grandkid Leilei

a1m6d5_desc_005.cn: 等待环卫职工老俞的后续消息。
a1m6d5_desc_005.en: Wait for Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu to contact you.

a1m6d6_desc_001.cn: 武陵城环卫管理员发来消息，对管理员这几天的协助表示了感谢，并邀请管理员参加清洁技能比拼赛。
a1m6d6_desc_001.en: Wuling City Sanitation Director has toasted the Endministrator. He thanks the Endmin for all the help provided during the past few days, and cordially invites the Endmin to take part in the Sanitation Technical Tournament.

a1m6d6_desc_002.cn: 等待武陵环卫体验日活动的后续消息。
a1m6d6_desc_002.en: Wait for messages from the Wuling Sanitation Open Day event.

a1m6d7_desc_001.cn: 前往材料研究所附近，继续参加清洁技能比拼赛。
a1m6d7_desc_001.en: Go to the Institute of Materials Science and keep taking part in the Sanitation Technical Tournament.

a1m7_desc_001.cn: 工人之家的卡莉随运输车队来到了武陵城，想要见管理员一面。前往方兴衢，了解具体发生了什么。
a1m7_desc_001.en: Carly from the Worker Dorms hitched a ride with a supply caravan and arrived at Wuling City. She wants to meet the Endmin. Go to Fangxing Avenue and find out what is going on.

a1m7_desc_002.cn: 卡莉想要画一本全新的故事书。帮助她完成故事书。
a1m7_desc_002.en: Carly wants to draw a new storybook. Help her complete it.

a1m7_desc_003.cn: 帮卡莉完成故事书后，和卡莉聊一聊。
a1m7_desc_003.en: You helped Carly complete her storybook and decide to have a chat with her.

a1m8d1_desc_001.cn: 管理员在天师府学院遇见了正在苦恼的彦宁，询问她发生了什么事。
a1m8d1_desc_001.en: The Endministrator encounters a troubled Yan Ning at the Tianshi Bureau Academy and asks if anything has happened.

a1m8d1_desc_002.cn: 管理员前去向彦宁询问目前息壤防护装置的情况。
a1m8d1_desc_002.en: The Endministrator goes to Yan Ning to ask her about the current status of the Xiranite-based protection device.

a1m8d2_desc_001.cn: 寨民们已经使用了一段时间的息壤葫芦，管理员决定前往清波寨，观察效果如何。
a1m8d2_desc_001.en: The Stockaders have used the Xiranite Gourds for a while. The Endministrator decides to visit Qingbo Stockade and observe the effectiveness of the devices.

a1m8d2_desc_002.cn: 等待寨民使用息壤葫芦一段时间后，再前往清波寨观察效果如何。
a1m8d2_desc_002.en: Wait for the Stockaders to use the Xiranite Gourds for a while, then visit Qingbo Stockade to assess user experience.

a1m8d3_desc_001.cn: 左顾言发消息称有寨民不见了，希望管理员前往清波寨查看情况，他随后就到。
a1m8d3_desc_001.en: Zuo Guyan toasts you on Baker and informs you that some Stockaders have disappeared. He hopes you can visit Qingbo Stockade and find out what happened, and mentions that he will be there shortly.

a1m8d3_desc_002.cn: 提交息壤玉葫芦或息壤葫芦，获取援助成果券。
a1m8d3_desc_002.en: Trade Xiranite Jade Gourds or Xiranite Gourds for Fruits of Altruism Certs.

a1m9_desc_001.cn: 武陵城似乎在准备举办一场厨艺爱好者竞赛，佩丽卡想和管理员商量与比赛相关的一些事情。与佩丽卡交谈，了解详情。
a1m9_desc_001.en: Wuling seems to be organizing a competition for culinary aficionados. Perlica wants to discuss competition matters with the Endministrator. Talk to her and get more details.

a1m9_desc_002.cn: 为了了解“武陵特厨”厨艺爱好者竞赛，管理员准备向赛事的组织者田悯了解比赛详情。
a1m9_desc_002.en: To get more details about the "Wuling Super Chef" competition for culinary aficionados, the Endministrator plans to talk to event organizer Tian Min.

a1m9_desc_003.cn: 管理员正在为决赛作品的选择而苦恼。
a1m9_desc_003.en: The Endministrator is struggling to choose a dish for the final round.

a1m9_desc_004.cn: 维尔莫林似乎有事找你。与维尔莫林交谈，了解详情。
a1m9_desc_004.en: Wellmorin seems intend to tell you something. Talk to him to learn more.

a1m9_desc_005.cn: 你决定参加“武陵特厨”比赛。与主持人交谈，了解赛事流程。
a1m9_desc_005.en: You decide to join the "Wuling Super Chef" cook-off. Talk to the Competition Host to learn how the event works.

a1m9_desc_006.cn: 提交作品，参加“武陵特厨”比赛。
a1m9_desc_006.en: Submit your dish and join the "Wuling Super Chef" cook-off.

a1m9_desc_007.cn: 准备罗德岛特制口粮，参加“武陵特厨”的决赛。
a1m9_desc_007.en: Prepare the Rhodes Island Special Ration and join the final round of "Wuling Super Chef".

activity_dung01_cdg012_toast_03.cn: 使用工业爆炸物击败所有敌人
activity_dung01_cdg012_toast_03.en: Defeat all enemies with Industrial Explosives

activity_permanent_instru.cn:
常驻活动玩法会永久开放，管理员可在任意时间参与。
部分常驻活动首次上线时，会伴随开启限时活动；限时活动结束后，对应限时奖励将无法获取，但该常驻活动玩法仍可正常参与。
activity_permanent_instru.en:
Permanent events are always available, Endministrator. You can take part in them at any time.
When some permanent events are released for the first time, they may be accompanied by limited-time events with rewards that will no longer become available when the limited-time events expire. However, you can still take part in the permanent events normally.

black_a1m16d1_1_001.cn: 你向陈千语说明了情况。
black_a1m16d1_1_001.en: You describe the situation to Chen Qianyu.

black_a1m16d3_1_001.cn: 左顾言将事情的来龙去脉告诉了彦宁……
black_a1m16d3_1_001.en: Zuo Guyan describes the entire incident to Yan Ning...

black_a1m6d2_3_001.cn: 冲洗干净的领头驮兽带领驮兽群离开了，除了一头……
black_a1m6d2_3_001.en: The clean burdenbeast bosses lead their herds away, except for one...

black_a1m6d3_1_001.en: The special machinery makes a few hums...

black_a1m6d4_1_001.cn: 你抬头望去，看到了满身污渍的龙泡泡……
black_a1m6d4_1_001.en: You raise your head and see the Chubby Lungs all covered in stains...

black_a1m8d1_1_001.cn: 你将图纸导入了终端，一会儿就完成了防护装置的迭代。
black_a1m8d1_1_001.en: You imported the blueprints into your handyterm and quickly finalized the upgrades for the protection device.

black_a1m8d1_2_002.cn: 在了无痕的帮助下，其余寨民将信将疑地拿走了一些息壤葫芦。
black_a1m8d1_2_002.en: With help from Liao the Scarless, the other Stockaders take a few Xiranite Gourds, though they remain doubtful.

black_a1m8d3_1_001.cn: 左顾言头也不回地冲进了清波寨，跑到了依旧尝试动员其他寨民的了无痕面前。
black_a1m8d3_1_001.en: Zuo Guyan runs into the Stockade and makes his way to Liao the Scarless who is still trying to rally the Fam.

black_a1m8d3_2_001.cn: 救出遇险的寨民后，众人回到了清波寨。
black_a1m8d3_2_001.en: The Stockaders are saved and everyone returns to the Qingbo Stockade.

black_a1m9_1_001.cn: 比赛如火如荼地进行着……
black_a1m9_1_001.en: The cook-off is hot and very competitive...

black_a1m9_1_002.cn: 你看见了似乎还活着的鳞、黑得无法分辨是何物的菜品……
black_a1m9_1_002.en: You notice fins that seem to be alive as well as food that has been charred beyond all recognition...

black_a1m9_2_001.cn: 其他参赛选手也陆续提交了自己的作品……
black_a1m9_2_001.en: One by one, the other participants also submit their dishes...

black_c13m2_1_001.cn: 一番挖掘后，你们找到了一页被撕碎的日记……
black_c13m2_1_001.en: You spend some time digging and find a torn page of a diary.

black_c17m3_1_001.cn: 与法比安等人告别后，你们回到最初涂鸦的地点……
black_c17m3_1_001.en: After bidding farewell to Fabian and the others, you return to the initial graffiti site...

black_c1m2_1_001.cn: 你与狼卫暂时分别，按计划抵达谷地通道。
black_c1m2_1_001.en: You and Wulfgard split your ways. You then make your way to Valley Pass according to plan.

black_c1m3_0d7_001.cn: 狼卫带着乔瓦尼离开了谷地通道。
black_c1m3_0d7_001.en: Wulfgard carries Giovanni out of the Valley Pass

black_c1m3_1_001.cn: 火堆中，火焰熊熊燃烧着，时而向天空中蹿起一两颗火星子。
black_c1m3_1_001.en: The pyre burns brightly, sending embers flying into the air.

black_c1m3_1_002.cn: 乔瓦尼衣物的一角布料从火堆里飞出来，落在脚边。
black_c1m3_1_002.en: A charred piece of Giovanni's clothing flew out of the pyre and rests by you feet.

black_c1m3_1_003.cn: 其余的部分也许都烧成灰了吧。
black_c1m3_1_003.en: The rest of the ex-Landbreaker is probably ash.

black_c27m3_1_001.en: After waiting around for a while...

black_c27m3_2_001.en: You support Tangtang and help her sit down and rest.

black_c27m4_2_001.cn: 裂地者带着一些寨民离开了，只留下洗浊一行人。
black_c27m4_2_001.en: The Landbreaker took off with a band of Stockaders, and left Dirt Rinser and his group.

black_c27m5_1_001.cn: 你给汤汤买了个龙泡泡气球。
black_c27m5_1_001.en: You buy a Chubby Lung balloon for Tangtang.

black_c27m5_2_001.cn: 畅谈许久后，汤汤心中生出很多想法……回清波寨的路上，你一直陪着她。
black_c27m5_2_001.en: The long talk gave Tangtang many ideas. You accompany her and make your way back to Qingbo Stockade.

black_c28m2_1_001.cn: “风铃公爵”取下了剑上的花环，递给哭泣的小男孩
black_c28m2_1_001.en: The "Duchess of Windbell" takes the floral wreath from the sword and gives it to the crying boy.

black_c31m1_1_001.cn: 你和弭弗为了准备比武而训练到了深夜……
black_c31m1_1_001.en: You and Mi Fu stay up late, training hard for the upcoming competition...

black_c31m1_3_001.cn: 一段时间前  总桩办公室
black_c31m1_3_001.en: A short while ago at the Main Pillar Office

black_c31m2_1_001.cn: 你和弭弗回到了昨日练武的地方。
black_c31m2_1_001.en: You and Mi Fu return to the place where you trained yesterday.

black_c31m2_4_001.cn: 你跟随这个人，来到居民区一角……
black_c31m2_4_001.en: You follow this person to a quiet corner of the Residential Area...

black_c31m2_5_001.cn: 你和弭弗为了准备与二师父的比武而展开切磋……
black_c31m2_5_001.en: You and Mi Fu engage in sparring sessions to prepare for the fight against Senior Master...

black_c31m2_6_001.cn: 第四日 登擂迎战大师父前
black_c31m2_6_001.en: Day four, before ascending the arena to fight the Grand Master

black_c33m1_1_001.cn: 你找到血液样本的物流负责人德鲁安……
black_c33m1_1_001.en: You locate Druan, the logistics supervisor in charge of the blood samples...

black_c33m1_2_001.cn: 预言，源自古老的萨卡兹巫术，贯穿了这一种族的历史……
black_c33m1_2_001.en: Prophecy, based on ancient Sarkazian witchcraft that permeates the entire history of this race...

black_c33m1_2_002.cn:
回顾过去，那些破碎的图景昭示的似乎总是灾难与厄运。
<@nar.right>——《萨卡兹与预言》</>
black_c33m1_2_002.en:
In retrospect, these shattered images seem to be portents of disasters and ill fortune.
<@nar.right> — The Sarkaz and Their Prophecies</>

black_c33m1_3_001.cn: 一段时间前  枢纽区基地
black_c33m1_3_001.en: A while ago at the Hub Base

black_c33m2_1_001.cn: 你安静地听着卡缪倾诉他看到的一切……
black_c33m2_1_001.en: You listen quietly as Camille shares everything he saw...

black_c33m2_1_002.cn: 查尔一直对某个“预言”深信不疑，认定兄弟二人注定彼此相残，直至一人存活。
black_c33m2_1_002.en: Char has an unshakeable belief in a "prophecy" that speaks of brothers fated to fight one another and leave only one standing.

black_c33m2_1_003.cn: 而现在，尽管查尔本人已然离开，那个预言与他的计划也仍在继续……
black_c33m2_1_003.en: Although Char himself has left the scene, the prophecy still holds and his plans will continue...

black_c33m2_2_001.cn: 五分钟后，卡缪赶了回来。

black_c33m2_4_001.cn:
而血海之后仍有新的血海，血与火的追逐永无止尽。
直至他们再会于下一个光暗交汇的时刻……
<@nar.right>——《萨卡兹与预言》</>
black_c33m2_4_001.en:
A new blood sea will emerge,
an endless chase of fire and carnage.
Till the hour they meet again,
the hour when light and dark mixes...
<@nar.right>— The Sarkaz and Their Prophecies</>

black_c33m2_5_001.cn:
一对兄弟在注定的分离之后，终将再会。
届时，血海会消弭一切……
<@nar.right>——《萨卡兹与预言》</>
black_c33m2_5_001.en:
Brothers destined to separate,
but reunion will be their fate.
Upon the moment dictated,
a blood sea shall wash it all away...
<@nar.right>— The Sarkaz and Their Prophecies</>

black_c34m1_3_001.cn: 管理员前行两步，镜头给到终末地的箱子
black_c34m1_3_001.en: The Endministrator takes a few steps forward. The view pans to an Endfield crate.

black_c34m1_8_001.cn: 女孩射出弓箭，符文连成线为众人指出道路，拦路的雾气也消散
black_c34m1_8_001.en: Typh fires the arrows. The runes align and points the way. The fog is also lifted.

black_c34m2_15_001.cn: 数次努力后，你顺利通过了此处。
black_c34m2_15_001.en: After multiple attempts, you successfully pass through this area.

black_c34m2_16_001.cn: 数次努力后，你们顺利通过了此处。
black_c34m2_16_001.en: After multiple attempts, you successfully pass through this area.

black_c34m3_1_001.cn: 你将发生的一切坦诚告知给安德烈。
black_c34m3_1_001.en: You tell Andre everything that happened, with honesty.

black_c35m1_1_001.cn: 之后，梨诺非常耐心地听完了格蕾丝想对她倾诉的话。
black_c35m1_1_001.en: Liino listens with immense patience to everything Grace wanted to tell her.

black_c35m1_2_001.cn: 梨诺认真地向你描述了一个听上去似乎有点冒险的“宏大演出计划”。
black_c35m1_2_001.en: Liino lays out her grand performance plan for you. It sounds a little risky.

black_c35m2_1_001.cn: 你与梨诺将起飞点的情况与需要的高度告知了安德烈。
black_c35m2_1_001.en: You and Liino tell Andre the specifics of the launch site and the altitude targets required for the concert.

black_c35m2_3_001.cn: 梨诺启动装甲在半空飞行了一圈之后，回到原地。
black_c35m2_3_001.en: Liino fires up the boosters, carving a wide arc through the air before banking back to where she started.

black_c35m3_1_001.cn: 梨诺的行踪差点暴露，你们不得不返回安全位置。
black_c35m3_1_001.en: Liino almost got spotted. You had to return to a safe spot.

black_c35m3_2_001.cn: 梨诺不知从哪里变出了一颗星形糖果，放在了少年的手上。
black_c35m3_2_001.en: Liino pulls out a star-shaped candy out of nowhere, gently placing it in the boy's hand.

black_c35m3_3_001.cn: 一段时间后，你们抵达了矿区营地。此时已是傍晚，夜幕悄然降临……
black_c35m3_3_001.en: It took you a while to arrive at the Mining Camp. The sun has already set and night has descended...

black_c35m4_1_001.cn: 一段时间后，梨诺调整好了助推器。
black_c35m4_1_001.en: Some time later, Liino finishes adjusting the booster.

black_c6m1_2_001.cn: 之后，你与狼卫一同跟随乔万尼前往谷地通道。
black_c6m1_2_001.en: After that, you and Wulfgard follow Giovanni to the Valley Pass.

black_c6m1_4_001.cn: 狼卫带着乔万尼的尸首离开了谷地通道。
black_c6m1_4_001.en: Wulfgard carries Giovanni's body out of the Valley Pass.

black_e10m3_1_001.en: Prior to this, outside the clinic...

black_e10m3_2_001.cn: 慰问过所有伤员后，庄方宜郑重与众人道别。
black_e10m3_2_001.en: After visiting the injured, a somber Zhuang Fangyi bids everyone farewell.

black_e10m4_1_001.cn:
“就算是被侵蚀重创的土地，也终会有梨花遍地盛开。
你愿意相信吗？”
black_e10m4_1_001.en:
"Pear trees will blossom, even upon the most Blighted lands.
Will you have faith in this vision?"

black_e11m1_2_001.cn: 仪式不能被打断。重整旗鼓。
black_e11m1_2_001.en: The ritual cannot be stopped. The expedition must be rallied.

black_e11m2_4_001.cn: 大潘抓起坛子，饮尽了坛中之物。
black_e11m2_4_001.en: Da Pan takes the cask and drinks all the kohl.

black_e11m3_11_001.cn: 一番鏖战后，决因为伤势未愈，明显表现出体力不支
black_e11m3_11_001.en: After an intense battle, Arcane is visibly exhausted due to her lingering injuries.

black_e11m3_1_001.cn: 诀的伤势有些复发，她停下来，喘息了片刻
black_e11m3_1_001.en: Arcane's injuries seem to be getting worse. She stops to catch her breath.

black_e11m3_23_001.cn: 一段时间后，庄方宜携天师队伍抵达，开始搭建前哨站……
black_e11m3_23_001.en: After a while, Zhuang Fangyi arrives with the Tianshi convoy and begins building the Sentry Base...

black_e11m4_1_001.cn: 一段时间后，庄方宜携天师队伍抵达，开始搭建前哨站……
black_e11m4_1_001.en: After a while, Zhuang Fangyi arrives with the Tianshi convoy and begins building the Sentry Base...

black_e11m7_1_001.cn: 临时画面描述：镜头扫过众人，而管理员驻足，在高处眺望
black_e11m7_1_001.en: SCENE: Pans over the crowd. The Endmin stops and gazes from the vantage point.

black_e11m7_1_002.cn: 临时画面描述：沟壑中不再有瘴气，沿途武陵人搭建的前哨在暮色下熠熠生辉。
black_e11m7_1_002.en: SCENE: The Miasma is gone from the gorge. The Sentry Bases built by the Wulingers glitter in the sunset.

black_e1m5_1_001.cn: 佩丽卡为阿吉注射了矿石病抑制剂。
black_e1m5_1_001.en: Perlica gives Ginny a dose of Oripathy suppressants.

black_e1m8_1_001.cn: 道路被完全破坏，众人只能返回枢纽区基地商议对策。
black_e1m8_1_001.en: The road is completely out. The team has no choice but to return to the Hub Base and find a solution.

black_e4m1d5_1_001.cn: 为了维系生命的存续，你已经付出了所有。
black_e4m1d5_1_001.en: You gave everything to ensure the survival of life.

black_e4m1d5_1_002.cn: 当一切不再拥有退路，你把希望埋进了“零号委托”。
black_e4m1d5_1_002.en: With all retreat cut off, you placed your hope in the Zeroth Directive.

black_e4m2_1_001.cn: 一阵运转后，石棺开启，你重新躺进石棺。
black_e4m2_1_001.en: The Sarcophagus is activated to the humming of machines. You lay yourself within it.

black_e5m2_1_001.cn: 你们向佩丽卡解释了陈千语的“锦囊妙计”……
black_e5m2_1_001.en: You explain Chen's "brilliant plan" to Perlica

black_e7m1_1_001.en: You arrive at the Monitoring Center.

black_e7m1_2_001.en: You arrive at the Field Logistics Depot...

black_e7m1_3_001.cn: 已经过去了一段时间，但此前回内寨处理事务的汤汤却一直没有联系你们……
black_e7m1_3_001.en: A while passed after Tangtang returned to her fort to handle things, but she still has not called you.

black_e7m2_1_001.cn: 弭弗触碰了一个极为隐秘的开关，暗门缓缓打开。
black_e7m2_1_001.en: Mi Fu touches a very well-hidden mechanism. The secret door slowly opens.

black_e7m2_2_001.cn: 你们放出了所有被关着的寨民……
black_e7m2_2_001.en: You free all of the imprisoned Stockaders...

black_e7m3_1_001.cn: 汤汤找了一处安全的地方，妥善安置好了这个可怜的人……
black_e7m3_1_001.en: Tangtang finds a secure place for Waterbell to lie down safely and rest...

black_e7m3_1_002.cn: 陈千语一剑劈开了水桶……
black_e7m3_1_002.en: Chen splits the barrel open with a slash...

black_e7m3_1_003.cn: 你破坏了笼子，放他出来……
black_e7m3_1_003.en: You broke the lock and opened the cage...

black_e7m4_1_001.cn: 你们给汤汤留下了独处的空间……
black_e7m4_1_001.en: You left Tangtang alone for a while...

black_e8m5_1_001.cn: 你目睹了巨兽心脏被阿达希尔摧毁……
black_e8m5_1_001.en: You witness how Ardashir destroyed the Feranmut Heart...

black_e9m2_1_001.cn: 一段时间后，你们成功跨越了障碍，离需要修复的天师桩更近了一步……
black_e9m2_1_001.en: A while passes. You overcome the obstacles and arrive closer to the Tianshi Pillar that needs repairs.

black_e9m4_1_001.cn: 城内的善后工作持续了整整三天……
black_e9m4_1_001.en: The post-battle cleanup in the city lasted a full three days...

black_e9m4_2_001.cn: 尘埃落定，城内逐渐恢复了宁静……
black_e9m4_2_001.en: The dust has settled. Peace gradually returns to the city...

black_f1m18_1_001.cn: 武陵联合科考基地完成了基础设施升级，建设工作迈入新的阶段。
black_f1m18_1_001.en: Basic amenities for the Wuling Science Station are complete. Outpost construction has reached a new phase.

black_f1m18_2_001.cn: 联盟工团的增援顺利进驻科考基地，研究准备工作得到了进一步完善。
black_f1m18_2_001.en: UWST support has arrived at the Science Station. The outpost is now better prepared for research work.

black_f1m18_3_001.cn: 武陵联合科考基地确立了首要研究方向。
black_f1m18_3_001.en: The Wuling Science Station has chosen their first research project.

black_f1m18_3_002.cn: 研究与实践的结合终将带来切实的温暖与关怀。
black_f1m18_3_002.en: Research that focuses on actual needs will bring about true warmth and prosperity.

black_f1m29d3_3_001.cn: 你们抓住时机，身形如飞，逮住了数只羽兽。
black_f1m29d3_3_001.en: You find your chance. By using your agility and skills, you manage to catch a few fowlbeasts.

black_f1m29d3_4_001.cn: 卫西东将准备好的小型记录仪装在了羽兽身上。
black_f1m29d3_4_001.en: Wei Xidong attaches the miniature flight recorders he has prepared to the fowlbeasts.

black_f1m29d4_1_001.cn: 你们观察到，候羽针一直在指向某个方向……
black_f1m29d4_1_001.en: You notice that the Migratory Fowl Rod has been pointing at a certain direction...

black_f1m29d4_3_001.cn: 天师们将最后的注能组件装到盈天台上……
black_f1m29d4_3_001.en: A team of Tianshi begins to work. They install the last energy injector onto the Xiranflow Cloudseeder...

black_f1m32_2_001.cn: 将之前发生的事告诉了诀。

black_f1m32_3_001.cn: 诀向你们郑重点头示意，随后转身离开。
black_f1m32_3_001.en: Arcane gives you a solemn nod before turning around and leaving.

black_f1m4_1_001.cn: 居民们顺利挺过了难关，定居地得以继续发展。
black_f1m4_1_001.en: The residents have successfully survived the challenge and the outpost continues to grow.

black_f1m4_2_001.cn: 谷地难民定居地顺利完成了升级建设，生产活动得到进一步保障。
black_f1m4_2_001.en: The Valley Pass Camp has successfully completed its upgrades. Production activities and services have been guaranteed.

black_f1m4_3_001.cn: 谷地难民定居地的建设迈入了新篇章。希望与未来开始在此萌芽。
black_f1m4_3_001.en: Development of the Valley Pass Camp has entered a new phase. The seeds for a better future have been planted and everyone is hopeful.

black_f1m7_1_001.cn: 工人们得到了妥善的医疗照顾，高地灾后恢复前哨得以顺利发展。
black_f1m7_1_001.en: The crew is now getting proper medical care. The Plateau Relief Outpost can continue to grow.

black_f1m7_2_001.cn: 工人们获得了更多灾害防护手段，前哨的建设与探索工作得以及时恢复。
black_f1m7_2_001.en: The UWST crew now has better protection against Blight hazards. Outpost construction and area surveillance activities have been restored quickly.

black_f1m7_3_001.cn: 工人们重新在供能高地站稳了脚跟。天灾人祸过后，四号谷地再一次开始呼吸。
black_f1m7_3_001.en: The crew successfully made their stand at the Power Plateau. Post-disaster relief efforts conducted by this outpost shall revitalize Valley IV.

black_f1m9d2_1_001.cn: 你们将所有伤员运回了基建前站。
black_f1m9d2_1_001.en: You moved all the injured back to the Infra-Station.

black_f1m9d4_1_001.cn: 之后，众人一同返回了基建前站。
black_f1m9d4_1_001.en: Your group returns to the Infra-Station afterwards.

black_gm01m1_1_001.en: Vallia follows you into the BPPP.

black_gm01m1_2_001.en: You spend quite some time on this.

black_gm01m1_3_001.cn: 一个工人从角落里爬了出来。
black_gm01m1_3_001.en: A crew mate crawls out from a dark corner.

black_gm01m6_1_001.cn: 你们一起修好了伸缩桥。
black_gm01m6_1_001.en: You and Hermann successfully repaired the collapsible bridge.

black_gm02m11_1_001.cn: 陆欣关闭了检修模式，收起了供能池周边的排水闸。
black_gm02m11_1_001.en: Lu Xin exited repair mode and disabled the sluice gates around the energy reservoir.

black_gm02m14_1_001.cn: 你替安虞解释了前因后果。
black_gm02m14_1_001.en: You help An Yu explain the situation.

black_gm02m20_1_001.cn: 一段时间后，依然没有任何读数异常的蚀影出现。
black_gm02m20_1_001.en: You wait for a while, but no Blightshades giving off abnormal readings have appeared.

black_gm02m21_1_001.cn: 泠闻言，提起蜷缩在一起的源石虫，详细地检查了一番……
black_gm02m21_1_001.en: After listening to the story, Frigid picks up the retracted Originium Slug and studies it closely...

black_gm02m23_1_001.cn: 一段时间后，你抵达了三号数据备份附近的位置。
black_gm02m23_1_001.en: After a while, you arrive near the location of data backup 3.

black_gm02m23_2_001.cn: 一段时间后，洛鞍在你的协助下成功将三个数据的备份统合为一份。
black_gm02m23_2_001.en: With your help and a bit of time, Luo An successfully compiles the 3 data backups into a single complete file.

black_gm02m23_3_001.cn: 一段时间后，你抵达了三号数据备份附近的位置。
black_gm02m23_3_001.en: After a while, you arrive near the location of data backup 3.

black_gm02m23_4_001.en: You return along the same path you took.

black_gm02m6_1_001.cn: 对方有些惊魂未定，颤颤巍巍地站了起来……
black_gm02m6_1_001.en: Still visibly shaken, he rises to his feet unsteadily.

black_map02_lv003_env_1_001.cn: 你破坏了笼子，放他出来……
black_map02_lv003_env_1_001.en: You broke the lock and opened the cage...

black_map02_lv003liuhan_1_001.cn: 你们将刘瀚妥善安葬到了别处……
black_map02_lv003liuhan_1_001.en: You lay Liu Han to rest at a fitting place...

black_map02_lv005_12001_001.cn: 随着三个丙型天师桩亮起，中央的主桩也由红转绿
black_map02_lv005_12001_001.en: The 3 Type-C Tianshi Pillars are lit. The central main pillar turns from red to green.

black_map02_lv005_12002_001.cn: 佩丽卡发现原本绿色的主桩又重新变成了红色故障状态
black_map02_lv005_12002_001.en: Perlica notices that the green main pillar has reverted to its red and malfunctioning state

black_map02_lv005_12003_001.en: The terrace farm modules rise one after another

black_map02_lv005_12004_001.en: The entire orchard of peach trees burst in full bloom

black_map02_lv005_12004_002.cn: 主桩与子桩产生了能量上的呼应
black_map02_lv005_12004_002.en: An energy link has been created between the main pillar and auxiliary pillar

black_map02_lv005_12004_003.cn: 机芯化作能量回归主桩根系，控制台下降
black_map02_lv005_12004_003.en: The core turned into energy, returned to the main pillar's roots, and brought the control panel down

black_sm1l1m10_1_001.cn: 希茜反复调试了脉冲发射器。

black_sm1l1m1_1_001.cn: 你联系上了菲奥娜，向她简单说明了现场的情况。
black_sm1l1m1_1_001.en: You call Fiona and explain the situation.

black_sm1l1m1_1_002.cn: 你耗费了一些时间，终于将找到的物资全部收集完毕。
black_sm1l1m1_1_002.en: You spend some time and recover all of the lost supplies.

black_sm1l1m2_1_001.cn: 伴随机关启动的声音，沉重的石门轰然打开。
black_sm1l1m2_1_001.en: The mechanisms spring into life as the heavy stone door slowly opens.

black_sm1l1m2_2_001.cn: 你破坏了门锁，将乔斯特从笼子里救了出来。
black_sm1l1m2_2_001.en: You smash the lock and free Jouster from the cage.

black_sm1l1m2_3_001.cn: 耗费了一些时间，终于将得到的物资全部收集完毕。
black_sm1l1m2_3_001.en: You spend some time and recover all of the lost supplies.

black_sm1l1m8_1_001.cn: 经过一番时间，成功排除了所有风险。
black_sm1l1m8_1_001.en: The team works for a while and successfully eliminates the threat.

black_sm1l2m1_1_001.cn: 佩丽卡和陈千语在谷地通道入口与你会合。
black_sm1l2m1_1_001.en: Perlica and Chen Qianyu meet you at the entrance of Valley Pass.

black_sm1l2m2_0d5_001.cn: 你们脊背一凉，听见身后传来一阵响动……
black_sm1l2m2_0d5_001.en: You feel a shiver up your spines as you hear riotous howlings coming from behind you...

black_sm1l2m2_1_001.cn: 裂地者头目应声倒地。就在这时，弧光那边传来了好消息。
black_sm1l2m2_1_001.en: The Landbreaker chief collapses. You then receive some good news from Arclight.

black_sm1l2m2_1_002.cn: 热能刀将铁丝网熔开，受困的人们重获自由，一举冲出。
black_sm1l2m2_1_002.en: The thermal lance successfully cuts through the metal fence and frees those who have been trapped inside the cage.

black_sm1l2m2_2_001.cn: 刺眼的阳光和清新的空气，阻隔了地牢的陈腐气味。
black_sm1l2m2_2_001.en: The bright sunlight and fresh air purged the dank smells of the LB lair.

black_sm1l2m2_3_001.cn: 把米娅平安地送回了暂居处，你们远远看见一个焦急的男子赶了过来。
black_sm1l2m2_3_001.en: You escort Mia safely back to the camp and see a distressed-looking figure in the distance.

black_sm1l2m4_0d2_001.cn: 伴随巢雕雾气对视觉的影响，你的眼前再次出现了那些图案……
black_sm1l2m4_0d2_001.en: The denstack haze changes your vision. Once again you see those strange glyphs...

black_sm1l2m4_0d6_001.cn: 在一番挖掘后，你找到了一张放在瓶中的纸条。
black_sm1l2m4_0d6_001.en: You dig around and find a note hidden in a bottle.

black_sm1l2m4_1_001.cn: 轰隆的声音响起，大门打开了。
black_sm1l2m4_1_001.en: The gate opens with loud rumbling.

black_sm1l2m4_2_001.cn: 在一番挖掘后，你找到了一个装满物资的箱子。
black_sm1l2m4_2_001.en: You spend some time digging and find a crate filled with supplies.

black_sm1l3m2_3_001.cn: 将事情经过告知了佩妮。

black_sm1l3m2_4_001.cn: 几个眨眼的工夫，佩妮已经借助手上的攀爬工具爬到了高处。
black_sm1l3m2_4_001.en: Penny uses her climbing tools and reaches the top in an astonishing speed.

black_sm1l3m2_5_001.cn: 你将佩妮的情况告知拉蒙，并向他讲解了佩妮教给自己的方法。
black_sm1l3m2_5_001.en: You tell Ramon about Penny's situation and the solution she taught you.

black_sm1l3m3_1_001.cn: 你们向菲莉丝讲述了来到此地的整个过程。
black_sm1l3m3_1_001.en: You tell Phyllis about your SAR mission thus far in the Aburrey Quarry.

black_sm1l5m1_1_001.cn: 接到通讯后，艾莱扎·柯林斯连忙赶到了现场。
black_sm1l5m1_1_001.en: Aleeza Collins rushes to the site after receiving the message.

black_sm1l5m2_1_001.cn: 你和艾维文娜一同将拉奎尔从裂地者的牢笼中救出。
black_sm1l5m2_1_001.en: Together, Avywenna and you help Raquel escape the Landbreaker cage.

black_sm1l5m3_1_001.cn: 经过一段时间的工作，基建前站的建设有了很大的进展。
black_sm1l5m3_1_001.en: The crew mates work for a while, making tremendous progress in building the Infra-Station.

black_sm1l5m3_2_001.cn: 大潘做了丰盛的饭菜，诺夫曼和工人们纷纷前来。
black_sm1l5m3_2_001.en: Da Pan prepares a feast. Noffman and the crew rush over for food.

black_sm1l6m1_1_001.cn: 你们帮助越医生把莉莉卡送到病床上。
black_sm1l6m1_1_001.en: You help Surgeon Yue move Lilica to her bed

black_sm1l6m2_1_001.cn: 裂地者砸坏了装满药物的箱子。
black_sm1l6m2_1_001.en: The Landbreaker smashes the crate filled with the medication.

black_sm1l6m3_0d5_001.cn: 之后，越医生给詹娜注射了配好的药剂。
black_sm1l6m3_0d5_001.en: Yue administers some medicine to Jenner.

black_sm1l6m3_2_001.cn: 你和阿丽娅将厨师带到一边，悄声向他解释了詹娜现在的情况。
black_sm1l6m3_2_001.en: Endmin and Alia take the Chef aside and quietly explain Jenner's current situation.

black_sm1l6m3_3_001.cn: 你将詹娜描述的流程记了下来，然后把它交给了厨师。
black_sm1l6m3_3_001.en: You jot down what Jenner says, and hand it over to the chef.

black_sm1l6m3_4_001.cn: 你向马特维解释了詹娜的情况。
black_sm1l6m3_4_001.en: You explain Jenner's situation to Matvei.

black_sm1l6m4_1_001.cn: 詹娜像往常一样为源石树苗浇了水，阿丽娅也像往常一样送她回了家。次日……
black_sm1l6m4_1_001.en: Jenner tended to the Originium sapling as usual, and Alia walked her home like always. The next day...

black_sm1l7m2_1_001.cn: 你将自己的所见所闻告诉了小女孩。
black_sm1l7m2_1_001.en: You tell the little girl about what you've seen.

black_sm1l7m2_2_001.cn: 你将自己的所见所闻告诉了技术员。
black_sm1l7m2_2_001.en: You tell the technician about what you've seen.

black_sm1l7m2_3_001.cn: 你将自己的所见所闻告诉了技术专家。
black_sm1l7m2_3_001.en: You tell the tech expert about what you've seen.

black_sm2l1m1_1_002.cn: 度渡接过材料，三下五除二地修好了竹筏。
black_sm2l1m1_1_002.en: Dudu takes the materials and quickly fixes the raft.

black_sm2l1m1_1_003.cn: 一番忙碌后，你们救起了受伤的人。
black_sm2l1m1_1_003.en: You manage to save the injured person after putting some work into it.

black_sm2l1m5_1_001.cn: 你们打开笼门，长耳兽重获自由，飞快地跑掉了……
black_sm2l1m5_1_001.en: You open the cage and free the long-ear. She quickly runs away...

black_sm2l1m5_2_001.cn: 阿土慷慨地展示了锦草的烹饪方法，技惊四座。
black_sm2l1m5_2_001.en: Ah Tu demonstrates how to cook jincao, her skill leaving everyone impressed.

black_sm2l1m5_3_001.cn: 笼门打开的一瞬间，小吴往寨民脸上一人蹬了一脚，飞速逃脱了……
black_sm2l1m5_3_001.en: The cage opens. Woolsey leaps onto the stockade residents', kicks them, and then runs away in a flash...

black_sm2l1m5_3_002.cn: 阿土后退两步，待你回头时已经逃走了。
black_sm2l1m5_3_002.en: Ah Tu back off two steps. She already ran away when you turned around.

black_sm2l2m2_1_002.cn: 一番寻找后，你们挖到了竹林虫笋。
black_sm2l2m2_1_002.en: You search around and successfully acquire some grove nymphsprouts.

black_sm2l2m4_1_001.cn: 老人一动不动，枯稿的手臂垂着，那瘦弱的手腕甚至无法想象能够挥动鞭子。
black_sm2l2m4_1_001.en: The old man is unmoving. His withered arms hang limp on his sides. How did he wield the whip? Nobody knows.

black_sm2l2m4_2_001.cn: 老人紧闭的双眼，不再有“火光”闪烁。他不会再醒来了。
black_sm2l2m4_2_001.en: The old man's eyes are tightly shut and no longer flicker with his fire. He will never wake up again.

black_sm2l2m6_1_001.cn: 你们把找到的线索交给了弭弗……
black_sm2l2m6_1_001.en: You give the investigation clues to Mi Fu...

black_sm2l2m7_1_001.cn: 你们大快朵颐，比赛接近尾声……
black_sm2l2m7_1_001.en: After you enjoyed your noodles, the competition nears its end...

black_sm2l3m1_1_001.cn: 你们将阮一之死的前后经过告知了杜鸣。
black_sm2l3m1_1_001.en: You tell Du Ming the events leading up to Ruan Yi's death and what happened afterwards.

black_sm2l3m1_2_001.en: Free the youth in the cage.

black_sm2l3m2_1_001.cn: 在佩丽卡的协助下，你顺利关停装置，同时用源石技艺将其完全封死。
black_sm2l3m2_1_001.en: With Perlica's assistance, you successfully shutdown the machine and completely seal it up with Originium Arts.

black_sm2l3m2_1_002.cn: 之后，你们与杜鸣一同离开了泉源。
black_sm2l3m2_1_002.en: You and Du Ming leave the source of the spring together.

black_sm2l3m2_1_003.en: You give chase for quite a while...

black_sm2l3m2_1_004.cn: 你们将救下杜鸣并送他去祖泉的前因后果，告诉了汤汤。
black_sm2l3m2_1_004.en: You tell Tangtang about how you freed Du Ming, escorted him to the Ancestral Spring, and then lost track of him.

black_sm2l3m4_1_001.cn: 佩丽卡还没来得及解释，玛蒂娜就从牢笼里冲了出来。
black_sm2l3m4_1_001.en: Martina rushes out of the cage before Perlica could explain.

black_sm2l3m5_1_001.cn: 长杆头戴着眼罩，就这样在竹床上睡了过去……
black_sm2l3m5_1_001.en: Punty Pole wears his eye mask, then falls asleep on his bamboo bed...

black_sm2l4m1_1_002.cn: 你们离开城区医疗点，迎面遇见了找过来的弭弗……
black_sm2l4m1_1_002.en: You leave the City Medical Clinic, and then run into Mi Fu who came looking for you...

black_sm2l4m1_1_003.cn: 你们向铁锚子讲述了前来此地调查的原因。
black_sm2l4m1_1_003.en: You tell Iron Boatswain about the story behind your ongoing investigation at this site.

black_sm2l4m1_1_004.cn: 陈千语作势打出剑气，一个人慌忙从阴影中走出——
black_sm2l4m1_1_004.en: Chen feints a powerful Sword-Chi attack. Someone panics and steps out of their hiding spot —

black_sm2l4m1_2_001.cn: 铁锚子低头走来，手里捧着一只眼罩。
black_sm2l4m1_2_001.en: Iron Boatswain enters the scene with a bowed head with an eye patch in his hand.

black_sm2l4m1_3_001.cn: 片刻后，弭弗赶来。你们向弭弗分享了调查结果。
black_sm2l4m1_3_001.en: Mi Fu rushes into the scene and you share your investigative findings with her.

black_sm2l4m2_1_001.cn: 你们轻轻移动眼前的息壤块，看见一件衣服……
black_sm2l4m2_1_001.en: You gently move the Xiranite block you see and reveal a set of clothing...

black_sm2l4m2_2_001.cn: 片刻后，你们抵达了城区医疗点。苏醒过来的贾班面带愁容……
black_sm2l4m2_2_001.en: You walk a bit and arrive at the City Medical Clinic. Jia Ban is awake, but his face looks sad...

black_sm2l4m3_1_001.cn: 不久后，追悼仪式开始，你们在永垂壁前放上了鲜花。
black_sm2l4m3_1_001.en: The memorial service soon begins. You place some fresh flowers next to Eternal Wall.

black_sm2l4m5_3_001.cn: 墨魉飞回通道又再次飞出，几次后消失了。
black_sm2l4m5_3_001.en: The Ink Spirit flutters in and out of the passageway repeatedly before disappearing.

black_sm2l4m6_1_001.cn: 你将峰的经历悉数告知奚墨。
black_sm2l4m6_1_001.en: You tell Xi Mo about Summit's story and experiences.

black_sm2l4m6_3_001.cn: 你靠近“蟠兽”，它跳下柱子，亲昵地回应你的呼唤。
black_sm2l4m6_3_001.en: You approach the "pantailbeast". It jumps off the pillar and amiably responds to your call.

black_sm2l4m6_4_001.cn: “蟠兽”化作水墨，飞回了画卷之中。
black_sm2l4m6_4_001.en: The "pantailbeast" becomes a splash of ink and flies back into the scroll.

black_sm2l4m6_6_001.cn: “蟠兽”化作水墨，飞回了画卷之中。
black_sm2l4m6_6_001.en: The "pantailbeast" becomes a splash of ink and flies back into the scroll.

black_sm2l4m6_8_001.cn: 你们三人将所有“蟠兽”送回了画卷。
black_sm2l4m6_8_001.en: The three of you send all the "pantailbeasts" back into the scroll.

black_sm2l5m1_1_001.cn: 随后，巡卫将园区附近的围栏都撤走了。
black_sm2l5m1_1_001.en: The watchguard then removes the fences around the Test Area.

black_sm2l5m3_1_001.cn: 陆令香在这里找到了前辈们留下的大量研究资料与设计图纸。
black_sm2l5m3_1_001.en: Lu finds a large collection of research materials and design blueprints left behind by her seniors here

black_sm2l6m1_3_001.cn: 你们将在此处的发现告诉大家，并带他们领略了这座人文艺术的宝库。
black_sm2l6m1_3_001.en: You tell everyone about the discovery, and show them the vault of fine arts.

black_sm2l6m1_4_001.cn: 一番闪转腾挪之后，你们一行顺利通过。
black_sm2l6m1_4_001.en: After some maneuvering, you successfully pass through.

black_sm2l7m1_1_001.cn: 蓝衫将自己携带的那一支鼓棒交给了轻竹，确认是一对后，轻竹收下了鼓棒。
black_sm2l7m1_1_001.en: A closer inspection reveals that the two drumsticks came from the same pair. Qingzhu accepts Lan's drumstick.

black_sm2l7m1_2_001.cn: 你们将乐器摊开在了沈海面前，沈海拿起了其中的一把二胡。
black_sm2l7m1_2_001.en: You lay out the instruments before Shen Hai. The chef picks up an erhu.

black_sm2l7m1_3_001.cn: 你们将乐器摊开在了李良良面前，李良良拿起了其中的一面铜锣。
black_sm2l7m1_3_001.en: You lay out the instruments before Li Liangliang. The watchguard picks up a cuprium gong.

black_sm2l8m1_2_001.en: Everyone spends quite a while in the search...

black_sm2l8m1_3_001.cn: 你们听连晓雾讲述了许久，从她和故友们的相识，直到十年前的离别。
black_sm2l8m1_3_001.en: Lian Xiaowu talks about the friends she made over the years until the disaster took them away.

black_sm2l8m1_4_001.en: Lifeng busies himself for a while.

black_sm2l9m1_1_001.cn: 提弗洛斯和你来到大石碑附近。
black_sm2l9m1_1_001.en: Typhoeus and you arrive at the big stone stele.

black_sm2l9m1_5_001.cn: 一张纸落到提弗洛斯手上。
black_sm2l9m1_5_001.en: A piece of paper falls into Typhoeus's hand.

black_sm2l9m1_6_001.cn: 突然间雾气弥漫，你和提弗洛斯被送到了新的地方。
black_sm2l9m1_6_001.en: The fog suddenly thickens. Both you and Typhoeus find yourselves in a new place.

block_quest_login_days.en: Log in after {0} day(s) to progress mission

block_quest_max_level.cn: 需管理员权限等阶达到{0}级

block_quest_toast.cn: 后续任务暂未解锁，可前往任务界面查看详情
block_quest_toast.en: Subsequent missions not yet unlocked. Go to the mission screen for details.

c13m1_desc_001.cn: 正在枢纽区基地帮忙的洁尔佩塔发来讯息，她希望管理员能帮她一个小忙。答应了请求的管理员决定前去赴约。
c13m1_desc_001.en: Having largely recovered, Gilberta sends you a message asking if you can help her out with something small. You agree to help and meet her at the appointed location.

c13m2_desc_001.cn: 得知小女孩卡莉不见了，管理员与洁尔佩塔决定一同将她找回。
c13m2_desc_001.en: You learn that a little girl named Carly has gone missing. Gilberta and you decide to find her.

c13m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员与洁尔佩塔决定帮助安德烈寻找关于过滤装置的线索。
c13m2_desc_002.en: You and Gilberta decide to help Andre locate the water purifier prototype.

c13m3_desc_001.cn: 成功取得锁有过滤装置的保险柜之后，管理员与洁尔佩塔决定将这件事告诉工团在此处的负责人。
c13m3_desc_001.en: You and Gilberta successfully retrieve the safe with the filter locked within it. You decide to inform the UWST site monitor of your finding.

c16m1_desc_001.cn: 在发生了这么多事情之后，佩丽卡希望管理员能够回一趟帝江号的静滞核心，确认记忆是否有所恢复。
c16m1_desc_001.en: Following recent events, Perlica invites you to return to Dijiang's Stasis Core to assess memory recovery progress.

c16m1_desc_002.cn: 管理员在神秘痕迹的引导下，来到了一片陌生的冰原。跟随红发萨卡兹少女，走出此地。
c16m1_desc_002.en: Following mysterious traces, you reach an uncharted icefield. Follow the crimson-haired Sarkaz girl to find a way out.

c16m2_desc_001.cn: 管理员在协议空间中遇到的红发萨卡兹少女似乎并不简单。根据线索，前往四号谷地，寻找她的踪迹。
c16m2_desc_001.en: That red-haired Sarkaz girl you met in the Protocol Space isn't ordinary. Follow the clues to Valley IV and track her down.

c16m3_desc_001.cn: 那位红发萨卡兹少女就是与罗德岛失联已久的再旅者莱万汀。管理员决定再度进入协议空间，找到莱万汀并探寻自己的记忆。
c16m3_desc_001.en: That red-haired Sarkaz girl is Laevatain, Rhodes Island's long-missing reconvener. You decide to re-enter the Protocol Space to find her and recover what was lost.

c16m3_desc_002.cn: 要利用协议奇点，准确进入莱万汀所在的协议空间，需要更多与她直接相关的源石反应参数。管理员决定前往枢纽区基地，调查她可能活动过的地方，以搜集足够的信息。
c16m3_desc_002.en: To leverage the Protocol Singularity and accurately enter the Protocol Space where Laevatain is, more direct Originium reaction parameters linked to her are required. You decide to proceed to the Hub Base and investigate areas where she may have been active, in order to gather sufficient data.

c16m4_desc_001.cn: 获得所需的信息之后，管理员准备返回帝江号的静滞核心，再度利用协议奇点进入协议空间，寻找莱万汀。
c16m4_desc_001.en: After obtaining the necessary information, you decide to return to the Stasis Core of Dijiang to once again utilize the Protocol Singularity and enter the Protocol Space in search of Laevatain.

c16m4_desc_002.cn: 管理员成功与莱万汀会合。二人决定一同踏入协议空间深处，探寻深埋于此的记忆。
c16m4_desc_002.en: You successfully meet up with Laevatain. Together, you venture deeper into the Protocol Space, seeking the memories buried within.

c16m4_desc_003.cn: 莱万汀已经找到了新的寄托。和她一起挣脱记忆的枷锁，离开这里。
c16m4_desc_003.en: Laevatain has found a new anchor. Break free from the chains of memory with her and leave.

c17m1_desc_001.cn: 应安德烈所托，取到包裹并带给伊冯。
c17m1_desc_001.en: Retrieve the package as requested by Andre and deliver it to Yvonne.

c17m1_desc_002.cn: 跟上伊冯，看看她的计划。
c17m1_desc_002.en: Follow Yvonne and see what she's planning

c17m2_desc_001.cn: 前往枢纽区基地寻找涂鸦灵感。
c17m2_desc_001.en: Head to the Hub Base for graffiti inspiration.

c17m2_desc_002.cn: 前往矿区营地寻找涂鸦灵感。
c17m2_desc_002.en: Head to the Mining Camp for graffiti inspiration.

c17m2_desc_003.cn: 前往超域试验场寻找涂鸦灵感。
c17m2_desc_003.en: Head to the Æther Test Site for graffiti inspiration

c17m3_desc_001.cn: 返回源石实验园区，协助伊冯完成作品。
c17m3_desc_001.en: Head back to the Originium Science Park and help Yvonne finish her project

c17m3_desc_002.cn: 涂鸦似乎还不够完美，陪伊冯再去一个地方，寻找她最想“呐喊”出的东西。
c17m3_desc_002.en: Yvonne doesn't seem too pleased. Go to one more place with her to find what she most wants to "scream" out.

c17m3_desc_003.cn: 陪伊冯进入车间并解决里面的天使。
c17m3_desc_003.en: Enter the underground production floors with Yvonne and defeat the Aggeloi.

c1m2_desc_001.cn: 从乔瓦尼处得知哈伦的情报后，管理员决定与狼卫先讨论一下后续的行动计划。

c1m3_desc_010.cn: 为了追上逃走的乔瓦尼，管理员与狼卫前往裂地者的藏身处。

c27m1_desc_005.cn: 根据得到的线索，前往水车附近寻找汤汤。
c27m1_desc_005.en: Follow the gathered intel and look for Tangtang near the waterwheel.

c27m1_desc_006.cn: 管理员与汤汤受到阮一残党伏击，只能先合力击退他们。
c27m1_desc_006.en: The Endmin and Tangtang are ambushed by Ruan Yi's loyalists. Fight as a team and defeat them.

c27m1_desc_009.cn: 在寨子内寻找见过汤汤的人，偷听他们的对话，打探汤汤的去向。
c27m1_desc_009.en: Look for Stockaders who saw Tangtang recently, listen in to their conversations, and look for Tangtang's whereabouts.

c27m1_desc_010.cn: 应弭弗的请求，管理员前往清波寨外寨寻找汤汤。
c27m1_desc_010.en: Having received Mi Fu's request, the Endmin visits Qingbo Bailey to look for Tangtang.

c27m1_desc_011.cn: 听从河佬的建议，向汤汤发送消息，询问她的近况。
c27m1_desc_011.en: You follow He Lao's advice and toast Tangtang on Baker to ask how she is doing.

c27m1_name.en: A River Restless in Still Winds

c27m2_desc_004.cn: 询问附近的老人是否有阮一残党的线索。
c27m2_desc_004.en: Ask the elderly nearby for clues about Ruan Yi's loyalists.

c27m2_desc_007.cn: 询问附近的店主是否有阮一残党的线索。
c27m2_desc_007.en: Ask the shopkeepers nearby for clues about Ruan Yi's loyalists.

c27m2_desc_008.cn: 进入火锅店，寻找阮一残党的踪迹。
c27m2_desc_008.en: Enter the hotpot place to look for Ruan Yi's loyalists.

c27m2_desc_012.cn: 抽干水渠中的水，进入地下水渠。
c27m2_desc_012.en: Completely drain the water to enter the underground canal.

c27m2_desc_018.cn: 汤汤拜托青芜给管理员带了些好东西。找到青芜拿取礼物。
c27m2_desc_018.en: Tangtang has asked Qingwu to bring a gift to the Endmin. Find Qingwu and pick it up from her.

c27m2_desc_019.cn: 询问附近的天师是否有阮一残党的线索。
c27m2_desc_019.en: Ask the Tianshi nearby for clues about Ruan Yi's loyalists.

c27m3_desc_003.cn: 到达约定的地点后，汤汤却没有出现。在附近搜寻她的踪迹。
c27m3_desc_003.en: You arrive at the location but Tangtang fails to show up. Look around and search for her trail.

c27m3_desc_004.cn: 汤汤被阮一残党围住，帮助她脱困。
c27m3_desc_004.en: Ruan Yi's loyalists have surrounded Tangtang. Help her escape.

c27m3_desc_005.cn: 汤汤在战斗中受了伤，查看她的伤势，并为其治疗。
c27m3_desc_005.en: Tangtang has been injured in the fight. Check and treat her wounds.

c27m3_desc_006.cn: 使用扫描功能，调查阮一残党的踪迹。
c27m3_desc_006.en: Use the scan feature to investigate the trails and clues of the loyalists.

c27m4_desc_009.cn: 帮助汤汤寻找阮一留下的东西。
c27m4_desc_009.en: Help Tangtang look through Ruan Yi's belongings.

c27m4_desc_016.cn: 陪伴汤汤将阮一的角埋在祖泉边。
c27m4_desc_016.en: Accompany Tangtang and bury Ruan Yi's horn by the Ancestral Spring.

c27m4_desc_017.cn: 与汤汤一起前往河边，寻找阮一残党的藏身处。
c27m4_desc_017.en: Accompany Tangtang to the riverbank and locate the hideout of Ruan Yi's loyalists.

c27m5_desc_009.cn: 陪同汤汤前往总桩办公室，会见庄方宜。
c27m5_desc_009.en: Accompany Tangtang to the Main Pillar Office for her meeting with Zhuang Fangyi.

c27m5_desc_010.en: Accept Tangtang's invitation and look for her.

c27m5_name.en: 'Twas One River That Gave Us Drink

c28m1_desc_001.cn: 查看菲奥娜发来的消息，了解发生了什么事。
c28m1_desc_001.en: Read the messages that Fiona sent you to learn about the situation.

c28m1_desc_002.cn: 一份侵蚀相关物质的提取样本遗失，疑似被裂地者所掠夺。终末地锁定了样本可能在的地点，当务之急是在造成危害前将其找回。
c28m1_desc_002.en: A missing Blight material sample is suspected to have been seized by the Landbreakers. Endfield has identified a possible location of the sample's whereabouts. It must be retrieved before it could deal any harm.

c28m1_desc_003.cn: 裂地者的营地里没有遗失样本的踪迹，菲奥娜怀疑样本已经被转移，提议在附近区域搜索一番。
c28m1_desc_003.en: You find no traces of the missing sample in the Landbreaker camp. Fiona suspects that the raiders may have moved the sample elsewhere and recommends searching the nearby areas.

c28m1_desc_004.cn: 跟随洛茜，寻找可疑的线索。
c28m1_desc_004.en: Follow Rossi and look for anything suspicious.

c28m1_desc_005.cn: 得知了样本的下落，管理员与洛茜决定寻找孩子们口中的“国王陛下”，取回样本。
c28m1_desc_005.en: After learning where the sample is, the Endmin and Rossi decide to find the children's "King" and retrieve the dangerous material.

c28m2_desc_001.cn: 为了换回样本，管理员和洛茜决定想办法拿到“国王”需要的两件“宝物”。第一个目标在“风铃公爵”的“领地”。
c28m2_desc_001.en: The Endmin and Rossi decide to acquire two pieces of "treasure" that the "King" desires in exchange for the sample. The first is located in the "domain" of the "Duchess of Windbell".

c28m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员和洛茜得到了“国王”要求的第一件“宝物”，下一个目标在“发条公爵”的“领地”。
c28m2_desc_002.en: The Endmin and Rossi have acquired the first "Treasure" desired by the "King". The second treasure is located in the "domain" of the "Duke of Clockwork".

c28m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员和洛茜找齐了两件“宝物”。与“积木国王”交谈，尝试换回样本。
c28m3_desc_001.en: The Endmin and Rossi have secured two "Treasures". Talk to the "King of Brickyland" and try to exchange the "Treasures" for the sample.

c28m3_desc_002.cn: 管理员和洛茜决定进入“积木王国”，救出滞留其中的“国王”并取回样本。
c28m3_desc_002.en: The Endmin and Rossi decide to enter "Kingdom of Brickyland", rescue the "King" trapped in the place, and retrieve the sample.

c28m3_desc_003.cn: 管理员和洛茜需要穿过“勇者之路”，继续前进。
c28m3_desc_003.en: The Endmin and Rossi must journey down the "Trail of the Brave".

c28m3_desc_004.cn: 利用地上的上升气流进行跳跃，设法穿越“熔岩地带”。
c28m3_desc_004.en: Use the vents of rising air to boost your jumps and pass through the "Lava Zone".

c28m3_desc_005.cn: 深入“积木王国”的路被一处转盘所阻隔，它被孩子们称为“旋转木马”。想要通过这里，需要给“旋转木马”通上电，让它重新转起来。
c28m3_desc_005.en: The road heading deeper into the "Kingdom of Brickyland" is blocked by a large, rotating platform. The children call it the "swiftbeast carousel". You must power this machine and get it turning again to pass through this place.

c28m3_desc_006.cn: 管理员和洛茜进入了“积木王国”的“宝库”，这里是孩子们堆放玩具的地方。周围的布置错综复杂，需要找到另一个出口才能继续前进。
c28m3_desc_006.en: The Endmin and Rossi enter the "Brickyland Vault" where the children keep their toys. The Vault has a complicated layout. You must find another exit in order to progress.

c28m3_desc_007.cn: 孩子们建议管理员和洛茜，借助长耳兽找到正确的路线。想办法和这只名叫“黄金小伯爵”的长耳兽成为好朋友吧。
c28m3_desc_007.en: The children advise the Endmin and Rossi to use the long-ear and find the correct path. Try to befriend the creature they call "Little Golden Count".

c28m3_desc_008.cn: 前路摆放着许多被孩子们当作军队的箱子，进入“宫殿”的钥匙就在这些箱子中。打散箱子，找到钥匙。
c28m3_desc_008.en: The children have placed many boxes that they treat as soldiers. The key to enter the "Palace" lies within them. Smash the boxes and find the key.

c28m3_desc_009.cn: 管理员和洛茜得到了进入“王国宫殿”的钥匙。启动电梯，前往“宫殿”。
c28m3_desc_009.en: The Endmin and Rossi acquire the key to enter the "Kingdom Palace". Activate the lift and reach the place.

c28m3_desc_010.cn: 管理员和洛茜救下了“国王”，但回头的道路已经很难走通。眼前的一条狭长昏暗的矿道成了出去的好方法，但受到惊吓的“国王”止步不前，需要想办法让他重拾勇气。
c28m3_desc_010.en: The Endmin and Rossi rescue the "King" but backtracking is near impossible. A narrow and dark mining trail seems to be the only way out. However, the frightened "King" refuses to move. The team must instill courage into the boy.

c31m1_desc_001.cn: 管理员收到弭弗发来的消息，准备动身前往总桩办公室与她会合。
c31m1_desc_001.en: The Endmin receives a message from Mi Fu, and goes off to meet her at the Main Pillar Office.

c31m1_desc_002.cn: 庄方宜被掳走，总桩办公室中只留下了一封战书，循着这唯一的线索，管理员与弭弗一同前往迷踪林赴约。
c31m1_desc_002.en: Zhuang Fangyi has been kidnapped. A written invitation to a fight is the only thing left in the Main Pillar Office. The Endmin and Mi Fu take their only lead and head to Stragglers Grove for battle.

c31m2_desc_001.cn: 备战演练后，管理员与弭弗一起前往擂台，为救出庄方宜而与三位师父展开对决。
c31m2_desc_001.en: After the preparation and training, the Endmin and Mi Fu head to the arena. There, they must defeat her three masters to save Zhuang Fangyi.

c31m2_desc_002.cn: 为了准备与二师父的对决，弭弗分身乏术，于是将自己巡逻武陵城的职责暂时交给了管理员。
c31m2_desc_002.en: Mi Fu must prepare for her fight against Senior Master and cannot be at two places at once. She thus asks the Endministrator to perform her duties of patrolling Wuling City.

c31m2_desc_003.cn: 掳走庄方宜的人用她的终端发来信息，管理员决定前去一探究竟。
c31m2_desc_003.en: Zhuang Fangyi's kidnappers have toasted the Endministrator with her handyterm. The Endministrator decides to go along.

c31m3_desc_001.cn: 前往擂台，和弭弗一同面对与大师父的最终对决。
c31m3_desc_001.en: Go to the arena, join Mi Fu, and face the Grand Master in the final challenge.

c33m1_desc_001.cn: 联络员菲奥娜发来了一条塞什卡的求助信息。
c33m1_desc_001.en: Fiona the Comms Officer has sent you a request for help from Seš'qa.

c33m1_desc_002.cn: 前往工人之家，与塞什卡的看护人会合。
c33m1_desc_002.en: Go to the Worker Dorms and meet with the Keeper of Wisdom from Seš'qa.

c33m1_desc_003.cn: 找到卡缪，确认他的调查情况。
c33m1_desc_003.en: Find Camille to confirm the progress of his investigation.

c33m1_desc_004.cn: 根据德鲁安提供的线索，前往运输车的出发地，进行深入调查。
c33m1_desc_004.en: Follow the lead provided by Druan, go to the departure point of the transport vehicle, and carefully investigate the place.

c33m1_desc_006.cn: 检查发现的尸体，确认对方的身份与情况。
c33m1_desc_006.en: Check the body to verify its state and the identity of the deceased.

c33m1_desc_007.cn: 去联盟停车场找到卡缪。
c33m1_desc_007.en: Find Camille at the United Parking Lot.

c33m1_desc_008.cn: 沿着新的血迹，继续追踪血液样本的去向。
c33m1_desc_008.en: Follow the fresh bloodstains and track the whereabouts of the blood sample.

c33m1_desc_009.cn: 根据杰弗里提供的线索，寻找运输车。
c33m1_desc_009.en: Use Jeffrey's clues to find the transport truck.

c33m2_desc_001.cn: 与卡缪一起进入废弃设施，找出幕后黑手。
c33m2_desc_001.en: Enter the abandoned facility with Camille and root out the mastermind.

c33m2_desc_002.cn: 沿着管道向内，深入调查地下的废弃设施。
c33m2_desc_002.en: Use the pipeline to head deeper into the abandoned underground facility.

c33m2_desc_007.cn: 从查尔的房间离开，继续深入废弃设施。
c33m2_desc_007.en: Leave Char's room and keep exploring the abandoned facility.

c33m2_desc_008.en: Keep advancing and make your way through the campsite.

c33m2_desc_010.cn: 与卡缪配合，打开通路，继续前进。
c33m2_desc_010.en: Work with Camille to open up the way and keep progressing.

c33m2_desc_011.cn: 击败拦路的敌人，继续向前。
c33m2_desc_011.en: Defeat the enemies in the way and keep advancing.

c33m2_desc_012.cn: 卡缪推开了门，和他一起前进，确认查尔的所在。
c33m2_desc_012.en: Camille has pushed open the door. Go with him and find out where Char is hiding.

c33m2_desc_013.en: Keep up the pursuit and find Char.

c33m2_desc_014.cn: 进入眼前的房子，寻找查尔。
c33m2_desc_014.en: Enter the house before you and find Char.

c33m2_desc_015.cn: 触碰八音盒，检查施术痕迹。
c33m2_desc_015.en: Touch the music box and inspect any traces of the Arts

c33m2_desc_016.cn: 返回发现达宁的地点，找出血液样本。
c33m2_desc_016.en: Return to the place where you first found Dunning and find the blood sample.

c34m1_desc_001.cn: 秦茳尺拜托管理员前往应龙关外的一片树林，寻找失踪的安德烈。
c34m1_desc_001.en: Andre has gone missing. Director Qin asks the Endministrator to investigate a forest outside Yinglung Pass and look for the missing engineer.

c34m1_desc_002.cn: 找到安德烈并与其交谈后，尝试离开这片树林。
c34m1_desc_002.en: Find Andre and talk to him, then find a way to leave the woods.

c34m1_desc_003.cn: 与提弗洛斯对话，了解林地大致情况后，一路跟随她，破除防护阵法，前往林中的雪祀小屋。
c34m1_desc_003.en: After talking to Typhoeus and getting a better understanding of the situation, the Endministrator decides to follow her. Break the protective runes and reach the Snowpriestess's cabin in the forest.

c34m1_desc_004.cn: 秦茳尺发来消息，需要及时查看。
c34m1_desc_004.en: Director Qin Jiangchi has sent an urgent message. Read it quickly.

c34m1_desc_005.cn: 受秦茳尺所托，深入应龙关外的林地，寻找安德烈的踪迹。
c34m1_desc_005.en: The Endministrator receives a plea from Director Qin to head into a forest outside Yinglung Pass and look for Andre.

c34m1_desc_006.cn: 为了寻找安德烈，管理员决定跟随雾中的人影，继续深入林地。
c34m1_desc_006.en: To find Andre, the Endministrator decides to follow the figure in the fog and head deeper into the Forest.

c34m1_desc_007.cn: 深入应龙关外的树林，循着林中呼救声，寻找声音来源。
c34m1_desc_007.en: Follow the calls for help and go deeper into the woods outside Yinglung Pass to find where they are coming from.

c34m1_desc_008.cn: 循着呼救声找到安德烈后，与其交谈，了解现状。
c34m1_desc_008.en: The Endministrator followed the calls for help and found Andre. Talk to the engineer to learn more about the situation.

c34m1_desc_009.cn: 离开林地的途中，管理员与安德烈再度分散。尝试找到道路，与安德烈会合。
c34m1_desc_009.en: While trying to leave the Forest, Andre becomes separated from the Endministrator again. Try to find a path and meet up with Andre.

c34m1_desc_010.cn: 与安德烈会合后，管理员偶遇一位来自罗德岛的干员——提弗洛斯。与她对话，了解现状。
c34m1_desc_010.en: The Endministrator meets up with Andre and is unexpectedly joined by a Rhodes Island Operator named Typhoeus. Talk to her to learn about the current situation.

c34m1_desc_011.cn: 前往雪祀小屋的途中，帮助提弗洛斯寻找合适的射击位置，破除阵法。
c34m1_desc_011.en: The team heads to the Snowpriestess's cabin. Help Typhoeus find a suitable firing position to disable the array.

c34m1_desc_012.cn: 破除路上的阵法后，跟随提弗洛斯继续深入林地，前往雪祀小屋。
c34m1_desc_012.en: The array along the way has been disabled. Follow Typhoeus and head deeper into the Forest to reach the Snowpriestess's cabin.

c34m1_desc_013.cn: 前往小屋途中，帮助提弗洛斯寻找合适的射击位置，移动浮石。
c34m1_desc_013.en: The team heads to the Snowpriestess's cabin. Help Typhoeus find a suitable firing position to move the floating rocks.

c34m1_desc_014.cn: 破除防御机关后，进入雪祀小屋详细调查，寻找离开林地的方法。
c34m1_desc_014.en: The team disables the defenses. Search the Snowpriestess's cabin for a way to leave the forest.

c34m1_desc_015.cn: 调查过整个雪祀小屋后，与提弗洛斯对话，了解离开林地的方法。
c34m1_desc_015.en: The team has searched through the Snowpriestess's cabin. Talk to Typhoeus to find a way to leave the forest.

c34m1_desc_016.cn: 要离开林地，需破坏三处林中祭坛，众人打算先生起炉火，暂时休整一夜。
c34m1_desc_016.en: To leave the forest, the three forest shrines must be taken down. The team decides to light the fireplace and rest for a while.

c34m1_desc_017.cn: 意料之外的讯息将管理员指向应龙关外的神秘松林，在那里，一位朋友正焦急等待着管理员的到来。
c34m1_desc_017.en: An unexpected message is leading the Endministrator to a mysterious pinewood forest outside Yinglung Pass. A friend is anxiously waiting for the Endministrator's arrival.

c34m1_desc_018.cn: 受秦茳尺所托，深入应龙关外的林地，寻找安德烈的踪迹。
c34m1_desc_018.en: The Endministrator receives a plea from Director Qin to head into a forest outside Yinglung Pass and look for Andre.

c34m1_desc_019.cn: 为了寻找安德烈的踪迹，管理员决定登上眼前的巨石，深入林地。
c34m1_desc_019.en: To track down Andre, the Endministrator decides to scale the giant rock and head deeper into the Forest.

c34m1_desc_020.cn: 绕开雾气，寻找雾中的人影，继续深入林地。
c34m1_desc_020.en: Get around the fog, find the figure in the mist, and go deeper into the Forest.

c34m1_desc_021.cn: 绕过雾气弥漫处，查看此地散落的物品，寻找安德烈的踪迹。
c34m1_desc_021.en: Get around the fog, examine the scattered items, and look for any clues of Andre's whereabouts.

c34m1_desc_022.cn: 前往雪祀小屋的途中，帮助提弗洛斯寻找合适的射击位置，破除阵法。
c34m1_desc_022.en: The team heads to the Snowpriestess's cabin. Help Typhoeus find a suitable firing position to disable the array.

c34m1_desc_023.cn: 来到雪祀小屋前，帮助提弗洛斯寻找合适的射击位置，破除防御机关。
c34m1_desc_023.en: The team arrives at the Snowpriestess's cabin. Help Typhoeus find a suitable firing position to disable the cabin's defenses.

c34m1_desc_024.cn: 进入雪祀小屋后，与安德烈交谈。
c34m1_desc_024.en: The team has entered the Snowpriestess's cabin. Talk to Andre.

c34m1_desc_025.cn: 进入雪祀小屋后，对其内部进行详细调查，寻找离开林地的方法。
c34m1_desc_025.en: Enter the Snowpriestess's cabin and search through it carefully to find a way to exit the Forest.

c34m2_desc_001.cn: 将睡着的安德烈安置在小屋中，与提弗洛斯一起前往林中祭坛，破除雪祀布下的仪式。
c34m2_desc_001.en: The Endministrator and Typhoeus leave a sleeping Andre safely in the cabin and make their way towards the forest shrine to dispel the Snowpriestess's ritual.

c34m2_desc_002.cn: 雪祀小屋里，管理员等人找到了离开林地的办法，并好好休息了一晚。就在众人以为一切顺利时，噩梦却悄无声息地到来。
c34m2_desc_002.en: The Endministrator's team has searched the Snowpriestess's cabin, found a way to leave the forest, and rested well for the night. Just as everyone believes the ordeal will be over soon, a nightmare strikes without a sound.

c34m2_desc_003.cn: 休整一夜后，众人准备前往林中祭坛。与安德烈对话，呼唤他一起出发。
c34m2_desc_003.en: After a full night of rest, the team prepares to go to the forest shrine. Talk to Andre and ask him to come along.

c34m2_desc_004.cn: 抵达第一处林中祭坛后，击败此地出现的巫术造物。
c34m2_desc_004.en: The team arrives at the first forest shrine but strange witchcraft creations appear. Defeat them.

c34m2_desc_005.cn: 击败巫术造物后，帮助提弗洛斯寻找合适的射箭位置，击破符文，破坏仪式。
c34m2_desc_005.en: The witchcraft creations have been defeated. Help Typhoeus find a suitable firing position to shoot the rune and disrupt the ritual.

c34m2_desc_006.cn: 破坏仪式后，进入祭坛，取下中间飘浮的捕梦网。
c34m2_desc_006.en: The ritual has been disrupted. Enter the shrine and retrieve the dreamcatcher floating in the center of it.

c34m2_desc_007.cn: 取得捕梦网后，安德烈不知为何离开木屋，走向第二处祭坛。与提弗洛斯一起追上他。
c34m2_desc_007.en: After retrieving the dreamcatcher, the team sees Andre staggering out of the cabin towards the second shrine for reasons unknown. Join Typhoeus and catch up to him.

c34m2_desc_008.cn: 取得捕梦网后，安德烈不知为何离开木屋，走向第二处祭坛。与提弗洛斯一起追上他。
c34m2_desc_008.en: After retrieving the dreamcatcher, the team sees Andre staggering out of the cabin towards the second shrine for reasons unknown. Join Typhoeus and catch up to him.

c34m2_desc_009.cn: 前往第二处林中祭坛，击败途中出现的巫术造物。
c34m2_desc_009.en: Go to the second forest shrine and defeat the witchcraft creations along the way.

c34m2_desc_010.cn: 抵达第二处林中祭坛，破坏仪式后靠近安德烈，查看他的状况。
c34m2_desc_010.en: The team arrives at the second forest shrine. Disrupt the ritual and approach Andre to check on his condition.

c34m2_desc_011.cn: 抵达第二处林中祭坛，破坏仪式后靠近安德烈，查看他的状况。
c34m2_desc_011.en: The team arrives at the second forest shrine. Disrupt the ritual and approach Andre to check on his condition.

c34m2_desc_012.cn: 安德烈受祭坛中的仪式影响，陷入沉睡。尽快取下捕梦网。
c34m2_desc_012.en: Andre is in deep slumber due to the ritual empowered by the shrines. Retrieve the dreamcatcher quickly.

c34m2_desc_013.cn: 将沉睡的安德烈带回小屋后，与提弗洛斯对话，商议接下来的行动。
c34m2_desc_013.en: A sleeping Andre has been brought back to the cabin. Talk to Typhoeus and discuss the next step.

c34m2_desc_014.cn: 管理员留下照料沉睡的安德烈，提弗洛斯独自一人前往第三处林中祭坛，破坏仪式。
c34m2_desc_014.en: The Endministrator stays behind to take care of a slumbering Andre while Typhoeus heads to the third forest shrine on her own to disrupt the ritual.

c34m2_desc_015.cn: 前往第三处林中祭坛，击败途中出现的巫术造物。
c34m2_desc_015.en: Go to the third forest shrine and defeat the witchcraft creations along the way.

c34m2_desc_016.cn: 前往第三处林中祭坛的途中，提弗洛斯发现了雪祀暂居过的山洞，详细调查其中物品。
c34m2_desc_016.en: While heading to the third forest shrine, Typhoeus discovers a cave where the Snowpriestess once lived. She then conducts a careful search.

c34m2_desc_017.cn: 调查过山洞后，提弗洛斯离开此地，继续前往第三处林中祭坛。
c34m2_desc_017.en: After searching through the cave, Typhoeus leaves the site and heads to the third forest shrine.

c34m2_desc_018.cn: 提弗洛斯抵达了第三处林中祭坛。尽快击败巫术造物，破坏仪式。
c34m2_desc_018.en: Typhoeus arrives at the third forest shrine. She must defeat the witchcraft creations quickly to disrupt the ritual.

c34m2_desc_019.cn: 提弗洛斯抵达了第三处林中祭坛。尽快击败巫术造物，破坏仪式。
c34m2_desc_019.en: Typhoeus arrives at the third forest shrine. She must defeat the witchcraft creations quickly to disrupt the ritual.

c34m2_desc_020.cn: 破坏仪式后，提弗洛斯需尽快进入祭坛中间，取下最后一只捕梦网。
c34m2_desc_020.en: After disrupting the ritual, Typhoeus must enter the center of the shrine quickly to retrieve the last dreamcatcher.

c34m2_desc_021.cn: 取下最后一只捕梦网后，提弗洛斯需尽快找办法下山，返回雪祀小屋。
c34m2_desc_021.en: After getting the last dreamcatcher, Typhoeus must find a way to descend the mountain and return to the Snowpriestess's cabin.

c34m2_name.en: A Snowy Realm Touched by Nightmares

c34m3_desc_002.cn: 安德烈已经苏醒并安然无恙。与他一起离开树林。
c34m3_desc_002.en: Andre is awake and unharmed. It is time to leave the forest with him.

c34m3_desc_003.cn: 安德烈的意识深陷梦中，无法唤醒。管理员与提弗洛斯决定举行一场特殊的萨米仪式，进入那笼罩整个林地的噩梦。
c34m3_desc_003.en: Andre cannot be awakened as his consciousness is trapped in a deep dream. The Endministrator and Typhoeus decide to perform a special Sami ritual and enter the nightmare that shrouds the entire forest.

c34m3_desc_004.cn: 全部祭坛被破坏，安德烈依旧没有苏醒。查阅雪祀留下的手稿，找寻唤醒他的方法。
c34m3_desc_004.en: Despite having destroyed all the shrines, Andre fails to wake. Read the Snowpriestess's notes and find a way to wake him.

c34m3_desc_005.cn: 在手稿中找到进入梦境的方法后，与提弗洛斯对话，商议如何布置仪式。
c34m3_desc_005.en: A method for entering the dreamscape has been found in the notes. Talk to Typhoeus and discuss how to set up the ritual.

c34m3_desc_006.cn: 与提弗洛斯商议后，按照她的指示准备仪式道具，拔下安德烈的眉毛。
c34m3_desc_006.en: The discussion with Typhoeus gives you a plan. Follow her instructions to prepare the ritual props and pluck some of Andre's brow feathers.

c34m3_desc_007.cn: 按照与提弗洛斯商议的内容，继续协助她放置捕梦网。
c34m3_desc_007.en: Follow the plan you have discussed with Typhoeus and help her place the dreamcatchers.

c34m3_desc_008.cn: 协助提弗洛斯布置仪式，用雪裹好安德烈的眉毛。
c34m3_desc_008.en: Help Typhoeus set up the ritual and pack Andre's brow feathers in snow.

c34m3_desc_009.cn: 仪式布置好后，返回小屋与提弗洛斯启动阵法，进入梦境拯救安德烈。
c34m3_desc_009.en: The ritual has been set up. Return to the cabin and join Typhoeus to activate the array, then enter the dreamscape to rescue Andre.

c34m3_desc_010.cn: 仪式布置好后，返回小屋与提弗洛斯启动阵法，进入梦境拯救安德烈。
c34m3_desc_010.en: The ritual has been set up. Return to the cabin and join Typhoeus to activate the array, then enter the dreamscape to rescue Andre.

c34m3_desc_011.cn: 阵法成功启动，与提弗洛斯一起走出小屋，步入梦境之中。
c34m3_desc_011.en: The array is successfully activated. Leave the cabin with Typhoeus and step into the dreamscape.

c34m3_desc_012.cn: 进入梦中，与提弗洛斯一起抵挡来袭的巫术造物。
c34m3_desc_012.en: Enter dreamscape with Typhoeus and fight off the attacking witchcraft creations together.

c34m3_desc_013.cn: <@nar.clue>哎，傻孩子，不要再和这些造物纠缠了，梦境中它们会一直出现，快跑！</>
c34m3_desc_013.en: <@nar.clue>Run, you fools! Stop fighting these creations. They are endless in the dreamscape. Run!</>

c34m3_desc_014.cn: 梦境中的巫术造物数量众多，当务之急是寻找安德烈的意识，尽量避免与之缠斗。
c34m3_desc_014.en: The creations of witchcraft seem endless in the dreamscape. Avoid getting bogged down in the fight and try to find Andre's consciousness.

c34m3_desc_015.cn: 孩子，我们是来找安德烈的，不用管那些巫术造物，避开就是。
c34m3_desc_015.en: Children, we are looking for Andre. Avoid the witchcraft creations and focus on the search.

c34m3_desc_016.cn: 梦境中升起无法视物的迷雾，与提弗洛斯一起努力寻找正确的方向。
c34m3_desc_016.en: An extremely thick fog rises in the dreamscape and completely obstructs your view. Work with Typhoeus and try to find the correct way out.

c34m3_desc_017.cn: 不要担心，即便是在雾中，你们也会找到方向。
c34m3_desc_017.en: Have no fear. The fog may be thick, but you will find a way out.

c34m3_desc_018.cn: 梦境中雾气缭绕，但请你不要担心。路就在脚下，往前走吧，你不会迷失的。
c34m3_desc_018.en: The fog may be thick in the dreamscape, but worry not. The road is still beneath your feet. Keep walking. You will not be lost.

c34m3_desc_019.cn: 被困于无法视物的迷雾中。与提弗洛斯一起跟随蹄声指引，找寻道路。
c34m3_desc_019.en: The team is trapped within an impenetrable fog. Follow the sound of trotting hooves with Typhoeus to find a way.

c34m3_desc_020.cn: 仔细听那蹄声，它会带你们走出眼前的迷雾。
c34m3_desc_020.en: Listen to the sound of trotting hooves. Let it lead you out of the fog.

c34m3_desc_021.cn: 被困于无法视物的迷雾中，只能跟随提弗洛斯，一路向前。
c34m3_desc_021.en: The team is trapped within an impenetrable fog. The only choice is to follow Typhoeus and press forward.

c34m3_desc_022.cn: 请你相信提弗洛斯，相信那蹄声，他们会带你找到路。
c34m3_desc_022.en: Please believe in Typhoeus and the sound of the hooves. They will lead you back to the correct path.

c34m3_desc_023.cn: 被困于无法视物的迷雾中，只能跟随提弗洛斯，继续一路向前。
c34m3_desc_023.en: The team is trapped within an impenetrable fog. The only choice is to follow Typhoeus and continue forward.

c34m3_desc_024.cn: <@nar.clue>不论何时，都请相信，会有道路自你脚下延伸。</>
c34m3_desc_024.en: <@nar.clue>Always believe this. No matter when, a road is always beneath your feet.</>

c34m3_desc_025.cn: 悬崖前，一串圣洁的蹄印奇迹般地出现在两人眼前。跟随蹄印，勇敢越过面前的悬崖。
c34m3_desc_025.en: Before the cliff, an immaculate trail of hoofprints suddenly appears before Typhoeus and the Endministrator. Follow the prints and bravely cross the chasm.

c34m3_desc_026.cn: <@nar.clue>孩子，越过悬崖，前方并非坦途，千万要小心。但也不必彷徨，大胆往前，我会一直在你们身边。</>
c34m3_desc_026.en: <@nar.clue>Cross the chasm, children. The path forward may be perilous, but do not be taken by fear. Be bold and press forth. I will always be by your side.</>

c34m3_desc_027.cn: 帮助提弗洛斯击破拦路的符文，继续向前。
c34m3_desc_027.en: Help Typhoeus shoot the runes blocking the way and press forward.

c34m3_desc_028.cn: 跨越悬崖后，继续跟随蹄印，抵达安德烈的意识所在。
c34m3_desc_028.en: After crossing the chasm, keep following the hoofprints to reach Andre's consciousness.

c34m3_desc_029.cn: 拦路的符文已被击破，跟随蹄印，抵达安德烈的意识所在。
c34m3_desc_029.en: The runes blocking the way have been shattered. Follow the hoofprints and reach Andre's consciousness.

c34m3_desc_030.cn: 在梦中找到安德烈的意识，将其带离梦境。
c34m3_desc_030.en: The team finally finds Andre's consciousness. Bring it along and leave the dreamscape.

c34m3_desc_031.cn: 巨型巫术造物突然出现，阻止二人带走安德烈的意识。需要将其击败。
c34m3_desc_031.en: A giant creation of witchcraft has appeared to stop the team from leaving with Andre's consciousness. It must be defeated.

c34m3_desc_032.cn: 击败巫术造物后，安玛赠予的箭支划破梦境，管理员与提弗洛斯返回现实。雪祀小屋内，安德烈正等着两人。
c34m3_desc_032.en: After defeating the witchcraft creation and breaking free of the dreamscape with an arrow gifted by Amma, the Endministrator and Typhoeus manage to return to reality. They return to the Snowpriestess's cabin where they see Andre waiting for them.

c34m3_desc_033.cn: 离开树林前，与安德烈交谈。
c34m3_desc_033.en: Talk to Andre before leaving the forest.

c34m3_desc_034.cn: 离开树林前，与提弗洛斯对话，询问其后续的打算。
c34m3_desc_034.en: Before leaving the forest, talk to Typhoeus and ask her about her plans.

c34m3_desc_035.cn: 在与提弗洛斯、安德烈分别交谈后，离开树林。
c34m3_desc_035.en: Talk to Typhoeus and Andre, and leave the forest.

c34m3_name.en: A Dreamscape Shattered by Her Arrow

c35m1_desc_001.cn: 环塔商会的一家企业即将在四号谷地举办一场公益演唱会。管理员收到邀请，决定前往观看。
c35m1_desc_001.en: A corporation under the TGCC is hosting a public welfare concert in Valley IV. You have been invited and decided to attend.

c35m2_desc_001.cn: 顺利找到了失踪的偶像梨诺后，在她的请求与诸多考虑下，管理员决定帮助她筹备个人演唱会，两人开始一同寻找合适的起飞地点。
c35m2_desc_001.en: After finding the missing idol Liino, she asks you to help prepare her solo concert. Following careful consideration, you agree, and the two of you set out to find a suitable launch site.

c35m3_desc_001.cn: 确认了降落地点后，筹备工作告一段落。为了完成个人演唱会的宣传活动，管理员与梨诺决定前往矿区营地进行筹划。
c35m3_desc_001.en: After confirming the landing site, the preparations are finally complete. To move forward with promoting the solo concert, you and Liino head to the Mining Camp to figure out the next step.

c35m4_desc_001.cn: 完成演唱会的宣传工作后，管理员与梨诺收到安德烈的消息，得知裂地者似乎正要袭击起飞地点。为了让演唱会顺利进行，两人决定赶往现场。
c35m4_desc_001.en: After finishing the concert promotion, you and Liino get a message from Andre: the Landbreakers are about to attack the launch site. To ensure the performance can go ahead, you both rush over.

c6m1_desc_001.cn: 管理员接到洛茜发来的通信，得知她似乎有件要紧事要找自己帮忙。
c6m1_desc_001.en: The Endministrator receives a message from Rossi, learning that she seemed to have something urgent and needed their help.

c6m1_desc_002.cn: 了解狼卫的目的后，管理员决定与他一起继续追查狼群叛徒的踪迹。
c6m1_desc_002.en: You learn what Wulfgard is after and decide to help him track down the Pack traitor.

c6m1_desc_003.cn: 管理员和狼卫决定同乔万尼一起深入营地，探寻真相。
c6m1_desc_003.en: You and Wulfgard decide to follow Giovanni into the camp to uncover the truth.

c6m1_desc_004.cn: 事情告一段落，叛徒得到了应有的下场，而狼卫与管理员也将离开地下营地。
c6m1_desc_004.en: The incident is over and the traitor got what he deserved. Endministrator and Wulfgard are leaving this underground camp.

chr_0016_ep1_name.en: Let Fire Consume the Ashen Past

chr_0034_ep1_name.en: A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods

chr_0035_ep1_name.en: Like a Star Streaking Through the Boundaries

cs_video_e0m0_3_02.en: I'll be waiting in the North.

cs_video_e0m2_1_02.en: Do not forget who you are.

cs_video_e0m2_6_01.cn: 三天前，各信息渠道都发来反馈

cs_video_e0m2_6_01d5.cn: 说天使有频繁的异常活动
cs_video_e0m2_6_01d5.en: abnormal spikes in Aggeloid activity three days ago...

cs_video_e0m2_6_02.cn: 按照管理员你留下的预案
cs_video_e0m2_6_02.en: We followed the contingency plan you left us

cs_video_e0m2_6_02d3.cn: 我们紧急将你沉睡的石棺秘密运回最近的基地
cs_video_e0m2_6_02d3.en: and quickly moved you and the Sarcophagus to our nearest base

cs_video_e0m2_6_03.cn: 但是，在经过四号谷地的途中

cs_video_e0m2_6_03d5.cn: 飞行器遭遇了攻击，被击落了
cs_video_e0m2_6_03d5.en: was shot down as it flew across Valley IV.

cs_video_e0m2_6_04.cn: 根据线人的情报，这必然是一次有预谋的伏击
cs_video_e0m2_6_04.en: Our intel tells us that this is a premeditated attack.

cs_video_e0m2_6_05.cn: 我们在坠落点发现了奄奄一息的你
cs_video_e0m2_6_05.en: We found you barely alive at the crash site

cs_video_e0m2_6_05d5.cn: 将你紧急送上了帝江号
cs_video_e0m2_6_05d5.en: and quickly sent you aboard Dijiang.

cs_video_e0m2_6_06.cn: 而石棺则继续送往四号谷地的基地
cs_video_e0m2_6_06.en: The Sarcophagus was sent to a base in Valley IV.

cs_video_e0m2_6_06d5.cn: 只有在那里，石棺才能进行充能
cs_video_e0m2_6_06d5.en: It's the only place where it can be charged.

cs_video_e0m2_6_07.cn: 同时，我们也检测到了极强的天使能量信号
cs_video_e0m2_6_07.en: We also picked up extremely powerful Aggeloid energy signatures.

cs_video_e0m2_6_09.cn: 我们向枢纽区基地发送了许多讯息，但都没有答复
cs_video_e0m2_6_09.en: We hailed the Hub Base many times but they failed to respond.

cs_video_e0m2_6_10.cn: 原计划是十天后带管理员前往基地，洁尔佩塔她
cs_video_e0m2_6_10.en: The plan was to bring the Endmin to the Base in ten days, but the Hub—

cs_video_e0m2_6_11d5.en: Fiona, prep for my drop at once.

cs_video_e0m2_6_12.en: Wait, wha? Now? Okay. I'll run the checks...

cs_video_e0m2_6_13.cn: 地面有信号干扰，要进行无引导紧急降落的话，一定会存在误差
cs_video_e0m2_6_13.en: There's surface interference. Unguided emergency drops might deviate.

cs_video_e0m2_6_14.cn: 安全起见，只能在基地周边地区着陆
cs_video_e0m2_6_14.en: We'll drop you near the Base, just to be safe.

cs_video_e0m2_6_15d5.cn: 秦茳尺工程师和安德烈都在枢纽区基地，我相信他们能应对
cs_video_e0m2_6_15d5.en: Director Qin and Andre are at the Base and should keep things together.

cs_video_e0m2_6_16.cn: 不论有没有来自地表的回复

cs_video_e0m2_6_16d3.cn: 都继续向枢纽区基地发送通讯
cs_video_e0m2_6_16d3.en: regardless of whether we have received any response from them.

cs_video_e0m2_6_16d5.en: Inform them that I'm coming soon.

cs_video_e0m2_6_16d7.cn: 另外，通知陈千语在基地和我会合
cs_video_e0m2_6_16d7.en: Also, tell Operator Chen to rendezvous with me there.

cs_video_e1m1_1_01.cn: 某种阴影，已经笼罩了这里……
cs_video_e1m1_1_01.en: This place has fallen under a dark shadow...

cs_video_e1m1_1_02.cn: 菲奥娜，你那边进展如何？

cs_video_e1m1_1_03.en: I'm still trying to re-establish contact...

cs_video_e1m1_1_04.cn: 慢着！佩丽卡，有未知物正在飞速接近！小心！
cs_video_e1m1_1_04.en: Wait! Perlica, we have multiple unknown objects coming in fast! Watch out!

cs_video_e1m8_4_02.en: You put up quite a show.

cs_video_e1m8_4_04.en: You lie to hide your greed.

cs_video_e1m8_4_05.cn: 掠夺不属于自己的土地，却察觉不到彼此力量的差距
cs_video_e1m8_4_05.en: You exploit lands that were never yours. You fail to realize that we are way beyond you.

cs_video_e1m8_4_06.cn: 看不清的话，不如上前一步？
cs_video_e1m8_4_06.en: Need a closer look? Just take another step forward.

cs_video_e3m5_3_01.cn: 如果你真的只有这点程度
cs_video_e3m5_3_01.en: If this is all the fight you can give me...

cs_video_e3m5_3_02.cn: 那他们究竟在害怕什么？
cs_video_e3m5_3_02.en: ...I wonder why they're so afraid of you?

cutscene_c13m3_1_01.cn: 管理员 为什么 那只是一封信……
cutscene_c13m3_1_01.en: It's just a letter. Why, Endmin?

cutscene_c13m3_1_02.cn: 但那是洁尔佩塔的宝藏 对吧？
cutscene_c13m3_1_02.en: {F}But it's something you treasure, right?{M}But it's something you treasure, right?

cutscene_c16m4_1_03.cn: 说好的承诺 只完成了一半
cutscene_c16m4_1_03.en: Remember your promise? You only delivered half.

cutscene_c16m4_1_08.cn: 我答应过你的事 无论到哪里 都不会改变
cutscene_c16m4_1_08.en: I'll keep my promise, wherever I go, whatever happens.

cutscene_c17m3_1_01.cn: 不要故意做鬼脸啦 塔塔的笑容才不是……

cutscene_c28m3_1_02.cn: 罗赞爷爷告诉过我 你所畏惧的 或许只是你心中的想象

cutscene_c28m3_1_03.cn: 克服恐惧的过程 也就是长大的过程

cutscene_e0m2_6_01.cn: 就在刚才 轨道着陆点中继无人机群发生了连续自毁
cutscene_e0m2_6_01.en: Just moments ago, simultaneous self-destruction occurred to the orbital landing relay drone squadrons.

cutscene_e0m2_6_02.cn: 通信故障范围正向四号谷地延伸 已经无法确认沿途设施的状态
cutscene_e0m2_6_02.en: The communication blackout is expanding towards Valley IV, and the status of facilities along the route is now unverifiable.

cutscene_e0m2_6_03.cn: 同时 我们也检测到了极强的天使能量信号
cutscene_e0m2_6_03.en: At the same time, we are picking up extremely intense Aggeloid energy signals in the affected area.

cutscene_e0m2_6_04.cn: 目前 枢纽区基地依然沉默 所有信道的呼叫都没有回应

cutscene_e0m2_6_05.cn: 原计划是十天后带管理员前往基地 枢纽区已经——

cutscene_e0m2_6_10.cn: 地面有信号干扰 要进行无引导紧急降落的话 一定会存在误差
cutscene_e0m2_6_10.en: There's surface interference. Current situation is too risky. Unguided emergency drops might deviate.

cutscene_e0m2_6_11.cn: 安全起见 只能在基地周边地区着陆
cutscene_e0m2_6_11.en: We'll drop you to the area near the Base, out of concern for safety.

cutscene_e0m2_6_12.cn: 秦茳尺和安德烈都在枢纽区基地 根据预案 他们会接管现场
cutscene_e0m2_6_12.en: Director Qin and Andre are at the Hub Base. In accordance with the contingency plan, they will take control of the scene as critical events happen.

cutscene_e0m2_6_13.cn: 不论有没有来自地表的回复 都继续向枢纽区基地发送通讯
cutscene_e0m2_6_13.en: Fiona, keep hailing the Hub Base, regardless of whether we have received any response from them.

cutscene_e0m2_6_14.en: Inform them that I'm coming soon.

cutscene_e0m2_6_15.en: Also, tell <@qu.key>Operator Chen</> to rendezvous with me there.
