guide_text_CC0_1.cn: 在危机合约中，可自由选择指标组合，进行战斗挑战。
guide_text_CC0_1.en: In Contingency Contract, you can select any combination of Test Criteria before starting the challenge.

guide_text_CC0_2.cn: 点击一个初始状态的<@gd.key>指标</>即可<@gd.key>选中</>该指标。
guide_text_CC0_2.en: Click on an initial <@gd.key>Test Criterion</> to <@gd.key>select</> it.

guide_text_CC0_2_ct.cn: 按下<action=navigation_target_click>即可<@gd.key>选中</>或取消对应指标。
guide_text_CC0_2_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to <@gd.key>select</> or remove the Test Criterion.

guide_text_CC0_3.cn: 已经选择的<@gd.key>指标</>将展示在此处，同时可以查看具体的<@gd.key>指标效果</>。
guide_text_CC0_3.en: All selected <@gd.key>Test Criteria</> will be displayed here. This section also displays the <@gd.key>actual effects of the Test Criteria</>.

guide_text_CC0_4.cn:
指标分为不同<@gd.key>难度等级</>，其中部分指标存在<@gd.key>冲突</>关系。
达成一定等级挑战后，可开放更多指标。
guide_text_CC0_4.en: Test Criteria are divided into different <@gd.key>difficulties</>. Some Test Criteria may also <@gd.key>conflict</> with another. More Test Criteria can be unlocked by reaching the specified challenge levels.

guide_text_CC0_5.cn: 此处汇总了挑战相关的<@gd.key>综合情报</>，可在后续进行查看。
guide_text_CC0_5.en: This section compiles the <@gd.key>general intel</> of the challenge. You can view this afterwards.

guide_text_CC0_6.cn: 选择指标后，点击此处即可开始挑战。
guide_text_CC0_6.en: Select the Test Criteria and click here to start the challenge.

guide_text_CC0_6_ct.cn: 选择指标后，按下<action=contingency_enter_dungeon>即可开始挑战。
guide_text_CC0_6_ct.en: Select the Test Criteria and press <action=contingency_enter_dungeon> to start the challenge.

guide_text_CC0_7.cn: 此处会展示危机合约挑战<@gd.key>波次</>信息，并包括了<@gd.key>重新挑战</>功能。
guide_text_CC0_7.en: Information of the Contingency Contract challenge <@gd.key>wave</> is displayed here. The section also includes the <@gd.key>Try Again</> feature to restart the challenge.

guide_text_CC0_8.cn:
可在此处查看当前危机合约挑战的综合情报。
接下来，请尝试挑战。
guide_text_CC0_8.en: Here, you can check the general intel about the current Contingency Contract challenge. Now, give the challenge a try.

guide_text_CC0_8_ct.cn:
按下<action=common_dungeon_cc_info>可查看当前危机合约挑战的综合情报。
接下来，请尝试挑战。
guide_text_CC0_8_ct.en: Press <action=common_dungeon_cc_info> to check the general intel of the current Contingency Contract challenge. Now, try to attempt the challenge.

guide_text_CC0_desc_1.cn:
在危机合约中，<@gd.key>指标</>是一系列会提升挑战难度的效果，分为3档难度等级。
可以自由选择指标组合，调节不同难度，进行战斗挑战。
guide_text_CC0_desc_1.en: The Contingency Contract <@gd.key>Test Criteria</> are a series of effects that make challenges more difficult. Test Criteria are divided into 3 difficulty tiers. Select any combination of Test Criteria to tweak the difficulty before starting the combat challenge.

guide_text_CC0_desc_2.cn:
指标会存在一些选择上的限制。部分指标之间存在冲突关系，最多只能选择其中一个。
同时还有部分指标，需要在达成<@gd.key>特定指标等级</>后，或在特定时间后，才会开放。
guide_text_CC0_desc_2.en: There may be selection limits for certain Test Criteria. Some Test Criteria conflict with another, forcing you to choose between one of them. Some are only available when <@gd.key>Test Criteria Level</> is high enough, or after a specified date.

guide_text_CC0_desc_3.cn: 部分指标是特殊的<@gd.key>「锁闭指标」</>，初始情况不可选择，必须先选择<@gd.key>「密钥指标」</>才能解锁。
guide_text_CC0_desc_3.en: Some Test Criteria are <@gd.key>[Locked Criteria]</> that cannot be selected by default. Select the specified <@gd.key>[Key Criteria]</> to unlock them.

guide_text_CC0_desc_4.cn: 成功完成每项指标的首次挑战，可获得相应的<@gd.key>晶化硬币</>奖励；更多晶化硬币奖励可通过完成合约任务获得。晶化硬币可用于在<@gd.key>机密圣所</>兑换活动奖励。
guide_text_CC0_desc_4.en: Successfully completing a challenge with a Test Criterion for the first time provides a reward of <@gd.key>Vitrified Coins</>. More Vitrified Coins can be earned by completing Contract Missions. Vitrified Coins are exchangeable for event rewards at the <@gd.key>Secret Sanctuary</>.

guide_text_accelerate_mushroom_desc_1.cn: 触碰涡流团后，主控干员会加速一小段时间。
guide_text_accelerate_mushroom_desc_1.en: Touching a vortex gives a temporary speed boost to the controlled operator.

guide_text_achievement_1.cn: <@gd.key>光荣之路</>中收纳了塔卫二蚀刻章的各种信息。
guide_text_achievement_1.en: The <@gd.key>Path of Glory</> has information on various Talos-II engraved medals.

guide_text_achievement_2.cn: 管理员可以点击此处自由编辑、展示已获得的蚀刻章。
guide_text_achievement_2.en: Click here to edit and showcase the engraved medals acquired, Endministrator.

guide_text_achievement_2_ct.cn: 管理员可以按下<action=achievement_display_edit>自由编辑、展示已获得的蚀刻章。
guide_text_achievement_2_ct.en: Press <action=achievement_display_edit> to edit and showcase the engraved medals acquired, Endministrator.

guide_text_achievement_3.cn: 在<@gd.key>蚀刻章列表</>中，可查看蚀刻章的具体信息。
guide_text_achievement_3.en: The <@gd.key>Medal Album</> shows the details of various medals.

guide_text_achievement_4.cn: 点击蚀刻章条目，可以查看对应蚀刻章的具体信息，包括达成时间、获得条件等。
guide_text_achievement_4.en: Click on the engraved medal entry to view its details, the time by which it was acquired, and the criteria for acquiring it.

guide_text_achievement_4_ct.cn: 从蚀刻章条目处，可以查看对应蚀刻章的具体信息，包括达成时间、获得条件等。
guide_text_achievement_4_ct.en: Each engraved medal entry shows its details, the time by which it was acquired, and the criteria for acquiring it.

guide_text_achievement_5.cn: 点击此处，可以查看蚀刻章相关图标的详细说明。
guide_text_achievement_5.en: Click here to view details about various engraved medal icons.

guide_text_achievement_5_ct.cn: <@gd.key>长按</><action=achievement_list_help>，可以查看蚀刻章相关图标的详细说明。
guide_text_achievement_5_ct.en: <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=achievement_list_help> to view details about various engraved medal icons.

guide_text_achievement_6.cn: 点击此处可以添加想要展示的蚀刻章。
guide_text_achievement_6.en: Click here to add an engraved medal to the showcase.

guide_text_achievement_6_ct.cn: 按下<action=achievement_depot>，可以添加想要展示的蚀刻章。
guide_text_achievement_6_ct.en: Press <action=achievement_depot> to add an engraved medal to the showcase.

guide_text_achievement_7.cn: 添加完蚀刻章后，拖拽或点击编辑栏中的蚀刻章，放置到展示栏位上。
guide_text_achievement_7.en: After adding the engraved medals, drag or click the engraved medal in the editing bar to place it in the showcase slot.

guide_text_achievement_7_ct.cn: 添加完蚀刻章后，按下<action=common_confirm>拿起编辑栏中的蚀刻章，再次按下<action=common_confirm>放置到展示栏位上。
guide_text_achievement_7_ct.en: After adding the engraved medals, press <action=common_confirm> to pick up an engraved medal in the editing bar, then press <action=common_confirm> again to place it in the showcase slot.

guide_text_achievement_8.cn: 排布完毕后，点击此处保存，就能够在名片与帝江号展示蚀刻章了。
guide_text_achievement_8.en: After arranging the medals, click here to save the showcase and display the medals at the Profile screen and Dijiang.

guide_text_achievement_8_ct.cn: 排布完毕后，按下<action=achievement_edit_save>保存，就能够在名片与帝江号展示蚀刻章了。
guide_text_achievement_8_ct.en: After arranging the engraved medals, press <action=achievement_edit_save> to save the showcase and display them via the Profile screen and Dijiang.

guide_text_achievement_intro.cn: 光荣之路已开放，可点击此处进入。
guide_text_achievement_intro.en: The Path of Glory is now available. Click here to open it.

guide_text_achievement_intro_ct.cn: 光荣之路已开放，可在此处进入。
guide_text_achievement_intro_ct.en: The Path of Glory is now available. It can be accessed from here.

guide_text_achievement_picture1.cn: 编辑好的蚀刻章会在个人名片与帝江号展示，请继续推进主线任务进度，解锁更多展示方式。
guide_text_achievement_picture1.en: The edited medal showcase will be displayed at the personal Profile and Dijiang. Progress through the main mission to unlock more ways to display the medals.

guide_text_achievement_picture2.cn: 编辑好的蚀刻章会在个人名片与帝江号蚀刻章展示墙处展示，请继续探索、获得更多蚀刻章。
guide_text_achievement_picture2.en: Once edited and saved, the medal showcase will be displayed at the personal Profile and medal display wall aboard Dijiang. Keep exploring to earn more engraved medals.

guide_text_acid_intro_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>沉积酸</>可溶解部分难以溶解的材料，在工业系统中有丰富的使用场景。
例如<@gd.key>沉积酸</>与<@gd.key>赤铜粉末</>可在<@gd.key>反应池</>中合成生成<@gd.key>赤铜溶液</>。
guide_text_acid_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</> can dissolve typically insoluble materials, making it remarkably useful in the AIC Factory. For example, <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</> and <@gd.key>Cuprium Powder</> can be added to the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium Solution</>.

guide_text_acid_intro_desc_2.cn: 可使用<@gd.key>蓝铁瓶</>等容器对<@gd.key>沉积酸</>进行采集，后续可通过研发工业技术，解锁<@gd.key>二型耐酸水泵</>进行自动化采集。
guide_text_acid_intro_desc_2.en: Containers such as <@gd.key>Ferrium Bottles</> can be filled with <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</> to gather the fluid. AIC technologies can also be researched to unlock <@gd.key>Acid Resistant Pumps Mk II</> and automate the gathering process.

guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_1.cn: 点击此处，可前往<@gd.key>物资兑换处</>。
guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_1.en: Click here to go to the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_2.cn: 后续任务未解锁，需要<@gd.key>等待一段时间</>查看清波寨后续情况。在此期间管理员可以生产更多<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>支援据点，获取<@gd.key>援助成果券</>，并在<@gd.key>物资兑换处</>兑换。
guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_2.en: Subsequent missions are not yet unlocked. <@gd.key>Wait for a while</> before checking the situation at Qingbo Stockade. Meanwhile, produce more <@gd.key>Xiranite Chubby Lungs</> to support the outpost, acquire <@gd.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>, and trade the certs at the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3.cn: <@gd.key>物资兑换处</>的<@gd.key>2期物资</>已开放获取，点击此处，可前往物资兑换处查看。
guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3.en: <@gd.key>Phase 2 goods</> are now available at the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>. Click here to go to the Goods Exchange and check the details.

guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3_ct.cn: <@gd.key>物资兑换处</>的<@gd.key>2期物资</>已开放获取，按下<action=activity_limited_formula_shop>，可前往物资兑换处查看。
guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3_ct.en: <@gd.key>Phase 2 goods</> are now available at the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>. Press <action=activity_limited_formula_shop> to go to the Goods Exchange and check the details.

guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3_ct_1.cn: <@gd.key>物资兑换处</>的<@gd.key>2期物资</>已开放获取，按下<action=activity_limited_formula_settlement_shop>，可前往物资兑换处查看。
guide_text_activity_formula2_hint_3_ct_1.en: <@gd.key>Phase 2 goods</> are now available at the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>. Press <action=activity_limited_formula_settlement_shop> to go to the Goods Exchange and check the details.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_1.cn: 可以看到目前据点处于特殊时间中，对<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>有特殊的需求。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_1.en: The outpost is currently in a special period with a new demand for <@gd.key>Xiranite Chubby Lungs</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_10.cn: 获得的援助成果券可以在<@gd.key>物资兑换处</>兑换物资。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_10.en: Fruits of Altruism Certs can be traded for supplies at the <@gd.key>Goods Exchange</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_11_.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_12.cn: 请点击此处，查看<@gd.key>重息壤龙泡泡</>的物品详情。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_12.en: Click here to view item details of the <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_12_.cn: 请按下<action=show_item_tips>，查看<@gd.key>重息壤龙泡泡</>的物品详情。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_12_.en: Press <action=show_item_tips> to view item details of the <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_13.cn: 已解锁重息壤龙泡泡的<@gd.key>限时</>生产配方，请利用配方进行<@gd.key>重息壤龙泡泡</>的生产吧。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_13.en: The <@gd.key>limited-time</> production formula for Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung has been unlocked. Use it to produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lungs</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_14.cn: 提交<@gd.key>重息壤龙泡泡</>可同时<@gd.key>获得更多</>据点调度券与活动代币。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_14.en: Trading <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lungs</> also <@gd.key>earns more</> stock bills and Fruits of Altruism Certs from the outpost.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_2.cn: 请点击此处，进入据点管理界面。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_2.en: Click here to enter the Outpost Management screen.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_3.cn: 在特殊时间中，据点<@gd.key>调度券</>的累计速度会大幅增加。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_3.en: During this special period, the outpost will accumulate <@gd.key>stock bills</> at a greatly accelerated rate.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_4.cn: 请点击此处，进行货物选择。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_4.en: Click here to select the goods.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_6.cn: 请点击此处，查看<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>的物品详情。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_6.en: Click here to view item details of the <@gd.key>Xiranite Chubby Lung</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_6_c.cn: 请按下<action=show_item_tips>，查看<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>的物品详情。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_6_c.en: Press <action=show_item_tips> to view item details of the <@gd.key>Xiranite Chubby Lung</>.

guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_7.cn: 在特殊时间中，我们会额外获得新的生产配方，请使用这些配方进行<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>的制造吧。
guide_text_activity_formula2_produce_7.en: New production formulas can be acquired during the special period. Use the new formulas to produce <@gd.key>Xiranite Chubby Lungs</>.

<@gd.key>息壤龙泡泡</>可由<@gd.key>实验龙泡泡外壳</>和<@gd.key>实验铜骨骼</>在<@gd.key>封装机</>中合成制造获得。

Go to the <@gd.key>Database - Item Files</> or item details to check the formula for producing Xiranite Chubby Lungs.

guide_text_adventure_book_2.cn: <@gd.key>行动手册</>系统中集成了行动节点、日常任务、战术训练等功能，可帮助您更快熟悉塔卫二的各项事务。

guide_text_adventure_book_3.cn: 在<@gd.key>行动节点</>中，可以完成这些任务来获取行动资历和其他奖励。
guide_text_adventure_book_3.en: <@gd.key>Activity Nodes</> include missions that can be completed to earn Operational EXP and other rewards.

guide_text_adventure_book_4.cn: 完成当前阶段后，即可解锁下一阶段。

guide_text_adventure_book_7.cn: 完成日常任务可获得<@gd.key>活跃度</>，达到一定进度可获得奖励。
guide_text_adventure_book_7.en: Complete these daily tasks to gain <@gd.key>Activity Points</> and earn rewards.
