guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_1.cn:
现在需要解锁更高的权限等阶，才可以继续推进<@gd.key>主线任务</>。
随着权限等阶的提升，可获得各种奖励，如<@gd.key>装备制造模板</>和<@gd.key>理智上限提升</>。
guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_1.en: A higher Authority Level is required to progress through the <@gd.key>main mission</>. Gaining Authority Levels also provides various rewards such as <@gd.key>gear templates</> and <@gd.key>higher Sanity limits</>.

guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_2.cn:
完成任务、冒险探索、探索协议空间、放置矿机等各项行动都能为管理员积累<@gd.key>行动资历</>。
每当<@gd.key>行动资历</>积累到一定程度，<@gd.key>权限等阶</>都会得到提升。
guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_2.en: The Endministrator can earn <@gd.key>Operational EXP</> via various activities, such as completing missions and Protocol Spaces, exploring the world, and placing mining rigs. Having enough <@gd.key>Operational EXP</> raises the <@gd.key>Authority Level</>.

guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_3.cn: 可以在协议同步器中打开等阶晋升，查看后续权限等阶的奖励。
guide_text_adventure_levelup_des_3.en: Open the Protocol Synchronizer (Protosync menu) to open the Authority Level screen and see rewards at various Authority Levels.

guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 洁尔佩塔的战技会持续吸引附近的敌人，最后对范围内的敌人施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_02_1.en: Gilberta's battle skill continuously pulls in nearby enemies and then applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> to enemies within its area of effect.

guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>时，可以触发洁尔佩塔的连携技。
guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_03_1.en: Gilberta's combo skill is triggered when an enemy suffers an <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reaction</>.

guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_03_2.cn: 洁尔佩塔的连携技可以对敌人强制造成<#ba.airborne>击飞</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_03_2.en: Gilberta's combo skill forcibly applies <#ba.airborne>Lift</> on the enemy.

guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 洁尔佩塔的终结技会对范围内敌人施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>、<#ba.slow>缓速</>和<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>，使敌人受到的法术伤害提高。
guide_text_aglina_chartrain01_04_1.en: Gilberta's ultimate applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>, <#ba.slow>Slow</>, and <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</> to enemies in its area of effect. Arts Susceptible enemies take more Arts DMG.

guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 洁尔佩塔是兼具法术和物理能力的辅助干员。她可以在触发<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>后快速造成<#ba.airborne>击飞</>，并且施放终结技后可以对大范围内的敌人施加<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>效果。
guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_1.en: Gilberta is a supporter with both Arts and Physical abilities. She can quickly <#ba.airborne>Lift</> enemies after triggering <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reactions</>. Once cast, her ultimate also applies <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</> to enemies within a large area.

guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_2.cn: 洁尔佩塔的战技会产生<@ba.key>重力奇点</>，持续牵引敌人，最后还会爆炸并施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_2.en: Gilberta's battle skill creates a <@ba.key>gravity well</> that continuously pulls in nearby enemies before exploding and applying <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>.

guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_3.cn: 当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>时，可以发动洁尔佩塔的连携技：让范围内敌人受重力作用，受到<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>和强制<#ba.airborne>击飞</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_3.en: Gilberta's combo skill is triggered when an <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reaction</> is applied on the enemy. Her combo skill exerts gravitational effects that deal <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> and forcibly apply <#ba.airborne>Lift</> to enemies within the area of effect.

guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_4.cn: 洁尔佩塔的终结技会创造一个<@ba.key>重力紊乱区域</>，对区域内的敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>并施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>。处于<@ba.key>重力紊乱区域</>中的目标会受到<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_4.en: Gilberta's ultimate creates an <@ba.key>Anomalous Gravity Field</> that deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> and applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> to enemies in the area of effect. The <@ba.key>Anomalous Gravity Field</> also applies <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</> to targets within it.

guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_5.cn: 终结技可以对敌人施加<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>。此时配合<#ba.spelldmg>法术伤害</>输出型干员，可以造成大量<#ba.spelldmg>法术伤害</>。
guide_text_aglina_chartrial01_01_5.en: First cast Gilberta's ultimate to apply <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</> to enemies and create an opportunity for <#ba.spelldmg>Arts DMG</> operators to deal massive <#ba.spelldmg>Arts DMG</>.

guide_text_anchor_wave_des_1.cn:
锚点会源源不断地产生危险的<@gd.key>震荡波</>。
如果被震荡波所波及，则会被强制传送离开。
guide_text_anchor_wave_des_1.en: Ankhors can constantly emit dangerous <@gd.key>shockwaves</>. If the controlled operator is hit by this shockwave, the entire team will be forced to retreat.

guide_text_anchor_wave_des_2.cn: 只有击破<@gd.key>锚点核心</>，才能阻止震荡波的产生。
guide_text_anchor_wave_des_2.en: Destroy the <@gd.key>Ankhor core</> to stop the shockwaves.

guide_text_anchor_wave_des_3.cn: <@gd.key>源石树枝</>能形成<@gd.key>保护罩</>，进入保护罩可免受震荡波的伤害。
guide_text_anchor_wave_des_3.en: <@gd.key>Originium branches</> can generate a <@gd.key>protective shield</>. Get behind the shield for protection against the shockwaves.

guide_text_anchor_wave_des_4.cn: 某些源石树枝的保护罩在经受一次震荡波的攻击后就会破碎并失去保护效果，经过一段时间后才会恢复。
guide_text_anchor_wave_des_4.en: The shield of some Originium branches will shatter and lose its protective effects after taking a shockwave hit. Such shields will take a while to recover.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_1.cn: <@gd.key>提弗洛斯的靶场</>已经改装完毕，现在可以开始进行<@gd.key>模拟训练</>了。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_1.en: <@gd.key>Typhoeus's Archery Range</> has been renovated. It can now be used for archery <@gd.key>simulations</>.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_2.cn: 模拟训练中包含一系列箭矢芯片的<@gd.key>基础教学</>，完成后可解锁靶场中该芯片的<@gd.key>配置权限</>。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_2.en: The simulations include a series of <@gd.key>Basic Training</> stages for various arrow chips. Complete the stages to make the chips <@gd.key>available for the Set Chip feature</> of the Archery Range.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_3.cn: 当前靶场已解锁模拟训练中的<@gd.key>“游荡之声”</>基础教学。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_3.en: The Archery Range has unlocked Basic Training for the arrow chip, <@gd.key>"Persistent Echo"</>.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_4.cn: 在<@gd.key>限定时间内</>击破所有靶标即可完成训练。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_4.en: Shatter all targets <@gd.key>within the time limit</> to complete the training.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_5.cn: 完成“游荡之声”基础教学后，可解锁在靶场中<@gd.key>该芯片的配置权限</>。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_5.en: Complete Basic Training "Persistent Echo" to make the chip <@gd.key>available for the Set Chip feature</> of the Archery Range.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_6.cn: 当前教学训练中芯片配置已被<@gd.key>锁定为“游荡之声”</>。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_6.en: For this training, the chip slot is <@gd.key>locked to "Persistent Echo"</>.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_7.cn: 请开始挑战“游荡之声”基础教学。

guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_7_ct.cn: 按下<action=entry_enter>，请开始挑战“游荡之声”基础教学。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_1_7_ct.en: Press <action=entry_enter> to challenge Basic Training "Persistent Echo".

guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_1.cn: 完成“游荡之声”基础教学后，解锁了新型箭矢芯片<@gd.key>“蛮兽之怒”</>的基础教学。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_1.en: Completing Basic Training "Persistent Echo" also unlocks Basic Training for a new arrow chip, <@gd.key>"Beastly Rage"</>.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_2.cn: 完成此基础教学可解锁在靶场中该芯片的<@gd.key>配置权限</>。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_2.en: Complete this Basic Training to make the chip <@gd.key>available for the Set Chip feature</> of the Archery Range.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_5.cn: 当前教学芯片的配置已被锁定为<@gd.key>“游荡之声”</>和<@gd.key>“蛮兽之怒”</>。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_5.en: For this training, chips are set and locked to <@gd.key>"Persistent Echo"</> and <@gd.key>"Beastly Rage"</>.

guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_6.cn: 请开始挑战“蛮兽之怒”基础教学。

guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_6_ct.cn: 按下<action=entry_enter>，请开始挑战“蛮兽之怒”基础教学。
guide_text_archery_basic_level_2_6_ct.en: Press <action=entry_enter> to challenge Basic Training "Beastly Rage".

guide_text_archery_chip_bomb_desc_1.cn:
配置燃松之脂芯片后，箭矢可以向靶标附着燃松效果，当附着燃松效果的靶标受到伤害时会<@gd.key>产生爆炸</>，对附近的靶标造成伤害。
每层燃松会造成<@gd.key>1点</>爆炸伤害，每个靶标上最多可附着<@gd.key>3层</>燃松效果，附着层数越高则爆炸伤害越高。
guide_text_archery_chip_bomb_desc_1.en: Setting the Flaming Resin chip allows arrows to apply Resin on targets. Dealing DMG to targets with Resin <@gd.key>triggers an explosion</> that deals DMG to nearby targets. The explosion deals <@gd.key>1</> DMG per Resin stack. Each target can have up to <@gd.key>3</> Resin stacks. Apply more stacks of Resin to deal more DMG with the explosion.

guide_text_archery_chip_bomb_desc_2.cn:
被<@gd.key>能量护盾</>保护的靶标，不能通过燃松之脂<@gd.key>主动</>附着燃松，需要先将<@gd.key>能量护盾击破</>才能附着燃松。
<@gd.key>燃松爆炸</>无法对能量护盾造成伤害。
guide_text_archery_chip_bomb_desc_2.en: Flaming Resin arrows cannot <@gd.key>actively</> apply Resin to <@gd.key>shielded</> targets. The <@gd.key>target's shield must be broken first</> before you can apply Resin. <@gd.key>Resin explosions</> cannot deal DMG to shields.

guide_text_archery_chip_frozen_desc_1.cn:
配置寒冰之簇芯片后，箭矢可以<@gd.key>更快锁定</>并同时对<@gd.key>冻结多个靶标</>。
面对快速移动的靶标，可先切换至寒冰之簇对其冻结，再切换至游荡之声配合击破。
guide_text_archery_chip_frozen_desc_1.en: Setting the Rime Tip chip gives a <@gd.key>faster lock-on</> and allows arrows to <@gd.key>freeze multiple targets</>. Switch to Rime Tip to freeze fast-moving targets, then switch to Persistent Echo to shatter them.

guide_text_archery_chip_manu_desc_1.cn: 完成基础教学获取<@gd.key>对应箭矢芯片配方</>后，可在<@gd.key>简易制作</>中制作对应芯片。
guide_text_archery_chip_manu_desc_1.en: Complete Basic Training stages to acquire <@gd.key>arrow chip formulas</>. This allows you to craft the arrow chips via the <@gd.key>Crafting</> feature.

guide_text_archery_chip_manu_desc_2.cn: 在<@gd.key>随身装置格</>中装备箭矢芯片可改变<@gd.key>箭矢射击能力</>。
guide_text_archery_chip_manu_desc_2.en: Equip arrow chips in the <@gd.key>personal device slot</> of the Backpack to give the <@gd.key>Archery</> action special powers.

guide_text_archery_chip_multiple_desc_1.cn: 配置游荡之声芯片后，箭矢可以同时对<@gd.key>多个靶标</>进行锁定射击，可有效应对大量低耐久度靶标。
guide_text_archery_chip_multiple_desc_1.en: Setting the Persistent Echo chip allows arrows to lock onto <@gd.key>multiple targets</>, making them effective against multiple low HP targets.

guide_text_archery_chip_penetrate_desc_1.cn:
配置破曙之光芯片后，箭矢可以<@gd.key>穿透靶标</>造成1点伤害。
面对<@gd.key>直线排布</>的靶标，可以切换至破曙之光进行穿透射击。
guide_text_archery_chip_penetrate_desc_1.en: Setting the Dawnbreaker chip allows arrows to <@gd.key>pierce targets</> and deal 1 DMG to all targets hit. When facing multiple targets <@gd.key>arranged in a line</>, switch to Dawnbreaker to pierce and deal DMG to multiple targets at once.

guide_text_archery_chip_shield_breaker_d.cn: 屏障靶标有较高耐久度，若使用游荡之声需要多次命中才能击破，可灵活使用蛮兽之怒快速击破。
guide_text_archery_chip_shield_breaker_d.en: Barrier Targets have higher HP. It will take many Persistent Echo arrows to shatter them. Use Beastly Rage instead to shatter them more quickly.

guide_text_archery_chip_shield_breaker_d.cn: 配置蛮兽之怒芯片后，箭矢可以对<@gd.key>单个靶标造成2点伤害</>，持续命中同个目标时伤害会大幅提高。可使用蛮兽之怒快速击破屏障靶标。
guide_text_archery_chip_shield_breaker_d.en: Setting the Beastly Rage chip allows arrows to deal <@gd.key>2 DMG to a target</>. Repeated shots also deal massively more DMG. Use Beastly Rage to quickly defeat Barrier Targets.

guide_text_archery_close_interface.cn: 点击关闭靶场界面，与安德烈交谈。
guide_text_archery_close_interface.en: Click to close the Archery Range screen and talk to Andre.

guide_text_archery_close_interface_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_cancel>关闭靶场界面，与安德烈交谈。
guide_text_archery_close_interface_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the Archery Range screen and talk to Andre.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_1.cn: 除模拟训练外，还可以在靶场中进行<@gd.key>日常训练</>来提升箭术。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_1.en: In addition to simulations, the Archery Range also offers <@gd.key>Daily Exercise</> stages to improve your archery skills.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_10_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_cancel>关闭配置芯片界面。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_10_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the Set Chip screen.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_11.cn: 已完成芯片配置，现在可以<@gd.key>开始训练</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_11.en: Chip setting complete. You can now <@gd.key>start the exercise</>.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_2.cn: 当前靶场等级为1级，已解锁关卡<@gd.key>“日常训练01”</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_2.en: The Archery Range is currently at Level 1. <@gd.key>"Daily Exercise 01"</> has been unlocked.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_3.cn: 每个日常训练关卡包含<@gd.key>3个训练目标</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_3.en: Every Daily Exercise stage has <@gd.key>3 goals</>.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_4.cn: 提升靶场等级可<@gd.key>解锁更多日常训练关卡</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_4.en: Level up the Archery Range to <@gd.key>unlock more "Daily Exercise" stages</>.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_5.cn: 日常训练关卡存在<@gd.key>随机芯片强化机制</>，利用关卡机制配置对应芯片，可以更轻松地达成训练目标。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_5.en: Daily Exercise stages come with <@gd.key>random chip enhancement mechanics</>. Refer to these mechanics and use the Set Chip feature to fulfill the goals more easily.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_6.cn: 关卡机制和目标状态<@gd.key>每日重置</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_6.en: Stage mechanics and goal statuses are <@gd.key>reset every day</>.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_7.cn: 日常训练关卡可以自由配置芯片，点击进入<@gd.key>配置芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_7.en: In Daily Exercise stages, you can set chips of your choice. Click here to open the <@gd.key>Set Chip</> screen.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_7_ct.cn: 日常训练关卡可以自由配置芯片，按下<action=typhoea_training_configure_chip><@gd.key>配置芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_7_ct.en: In Daily Exercise stages, you can set chips of your choice. Press <action=typhoea_training_configure_chip> to open the <@gd.key>Set Chip</> screen.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_8.cn: 当前已解锁“游荡之声”和“蛮兽之怒”芯片，请配置<@gd.key>“游荡之声”</>芯片。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_8.en: The chips "Persistent Echo" and "Beastly Rage" have been unlocked. Set the <@gd.key>"Persistent Echo"</> chip.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_8_ct.cn: 当前已解锁“游荡之声”和“蛮兽之怒”芯片，请按下<action=common_confirm>配置<@gd.key>“游荡之声”</>芯片。
guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_8_ct.en: The chips "Persistent Echo" and "Beastly Rage" have been unlocked. Press <action=common_confirm> to set the <@gd.key>"Persistent Echo"</> chip.

guide_text_archery_daily_level_1_9_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to set the <@gd.key>"Beastly Rage"</> chip.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_1.cn: 已解锁“进阶训练”系列关卡，进阶训练难度更高，需要针对靶标特点<@gd.key>灵活配置</>不同的芯片。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_1.en: "Advanced Training" stages unlocked. These stages are more difficult. Take note of the target mechanics and use the <@gd.key>Set Chip</> feature to set different chips.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_2.cn: 点击此处可查看当前关卡的靶标详情。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_2.en: Click here to view details of the targets in the stage.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_2_ct.cn: 按下<action=typhoea_training_target_detail>可查看当前关卡的靶标详情。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_2_ct.en: Press <action=typhoea_training_target_detail> to view details of the targets in the stage.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_3.cn: 此处可以看到当前关卡可能出现的所有靶标。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_3.en: This shows all of the targets that might appear in this stage.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_4.cn: 此处可以看到每个靶标的情报信息。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_4.en: This shows the details of every type of target.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_5.en: Click to close the List of Targets.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_5_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the List of Targets.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_6.cn: 进阶训练关卡可以自由配置芯片，点击此处进入<@gd.key>配置芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_6.en: In Advanced Training stages, you can set chips of your choice. Click here to open the <@gd.key>Set Chip</> screen.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_6_ct.cn: 进阶训练关卡可以自由配置芯片，按下<action=typhoea_training_configure_chip>进入<@gd.key>配置芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_6_ct.en: In Advanced Training stages, you can set chips of your choice. Press <action=typhoea_training_configure_chip> to open the <@gd.key>Set Chip</> screen.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_7.cn: 点击即可装配或卸下对应芯片，<@gd.key>最多</>同时装配<@gd.key>两种芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_7.en: Click to set or remove a chip. A <@gd.key>maximum</> of <@gd.key>2 chip types</> can be set at once.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_7_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_confirm>即可装配或卸下对应芯片，<@gd.key>最多</>同时装配<@gd.key>两种芯片</>。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_1_7_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to set or remove a chip. A <@gd.key>maximum</> of <@gd.key>2 chip types</> can be set at once.

guide_text_archery_hard_level_2_1.cn: 进阶训练系列关卡也可以在此处进行芯片配置。
guide_text_archery_hard_level_2_1.en: You can use this feature to set chips for Advanced Training stages.

guide_text_archery_switch_hint_1.cn: 按<action=typhoea_hud_switch_chip>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>后<@gd.key>点击</>此处可切换箭矢进行射击。
guide_text_archery_switch_hint_1.en: Press <action=typhoea_hud_switch_chip> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and <@gd.key>click</> here to switch arrows.

guide_text_archery_switch_hint_1_mb.cn: 点击此处可切换箭矢进行射击。

guide_text_archery_switch_hint_2.cn: 当前箭矢已切换为蛮兽之怒。

guide_text_archery_switch_hint_3_ct.cn: 按住<action=typhoea_training_target_detail>或<action=typhoea_training_limited_task>可进入锁定状态，瞄准靶标。
guide_text_archery_switch_hint_3_ct.en: Press <action=typhoea_training_target_detail> or <action=typhoea_training_limited_task> to aim and lock onto targets.

guide_text_archery_wiki_desc_1.cn: 在提弗洛斯的靶场，可以通过完成<@gd.key>基础教学</>解锁多种<@gd.key>箭矢芯片</>，通过配置不同的箭矢芯片完成<@gd.key>进阶训练</>和<@gd.key>日常训练</>，获取对应奖励，完成关卡目标。
guide_text_archery_wiki_desc_1.en: In Typhoeus's Archery Range, complete <@gd.key>Basic Training</> stages to unlock various <@gd.key>arrow chips</>. Set and equip different arrow chips to complete <@gd.key>Advanced Training</> and <@gd.key>Daily Exercise</> stages to earn various rewards.

guide_text_archery_wiki_desc_2.cn:
花费<@gd.key>调度券</>，可以解锁提弗洛斯的靶场，并提升<@gd.key>靶场等级</>。
提升靶场等级后，能够解锁更多关卡，获得更丰厚的通关奖励。
guide_text_archery_wiki_desc_2.en: Spend <@gd.key>stock bills</> to unlock and <@gd.key>level up</> Typhoeus's Archery Range. Leveling up the archery range unlocks more stages that can be completed for generous rewards.

guide_text_archery_wiki_title_2.cn: 提弗洛斯的靶场 - 解锁与升级
guide_text_archery_wiki_title_2.en: Typhoeus's Archery Range: Unlocks and Upgrades

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 艾尔黛拉的战技会对目标造成自然伤害。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_1.en: Ardelia's battle skill deals Nature DMG to the target.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 解锁天赋<@ba.key>朋友的身影</>后，艾尔黛拉的战技命中敌人后生成<@ba.key>多利先生的影子</>。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_2.en: With the talent <@ba.key>Friendly Presence</> unlocked, Ardelia's battle skill also creates <@ba.key>Shadow of Mr. Dolly</> when it hits enemies.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_3.cn: 主控干员触碰<@ba.key>多利先生的影子</>后，艾尔黛拉为其回复生命值。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_02_3.en: When the controlled operator touches a <@ba.key>Shadow of Mr. Dolly</>, Ardelia grants HP restoration to the said operator.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 主控干员对不处于<#ba.noguard>破防</>或<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>的敌人造成重击后，可以发动艾尔黛拉的连携技。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_1.en: Ardelia's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on an enemy with no <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks or <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_2.cn: 艾尔黛拉的连携技可以对敌人施加<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_2.en: Ardelia's combo skill applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> on the enemy.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_3.cn: 艾尔黛拉的战技若命中处于<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态的敌人，会<#ba.consume>消耗</><#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态并对其施加<#ba.physicalvul>物理脆弱</>与<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_03_3.en: If Ardelia's battle skill hits an enemy with <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, it <#ba.consume>consumes</> the said <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> and applies <#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</> and <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</> to the said enemy.

guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 艾尔黛拉的终结技持续造成伤害并生成多个<@ba.key>多利先生的影子</>。
guide_text_ardelia_chartrain01_04_1.en: Ardelia's ultimate deals DMG over time and creates multiple <@ba.key>Shadows of Mr. Dolly</>.

guide_text_attacked_switch_desc_1.cn: 当<@gd.key>受击装置</>受到<@gd.key>攻击</>或<@gd.key>爆炸冲击</>会暂时改变运行状态。
guide_text_attacked_switch_desc_1.en: A <@gd.key>reactive device</> temporarily changes its operation mode when <@gd.key>attacked</> or <@gd.key>hit by an explosion</>.

guide_text_attribute_1.cn:
每位干员都具备力量、敏捷、智识、意志四种能力值。
四种能力会为干员提供<@gd.key>不同属性加成</>。
guide_text_attribute_1.en: Every operator has 4 attributes: Strength (STR), Agility (AGI), Intellect (INT), and Will (WILL). These attributes give operators <@gd.key>different stat bonuses</>.

guide_text_attribute_2.cn:
不同干员都有其擅长的<@gd.key>主能力</>和<@gd.key>副能力</>。
主能力提升时，会为干员额外提供<@gd.key>大量攻击力加成</>；副能力则会提供少量攻击力加成。
guide_text_attribute_2.en: Every operator has a <@gd.key>main attribute</> and a <@gd.key>secondary attribute</>. Increasing the main attribute gives the operator a <@gd.key>large bonus to Attack</>, while increasing the secondary attribute gives a smaller bonus to Attack.

guide_text_attribute_3.cn: 可在此处查看干员各项具体属性。
guide_text_attribute_3.en: This shows the operator's various stats.

guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 昼雪的战技会使周围干员获得<#ba.guard>庇护</>，如果期间受到攻击，会发动反击，并对敌人施加1层<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>。
guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_02_1.en: Snowshine's battle skill grants <#ba.guard>Protection</> to nearby operators. If Snowshine is attacked during her battle skill, she performs a retaliation bash that applies 1 stack of <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> on the enemy.

guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 当主控干员受到攻击后，如果生命值低于一定比例，可以发动昼雪的连携技。
guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_03_1.en: Snowshine's combo skill is triggered when the main controlled operator is attacked and the said operator is below a certain HP.

guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_03_2.cn: 昼雪的连携技会持续对主控干员附近的区域提供<@ba.heal>治疗</>。
guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_03_2.en: Snowshine's combo skill provides <@ba.heal>HP treatment</> in a small area around the controlled operator.

guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_04_1.cn:
昼雪的终结技会生成一个持续数秒的<@ba.key>冰雪地带</>。
处于<@ba.key>冰雪地带</>内的敌人一段时间后将被强制<#ba.frozen>冻结</>。
guide_text_aurora_chartrain01_04_1.en: Snowshine's ultimate creates a <@ba.key>Snow Zone</> that lasts for several seconds. The <@ba.key>Snow Zone</> forcibly applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</> to enemies who remain within it for too long.

guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 主控干员对处于<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>或<#ba.conduct>导电</>状态的目标造成<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>后，可以发动艾维文娜的连携技。
guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_02_1.en: Avywenna's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> on a target with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> or <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>.

guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 艾维文娜的连携技会掷出3枚<@ba.key>雷枪</>。

guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 艾维文娜的战技会召回全部<@ba.key>雷枪</>。<@ba.key>雷枪</>被召回时，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。
guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_03_1.en: Avywenna's battle skill retrieves all thrown <@ba.key>Thunderlances</>. A returning <@ba.key>Thunderlance</> deals DMG to all enemies hit along its path.

guide_text_avywen_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 艾维文娜的终结技可以投下一支<@ba.key>强雷枪</>。

guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 余烬的战技可以对敌人造成<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>，战技施放过程若受到过来自敌人的伤害，命中时额外造成一定失衡。
guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_02_1.en: Ember's battle skill applies <#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</> on the enemy. If Ember takes DMG from the enemy while casting her battle skill, the skill also deals some additional Stagger when it hits.

guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_02_2.cn: <#ba.knockdown>倒地</>：对敌人造成<#ba.noguard>破防</>，如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会叠加1层<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数并累积<@ba.poise>失衡值</>。
guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_02_2.en: <#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</>: Applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> on an enemy. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, then add 1 <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stack and deal <@ba.poise>Stagger</>.

guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 主控干员受到攻击时，可以发动余烬的连携技。
guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_04_1.en: Ember's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator is attacked.

guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_04_2.cn: 余烬的连携技会造成<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>并治疗主控干员。
guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_04_2.en: Ember's combo skill applies <#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</> to enemies, and also gives HP treatment to the controlled operator.

guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_05_1.cn: 余烬的终结技会对敌人造成伤害并使全队获得<#ba.shield>护盾</>。
guide_text_azrila_chartrain01_05_1.en: Ember's ultimate deals DMG to enemies and grants <#ba.shield>shields</> to the entire team.

guide_text_backup_power_1.cn: 在备用电源启用状态下，该地区所有设备将正常运转。
guide_text_backup_power_1.en: While Backup Power is active, all facilities in the region will work normally.

guide_text_backup_power_2.cn: 当前已自动启用备用电源，如需关闭请在此处取消勾选。
guide_text_backup_power_2.en: Backup Power is currently active. To switch it off, uncheck this box.

guide_text_backup_power_3.cn: 请关注当前集成工业系统的供电状态，以确保其在备用电源耗尽后能正常运转。
guide_text_backup_power_3.en: Please monitor your Automated Industry Complex (AIC) power supply so that AIC facilities can still work normally after Backup Power runs out.

guide_text_backup_power_4.cn: 备用电源已耗尽，当前正在恢复中。
guide_text_backup_power_4.en: Backup Power has been exhausted and is currently being charged up again.

guide_text_backup_power_5.cn: 备用电源将于玩家在线且存电耗尽时自动启用，如需关闭请取消勾选。
guide_text_backup_power_5.en: Backup Power will be auto-activated once power reserves are depleted while the player is online. To switch it off, uncheck this box.

guide_text_backup_power_desc_1.cn:
备用电源启用后，可在<@gd.key>30分钟</>内维持该地区设备的正常运转。
若协议核心自身的供电不足，则在备用电源持续时间结束后，仍会进入断电状态。
guide_text_backup_power_desc_1.en: Activating Backup Power keeps all AIC Factory facilities running normally for <@gd.key>30 minutes</>. However, if PAC power output is still insufficient, a power outage will still occur once the Backup Power duration ends.

guide_text_backup_power_desc_2.cn: 备用电源供电结束后，需要12小时恢复，恢复完成后可再次使用。
guide_text_backup_power_desc_2.en: After Backup Power duration ends, the feature will undergo a 12-hour cooldown before it can be used again.

guide_text_backup_power_desc_3.cn: 在线且某个地区断电时，将自动启用备用电源。备用电源默认自动启用，可手动取消自动启用功能。
guide_text_backup_power_desc_3.en: When a region experiences power outage while the Endministrator is online, Backup Power will be automatically activated by default. This auto-activation can be manually switched OFF.

guide_text_backup_power_hint.cn: 当前协议核心存电已耗尽，可在此处启用<@gd.key>备用电源</>。
guide_text_backup_power_hint.en: PAC power grid reserves have been depleted. <@gd.key>Backup Power</> can be activated here.

guide_text_bag_full_1.cn: 背包已满时，将暂时无法获取新物品，您可以考虑在安全区将多余物品<@gd.key>存入仓库</>，或<@gd.key>销毁</>不需要的物品。
guide_text_bag_full_1.en: No new items can be acquired when the Backpack is full. Go to a safe zone and move extra items to the <@gd.key>Depot</> or <@gd.key>destroy</> items no longer required.

guide_text_bagfull_hint_1.cn: 背包已满，<@gd.key>蓝铁瓶</>已存至仓库，可前往附近<@gd.key>协议传送点</>取至<@gd.key>背包</>
guide_text_bagfull_hint_1.en: Backpack is full. <@gd.key>Ferrium Bottles</> have been stored at the Depot. Go to the nearby <@gd.key>TP Point</> to move them into the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_balloon_desc_1.cn: 塔卫二分布着很多个<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>。靠近并交互后，即可获得<@gd.key>工业点数</>。
guide_text_balloon_desc_1.en: Many <@gd.key>Protocol Dataloggers</> can be found scattered across Talos-II. Approach and interact with them to acquire <@gd.key>AIC Index</>.

guide_text_balloon_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>协议采录桩</>已经被标记在了地图中，可以通过地图标记来定位<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>。
guide_text_balloon_desc_2.en: The locations of <@gd.key>Protocol Dataloggers</> are already marked on the map. Use map markers to find these <@gd.key>Protocol Dataloggers</>.

guide_text_balloon_gameplay_desc_1.cn: 通过<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>可以对待回收物品进行回收，管理员可改变气球在浮板上的位置，<@gd.key>使浮空回收装置平衡</>。平衡后，物品才会开始回收。
guide_text_balloon_gameplay_desc_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> to salvage a salvageable. Place and move balloons on the lifting platform to <@gd.key>balance the Aero-Salvager</>. Aero-salvaging can only proceed when the entire setup is balanced.

guide_text_balloon_gameplay_desc_2.cn: 待回收物品的大小等级不同，使用<@gd.key>简易制作</>可制造不同等级的<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>，以适应各种物品回收的需求。
guide_text_balloon_gameplay_desc_2.en: Salvageables come in different sizes. Use the <@gd.key>Crafting</> feature to craft <@gd.key>Aero-Salvagers</> of various levels to meet various salvaging requirements.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_1.cn: 在装配<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>后，可以开始回收物品。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_1.en: Once you have an <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> placed in the proper slot, you can start salvaging.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_2.cn: 可以点击此处，开始回收。

guide_text_balloon_recycle_2_mb.cn: 可以点击此处，开始回收。

guide_text_balloon_recycle_3.cn: 这里是所有可用的浮空气球，每个气球图标的数字代表其提供的<@gd.key>升力</>，右下角数字代表气球的数量。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_3.en: This shows all the lifting balloons available. The number on each balloon icon represents the <@gd.key>lifting power</> of the balloon, while the number at the lower right corner represents the number of balloons available.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_4.cn: 拖动将气球挂在浮板目标位置或改变气球的位置，每挂一个气球，浮板都会根据气球的<@gd.key>位置和升力</>发生横向和纵向倾斜。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_4.en: Drag to hook the balloons at the target positions of the lifting platform, or move the balloons to another position. Hooking a balloon will cause the lifting platform to tilt vertically and horizontally according to the <@gd.key>position and lifting power</> of all hooked balloons.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_4_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_confirm>选中气球,再次按下<action=common_confirm>将气球挂在浮板目标位置或改变气球的位置，每挂一个气球，浮板都会根据气球的<@gd.key>位置和升力</>发生横向和纵向倾斜。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_4_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select the balloons, then press <action=common_confirm> again to hook them at the targeted positions of the lifting platform, or move the balloons to another position. Hooking a balloon will cause the lifting platform to tilt vertically and horizontally according to the <@gd.key>positions and lifting powers</> of all hooked balloons.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_5.cn: <@gd.key>使用完所有的气球</>且<@gd.key>浮空回收装置平衡</>后，按下<@gd.key>完成回收</>按钮，装置会开始回收。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_5.en: Once <@gd.key>all balloons are placed</> and the <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager is balanced</>, click the <@gd.key>Complete</> button below to start aero-salvaging.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_desc_1.cn: 用于回收物品。可在<@gd.key>简易制作</>进行<@gd.key>制作</>和<@gd.key>升级</>。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_desc_1.en: A device for salvaging items. It can be <@gd.key>crafted</> and <@gd.key>upgraded</> with the <@gd.key>Crafting</> feature.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_1.cn: 已获得<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>，浮空回收器属于<@gd.key>随身装置</>，需要激活后才能使用。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_1.en: <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> acquired. The Aero-Salvager is a <@gd.key>personal device</> and must be activated for it to be usable.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_2.cn: 将<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>移动到<@gd.key>随身装置格</>中，即可激活浮空回收器。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_2.en: Move the <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> into a <@gd.key>personal device slot</> to activate the device.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>浮空回收器</>也属于<@gd.key>随身装置</>，与<@gd.key>枢壤仪</>相同，须放在<@gd.key>随身装置格</>中，才会生效。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</>, like the <@gd.key>Xiranite Nexus</>, is also a <@gd.key>personal device</> and must be placed in a <@gd.key>personal device slot</> to work.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_desc_2.cn: 装配浮空回收器后，可与<@gd.key>待回收物品</>交互，回收对应的物品。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_equip_desc_2.en: Once an Aero-Salvager is placed in the personal device slot, you can interact with various <@gd.key>salvageables</> to start salvaging them.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1.cn:
<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>属于<@gd.key>随身装置</>，需要通过<@gd.key>简易制作</>获得。
按下<action=common_open_inventory>键或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1.en: <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> is a <@gd.key>personal device</> and can only be acquired via the <@gd.key>Crafting</> feature. Press the hotkey <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1_ct.cn:
<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>属于<@gd.key>随身装置</>，需要通过简易制作获得。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>，打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> is a <@gd.key>personal device</> and can only be acquired via the Crafting feature. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1_mb.cn:
<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>属于<@gd.key>随身装置</>，需要通过简易制作获得。
点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_1_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> is a <@gd.key>personal device</> and can only be acquired via the Crafting feature. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_2_ct.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，进入<@gd.key>背包</>界面。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_2_ct.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_3_ct.cn: 选择<@gd.key>随身装置</>页签，已自动为您选中。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_3_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Personal Device</> tab has been automatically selected for you.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_4.cn: 在此选中查看<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>配方。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_4.en: Select this to view the <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> formula.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_4_ct.en: Press <action=inventor_open_manual_craft> to open the Crafting screen.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_5.cn: 要制作浮空回收器Ⅰ，我们需要用到装有<@gd.key>惰气</>的<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，使用刚刚获得的<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，在<@gd.key>惰气矿点</>收集惰气即可获得。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_5.en: Crafting Aero-Salvager Ⅰ requires <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> filled with <@gd.key>Inergen</>. We have just acquired some <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>. The next step is to extract Inergen from <@gd.key>Inergen vents</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_5_ct.cn: 附近有一处<@gd.key>惰气矿点</>，请按<action=manual_ui_back>关闭界面，前往附近的惰气矿点收集气体。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_5_ct.en: There is an <@gd.key>Inergen vent</> nearby. Press <action=manual_ui_back> to close the screen, then go to the Inergen vent and extract the gas.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_6.cn: 附近有一处<@gd.key>惰气矿点</>，请关闭界面，前往附近的惰气矿点收集气体。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_6.en: There is an <@gd.key>Inergen vent</> nearby. Close this screen and go to that Inergen vent to gather the gas.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_6_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> again to close the screen.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_1.cn: 已收集了足够的<@gd.key>惰气罐</>，可以在简易制作中制作<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>了。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_1.en: You now have enough <@gd.key>Inergen (Bottled)</>. Open the Crafting screen to craft <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_1_c.cn:
已收集了足够的<@gd.key>惰气罐</>，可以在<@gd.key>简易制作</>中制作<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>了。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>，打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_1_c.en: You now have enough <@gd.key>Inergen (Bottled)</>. Open the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen to craft <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</>. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_2_c.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，进入<@gd.key>背包</>界面。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_2_c.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_3_c.cn: 选择<@gd.key>随身装置</>页签，已自动为您选中。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_3_c.en: The <@gd.key>Personal Device</> tab has been automatically selected for you.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_4.cn: 材料足够，可以制作<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>了。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_manu_hint_4.en: You now have enough materials to craft <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</>.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_upgrade.cn: 已解锁更高级的<@gd.key>浮空回收器配方</>，制作更高级的<@gd.key>浮空回收器</>，可以应对后续更复杂的回收目标。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_upgrade.en: An advanced <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> crafting formula has been unlocked. Craft the more advanced <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager</> so you can complete more complicated salvaging jobs.

guide_text_balloon_recycle_use_1.cn: 未装配<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>，无法开始回收。请前往背包中将<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>置于<@gd.key>随身装置格</>中。
guide_text_balloon_recycle_use_1.en: The <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> must be placed in the personal device slot to start salvaging. Go to the Backpack and place <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</> in a <@gd.key>personal device slot</>.

guide_text_banana_peel_desc.cn: 似乎是野兽扔在地上的<@gd.key>陷阱</>，踩到就会摔倒。
guide_text_banana_peel_desc.en: A beast threw these to the ground to create a <@gd.key>trap</>. Anyone who steps on them will slip and fall.

guide_text_bandwidth_des_1.cn:
每个地区设有独立的<@gd.key>协议容量</>上限。
在<@gd.key>集成核心区域外</>放置设备会消耗协议容量。
不同类型的设备，消耗的协议容量也会有所不同。
当某个地区的协议容量达到上限时，该地区将无法放置新的设备。
guide_text_bandwidth_des_1.en: Every region has its own <@gd.key>Protocol Capacity</>. Different facilities take up different amounts of Protocol Capacity and placing them <@gd.key>outside the Core AIC Area</> uses up the Capacity. If Protocol Capacity of a region has been used up, no more facilities can be placed in that region.

guide_text_battery_desc_1.cn:
已完成谷地电池制造，热能池可改为使用<@gd.key>电池</>发电。
使用<@gd.key>电池</>发电可<@gd.key>大幅提高</>发电效率，降低源矿消耗。
guide_text_battery_desc_1.en: Valley batteries have been produced. Thermal Banks can also use <@gd.key>batteries</> to generate power. <@gd.key>Batteries</> generate <@gd.key>more</> power and reduce overall consumption of Originium Ore.

guide_text_battery_hint_1.cn: 当前发电功率较高，推荐热能池使用<@gd.key>电池发电</>，提高发电效率降低源矿消耗
guide_text_battery_hint_1.en: Power output is currently very high. Recommend using <@gd.key>battery power generation</> at the Thermal Banks to raise power efficiency and reduce Originium Ore consumption.

guide_text_battle_airborne_desc_1.cn:
带有<@ba.airborne>击飞</>的技能会使敌人<#ba.noguard>破防</>。
如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会真正触发<@ba.airborne>击飞</>的异常效果：叠加一层<#ba.noguard>破防</>（最多4层），造成<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>，累积一定<@ba.poise>失衡值</>，并使弱小的敌人浮空。
guide_text_battle_airborne_desc_1.en: Skills with the <@ba.airborne>Lift</> effect first make the enemy <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, such skills then apply the actual Physical Status of <@ba.airborne>Lifted</>: Adds 1 more <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stack (max: 4), deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and some <@ba.poise>Stagger</>, and lifts a weak enemy into mid-air.

guide_text_battle_airborne_desc_2.cn: 一些技能带有强制<@ba.airborne>击飞</>：无论敌人是否<#ba.noguard>破防</>，直接触发<@ba.airborne>击飞</>。
guide_text_battle_airborne_desc_2.en: Some skills can forcibly apply <@ba.airborne>Lift</>: Enemies are directly <@ba.airborne>Lifted</> into mid-air whether they are <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</> or not.

guide_text_battle_battle_debuff_1_desc_1.cn:
“酸洗”MK-Ⅰ通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
发射特制酸液弹，酸液弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并造成范围<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>，同时降低范围内敌人的防御力。
guide_text_battle_battle_debuff_1_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, the Acid Soaker Mk I tower can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower fires special acid bombs that deal <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> and apply DEF Reduction to enemies in the area of effect.

guide_text_battle_battle_trap_desc_1.cn:
AF1“熔甲者”通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
当敌人靠近时，AF1“熔甲者”会喷射火焰攻击敌人，对范围内的敌人持续造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_battle_trap_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, AF1 Armor Fragger can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower fires a flaming jet to attack approaching enemies. The flaming jet continuously deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> to enemies within range.

guide_text_battle_breakarmor_desc_1.cn:
带有碎甲的技能会使敌人<#ba.noguard>破防</>。
如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会真正触发<@ba.fracture>碎甲</>的异常效果：<#ba.consume>消耗</>目标所有<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数，使其在一段时间内受到的<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>提高。
guide_text_battle_breakarmor_desc_1.en: Skills with the Breach effect first make the enemy <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, then apply the actual Physical Status of <@ba.fracture>Breached</>: <#ba.consume>Consumes</> all active <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks and makes the target take more <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> for a certain duration.

guide_text_battle_breakarmor_desc_2.cn: <#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数越多，<@ba.fracture>碎甲</>使敌人受到的<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>提高效果越强。
guide_text_battle_breakarmor_desc_2.en: By <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks, <@ba.fracture>Breach</> makes the enemy take even more <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_cannon_2_desc_1.cn:
高爆榴弹塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
高爆榴弹会在敌人附近地面爆炸并造成范围<@gd.key>灼热伤害</>，同时留下一片燃烧区域。
guide_text_battle_cannon_2_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, HE Grenade Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower fires HE grenades that explode near enemies to deal <@gd.key>Heat DMG</> to the area of effect and leave a burning zone.

guide_text_battle_cannon_desc_1.cn:
榴弹塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
榴弹命中敌人后会爆炸，造成范围<@gd.key>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_cannon_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Grenade Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. The grenades explode upon hitting the enemy to deal <@gd.key>Heat DMG</> to the area of effect.

guide_text_battle_cold_desc_1.cn: 处于<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>状态的敌人再次被施加<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>时，会增加一层<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>，并受到<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_cold_desc_1.en: To an enemy with <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</>, applying another <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> adds 1 more stack of <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> and deals <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_combust_desc_1.cn:
处于其他<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>状态的敌人，再被施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>时，会<#ba.consume>消耗</>所有<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>，受到一次初始<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，并进入<@ba.burning>燃烧</>状态。
<@ba.burning>燃烧</>状态下，敌人每秒受到<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。伤害量基于触发<@ba.burning>燃烧</>的干员的攻击力。
guide_text_battle_combust_desc_1.en: To an enemy with a non-Heat <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>, applying <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> <#ba.consume>consumes</> all <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Inflictions</>, deals 1 initial hit of <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</>, and triggers the Arts Reaction of <@ba.burning>Combustion</>. An enemy with <@ba.burning>Combustion</> suffers <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> every second. The amount of DMG dealt is based on the ATK of the operator who triggered the <@ba.burning>Combustion</>.

guide_text_battle_combust_desc_2.cn:
触发<@ba.burning>燃烧</>时，<#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>层数越多，初始伤害和<@ba.burning>燃烧</>的伤害越高。
强制施加的<@ba.burning>燃烧</>不会有初始伤害。
guide_text_battle_combust_desc_2.en: When triggering <@ba.burning>Combustion</>, <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stacks deals higher DMG in the initial hit and higher <@ba.burning>Combustion</> DMG. Forcibly applied <@ba.burning>Combustion</> does not deal the initial hit of DMG.

guide_text_battle_conduct_desc_1.cn:
处于其他<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>状态的敌人，再被施加<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>时，会<#ba.consume>消耗</>所有<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>，受到一次初始<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，并进入<@ba.conduct>导电</>状态。
<@ba.conduct>导电</>状态下，敌人受到的<#ba.spelldmg>法术伤害</>会提高。
guide_text_battle_conduct_desc_1.en: To an enemy with non-Electric <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>, applying <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> <#ba.consume>consumes</> all <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>, deals 1 initial hit of <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>, and triggers the Arts Reaction of <@ba.conduct>Electrification</>. An enemy with <@ba.conduct>Electrification</> takes more <#ba.spelldmg>Arts DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_conduct_desc_2.cn:
触发导电时，<#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>层数越多，初始伤害越高，敌人受到<#ba.spelldmg>法术伤害</>提高的效果越强。
强制施加的<@ba.conduct>导电</>不会有初始伤害。
guide_text_battle_conduct_desc_2.en:
When triggering Electrification, <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stacks deals higher DMG in the initial hit and makes the enemy take even more <#ba.spelldmg>Arts DMG</>.
Forcibly triggered <@ba.conduct>Electrification</> does not deal the initial hit of DMG.

guide_text_battle_corrode_desc_1.cn:
处于其他<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>状态的敌人，再被施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>时，会<#ba.consume>消耗</>所有附着，受到一次初始<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>，并进入<@ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态：一段时间内全属性抗性逐渐下降，该效果存在上限。
如果刷新<@ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态，会维持之前的抗性下降。
guide_text_battle_corrode_desc_1.en:
To an enemy with non-Nature <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>, applying <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> <#ba.consume>consumes</> all Arts Infliction, deals 1 initial hit of <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>, and triggers the Arts Reaction of <@ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>: Resistance to all elements decreases over time until it reaches a certain minimum.
Refreshing the <@ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> does not change the amount of resistance reduction.

guide_text_battle_corrode_desc_2.cn:
触发<@ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>时，<#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>层数越多，初始伤害越高，<@ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>每秒降低的全属性抗性越多，降低全属性抗性效果的上限越高。
强制造成的<@ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>不会有初始伤害。
guide_text_battle_corrode_desc_2.en:
When triggering <@ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stacks deals higher DMG in the initial hit, makes <@ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> reduce more resistance against all elements per second, and reduce the resistance against all elements to an even lower minimum.
Forcibly applied <@ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> does not deal the initial hit of DMG.

guide_text_battle_electric charge_desc_1.cn: 甲二型“电荷”通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。释放电能攻击敌人，攻击会弹射到附近敌人（至多2次），造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，并在敌人附近留下电球，持续对附近敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_electric charge_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Electrochargers Model A-2 can automatically attack enemies within range. This tower releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>. The arc also leaves an electric orb close to the enemy. The orb continuously deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to nearby enemies.

guide_text_battle_fire_desc_1.cn: 处于<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>状态的敌人再次被施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>时，会增加一层<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>，并受到<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_fire_desc_1.en: To an enemy with <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, applying another <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> adds 1 more stack of <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> and deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_fog_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>“毒沼”MK-Ⅰ</>通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
特制毒雾弹爆炸后造成范围<@gd.key>自然伤害</>，同时在地面留下毒雾区，对敌人造成伤害及<@gd.key>减速效果</>。
guide_text_battle_fog_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, <@gd.key>Marsh Gas Mk I</> towers can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower fires special gas bombs that deal <@gd.key>Nature DMG</> to the area of effect and leave a Mist Zone that deals DMG and <@gd.key>slows</> enemies within it.

guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_1.cn:
处于其他<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>的敌人，再被施加<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>时，会<#ba.consume>消耗</>所有附着，受到一次初始<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>，并进入<@ba.frozen>冻结</>。
<@ba.frozen>冻结</>状态下，弱小的敌人无法行动。
guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_1.en: To an enemy with non-Cryo <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>, applying <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> <#ba.consume>consumes</> all Arts Infliction, deals 1 initial hit of <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</>, and triggers the Arts Reaction of <@ba.frozen>Solidification</>. A weak enemy with <@ba.frozen>Solidification</> cannot move.

guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_2.cn: 对处于<@ba.frozen>冻结</>状态的敌人施加<#ba.noguard>破防</>或<#ba.physicalstatus>物理异常</>时会触发<@ba.crystbreak>碎冰</>：<#ba.consume>消耗</>敌人<@ba.frozen>冻结</>状态，并造成大量<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_2.en: To an enemy with active <@ba.frozen>Solidification</>, applying <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> or <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Statuses</> triggers <@ba.crystbreak>Shatter</>: <#ba.consume>Consumes</> the enemy's <@ba.frozen>Solidification</> and deals massive <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_3.cn:
触发<@ba.frozen>冻结</>时，<#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>层数越多，初始伤害越高，<@ba.frozen>冻结</>持续时间越长，<@ba.crystbreak>碎冰</>的伤害越高。
强制施加的<@ba.frozen>冻结</>不会有初始伤害。
guide_text_battle_freeze_desc_3.en: When triggering <@ba.frozen>Solidification</>, <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stacks deals higher DMG in the initial hit, extends the duration of <@ba.frozen>Solidification</>, and deals more DMG upon <@ba.crystbreak>Shatter</>. Forcibly applied <@ba.frozen>Solidification</> does not deal the initial hit of DMG.

guide_text_battle_frost_desc_1.cn:
液氮塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
液氮晶体命中后会使敌人<@gd.key>减缓行动速度</>。
guide_text_battle_frost_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, LN Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. LN crystals can <@gd.key>slow the movement</> of enemies hit.

guide_text_battle_jet_desc_1.cn:
激流塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
当敌人靠近时，激流塔会发射一道激流，激流会使中型及小型敌人向攻击方向后退。
guide_text_battle_jet_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Deluge Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower fires a stream of deluge at approaching enemies. The stream pushes back small and medium enemies along the direction of the attack.

guide_text_battle_knockback_desc_1.cn:
带有<@ba.crush>猛击</>的技能会使敌人<#ba.noguard>破防</>。
如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会真正触发<@ba.crush>猛击</>的异常效果：<#ba.consume>消耗</>目标所有<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数，造成大量<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_knockback_desc_1.en: Skills with the <@ba.crush>Crush</> effect first make the enemy <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, such skills then apply the actual Physical Status of <@ba.crush>Crushed</>: <#ba.consume>Consumes</> all active <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks of the target to deal massive <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_knockback_desc_2.cn:
<#ba.consume>消耗</>的<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数越多，<@ba.crush>猛击</>的伤害越高。
先用<#ba.airborne>击飞</>、<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>叠加<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数，最后触发<@ba.crush>猛击</>，可以打出大量伤害。
guide_text_battle_knockback_desc_2.en: By <#ba.consume>consuming</> more <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks, <@ba.crush>Crush</> can deal more DMG. Use skills with <#ba.airborne>Lift</> or <#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</> effect to add <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stacks, then apply <@ba.crush>Crush</> to deal massive DMG.

guide_text_battle_knockdown_desc_1.cn:
带有倒地的技能会使敌人<#ba.noguard>破防</>。
如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会真正触发<@ba.knockdown>倒地</>的异常效果：叠加一层<#ba.noguard>破防</>（最多4层），造成<@ba.pd>物理伤害</>，累积一定<@ba.poise>失衡值</>，并将弱小的敌人击倒。
guide_text_battle_knockdown_desc_1.en: Skills with the Knock Down effect first make the enemy <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, such skills then apply the actual Physical Status of <@ba.knockdown>Knocked Down</>: Adds 1 more <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stack (max: 4), deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and some <@ba.poise>Stagger</>, and knocks down weak enemies.

guide_text_battle_knockdown_desc_2.cn: 一些技能带有强制<@ba.knockdown>倒地</>：无论敌人是否<#ba.noguard>破防</>，直接触发<@ba.knockdown>倒地</>。
guide_text_battle_knockdown_desc_2.en: Some skills can forcibly apply <@ba.knockdown>Knock Down</>: Enemies are directly <@ba.knockdown>Knocked Down</> to the ground whether they are <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</> or not.

guide_text_battle_laser_2_desc_1.cn:
高能射线塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
消耗大量充能向目标发射强力射线，优先锁定范围内威胁更高的敌人，对敌人造成高额<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_laser_2_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Hyper Beam Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. The tower prioritizes its attacks on high-threat enemies. It consumes a vast amount of power to fire a powerful beam that deals massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG </> at the target enemy.

guide_text_battle_laser_desc_1.cn:
射线塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
射线对<@gd.key>单个敌人</>杀伤性大，能够造成高额<@gd.key>电磁伤害</>但攻击间隔较长。
guide_text_battle_laser_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Beam Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. Beam Towers deal massive <@gd.key>Electric DMG</> against <@gd.key>a single enemy</> but have a slow rate of fire.

guide_text_battle_levelup_desc.cn:
击败敌人后，编队中的干员可以获得经验、提升等级。
提升等级后，干员的基础属性与能力值会得到提升。
guide_text_battle_levelup_desc.en: Defeating enemies gives team operators EXP. With enough EXP, operators can level up and improve their base stats and attributes.

guide_text_battle_lightning_desc_1.cn:
电涌塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
电流命中敌人后会进行至多2次弹射，对目标附近的敌人也造成<@gd.key>电磁伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_lightning_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Surge Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. After hitting an enemy, the arc surge can chain up to 2 times and deal <@gd.key>Electric DMG</> to enemies near the target.

guide_text_battle_nature_desc_1.cn: 处于<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>状态的敌人再次被施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>时，会增加一层<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，并受到<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_nature_desc_1.en: To an enemy with <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>, applying another <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> adds 1 more stack of <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> and deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_ope_combust_desc_1.cn:
一些敌人的技能会给干员施加<@ba.fire>灼热附着</>。
达到4层时，干员会进入<@ba.fire>燃烧</>状态：一段时间内，持续受到无视防御力的<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_ope_combust_desc_1.en: Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of <@ba.fire>Heat Infliction</> to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes <@ba.fire>Combusted</>: Temporarily suffer continuous <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> that ignores DEF.

guide_text_battle_ope_conduct_desc_1.cn:
一些敌人的技能会给干员施加<@ba.pulse>电磁附着</>。
达到4层时，干员会进入<@ba.pulse>导电</>状态：短暂眩晕，且一段时间内，受到的<#ba.spelldmg>法术伤害</>提高。
guide_text_battle_ope_conduct_desc_1.en: Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of <@ba.pulse>Electric Infliction</> to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes <@ba.pulse>Electrified</>: Temporarily stunned and take more <#ba.spelldmg>Arts DMG</> for a certain duration.

guide_text_battle_ope_corrode_desc_1.cn:
一些敌人的技能会给干员施加<@ba.natur>自然附着</>。
达到4层时，干员会进入<@ba.natur>腐蚀</>状态：一段时间内无法冲刺，且移动速度降低。
guide_text_battle_ope_corrode_desc_1.en: Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of <@ba.natur>Nature Infliction</> to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes <@ba.natur>Corroded</>: Cannot dash and suffer movement speed reduction for a certain duration.

guide_text_battle_ope_freeze_desc_1.cn:
一些敌人的技能会给干员施加<@ba.cryst>寒冷附着</>。
达到4层时，干员会进入<@ba.cryst>冻结</>状态：一段时间内无法行动。
guide_text_battle_ope_freeze_desc_1.en: Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of <@ba.cryst>Cryo Infliction</> to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes <@ba.cryst>Solidified</>: Cannot move for a certain duration.

guide_text_battle_pulse_desc_1.cn: 处于<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>状态的敌人再次被施加<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>时，会增加一层<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>，并受到<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_pulse_desc_1.en: To an enemy with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, applying another <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> adds 1 more stack of <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>.

guide_text_battle_rocket_1_desc_1.cn:
重锤迫击炮通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
消耗大量充能向目标发射威力极大的炮弹，对范围内敌人造成高额<@ba.phy>物理伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_rocket_1_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, the Sledgehammer Mortar tower can automatically attack enemies within range. It consumes massive amounts of power to fire extremely powerful shells at the target, creating explosions that deal massive <@ba.phy>Physical DMG</> to enemies within the area of effect.

guide_text_battle_shockwave_desc_1.cn:
全向声波塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
全向声波不造成伤害，命中后会使敌人<@gd.key>眩晕</>。
guide_text_battle_shockwave_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, the Omnidirectional Sonic Tower can automatically attack enemies within the area. The tower emits non-damaging sonic waves that <@gd.key>stun</> enemies they hit.

guide_text_battle_sniper_desc_1.cn:
哨戒塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
哨戒塔面对多名敌人时，会<@gd.key>优先攻击威胁更高的目标</>，敌人造成高额<@gd.key>物理伤害</>。
哨戒塔的攻击范围较大。
guide_text_battle_sniper_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Sentry Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. When facing multiple enemies, Sentry Towers will <@gd.key>first attack high threat targets</> and deal massive <@gd.key>Physical DMG</> to enemies. Sentry Towers also have a long attack range.

guide_text_battle_turret_2_desc_1.cn:
扩装铳械塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。
扩装铳械塔每3次攻击后第4次会发射一枚<@gd.key>强力能量弹</>，对敌人造成<@gd.key>物理伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_turret_2_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Heavy Gun Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. Every 4th round fired by the Heavy Gun Tower is an <@gd.key>empowered energy bolt</> that deals <@gd.key>Physical DMG</> to enemies.

guide_text_battle_turret_3_desc_1.cn: “暴雨”铳械塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，会自动攻击范围内的敌人。持续发射Ⅲ级能量弹，对敌人造成<@ba.phy>物理伤害</>，每第6次攻击会发射强力能量弹对范围内的敌人造成<@ba.phy>物理伤害</>。
guide_text_battle_turret_3_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Torrent Gun Towers can automatically attack enemies within range. This tower continuously fires Mk Ⅲ energy bolts and an empowered energy bolt for every 6th attack at enemies within range. The bolts deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG</>.

guide_text_beacon_desc.cn: 启动烽燧桩之前，需要点燃与它相关的三座祭坛。
guide_text_beacon_desc.en: Before activating a Balepyre Tower, you must first ignite the three altars linked to it.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_1.cn: 接下来将介绍如何使用<@gd.key>传送带</>进行自动化生产。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_1.en: Time to learn how to use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to automate production.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10.cn: 传送带具有<@gd.key>方向性</>，起点必须是物品的<@gd.key>出发地：次级核心</>，而终点必须是物品的<@gd.key>目的地：精炼炉</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10.en: The transport belt is <@gd.key>directional</>. It must start from the <@gd.key>item source: Sub-PAC</> and end at the <@gd.key>item destination: Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10_1.cn: 现在，精炼炉的输入口处已转换为<@gd.key>白色向内箭头</>，代表可以将传送带连入精炼炉中。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10_1.en: Now, the Refining Unit input ports have been replaced with <@gd.key>white inward arrows</>, indicating that the transport belt can be connected to them.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10_2.cn: 如地面上的引导线所示，成功放置传送带后，可将物品从次级核心取货口输入到精炼炉内。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_10_2.en: Follow the guiding line on the ground to place the transport belt. This moves items from the Sub-PAC output port to the input of the Refining Unit.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11.cn: 现在请通过<@gd.key>移动并<image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3>转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到精炼炉输入口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11.en: Now <@gd.key>move and adjust the view with <image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3></> to move the indicator cone to the specified Refining Unit input port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11_ct.cn: 现在请通过<@gd.key>移动并推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到精炼炉输入口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11_ct.en: Now, <@gd.key>move and adjust the view with the <action=common_rightstick> stick</> to move the indicator cone to the marked Refining Unit input port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11_mb.cn: 现在请通过<@gd.key>移动并转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到精炼炉输入口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_11_mb.en: Now <@gd.key>move and adjust the view</> to move the indicator cone to the specified Refining Unit input port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12.cn:
指示器移动到了正确位置，精炼炉此时也进入<@gd.key>选中并高亮</>状态，代表它是传送带的<@gd.key>终点</>。
<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse0" scale=1.3><@gd.key>确认终点</>，即可<@gd.key>完成</>传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12.en:
The indicator cone has been moved to the proper place and the Refining Unit has been <@gd.key>selected and highlighted</> to indicate that it is the <@gd.key>final destination</> of the transport belt. 
<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse0" scale=1.3><@gd.key>Confirm Ending Point</> to <@gd.key>complete</> placing the transport belt.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12_ct.cn:
指示器移动到了正确位置，精炼炉此时也进入<@gd.key>选中并高亮</>状态，代表它是传送带的<@gd.key>终点</>。
再次按下<action=fac_build_confirm_belt_end>，即可<@gd.key>完成</>传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12_ct.en:
The indicator cone has been moved to the proper place and the Refining Unit has been <@gd.key>selected and highlighted</> to indicate that it is the <@gd.key>final destination</> of the transport belt. 
Press <action=fac_build_confirm_belt_end> again to <@gd.key>complete</> the placement of the transport belt.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12_mb.cn:
指示器移动到了正确位置，精炼炉此时也进入<@gd.key>选中并高亮</>状态，代表它是传送带的<@gd.key>终点</>。
点击<@gd.key>确认终点</>，即可<@gd.key>完成</>传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_12_mb.en:
The indicator cone has been moved to the proper place and the Refining Unit has been <@gd.key>selected and highlighted</> to indicate that it is the <@gd.key>final destination</> of the transport belt. 
Tap <@gd.key>Confirm Ending Point</> to <@gd.key>complete</> placing the transport belt.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_13.cn: 现在，传送带已连接成功，可以看到，源矿正在持续从次级核心取货口<@gd.key>自动运输</>至精炼炉。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_13.en: Transport belt connection success. Originium Ore is now being <@gd.key>automatically transported</> from the Sub-PAC output port to the Refining Unit.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_14.cn: 精炼炉会用输入的源矿生产晶体外壳。下一步，需要把晶体外壳<@gd.key>运回仓库</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_14.en: The Refining Unit will use the Originium Ore arriving at its input port to produce Origocrusts. The next step is to <@gd.key>move the Origocrusts back to the Depot</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_2.cn: 观察次级核心取货口，这里出现了<@gd.key>向外的箭头</>，代表这里是<@gd.key>物流输出口</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_2.en: Observe the Sub-PAC output port. Note it has an <@gd.key>outward arrow</> to indicate that it is an <@gd.key>output port</> for transport and logistics purposes.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_3.cn: 另一侧的精炼炉的底座出现了<@gd.key>向内的箭头</>，代表这里是设备的<@gd.key>输入口</>。箭头的朝向都是<@gd.key>固定</>的。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_3.en: The Refining Unit nearby has <@gd.key>inward arrows</> at this side of its base. These mark the <@gd.key>input ports</> of the facility. The directions of these arrows are <@gd.key>fixed</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_4.cn: 将传送带从次级核心的<@gd.key>输出口</>连到精炼炉的<@gd.key>输入口</>中，就可以将刚才的源矿从<@gd.key>仓库</>自动输送进<@gd.key>精炼炉</>了。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_4.en: Connecting a transport belt from the Sub-PAC <@gd.key>output port</> to the Refining Unit <@gd.key>input port</> will automatically move the Originium Ore from the <@gd.key>Depot</> to the said <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5.cn: 工业模式下，按下快捷键<action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击<@gd.key>传送带</>按钮，进入<@gd.key>传送带建造模式</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5.en: In AIC Mode, press the hotkey <action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>transport belt</> button to enter <@gd.key>transport belt placement mode</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_1.cn: 可以看到地面上出现了红色的<@gd.key>锥形指示器</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_1.en: A red <@gd.key>indicator cone</> has appeared on the ground.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_1_mb.cn: 可以看到地面上出现了红色的<@gd.key>锥形指示器</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_1_mb.en: A red <@gd.key>indicator cone</> has appeared on the ground.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_ct.cn: 请按下<action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt>，进入<@gd.key>传送带建造模式</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_ct.en: Press <action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt> to enter <@gd.key>transport belt placement mode</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_mb.cn: 工业模式下，可以点击<@gd.key>传送带</>按钮，进入<@gd.key>传送带建造模式</>。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_5_mb.en: In AIC Mode, tap the <@gd.key>transport belt</> button to enter <@gd.key>transport belt placement mode</>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6.cn: 传送带需要从<@gd.key>物流输出口</>开始连接，无法在空地上放置，也不能在地面上的<@gd.key>红色叉形标记</><image="TermIcon/icon_term_ba_cross" scale=1.3>上放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6.en: Transport belts must be first connected to an <@gd.key>output port</>. They cannot be placed on empty ground or grids marked with <@gd.key>red crosses</><image="TermIcon/icon_term_ba_cross" scale=1.3>.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6_1.cn: 可以看到，场景中所有可以作为传送带起点的输出口都以地面上的<@gd.key>白色向外箭头</><image="Factory/Build/image_ui_build_exit_belt" width=40 height=40>表示。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6_1.en: All output ports that can serve as a starting point for transport belts are marked by <@gd.key>white outward arrows</> <image="Factory/Build/image_ui_build_exit_belt" width=40 height=40> on the ground.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6_mb.cn: 在指示器对准取货口后，<@gd.key>点击"确认"按键</>开始放置传送带，通过<@gd.key>移动并转动视角</>将虚影路径连接至传送带的终点处，<@gd.key>再次点击"确认"按键</>完成传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_6_mb.en: After moving the indicator cone at the output port, <@gd.key>tap the [Confirm] button </> to start placing the transport belt. <@gd.key>Move and adjust the view</> to follow the guiding lines and connect the belt to the destination. Finally, <@gd.key>tap [Confirm] again</> to complete transport belt placement.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7.cn: 现在，可以<@gd.key>移动角色并<image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3>转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到次级核心取货口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7.en: Now <@gd.key>move the operator and adjust the view with <image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3></> to move the indicator cone to the specified Sub-PAC output port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7_ct.cn: 现在，可以<@gd.key>移动角色并推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到次级核心取货口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7_ct.en: Now, <@gd.key>move the operator and adjust the view with the <action=common_rightstick> stick</> to move the indicator cone to the marked Sub-PAC output port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7_mb.cn: 现在，可以<@gd.key>移动角色并转动视角</>，将锥型指示器移动到次级核心取货口的指示位置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_7_mb.en: Now <@gd.key>move the operator and adjust the view</> to move the indicator cone to the specified Sub-PAC output port.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_8.cn: 使用<@gd.key><image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse0" scale=1.3>点击</>，即可<@gd.key>开始</>传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_8.en: <@gd.key>Click <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse0" scale=1.3></> to <@gd.key>begin</> placing the transport belt.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_8_ct.cn: 按下<action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start>，即可<@gd.key>开始</>传送带的放置。
guide_text_belt1_e1m6_8_ct.en: Press <action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start> to <@gd.key>start</> placing the transport belt.

guide_text_belt1_e1m6_8_mb.cn: 点击<@gd.key>确认起点</>，即可<@gd.key>开始</>传送带的放置。

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_1.cn: 传送带是一种基础物流设备，作用是在设备间运输各种材料，只限定在<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>中才可以建设传送带。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_1.en: Transport belts are basic logistics units. They are used to move materials and products between facilities. Transport belts can only be placed in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>.

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_2.cn: 在集成核心区域点击传送带按钮开始放置传送带，点击地面或任意拥有输入输出口设备的输出输入口，可以规划出传送带的方向和路线。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_2.en: Click the transport belt button at the Core AIC Area to start placing transport belts. Click on the ground, facility outputs, or facility inputs to determine the directions of the transport belt and plan its route.

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_2_ct.cn: 在集成核心区域按下<action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt>开始放置传送带，对准地面或任意拥有输入输出口设备的输出输入口，按下<action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start>后，即可规划出传送带的方向和路线。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_2_ct.en: In the Core AIC Area, press <action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt> to start placing transport belts. Target any grid on the ground, facility outputs, or facility inputs, then press <action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start> to start setting the directions of the transport belt and planning its route.

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_3.cn: 放置传送带时，设备的输入口与取货口的物流方向会用明显的箭头标出。传送带的起点必须是设备或者已放置的传送带。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_3.en: When placing transport belts, the input and output ports of facilities will be marked with conspicuous arrows. Any transport belt must start from a facility or another transport belt already placed.

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_4.cn:
工业设备的操作面板上也可查看传送带的物流信息。
左侧表示设备的<@gd.key>输入口</>以及传送带自动<@gd.key>输入</>的材料情况。
右侧表示设备的<@gd.key>取货口</>以及传送带自动<@gd.key>输出</>的产物情况。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_4.en: The control panels of AIC Factory facilities also show their logistics info. The LEFT side represents the facility's <@gd.key>input ports</> and auto-<@gd.key>loading</> of materials from incoming transport belts. The RIGHT side shows the facility's <@gd.key>output ports</> and auto-<@gd.key>unloading</> of products to outgoing transport belts.

guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_5.cn: 当出现阻塞情况时，物品将停止输入设备或从设备输出，操作面板下方会出现阻塞警示。
guide_text_belt_e1m6_limited_5.en: When a facility is clogged, the facility will stop loading materials or unloading products. The bottom part of control panel will also display warning signs that the facility is clogged.

guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_1.cn: 所有模拟目标达成后，此处会显示为完成状态。
guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_1.en: When all simulation goals are completed, the completed status will be shown here.

guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2.cn: 按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击<@gd.key>完成模拟</>按钮，或使用快捷键<action=common_open_watch>都可以完成模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2.en: Hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>End SIM</> button, or press the hotkey <action=common_open_watch> to complete the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_open_watch>即可完成并退出模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_watch> to complete and exit the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2_mb.cn: 点击<@gd.key>完成模拟</>按钮即可完成并退出模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_complete_2_mb.en: Tap the <@gd.key>End SIM</> button to complete and exit the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1.cn: <@gd.key>工业设备</>可对不同原料进行加工，用以生产各类工业材料和成品。精炼炉对应<@gd.key>精炼</>这一加工方式。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1.en: <@gd.key>AIC facilities</> can process different raw materials to produce various factory goods and products. The Refining Unit processes materials by <@gd.key>refining</> them.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_10.cn: 接下来请前往<@gd.key>粉碎机</>处，生产修复所需的<@gd.key>源石粉末</>材料。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_10.en: Next, go to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Originium Powder</> needed to repair our production line.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1_1.cn: 这里显示了当前背包中可用的材料，可以看到我们现在有一批<@gd.key>源矿</>可用于加工。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1_1.en: This shows the usable materials in the current Backpack. There is a batch of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> that can be used for production.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1_2.cn: 将合适的材料放入不同设备进行加工，便可生产出不同的产物。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_1_2.en: Place the right materials in the facility and it will process them into various products.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_2.cn: 我们需要生产<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>来修复中继器。本次模拟中该设备已设定只能使用这一<@gd.key>生产配方</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_2.en: We must produce some <@gd.key>Origocrusts</> to fix this Relay Tower. The facility of this simulation can only use this <@gd.key>production formula</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_3.cn: 可以看到，每1份<@gd.key>源矿</>原料，
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_3.en: This shows that each unit of the raw material, <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>,

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_4.en: can be processed for a certain time,

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_5.cn: 可精炼为1份<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>产物。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_5.en: and give the refined product: 1 unit of <@gd.key>Origocrust</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_6.cn: 现在将<@gd.key>源矿</>从背包拖入精炼炉中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_6.en: Let's drag the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> from the Backpack into the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_6_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>将原料放入精炼炉中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_6_1_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to place the raw materials into the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_6_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to perform actions on the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_7.cn: 精炼炉已经开始运转了，加工需要耗费一点时间，让我们等它生产3份晶体外壳。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_7.en: The Refining Unit is doing its job. Processing will take a while. Let's wait till 3 units of Origocrust are produced.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_8.cn: 加工的产物会已经自动存放在了缓存区中，点击按钮进行收取吧。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_8.en: The products will be automatically placed in the facility's cache. Click the button to take them.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_8_ct.cn: 加工的产物会已经自动存放在了缓存区中，按下<action=common_function_btn_1>进行收取吧。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_8_ct.en: The products will be automatically placed in the facility's cache. Press <action=common_function_btn_1> to gather them.

guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_9.cn: 点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_1_furance_9.en: Click the close button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_1.cn: 粉碎机对应<@gd.key>粉碎</>这一加工方式，本次模拟中该设备已设定只能使用<@gd.key>源石粉末</>配方。
guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_1.en: The Shredding Unit processes materials by <@gd.key>shredding</> them. The facility of this simulation can only use the <@gd.key>Originium Powder</> formula.

guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_2.cn: 在这里可以看到，每份<@gd.key>源矿</>可以粉碎为1份<@gd.key>源石粉末</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_2.en: Each unit of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> can be shredded into 1 unit of <@gd.key>Originium Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_3.cn: 现在就参照刚刚的方式，将<@gd.key>源矿</>从背包拖入到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中进行加工吧。
guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_3.en: Refer to what we did in the previous steps and drag the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> from the Backpack into the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_4.cn: 请等粉碎机进行生产，我们需要3份<@gd.key>源石粉末</>来进行修复。
guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_4.en: Let the Shredding Unit process the materials. We need 3 units of <@gd.key>Originium Powder</> for the repair job.

guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_5.cn: 生产完成了，点击按钮进行收取吧。
guide_text_blackbox_1_grinder_5.en: Production complete. Click the button to claim the products.

guide_text_blackbox_1_ore_1.cn: 很好，有了源矿作为原料，我们就可以使用工业设备来加工获取修复所需的材料了。
guide_text_blackbox_1_ore_1.en: Great. We can use AIC facilities to process Originium Ore into products we need for repairing things.

guide_text_blackbox_1_ore_2.cn: 接下来请前往<@gd.key>精炼炉</>处，生产修复所需的<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_ore_2.en: Now let's go to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and produce the <@gd.key>Origocrust</> we need for the repair.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_1.cn: 中继器需要修复才能恢复电力传输功能。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_1.en: The Relay Tower must be repaired so that it can start transmitting power once more.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_2.cn: 在这里可以看到，修复中继器需要用到3份<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>和3份<@gd.key>源石粉末</>
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_2.en: This shows that repairing the Relay Tower requires 3 units of <@gd.key>Origocrust</> and 3 units of <@gd.key>Originium Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3.cn: 这些材料都可由<@gd.key>源矿</>经<@gd.key>工业设备</>加工获得。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3.en: These materials can be acquired by processing <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> with the right <@gd.key>AIC facilities</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_1.cn: 请点击材料图标查看它的详细信息。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_1.en: Click the icon of a material to view its details.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_focus_on_item_list>查看物品的详细信息。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_focus_on_item_list> to view details of the item.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_2.cn: 晶体外壳是一种常用的工业材料。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_2.en: Origocrust is a common type of factory goods.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_3.cn: 它可以通过将<@gd.key>源矿</>放入<@gd.key>精炼炉</>来加工获取。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_3_3.en: It is a processed product made by placing <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> in a <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_4.cn: 请点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_4.en: Click the close button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_5.cn: 看，这附近就分布了一些源矿，攻击这些晶体就可以进行采集。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_5.en: Look. There are some Originium Ore formations nearby. Attack and break them up into gatherable bits.

guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_6.cn: 现在就先来采集一些源矿作为原料吧。
guide_text_blackbox_1_powerpole_6.en: Now let's gather some Originium Ore for raw materials.

guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_1.cn: 如果不小心将耗尽了材料不知道如何继续的话。
guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_1.en: When running out of raw materials or feeling stuck,

guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_2.cn: 可以按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处的<@gd.key>重置</>按钮来重新开始模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_2.en: Hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>Reset</> button here to restart the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_2_mb.cn: 可以点击此处的<@gd.key>重置</>按钮来重新开始模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_2_mb.en: Tap the <@gd.key>Reset</> button here to restart the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_3.cn: 这边的储存箱中也备有更多<@gd.key>源矿</>，可以前往取用。
guide_text_blackbox_1_restart_3.en: This Stash also contains plenty of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> that can be used.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_1.cn: 欢迎来到<@gd.key>模拟空间</>。塔卫二分布着很多这样的空间，在其中可以学习集成工业系统的基本操作。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_1.en: Welcome to the <@gd.key>simulation</>. These VR spaces are scattered across Talos-II and teach the basics of using the AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_2.cn: 在模拟空间中，背包、仓库以及设备与外部世界中的<@gd.key>不共通</>，但在这里学到的知识同样适用于外界。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_2.en: Simulations have their own set of Backpack and Depot items as well as facilities <@gd.key>not shared</> with those in the real world. However, the lessons and tricks learned in simulations are also useful outside.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_3.cn: 在这里可以查看当前模拟空间的<@gd.key>模拟目标</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_3.en: This shows the <@gd.key>goals</> of the current simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_4.cn: 达成<@gd.key>主要模拟目标</>后可完成模拟并获得相应的奖励，详细信息可点击<action=common_open_watch>进行查看。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_4.en: Finish the <@gd.key>main goals</> to complete the simulation and collect rewards. Click <action=common_open_watch> for more details.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_5.cn: 在本次模拟中，此<@gd.key>中继器</>的故障导致矿场出现了断电问题，我们需要<@gd.key>修复</>它来恢复电力。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_5.en: This simulation has experienced a mining site power outage as the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> is broken. We must <@gd.key>fix</> the Relay Tower to restore power to the place.

guide_text_blackbox_1_start_6.cn: 请前往此处与<@gd.key>中继器</>交互查看它的损坏情况。
guide_text_blackbox_1_start_6.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> and interact with it to view its damages.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>中继器</>交互查看它的损坏情况。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> to view its damages.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step0_2.cn: 请通过攻击采集获取6个<@gd.key>源矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step0_2.en: Attack and gather 6 units of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step1_1.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>精炼炉</>处，生产修复所需的<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>材料。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step1_1.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and produce the <@gd.key>Origocrust</> required for the repairs.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step2_1.cn: 请将<@gd.key>源矿</>放入<@gd.key>粉碎机</>加工，并收取3份<@gd.key>源石粉末</>。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step2_1.en: Place <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> in the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> for processing and take 3 units of <@gd.key>Originium Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step3_1.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>粉碎机</>处，生产修复所需的<@gd.key>源石粉末</>材料。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step3_1.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> and produce the <@gd.key>Originium Powder</> required for the repairs.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step4_1.cn: 所需的材料已经备齐了，请前往<@gd.key>损坏的中继器</>处对其进行修复。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step4_1.en: We have all the materials needed for the repair. Go to the <@gd.key>damaged Relay Tower</> to fix it.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1.cn: 模拟目标已达成，请点击<@gd.key>完成模拟</>按钮，或使用快捷键<action=common_open_watch>完成模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1.en: Simulation goals completed. Click the <@gd.key>End SIM</> button, or press the hotkey <action=common_open_watch> to complete the simulation.
