guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1_ct.cn: 模拟目标已达成，请按下<action=common_open_watch>完成模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1_ct.en: Simulation goals achieved. Press <action=common_open_watch> to complete the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1_mb.cn: 模拟目标已达成，请点击<@gd.key>完成模拟</>按钮完成模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_1_step5_1_mb.en: Simulation goals completed. Click the <@gd.key>End SIM</> button to complete the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_2_produce_1.cn: 在操作面板中，也可以查看其传送带的连接情况。
guide_text_blackbox_2_produce_1.en: Open the control panel to view transport belt connection details.

guide_text_blackbox_2_produce_2.cn: 左侧显示了设备的所有输入口。连接传送带后，可以在这里看到物品输入的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_2_produce_2.en: The left side shows all the input ports of the facility. When connected to a transport belt, it will also show items being delivered into the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心</>所在的<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>适合进行大面积的集成工业建设。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_1.en: The <@gd.key>PAC</> is located in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>, which is suitable for deploying a large AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_2.cn: 在<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>中可以使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接各个工业设备， 从而实现自动化的物流运输。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_2.en: While in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>, <@gd.key>transport belts</> can be used to connect AIC Factory facilities together and automate the transportation of materials and products.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_3.cn: 这里可以看到，<@gd.key>传送带</>正在将源矿从<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>运输到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_3.en: This shows that the <@gd.key>transport belt</> is moving Originium Ore from the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_4.cn: 源矿在进入精炼炉后会被加工为晶体外壳，并存放在缓存区中等待收取或输出。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_4.en: Placing Originium Ore in the Refining Unit processes it into Origocrust. The product is then stored at the cache for collection or transport.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_5.cn: 我们需要使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接<@gd.key>精炼炉</>与<@gd.key>协议核心</>，将晶体外壳自动运输回<@gd.key>仓库</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_5.en: We must use a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to connect the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Automation-Core</>. This will automatically move the Origocrust produced to the <@gd.key>Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_2_start_6.cn: 再参照此方式，搭建从<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>再到<@gd.key>协议核心</>的荞花粉末产线。
guide_text_blackbox_2_start_6.en: Reference these steps and create a Buckflower Powder production line starting from the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> to the <@gd.key>PAC</>.

guide_text_blackbox_2_step0_1.cn: 请先与<@gd.key>精炼炉</>交互，查看它的物流情况。
guide_text_blackbox_2_step0_1.en: First interact with the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to view its logistics info.

guide_text_blackbox_2_step2_6.cn: 接下来就使用传送带依次连接<@gd.key>协议储存箱、粉碎机、协议核心</>来完成物流连接吧。
guide_text_blackbox_2_step2_6.en: Next, connect transport belts to the facilities in this order: <@gd.key>Protocol Stash, Shredding Unit, and PAC</>.

guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_1.cn: <@gd.key>晶体外壳粉末</>可由晶体外壳在<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中加工得来。
guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_1.en: <@gd.key>Origocrust Powder</> can be made by processing Origocrust with the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_2.cn: 可以打开对应设备查看<@gd.key>生产配方</>。
guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_2.en: Interact with the facility to view the <@gd.key>production formula</>.

guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_3.cn: 可以先将源石运输到精炼炉中生成晶体外壳；再将晶体外壳运输至粉碎机中生成晶体外壳粉末。
guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_3.en: Transport Originium Ore to the Refining Unit to make Origocrust, then move the Origocrust to the Shredding Unit to make Origocrust Powder.

guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_4.cn: 最后将晶体外壳粉末运输至高亮的目标储存箱中。通电的储存箱可将产物无线传输回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_4.en: Finally, transport the Origocrust Powder to the highlighted target stash. The powered stash will use belt-free transfer to move its contents to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_5.cn: 记得使用供电桩给精炼炉、粉碎机、高亮的储存箱供电！使用尽量少的供电桩可以完成附加奖励目标！
guide_text_blackbox_3_grinder_5.en: Remember, the Refining Unit, Shredding Unit, and highlighted stash must be powered with the Electric Pylon! Use as few Electric Pylons as possible to complete the bonus goal and earn more rewards!

guide_text_blackbox_3_step1_1.cn: 请使用传送带连接各设备，形成荞花粉末产线。最后存入<@gd.key>高光的储物箱</>。
guide_text_blackbox_3_step1_1.en: Connect the facilities with transport belts to create a Buckflower Powder production line, and move the product to the <@gd.key>highlighted stash</>.

guide_text_blackbox_3_step2_1.cn: 请使用传送带连接各设备，形成晶体外壳粉末产线。最后存入<@gd.key>高光的储物箱</>。记得要放置供电桩给设备通电！
guide_text_blackbox_3_step2_1.en: Connect the facilities with transport belts to create an Origocrust Powder production line, then move the product to the <@gd.key>highlighted stash</>. Don't forget to place Electric Pylons for powering the facilities!

guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_0.cn: 主要目标达成了！本次模拟还有一个<@gd.key>附加目标</>，一起来看一下吧。
guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_0.en: Main goals completed! This simulation also has a <@gd.key>bonus goal</>. Let's take a look.

guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_1.cn: <@gd.key>附加目标</>不影响模拟的完成，但如果能够同时达成，还可获得额外的<@gd.key>附加目标奖励</>。
guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_1.en: The <@gd.key>bonus goal</> will not affect the completion of the simulation, but completing it gives <@gd.key>bonus goal rewards</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_2.cn: 想要运输更多源矿到仓库，需要先从附近的<@gd.key>便携源石矿机</>中手动收取源矿到背包中。
guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_2.en: To move more Originium Ore to the Depot, Originium Ore must be manually moved from the <@gd.key>Portable Originium Rig</> to the Backpack.

guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_3.cn: 再与已通电的<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>交互，将源矿从背包拖入储存箱中进行无线传输。
guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_3.en: Next, interact with a powered <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> and move the Originium Ore from the Backpack into the Stash for belt-free transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_4_extra_4.cn: 有兴趣的话就来试一试吧。

guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_1.cn: 不小心将供电桩无线传输回了仓库，无法为其他储存箱供电怎么办？
guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_1.en: An Electric Pylon has been accidentally moved back to the Depot by belt-free transfer. These Stashes have no power. What should we do?

guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_2.cn: 别担心，将其他协议储存箱移动到现有<@gd.key>供电桩的供电范围</>内同样可以进行供电。
guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_2.en: Don't worry. Move the other Protocol Stash to the <@gd.key>power supply radius of the existing Electric Pylon</> to power it.

guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_3.cn: 此外还可以通过<@gd.key>重置</>按钮重新开始模拟。
guide_text_blackbox_4_hint_3.en: The <@gd.key>Reset</> button can also be used to restart the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_4_power_1.cn: 在非集成核心区域放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>时，供电桩不会自动连电。
guide_text_blackbox_4_power_1.en: <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> placed outside the Core AIC Area cannot supply power immediately.

guide_text_blackbox_4_power_2.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>中继器</>处，选择<@gd.key>开始电力运输</>，再返回供电桩处<@gd.key>完成电力运输</>，以将其接入电网。
guide_text_blackbox_4_power_2.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> and select <@gd.key>Start Transmission</> to start pulling a power transmission cable, then go to the Electric Pylon, then select the <@gd.key>Plug Transmission Cable</> to complete the power transmission and connect it into the power grid.

guide_text_blackbox_4_start_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议储存箱</>的<@gd.key>无线传输</>功能可以将物品远程送回协议核心仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_4_start_1.en: The <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> can use <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> to teleport items to the PAC Depot directly.

guide_text_blackbox_4_start_2.cn: 请与此<@gd.key>已通电的协议储存箱</>交互，了解<@gd.key>无线传输功能</>的使用方法。
guide_text_blackbox_4_start_2.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>powered Protocol Stash</> to learn how to use <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_step1_1.cn: 请与此<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>交互，查看<@gd.key>无线传输功能</>的使用方法。
guide_text_blackbox_4_step1_1.en: Interact with this <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> to see how to use <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_step2_1.cn: 请在这批协议储存箱附近放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>进行供电。
guide_text_blackbox_4_step2_1.en: Place an <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> near these Protocol Stashes to power them.

guide_text_blackbox_4_step3_1.cn: 请通过中继器和供电桩为<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>供电，再启动<@gd.key>无线传输模式</>将源矿运回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_4_step3_1.en: Use the Relay Tower and the Electric Pylon to power the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</>, then activate <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> to move Originium Ore to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议储存箱</>可以用来存放物品，这里可以看到这个储物箱已经装满了源矿。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_1.en: <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> can be used for storing items. Here, we can see that this Stash is filled with Originium Ore.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_10.cn: 这里可以看到<@gd.key>源矿</>已经被无线传输到<@gd.key>本地仓储</>之中了。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_10.en: Here we can see that <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> is moved to the <@gd.key>local depot</> via belt-free transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_12.cn: 接下来我们只要为各协议储存箱供电并启动<@gd.key>无线传输</>功能，就可以将所有源矿运回仓库了。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_12.en: Now we'll just have to power all the Protocol Stashes and activate their <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> functions to move all the Originium Ore to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_13.cn: <@gd.key>供电桩</>在接入电网后可以为其附近的设备供电。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_13.en: An <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> connected to the power grid can supply power to nearby facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_14.cn: 下面就使用<@gd.key>供电桩</>为协议储存箱供电，再启动<@gd.key>无线传输模式</>，将所有源矿运回仓库吧。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_14.en: Let's use the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> to power the Protocol Stash, then activate <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> to move the Originium Ore to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_2.cn: 这里显示了当前协议储存箱的运转模式，在<@gd.key>仓储模式</>下，物品会正常存储，不会进行传输。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_2.en: This shows the current operational status of the Protocol Stash. In <@gd.key>Storage Mode</>, the Protocol Stash will hold on to its contents instead of transferring them to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_3.cn: 请点击这里更改模式，将其切换到<@gd.key>无线传输模式</>以启用自动传输功能。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_3.en: Click here to change its mode to <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> and activate this auto-transport feature.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_3_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>将其切换到<@gd.key>无线传输模式</>以启用自动传输功能。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_3_1_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch to <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> and activate this auto-transport feature.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_3_ct.en: Press <action=common_controller_side_menu> to expand the facility's <@gd.key>Quick Action</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_4.cn: 在<@gd.key>无线传输模式</>下，<@gd.key>已通电</>的协议储存箱可以将其内部存放的物品远程传输到<@gd.key>协议核心仓库</>
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_4.en: In <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> mode, the <@gd.key>powered</> Protocol Stash will teleport its contents to the <@gd.key>PAC Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_5.cn: 无线传输每隔一段时间会自动进行一次，这里可以看到它下次传输的倒计时。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_5.en: Belt-free transfer is automatically performed at regular intervals. This shows the countdown to the next transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_6.cn: 倒计时结束后，储存箱内部存放的物品会全部无线传输到仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_6.en: Once the countdown ends, all items in the Protocol Stash will be teleported directly to the Depot via belt-free transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8.cn: 请按下<action=fac_open_hub_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开协议核心面板查看仓库信息。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8.en: Press <action=fac_open_hub_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) panel and view the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8_1_ct.cn: 请请按下<action=common_toggle_group_down>打开协议核心面板查看仓库信息。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_toggle_group_down> to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) panel and view the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8_mb.cn: 请点击此处打开协议核心面板查看仓库信息。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_8_mb.en: Tap here to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) panel and view the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_9.cn: 储物箱在开启无线传输后<@gd.key>每隔一段时间</>都会自动将内部的物品传输回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_4_storager_9.en: After belt-free transfer is switched on, the Stash will automatically move its contents to the Depot at a <@gd.key>fixed interval</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_1.cn: 很好，电驱矿机已经将开采的紫晶矿无线传输回仓库了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_1.en: Great. The Electric Mining Rigs are moving the mined Amethyst Ore to the Depot via belt-free transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2.cn: 请按下<action=fac_open_hub_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开协议核心面板查看仓储信息。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2.en: Press <action=fac_open_hub_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the PAC screen to view the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_toggle_group_down>打开协议核心面板查看仓储信息。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_toggle_group_down> to open PAC panel to view storage information.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2_mb.cn: 请点击此处打开协议核心面板查看仓储信息。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_2_mb.en: Tap here to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) details panel to view storage management.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_3.cn: 电驱矿机在运转后<@gd.key>每隔一段时间</>都会自动将开采的矿物无线传输回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_3.en: The Electric Mining Rig will automatically move mined ores to the Depot via belt-free transfer on a <@gd.key>regular interval</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_4.cn: 这里可以看到我们刚刚开采的<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>已经被传输到了<@gd.key>本地仓储</>之中。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_4.en: Here, we can see the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> we mined being teleported to the <@gd.key>local depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_5.cn: 参照这一方式在更多矿点放置电驱矿机就可以实现矿物的自动开采和传输了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_5.en: Use this method to place Electric Mining Rigs on additional mining spots to achieve automated ore mining and transport.

guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_7.cn: 接下来请使用<@gd.key>滑索</>返回集成核心区对这批开采到的紫晶矿进行加工吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_bag_7.en: Next, let's use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to return to the Core AIC Area and process the Amethyst Ore we just mined.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_1.cn: 本次模拟还有一个<@gd.key>附加目标</>，一起来看一下吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_1.en: This simulation also has a <@gd.key>bonus goal</>. Let's take a look.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_2.cn: <@gd.key>附加目标</>不影响模拟的完成，但如果能够同时达成，还可获得额外的<@gd.key>附加目标奖励</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_2.en: The <@gd.key>bonus goal</> will not affect the completion of the simulation, but completing it gives <@gd.key>bonus goal rewards</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_3.cn: 本次模拟的附加目标需要我们开采源矿并将其运回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_3.en: The bonus goal of this simulation requires us to mine Originium Ore and transfer the mined ore back to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_4.cn: 请<@gd.key>返回矿区</>参照刚刚的方式使用<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>来进行<@gd.key>源矿</>的自动开采和传输吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extra_4.en: <@gd.key>Return to the mining area</> and use the same method to automatically mine and transfer <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> with <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_1.cn: 电驱矿机同样可以用来开采源矿。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_1.en: Electric Mining Rigs can also be used for mining Originium Ore.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_2.cn: 将源矿点上的<@gd.key>便携便携源石矿机</>收纳，并在上面放置新的<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_2.en: Stash the <@gd.key>Portable Originium Rigs</> from the Originium Ore mining spots, then place the new <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> on them.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_3.cn: 再使用<@gd.key>供电桩</>为电驱矿机供电即可实现源矿的<@gd.key>自动开采和传输</>，感兴趣的话就来试试吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extramine_3.en: Then place <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> to power the Electric Mining Rigs to achieve <@gd.key>auto-mining and transfer</> of the Originium Ore.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_0.cn: 请先使用<@gd.key>滑索</>返回矿区。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_0.en: Use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to return to the mining area.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_1.cn: 附加目标需要我们前往源矿点处放置电驱矿机。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_1.en: The bonus goal requires us to place Electric Mining Rigs on the Originium Ore mining spots.

guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_3.cn: 电驱矿机<@gd.key>每隔一段时间</>会自动将开采的矿物送回仓库。在源矿点上放置<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>并<@gd.key>供电</>后还请稍等一会。
guide_text_blackbox_5_extrastep_3.en: The Electric Mining Rig will, <@gd.key>on a regular basis</>, automatically move mined ores to the Depot via belt-free transfer. After placing an <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> on an Originium Ore mining spot and <@gd.key>powering</> it, wait a while before the mined ore arrives at the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_1.cn: 电驱矿机可以自动开采矿石并存入缓存区。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_1.en: The Electric Mining Rig will automatically mine ores and store them in its cache.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_2.cn: <@gd.key>通电后</>每隔一段时间，缓存区的矿石会自动<@gd.key>无线传输回仓库</>，为协议核心提供对应矿物的产能。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_2.en: When <@gd.key>powered</>, ores in the cache will be automatically <@gd.key>moved to the Depot via belt-free transfer</> on a regular interval, adding ore production to the PAC.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_3.cn: 要想让电驱矿机运转起来，就需要用<@gd.key>供电桩</>来为其供电。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_3.en: Use <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> to power Electric Mining Rigs and make them mine the ores.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_4_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_5.cn: 可以看到矿场内还分布了一些<@gd.key>紫晶矿点</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_5.en: This mining site has several <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore mining spots</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_6.cn: 接下来，请在各矿点上放置<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_6.en: The next step is to place <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> on each mining spot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_7.cn: 并在附近放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>，以为其提供电力。
guide_text_blackbox_5_miner_7.en: Place an <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> nearby to power the rigs.

guide_text_blackbox_5_oreminer_1.cn: 便携源石矿机只能通过手动的方式运输矿石，将其替换为电驱矿机可以大幅提升获取源矿的效率。
guide_text_blackbox_5_oreminer_1.en: Originium Ore mined by Portable Originium Rigs must be manually moved out of its cache. Replace them with Electric Mining Rigs to increase the efficiency of Originium Ore mining.

guide_text_blackbox_5_oreminer_2.cn: 按下收纳还可以将设备收回到背包里，之后就可以在此矿点上放置电驱矿机了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_oreminer_2.en: Press the Stash button to stash the facility into the Backpack. An Electric Mining Rig can then be placed on the mining spot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_power_1.cn: 注意，在非集成核心区域的野外放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>时，供电桩不会自动连电。
guide_text_blackbox_5_power_1.en: Note, <@gd.key>Electric Pylons</> placed outside the Core AIC Area cannot supply power to other facilities immediately.

guide_text_blackbox_5_power_2.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>中继器</>处，选择<@gd.key>开始电力运输</>，再返回供电桩处<@gd.key>完成电力运输</>，以将其接入电网。
guide_text_blackbox_5_power_2.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> and select <@gd.key>Start Transmission</> to start pulling a power transmission cable, then go to the Electric Pylon, then select the <@gd.key>Plug Transmission Cable</> to complete the power transmission and connect it into the power grid.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_1.cn: 刚刚我们通过电驱矿机开采到的紫晶矿已经被<@gd.key>无线传输回协议核心仓库</>了，现在就来看看吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_1.en: The Amethyst Ore mined by our Electric Mining Rigs has been moved to the <@gd.key>local PAC depot via belt-free transfer</>. Let's take a look.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2.cn: 在集成核心区域中<@gd.key>背包和仓库是连通的</>，请按下<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开<@gd.key>背包和仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2.en: The <@gd.key>Backpack is connected to the Depot</> in the Core AIC Area. Press <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open both the <@gd.key>Backpack and Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2_1_ct.cn: 在集成核心区域中<@gd.key>背包和仓库是连通的</>，请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，打开<@gd.key>背包和仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Backpack is connected to the Depot</> in the Core AIC Area. Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick and select this option to open the <@gd.key>Backpack and Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2_mb.cn: 在集成核心区域中<@gd.key>背包和仓库是连通的</>，请点击此处打开<@gd.key>背包和仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_2_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Backpack is connected to the Depot</> in the Core AIC Area. Tap here to open the <@gd.key>Backpack and Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_3.cn: <@gd.key>电驱矿机</>开采到的矿物会通过无线传输自动传回<@gd.key>协议核心仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_3.en: Ores mined by the <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> will be automatically moved to the <@gd.key>PAC Depot</> via belt-free transfer.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_4.cn: 在这里可以看到我们刚刚开采到的<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>已经被传输回仓库等待加工了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_4.en: Here, we can see the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> we mined has been moved to the Depot. The ore can now be processed.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_6.cn: 紫晶矿可通过精炼炉中加工为<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>，可以看到场地中已经放置了所需的设备。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_6.en: Amethyst Ore can be processed by the Refining Unit to produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>. Check the area. The required facility has already been placed.

guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_7.cn: 接下来请前往<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>进行设置，将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>从仓库输送到精炼炉中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_5_quartz_7.en: Next, let's go to a <@gd.key>PAC output port</> and set it up so that it moves <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> from the Depot to the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_1.cn: 欢迎来到<@gd.key>模拟空间</>。塔卫二分布着很多这样的空间，在其中可以学习集成工业系统的基本操作。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_1.en: Welcome to the <@gd.key>simulation</>. These VR spaces are scattered across Talos-II and teach the basics of using the AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_2.cn: 在模拟空间中，背包、仓库以及设备与外部世界中的<@gd.key>不共通</>，但在这里学到的知识同样适用于外界。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_2.en: Simulations have their own set of Backpack and Depot items as well as facilities <@gd.key>not shared</> with those in the real world. However, the lessons and tricks learned in simulations are also useful outside.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_3.cn: 在这里可以查看当前模拟空间的<@gd.key>模拟目标</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_3.en: This shows the <@gd.key>goals</> of the current simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_4.cn: 达成<@gd.key>主要模拟目标</>后可完成模拟并获得相应的奖励，详细信息可按下<action=common_open_watch>进行查看。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_4.en: Finish the <@gd.key>main goals</> to complete the simulation and collect rewards. Press <action=common_open_watch> for more details.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_4_mb.cn: 达成<@gd.key>主要模拟目标</>后可完成模拟并获得相应的奖励，详细信息可点击此按钮进行查看。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_4_mb.en: Finish the <@gd.key>main goals</> to complete the simulation and collect rewards. Click this button for more details.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_5.cn: 在本次模拟中，我们需要使用工业设备来开采矿物。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_5.en: In this simulation, we must use AIC facilities to mine mineral ores.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_6.cn: <@gd.key>电驱矿机</>可以用来开采<@gd.key>源矿和紫晶矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_6.en: The <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> can be used for mining <@gd.key>Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_7.cn: 在<@gd.key>通电</>后，电驱矿机会自行运转，并每隔一段时间将开采到的矿石<@gd.key>无线传输回仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_7.en: Once <@gd.key>powered</>, Electric Mining Rigs will automatically <@gd.key>move the mined minerals to the Depot via belt-free transfer</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_8.cn: 请先与此<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>交互，查看它的功能。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_8.en: First interact with the <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> to view its functions.

guide_text_blackbox_5_start_9.cn: 请与<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>交互，查看它的功能。
guide_text_blackbox_5_start_9.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> to view its details.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_1_1.cn: 请与此<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>交互，查看它的使用方法。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_1_1.en: Interact with this <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> to see how to use it.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_0_1.cn: 请放置<@gd.key>供电桩</>为3个<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>其提供电力。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_0_1.en: Place an <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> to power the 3 <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_1.cn: 请先在紫晶矿点上再放置2个<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_1.en: Place 2 more <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> on Amethyst Ore mining spots.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_1_1.cn: 电驱矿机正在进行<@gd.key>无线传输</>，请维持3个电驱矿机正常转运并稍等片刻。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_2_1_1.en: The Electric Mining Rigs are performing <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</>. Keep the 3 Electric Mining Rigs operational and wait for a while.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_3_1.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>滑索</>返回集成核心区域加工开采到的紫晶矿。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_3_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to return to the Core AIC Area and process the Amethyst Ore we just mined.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_1.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>从仓库输出到精炼炉中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_1.en: Go to the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to move <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> from the Depot to the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2.cn: 请按下<action=common_interact>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>设定要从协议核心输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2.en: Press <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to set the item to move out from the PAC.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_interact>在<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>中设定要输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_interact> to set the item to move out from the <@gd.key>PAC output port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2_mb.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>设定要输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_5_step_4_2_mb.en: Tap the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to set the item to move out of it.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_1.cn: 协议核心取货口可以将物品从仓库输送到传送带上，每个取货口可设定一种物品进行输出。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_1.en: PAC output ports can move items from the Depot to a connected transport belt. Each output port can unload one selected item from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_2.cn: 请点击这里选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_2.en: Click here to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_3.cn: 这里列出了当前协议核心仓库中的可用物品，可以看到刚刚电驱矿机开采到<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>已经被传输回仓库了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_3.en: This is a list of items that can be unloaded from the PAC Depot. It also shows the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> just mined and delivered to the Depot by the Electric Mining Rigs.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_4.cn: 请先点击<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>进行选择。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_4.en: Click on the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to select it.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_5.cn: 看，现在这个取货口可以持续输出紫晶矿了，请点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_5.en: Look. The output port is continuously unloading Amethyst Ore from the Depot. Click the close button to exit this panel.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_5_ct.cn: 看，现在这个取货口可以持续输出紫晶矿了，请按下<action=common_cancel>退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_5_ct.en: Look. The output port is continuously unloading Amethyst Ore from the Depot. Press <action=common_cancel> to exit this panel.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_6.cn: 现在精炼炉可以将电驱矿机开采到的紫晶矿自动加工为<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_6.en: The Refining Unit can now auto-process the Amethyst Ore mined by the Electric Mining Rigs into <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_7.cn: 电驱矿机同样可以用来开采源矿，今后就请参照这种方式进行更多矿物的自动开采和加工吧。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_7.en: Electric Mining Rigs can also be used for mining Originium Ore. Use this method to automatically mine and process more minerals.

guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_step.cn: 请等待<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>从取货口输送到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_5_unloader_step.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to be transported from the output port to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_7_bag_1.cn: 注意，在本次模拟中，我们并没有仓库的<@gd.key>手动存取权限</>。因此<@gd.key>无法</>通过拖放对背包和仓库中的物品进行转移。
guide_text_blackbox_7_bag_1.en: NOTE: <@gd.key>Manual Depot unloading and loading</> have been disabled in this simulation. <@gd.key>No items can be manually transferred</> to or from the Backpack or Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_bag_2.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接工业设备到<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>，以将产出的物品运输回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_7_bag_2.en: Connect the AIC facility to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> with a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move the products to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_block_2.cn: 加工设备产出的物品会存放在缓存区中，当<@gd.key>缓存区</>满后就会出现阻塞。
guide_text_blackbox_7_block_2.en: An AIC Factory processing facility will store its products in its <@gd.key>cache</>. The facility is clogged when its cache is full.

guide_text_blackbox_7_block_3.cn: 使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接设备取货口到协议核心的输入口，即可将产物运回仓库从而避免阻塞。
guide_text_blackbox_7_block_3.en: Connect the facility output port to the Automation-Core input port with a <@gd.key>transport belt</>. This will move products to the Depot and unclog the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_1.cn: 干得好，现在粉碎机产出的<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>可以通过传送带<@gd.key>自动运输回仓库</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_1.en: Nice work. The <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> made by the Shredding Unit is now being <@gd.key>automatically transported</> to the PAC Depot via the transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_2.cn: 这样我们就成功搭建了一条<@gd.key>自动化的荞花粉末</>产线。
guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_2.en: We have successfully placed an <@gd.key>automated Buckflower Powder</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_3.cn: 接下来只要<@gd.key>等待产线运转</>就可以在协议核心仓库中<@gd.key>储备一批荞花粉末</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_3.en: Let the <@gd.key>production line work for a while</> and provide the PAC Depot with a <@gd.key>stock of Buckflower Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_4.cn: 今后也可以参照这个方式来搭建更多自动化产线，储备不同类型的药品和材料。
guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_4.en: Reference this method to place more automated production lines for various medications and materials.

guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_5.cn: 接下来请<@gd.key>等待产线运转</>，让荞花粉末运输回协议核心仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_7_complete_5.en: Let the <@gd.key>production line work for a while</> for the Buckflower Powder to be transported back to the PAC Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_1.cn: 想要完成<@gd.key>附加目标</>，还需要在现有晶体外壳的产线上进行一点调整。
guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_1.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, the existing Origocrust production line must be adjusted.

guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_2.cn: 请先删除将晶体外壳送回仓库的这条<@gd.key>传送带</>。
guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_2.en: First, delete the <@gd.key>transport belt</> moving Origocrust to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_3.cn: 再放置<@gd.key>粉碎机</>，并将精炼炉产出的晶体外壳输送到粉碎机中以生产<@gd.key>晶体外壳粉末</>。
guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_3.en: Then place a <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> and transport Origocrust made by the Refining Unit to the Shredding Unit to produce <@gd.key>Origocrust Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_4.cn: 最后别忘了连接从粉碎机到协议核心输入口的<@gd.key>传送带</>，将产出的晶体外壳粉末送回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_7_extra_4.en: Don't forget to connect the Shredding Unit to the PAC input port with a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to transport the Origocrust Powder produced to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_1.cn: 让我们先来看一下集成核心区中原有的这条自动化生产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_1.en: Let's look at the current automated production line in this Core AIC Area.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_2.cn: 在协议核心两侧分布了多个<@gd.key>取货口</>。取货口可以将选定的物品<@gd.key>从仓库中取出</>，并不断输送到传送带上。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_2.en: The PAC has multiple <@gd.key>output ports</> along two of its sides. Use an output port to continuously <@gd.key>move a selected item from the Depot</> to the connected transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_3.cn: 这里可以看到，仓库中的源矿正在通过<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>和<@gd.key>传送带</>输送到精炼炉中，为生产晶体外壳持续提供原料。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_3.en: This shows that the Originium Ore in the Depot is being moved out of the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> onto the <@gd.key>transport belt</>, and then transported to the Refining Unit as raw materials for making Origocrusts.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_4.cn: 而产出的晶体外壳，则会通过这条<@gd.key>传送带</>和<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>运输回仓库，从而实现整个产线的自动化运转。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_4.en: The Origocrust made by the facility is then moved by the <@gd.key>transport belt</> into the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> and stored in the Depot. This is essentially a completely automated production line.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_5.cn: 下面我们就参照这个方式来搭建<@gd.key>荞花粉末带</>的自动产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_5.en: Let's reference this to set up an automated <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_7_start_6.cn: 请先前往粉碎机旁的<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>，选择要输出的原料。
guide_text_blackbox_7_start_6.en: First, go to the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> next to the Shredding Unit, and select the raw material to move out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_step1_1.cn: 请与粉碎机旁的<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>交互，打开物品选择界面。
guide_text_blackbox_7_step1_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> near the Shredding Unit and open the item selection panel.

guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_1.cn: 请使用传送带连接<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>和<@gd.key>粉碎机的输入口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_1.en: Connect the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit input port</> with a transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_2.cn: 很好，现在粉碎机可以从协议核心仓库中获取荞花作为原料了。
guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_2.en: Great. The PAC Depot will now constantly supply the Shredding Unit with Buckflower.

guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_3.cn: 接下来，请使用传送带连接<@gd.key>粉碎机的取货口</>到<@gd.key>协议核心的输入口</>上，以将产物送回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_7_step2_3.en: Next, connect the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit output port</> to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> with a transport belt to move products from the Shredding Unit to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_1.cn: 请点击此处选择希望从取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_1.en: Click here to select the item to move from the output port.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_2.cn: 这里列出了当前协议核心仓库中的可用物品，我们要生产<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>就需要使用<@gd.key>荞花</>作为原料。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_2.en: This section lists the items we can move out of the PAC Depot. <@gd.key>Buckflower</> is the raw material we need to produce <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_4.cn: 现在这个取货口可以持续从仓库中输出荞花了。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_4.en: This output port can now continuously move Buckflower out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_5.cn: 接下来我们还需要使用<@gd.key>传送带</>，将输出的荞花运到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_5.en: We must use a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move the Buckflower from the output port to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_6.cn: 请点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_6.en: Click the close button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_7.cn: 接下来请参照指示线进行<@gd.key>传送带</>的连接，将荞花运输到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_7_unloader_7.en: Reference the indicated line and connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</> for moving Buckflower to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_8_extrastep_1.cn: 想要达成<@gd.key>附加目标</>的话，就需要提高<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>的产能。
guide_text_blackbox_8_extrastep_1.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, we must raise the production yield of <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_extrastep_2.cn: 参照刚刚的方式再搭建一条<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>的产线就可以完成附加目标了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_extrastep_2.en: Reference the steps we took and set up 1 more <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottle</> production line to achieve the bonus goal.

guide_text_blackbox_8_reward_pop_1.cn: 获得了一份紫晶质瓶产线的<@gd.key>蓝图</>，推进<@gd.key>主线任务</>以解锁<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能后可快速搭建紫晶质瓶产线。
guide_text_blackbox_8_reward_pop_1.en: A <@gd.key>blueprint</> for the Amethyst Bottle production line has been acquired. Progress through the <@gd.key>main mission</> to unlock the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> feature that allows quick setting up of an Amethyst Bottle production line.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_1.cn: 本次模拟需要为工团提供<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>，先来看一下它的简制配方。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_1.en: In this simulation, we must make <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</> for the UWST. Let's take a look at its crafting formula.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2.cn: 使用快捷键<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击图标位置打开背包。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2.en: Press the hotkey <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the icon to open the Backpack.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2_1_ct.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，打开<@gd.key>背包</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2_1_ct.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2_mb.cn: 请点击此按钮打开背包。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_2_mb.en: Tap this button to open the Backpack.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_3.cn: 点击<@gd.key>简易制作</>按钮打开简制界面。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_3.en: Click the <@gd.key>Crafting</> button to open the Crafting screen.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_4.cn: 可以看到制作荞愈胶囊需要使用<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>和<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>这两种材料。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_4.en: We can see that crafting Buck Capsule [C] requires 2 materials: <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_5.en: Click the button to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_6.cn: 可以看到，集成核心区内已经搭建了一条生产<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>的自动产线。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_6.en: We can see that an automated <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> production line is already in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_7.cn: 荞花正在通过<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>和<@gd.key>传送带</>的不断运输到粉碎机中进行加工，
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_7.en: Buckflower is constantly being moved by the <@gd.key>transport belt</> from the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to the Shredding Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_8.cn: 而加工产出的荞花粉末则通过<@gd.key>传送带</>和<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>运输回了仓库，从而实现了整个产线的自动化运转。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_8.en: The Buckflower Powder made by the facility is then moved by the <@gd.key>transport belt</> into the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> and stored in the Depot. This is essentially a completely automated production line.

guide_text_blackbox_8_start_9.cn: 接下来我们只需参照这个方式搭建一条生产<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>的产线就可以制造<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_start_9.en: Our next step is to reference this to create an <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottle</> production line. This line will help us produce <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_1.cn: 制造荞愈胶囊所需的<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>可以通过<@gd.key>塑形机</>来生产。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_1.en: The <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</> for making Buck Capsule [C] can be made by the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_2.cn: 将紫晶矿放入<@gd.key>精炼炉</>加工成紫晶纤维后，再放入<@gd.key>塑形机</>即可制成紫晶质瓶。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_2.en: Place Amethyst Ore into the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to process it into Amethyst Fiber, then place this into the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> to make Amethyst Bottles.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_3.cn: 请先与<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>交互，将要输出的物品设为<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step1_3.en: First interact with the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> and select <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the item to move out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_1.cn: 请先放置一台<@gd.key>精炼炉</>，用来将紫晶矿精炼为<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_1.en: First place a <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> for refining Amethyst Ore into <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_10.cn: 由于在本次模拟中各设备禁用了<@gd.key>手动存取权限</>，所以我们还需要将紫晶质瓶通过传送带输送回仓库才能使用。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_10.en: <@gd.key>Manual cache access has been disabled</> for every facility in this simulation. We must use transport belts to move Amethyst Bottles back to the Depot before we can use them.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_11.cn: 请使用传送带连接<@gd.key>塑形机取货口</>到<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>，以将紫晶质瓶送回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_11.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit output port</> to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> with a transport belt to move Amethyst Bottles to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_12.cn: 非常好，最后请使用供电桩为设备供电并等待产线运转，让<@gd.key>塑形机生产5个紫晶质瓶</>并运回仓库吧。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_12.en: Excellent. Finally, place an Electric Pylon to power the facilities and let the production line run for a while. Wait for it to transport <@gd.key>5 Amethyst Bottles made by the Moulding Unit</> into the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_2.cn: 很好，有了精炼炉我们就可以生产<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_2.en: Good. The Refining Unit will let us produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_3.cn: 接下来请再放置一台<@gd.key>塑形机</>，用来将精炼炉生产的紫晶纤维加工为<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_3.en: Next, place a <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> to process Amethyst Fibers produced by the Refining Unit into <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_4.cn: 很好，生产紫晶质瓶的设备已经齐了，接下来就是物流<@gd.key>传送带</>的搭建了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_4.en: Wonderful. We now have the facility for making Amethyst Bottles. The next step is to set up the <@gd.key>transport belt</> for logistics.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_5.cn: 我们需要将紫晶矿从<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>输送到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>，再将产出的紫晶纤维从精炼炉输送到<@gd.key>塑形机</>中以进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_5.en: We must move Amethyst Ore from the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>, then move the Amethyst Fibers from the Refining Unit to the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_6.cn: 请先使用传送带连接<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>到<@gd.key>精炼炉输入口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_6.en: First, connect the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit input port</> via a transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_7.cn: 很好，现在紫晶矿可以从协议核心仓库运输到精炼炉中进行加工了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_7.en: Great. Amethyst Ore is now being moved from the PAC Depot to the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_8.cn: 请再使用传送带连接<@gd.key>精炼炉取货口</>到<@gd.key>塑形机输入口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_8.en: Now, connect the <@gd.key>Refining Unit output port</> to the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit input port</> with a transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_9.cn: 非常好，这样精炼炉产出的紫晶纤维就可以输送到塑形机中加工为<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_9.en: Wonderful. The Amethyst Fibers produced by the Refining Unit are now being moved to the Moulding Unit to be made into <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_9_1.cn: 每生产1个<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>需要2份紫晶纤维。如果希望提升效率的话还可以再多放置一个<@gd.key>精炼炉</>来为塑形机提供紫晶纤维。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step2_9_1.en: It takes 2 units of Amethyst Fiber to produce 1 <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottle</>. To raise production, place 1 more <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to supply more Amethyst Fiber to the Moulding Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step3_1.cn: 很好，现在我们已经有了足够数量的<@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step3_1.en: Good job. We now have enough <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottles</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_step3_2.cn: 接下来请打开<@gd.key>背包</>，使用<@gd.key>简易制作</>功能来制造<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>吧。
guide_text_blackbox_8_step3_2.en: Now, open the <@gd.key>Backpack</> and use <@gd.key>Crafting</> to craft <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>可以从仓库持续输出指定的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_1.en: The <@gd.key>PAC output port</> can continuously move a selected item out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_2.cn: 点击这里选择要取出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_2.en: Click here to select the item to move out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_3.cn: <@gd.key>紫晶质瓶</>需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>作为原料，依次经过<@gd.key>精炼</>、<@gd.key>塑形</>后加工获得。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_3.en: <@gd.key>Amethyst Bottle</> must be made with the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</>. This raw material must be <@gd.key>refined</> and <@gd.key>moulded</> to produce the bottles.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_4.cn: 所以这里我们需要选择紫晶矿，请点击<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>完成选择。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_4.en: Hence, we must select Amethyst Ore. Click on the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_4_ct.cn: 所以这里我们需要选择<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>，请按下<action=common_confirm>完成选择。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_4_ct.en: Hence, we must select <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</>. Press <action=common_confirm> to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_5.cn: 很好，现在这个取货口可以从仓库持续输出<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_5.en: Good. This output port is now moving <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_6.cn: 接下来我们还需要放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>塑形机</>，并使用传送带将原料依次运输到这些设备中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_8_unloader_6.en: The next step is to place the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</>, then use transport belts to move materials into these facilities for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_1.cn: 此设备已经锁定了生产配方，在这里可以看到生产<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_1.en: Production formula is locked for this facility. This shows that producing <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> needs <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_2.cn: <@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>可以通过将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>放入<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中加工获取。
guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_2.en: <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</> can be made by processing <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> at the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_3.cn: 现在我们只需要搭建一条<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>的产线并将其接入配件机就可以生产<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>了，现在就来试试吧。
guide_text_blackbox_9_assebling_3.en: We now need to set up an <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</> production line and connect it to a Fitting Unit to produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>. Let's give it a go.

guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_1.cn: 本次模拟中，我们没有协议核心仓库的手动存取权限。
guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_1.en: We are not authorized to access the PAC Depot for this simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_2.cn: 想要完成<@gd.key>附加目标</>可以使用<@gd.key>传送带</>将紫晶零件从配件机运输回协议核心仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_2.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, use a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move Amethyst Parts from the Fitting Unit back to the PAC Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_3.cn: 不妨试着增加产线数量，让几台<@gd.key>配件机</>一起进行<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>的生产以更快完成储备。
guide_text_blackbox_9_extrastep_3.en: Let's try expanding the production line. Use multiple <@gd.key>Fitting Units</> to produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> at the same time to meet the goals.

guide_text_blackbox_9_reward_pop_1.cn: 获得了一份紫晶零件产线的<@gd.key>蓝图</>，推进<@gd.key>主线任务</>以解锁<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能后可快速搭建紫晶零件产线。
guide_text_blackbox_9_reward_pop_1.en: A <@gd.key>blueprint</> for the Amethyst Part production line has been acquired. Progress through the <@gd.key>main mission</> to unlock the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> feature that allows quick setting up of an Amethyst Part production line.

guide_text_blackbox_9_start_1.cn: 滑索架出现故障，需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>来修复。
guide_text_blackbox_9_start_1.en: The Zipline Pylon is broken. Use the <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> to repair it.

guide_text_blackbox_9_start_2.cn: 集成核心区内已经预先安放了生产紫晶零件所需的<@gd.key>配件机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_start_2.en: The Core AIC Area already has the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> needed for producing Amethyst Parts.

guide_text_blackbox_9_start_3.cn: 请先与<@gd.key>配件机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_9_start_3.en: First interact with the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> and view the <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>配件机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> and view the <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step1_1.cn: 生产<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>作为原料。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step1_1.en: Producing <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> requires <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the raw material.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step1_2.cn: 请先与<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>交互，将要输出的物品设为<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step1_2.en: First interact with the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> and select <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the item to move out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_1.cn: 请先放置一台<@gd.key>精炼炉</>，用来将紫晶矿精炼为<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_1.en: First place a <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> for refining Amethyst Ore into <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_2.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>和<@gd.key>精炼炉输入口</>以将紫晶矿输送到精炼炉中。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_2.en: Connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</> to the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> and the <@gd.key>Refining Unit input port</> to move Amethyst Ore to the Refining Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_3.cn: 很好，现在精炼炉可以生产<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>了。接下来我们还需要把产出的紫晶纤维输送到<@gd.key>配件机</>中加工为<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_3.en: Great. The Refining Unit is now producing <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</>. Next, we must move the Amethyst Fibers to the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> to process them into <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_4.cn: 请使用传送带连接<@gd.key>精炼炉的取货口</>和<@gd.key>配件机的输入口</>，以将紫晶纤维输入到配件机中。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_4.en: Connect the transport belt to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit output port</> and the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit input port</> to move Amethyst Fibers to the Fitting Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_5.cn: 别忘了使用供电桩为各设备供电。然后请等待产线运转，<@gd.key>让配件机生产5份紫晶零件</>。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_5.en: And don't forget to use an Electric Pylon to power the facilities. Let the production line run for a while till the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit produces 5 Amethyst Parts</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_6.cn: <@gd.key>紫晶零件</>的生产已经完成了，请将其取出到背包中以备使用。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_6.en: <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> production completed. Manually place them in the Backpack for later.

guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_7.cn: 现在我们已经拥有了足够的<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>，请前往修复<@gd.key>滑索架</>吧。
guide_text_blackbox_9_step2_7.en: We now have enough <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>. Let's go and repair the <@gd.key>zipline facility</>.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>可以从仓库持续输出指定的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_1.en: The <@gd.key>PAC output port</> can continuously move a selected item out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_2.cn: 请点击这里设定要输送到传送带上的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_2.en: Click here to select the item to move onto the transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_3.cn: 这里可以看到当前协议核心仓库中的所有可用材料，现在我们需要使用<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>来生产紫晶纤维。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_3.en: This shows all the materials available in the PAC Depot. For now, we need <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to produce Amethyst Fiber.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_4.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>进行选择。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_4.en: Click on the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to select it.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_5.cn: 很好，现在这个协议核心取货口可以<@gd.key>持续输出紫晶矿</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_5.en: Good. This PAC output port can now <@gd.key>continuously move Amethyst Ore</> out of the depot.

guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_6.cn: 接下来我们就需要使用<@gd.key>传送带</>将紫晶矿运输到对应的设备中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_9_unloader_6.en: The next step is to use a <@gd.key>transport belt</> and move Amethyst Ore to the right facility for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_1.cn: <@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>可通过<@gd.key>封装机</>进行生产。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_1.en: The <@gd.key>LC Valley Battery</> is produced at the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_2.cn: 场地内已经预先设置了生产<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>所需的两种前置原料产线。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_2.en: This area already has production lines for 2 materials needed for producing <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_3.cn: 在这里，<@gd.key>源矿</>会从协议核心仓库输送到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中以加工为<@gd.key>源矿粉末</>。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_3.en: This production line moves <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> from the PAC Depot to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> where the ore is processed into <@gd.key>Originium Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_4.cn: 这里则是将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>输送到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>加工成紫晶纤维后，再输送到<@gd.key>配件机</>中以制成<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_4.en: This other production line moves <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> where the ore is processed into Amethyst Fiber. The fiber is then moved to the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_5.cn: 请先放置一台<@gd.key>封装机</>，再将这两种原料都输入封装机中即可加工获取<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_battery_5.en: Place a <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> and then move the two materials to the Packaging Unit to produce <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_1.cn: 所有作战设备都需要电力支持方可运转，在这里可以看到作战设备的充能情况。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_1.en: All combat facilities must be powered to become operational. This shows the charging status of the combat facility.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_2.cn: 除了接入电网外，一些设备还可通过电池来进行充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_2.en: To power certain facilities, either connect them to the power grid or give them batteries.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_3.cn: 当拥有电池时，<@gd.key>点击自动填充</>按钮或将电池<@gd.key>从背包拖入充能栏中</>都可对设备进行充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_3.en: If batteries are available in the Backpack, <@gd.key>click the Auto Place</> button or drag batteries <@gd.key>from the Backpack to the charging slot</> to charge a combat facility.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_3_.cn: 当拥有电池时，使用<@gd.key>自动填充</>或手动将电池从背包<@gd.key>放入充能栏中</>都可对设备进行充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_cannon_3_.en: When carrying batteries, use <@gd.key>Auto Place</> or manually drag batteries from the Backpack <@gd.key>into the charging slot</> to charge the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_1.cn: <@gd.key>榴弹塔</>是一种常用的作战设备，在有<@gd.key>电力充能</>的情况下可以自动对范围内的敌人发动攻击。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_1.en: The <@gd.key>Grenade Tower</> is a common combat facility. When <@gd.key>powered</>, it can automatically attack enemies within range.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_2.cn: 在野外未搭建电网的地区，我们还可以使用<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>来对作战设备进行单次充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_2.en: In the wilderness not yet covered by the power grid, we can also use single-use <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</> to add power charges to the combat facility.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_3.cn: 请先使用<@gd.key>滑索</>回到集成核心区域进行<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>的生产，之后再回到这里对榴弹塔进行充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_start_3.en: Use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to return to the Core AIC Area first and produce some <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>. After acquiring the batteries, return to the Grenade Tower to charge it.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step1_1.cn: 请先使用<@gd.key>滑索</>返回集成核心区域进行<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step1_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to return to the Core AIC Area and produce some <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_2.cn: 请将<@gd.key>源矿粉末</>和<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>输入到封装机中，并生产4块<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>。如果想更快完成电池的生产，不妨试着再搭建一条产线。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_2.en: Move <@gd.key>Originium Powder</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> to the Packaging Unit, then wait for the facility to produce 4 <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>. For faster battery production, try setting up an additional production line.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_3.cn: 已经生产了足够的<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>，请将它们从封装机<@gd.key>收取到背包中</>吧。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_3.en: There are now enough <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</>. Take them from the Packaging Unit and <@gd.key>place them in the Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_4.cn: 现在请使用<@gd.key>滑索</>返回野外区处， 将电池放入<@gd.key>榴弹塔</>中以对其进行充能。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling1_step2_4.en: Now use the <@gd.key>zipline</> to head back into the wilderness and place the batteries into the <@gd.key>Grenade Tower</> to charge it.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_1.cn: 请先去封装机查看<@gd.key>中容谷地电池</> 的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_1.en: Go to the Packaging Unit and view the <@gd.key>SC Valley Battery</> production formula first.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_2.cn: 野外开采蓝铁矿的<@gd.key>矿机</>坏了，请前往修复。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_2.en: The Ferrium Ore <@gd.key>mining rig</> in the wilderness is damaged. Let's go and fix it.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_3.cn: 封装机好像可以移动，或许可以使用<@gd.key>供电桩</>来为封装机供电。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_helper_3.en: The Packaging Unit can be moved. Try powering it with the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</>.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_start_1.cn: 请先去<@gd.key>封装机</>查看设备详情，以查看<@gd.key>中容谷地电池</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_start_1.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to view its facility details and the <@gd.key>SC Valley Battery</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_start_2.cn: 这就是<@gd.key>中容谷地电池</>的生产配方，请根据配方来搭建生产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_assebling_2_start_2.en: This is the <@gd.key>SC Valley Battery</> production formula. Let's follow it to set up a production line.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.cn: 在这里可以看到，制造<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>需要使用<@gd.key>酮化灌木粉末</>和<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>这两种材料。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.en: We can see that producing <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</> needs 2 materials: <@gd.key>Aketine Powder</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.cn: 我们需要将刚刚采集的<@gd.key>酮化灌木</>通过<@gd.key>粉碎机</>研磨为<@gd.key>粉末</>，之后再输送到封装机中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.en: We have gathered some <@gd.key>Aketine</>. Use the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> to shred them into <@gd.key>Aketine Powder</>, then move the powder to the Packaging Unit for production.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.cn: 而另一种材料<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>则可以通过将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>依次输送到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>配件机</>中加工获得。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.en: The other material, <@gd.key>Amethyst Part</>, can be produced by first processing <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> at the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> into Amethyst Fiber, and then processing the fiber at the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</> to get the product.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.cn: 接下来请补齐<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>的产线，完成爆炸物的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_assem.en: Now, let's complete the <@gd.key>Industrial Explosive</> production line and produce some Industrial Explosives.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 工业爆炸物可以从背包中直接使用。请先使用快捷键<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击图标位置<@gd.key>打开背包</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Industrial Explosives can be directly used at the Backpack panel. First press the hotkey <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the icon to <@gd.key>open the Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，打开<@gd.key>背包</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 工业爆炸物可以从背包中直接使用。请先按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Industrial Explosives can be directly used at the Backpack panel. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 工业爆炸物可以从背包中直接使用。请先点击此按钮<@gd.key>打开背包</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Industrial Explosives can be directly used at the Backpack panel. Tap this button to <@gd.key>open the Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>展开详情弹窗。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Click on the <@gd.key>Industrial Explosive</> to open its details panel.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>打开<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>的详情弹窗。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Press to <action=navigation_target_click> to open the details panel of <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 在投掷模式下可以通过移动和镜头控制来<@gd.key>瞄准</>要摧毁的目标。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: In throwing mode, move and adjust the view to <@gd.key>aim</> at the target to be demolished.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 接下来就请瞄准山体中间的<@gd.key>落石</>，之后再通过点击来投出爆炸物吧。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Now, aim at the <@gd.key>rubble</> in the hills then click to throw the explosive.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 接下来就请瞄准山体中间的<@gd.key>落石</>，之后再按下<action=battle_throw_mode_throw_show_only>投出爆炸物吧。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Now, aim at the <@gd.key>rubble</> in the hills then press <action=battle_throw_mode_throw_show_only> to throw the explosive.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.cn: 接下来就请瞄准山体中间的<@gd.key>落石</>，之后再点击<@gd.key>投掷</>按钮来投出爆炸物吧。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_bomb_.en: Now, aim at the <@gd.key>rubble</> in the hills and tap the <@gd.key>Throw</> button to throw the explosive.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.cn: 在本次模拟中，我们需要炸毁落石救出受困人员。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.en: In this simulation, we must blast apart rubble to rescue the trapped victims.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.cn: 这些非坚固结构的物体通常可使用<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>来进行破坏。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.en: Non-sturdy objects and structures can often be destroyed with <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.cn: 在矿场附近就分布了不少可以用来制造工业爆炸物的<@gd.key>酮化灌木</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.en: There are plenty of <@gd.key>Aketine</> plants near this mining site. They can be used to produce Industrial Explosives.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.cn: 请先采集一些<@gd.key>酮化灌木</>作为原料，再使用<@gd.key>滑索</>前往集成核心区制造工业爆炸物。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_start.en: Gather some <@gd.key>Aketine</> as raw materials then take the <@gd.key>zipline</> to the Core AIC Area to make Industrial Explosives.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.cn: 制造工业爆炸物需要使用<@gd.key>酮化灌木</>原料，请先采集一些。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.en: Making Industrial Explosives requires <@gd.key>Aketine</>. Gather some of the plant first.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.cn: 接下来请使用<@gd.key>滑索</>前往集成核心区，利用集成工业系统来制造工业爆炸物。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.en: Take the <@gd.key>zipline</> to the Core AIC Area and use AIC facilities to make Industrial Explosives.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.cn: <@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>可以使用封装机来制造，请与<@gd.key>封装机</>交互查看其生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step1.en: <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</> can be produced by the Packaging Unit. Interact with the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to view the production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 请将<@gd.key>酮化灌木</>输入到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中加工为<@gd.key>酮化灌木粉末</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Move <@gd.key>Aketine</> to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> to shred it into <@gd.key>Aketine Powder</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 请放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>配件机</>，别忘了使用供电桩进行供电。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Place the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and the <@gd.key>Fitting Unit</>, and don't forget to power them with Electric Pylons.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 请将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>从协议核心取货口依次输送到精炼炉和配件机中以加工为<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Move the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> from the PAC output port to the Refining Unit to make Amethyst Fiber, then move the fiber to the Fitting Unit to produce <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 请将<@gd.key>酮化灌木粉末</>和<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>输送到<@gd.key>封装机</>中以制造工业爆炸物。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Move the <@gd.key>Aketine Powder</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Parts</> to the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce Industrial Explosives.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 很好，我们已经成功生产出破坏落石所需的<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>，接下来请将其从封装机中<@gd.key>取出到背包里</>。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Good. We now have the <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</> to blast away the rubble. Take them out of the Packaging Unit and <@gd.key>place them in the Backpack</>.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.cn: 现在可以使用滑索<@gd.key>返回矿场</>进行救援了。另外仓库中还有更多酮化灌木，如果对爆破瞄准没有把握的话也可以再<@gd.key>多制备几个工业爆炸物</>再前往。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step2.en: Use the zipline and <@gd.key>return to the mining site</> to rescue the victims. The Depot has extra Aketine for <@gd.key>making more Industrial Explosives</>. Having extra explosives will help make up for bad aiming and throwing.

guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step3.cn: 请在背包中使用<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>进行投掷，摧毁阻塞道路的落石。
guide_text_blackbox_asseblingbomb1_step3.en: Open the Backpack and use the <@gd.key>Industrial Explosive</> to throw it and demolish the rubble blocking the way.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_1.cn: 在这个<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>中存放了生产荞花粉末所需的<@gd.key>荞花</>原料，
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_1.en: This <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> contains <@gd.key>Buckflower</>, the raw material for making Buckflower Powder.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_2.cn: 使用<@gd.key>传送带</>将其输送到<@gd.key>粉碎机</>中即可加工获得荞花粉末。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_2.en: Use the <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move the plant to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> that processes it into Buckflower Powder.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_3.cn: 最后再使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接<@gd.key>粉碎机取货口</>到<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>即可将荞花粉末运回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_3.en: Finally, connect one end of the <@gd.key>transport belt</> to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit output port</> and the other to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> to transport the Buckflower Powder to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_4.cn: 接下来就使用传送带依次连接<@gd.key>协议储存箱、粉碎机、协议核心</>来完成物流连接吧。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_grinder_4.en: Next, connect transport belts to the facilities in this order: <@gd.key>Protocol Stash, Shredding Unit, and PAC</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_1.cn: 在操作面板中，也可以查看其传送带的连接情况。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_1.en: Open the control panel to view transport belt connection details.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_2.cn: 左侧显示了设备的所有输入口。在连接传送带后，可以在这里看到物品输入的信息。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_2.en: The left side shows all the input ports of the facility. When connected to a transport belt, it will also display information of the incoming items.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_3.cn: 右侧则显示了设备的所有取货口。在连接传送带后，可以看到产物从缓存区不断向外输出。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_3.en: The right side shows all the output ports of the facility. After connecting a transport belt, products will be slowly moved out from the facility cache.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_4.cn: 接下来我们需要参照这种方式，再为<@gd.key>粉碎机</>建立完整的<@gd.key>荞花粉末</>物流线。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_4.en: Reference the steps we took to set up another <@gd.key>Buckflower Powder</> production line for the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_5.cn: 请先点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_produce_5.en: Click the close button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_reward_pop_1.cn: 获得了晶体外壳和紫晶纤维产线的<@gd.key>蓝图</>，推进<@gd.key>主线任务</>以解锁<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能后可快速搭建对应产线。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_reward_pop_1.en: Production line <@gd.key>blueprints</> for Origocrust and Amethyst Fiber acquired. Progress through the <@gd.key>main mission</> to unlock the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> feature to quickly set up various production lines.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心</>所在的<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>适合进行大面积的集成工业建设。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_1.en: The <@gd.key>PAC</> is located in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>, which is suitable for deploying a large AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_10.cn: 在<@gd.key>进行传送带放置时</>，可通过箭头在网格上的位置来选定<@gd.key>传送带的起始点</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_10.en: When <@gd.key>placing transport belts</>, use the position of the arrow on the grid to select the <@gd.key>starting point of the transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_10_ct.cn: 在放置<@gd.key>传送带时</>，可<@gd.key>移动并推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆转动视角</>，通过调整锥型指示器在网格上的位置来选定<@gd.key>传送带的起始点</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_10_ct.en: When placing <@gd.key>transport belts</>, <@gd.key>move and adjust the view with the <action=common_rightstick> stick</> to change the grid location of the indicator cone and select the <@gd.key>starting point of the transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11.cn: 确定起始点后<@gd.key>点击地面</>开始放置，之后可通过移动和更改朝向来拉出传送带，在选定结束位置后<@gd.key>再次点击地面</>即可完成一段传送带的放置。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11.en: After confirming a starting point, <@gd.key>click on the ground</> to start placing the transport belt using the movement and rotation controls. After reaching the end point of the transport belt, <@gd.key>click the ground again</> to complete placing this transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11_ct.cn: 确定起始点后<@gd.key>按下<action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start></>开始放置传送带，之后可<@gd.key>移动并推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆转动视角</>来拉出传送带。在选定结束位置后再次按下<action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start>即可完成一段传送带的放置。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11_ct.en: After confirming a starting point, <@gd.key>press <action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start></> to start placing the transport belt, then <@gd.key>move and adjust the view with the <action=common_rightstick> stick</> to place more belt sections. After reaching the desired end point of the belt, press <action=fac_build_confirm_belt_start> again to complete placing this transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11_mb.cn: 确定起始点后点击<@gd.key>确认</>按钮开始放置，之后可通过移动和更改朝向来拉出传送带。在选定结束位置后再次点击<@gd.key>确认</>按钮即可完成一段传送带的放置。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_11_mb.en: After confirming a starting point, tap the <@gd.key>Confirm</> button to start placing the transport belt using the movement and rotation controls. After confirming the end point of the transport belt, tap <@gd.key>Confirm</> again to complete placing this section of transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_12.cn: 接下来请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>进行<@gd.key>传送带</>的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_12.en: Now, refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_13.cn: 非常好，现在<@gd.key>传送带</>可以将源矿从<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>不断运输到<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中了。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_13.en: Excellent. Now the <@gd.key>transport belt</> can move Originium Ore from the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_14.cn: 想要建立完整的物流线，我们还需要把将精炼炉产出<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>运输回协议核心<@gd.key>仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_14.en: To create a complete automated transport loop, we must move the <@gd.key>Origocrust</> made by the Refining Unit to the PAC <@gd.key>Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_15.cn: 这就需使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接<@gd.key>精炼炉的取货口</>和<@gd.key>协议核心的输入口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_15.en: The <@gd.key>transport belt</> must be connected to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit output port</> and to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_16.cn: 下面请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>进行<@gd.key>传送带</>的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_16.en: Now, reference the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_17.cn: 干得好，现在<@gd.key>精炼炉</>产出的晶体外壳可以通过<@gd.key>传送带</>自动运输回<@gd.key>协议核心</>的仓库了。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_17.en: Nicely done. The Origocrust made by the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> is now being automatically transported to the <@gd.key>PAC</> Depot via the <@gd.key>transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_18.cn: 这样我们就建立了一条从储存箱提供原料到精炼炉中进行加工，再将设备的产物运回仓库的完整产线。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_18.en: We now have a complete production line that moves raw materials from the Protocol Stash to the Refining Unit for processing, and delivers products from the facility to the depot for storage.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_19.cn: 接下来请前往<@gd.key>精炼炉</>处，在操作面板中查看它的物流情况。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_19.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and view its logistics info shown in the control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_2.cn: 在<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>中可以使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接各个工业设备， 从而实现自动化的物流运输。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_2.en: While in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>, <@gd.key>transport belts</> can be used to connect AIC Factory facilities together and automate the transportation of materials and products.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_3.cn: 带有物流底座的工业设备都可以进行传送带的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_3.en: Transport belts can connect to logistics input and output ports along the base of some AIC facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_4.cn: 注意看<@gd.key>箭头</>的朝向，指向内部的是设备的<@gd.key>输入口</>。在接入<@gd.key>传送带</>后，可以将加工所需的原料由此<@gd.key>输入到设备之中</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_4.en: Check the direction of the <@gd.key>arrows</>. Those pointing into the facility are the <@gd.key>input ports</>. Connect the input port to a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move raw materials <@gd.key>into the facility</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_5.cn: 指向外部的则是设备的<@gd.key>取货口</>。在连接<@gd.key>传送带</>后，可以将加工产出的物品从设备的缓存区自动<@gd.key>输出到传送带上</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_5.en: Arrows pointing outwards from the facility are the <@gd.key>output ports</>. Connect the output port to a <@gd.key>transport belt</> to move processed products from the facility cache <@gd.key>onto the transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_6.cn: 在本次模拟中我们需要使用<@gd.key>传送带</>为工业设备搭建物流线。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_6.en: For this simulation, we must use <@gd.key>transport belts</> to create a logistics line for the AIC facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_7.cn: 在这个<@gd.key>协议储存箱</>中存放了很多<@gd.key>源矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_7.en: This <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> contains a lot of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_8.cn: 参照<@gd.key>指示线</>将传送带从协议<@gd.key>储存箱的取货口</>连接到<@gd.key>精炼炉的输入口</>中，就可以<@gd.key>将源矿输送到精炼炉中</>进行加工了。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_8.en: Refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>Protocol Stash output port</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit input port</> via a transport belt. This <@gd.key>automatically moves Originium Ore to the Refining Unit</> for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9.cn: 现在就来试试吧。请先使用快捷键<action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击<@gd.key>传送带</>按钮开始放置传送带。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9.en: Let's give this a try. Press the hotkey <action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>transport belt</> button to start placing the transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9_ct.cn: 现在就来试试吧。请按住<action=fac_activate_quick_bar>并按下<action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt>进入<@gd.key>传送带建造模式</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9_ct.en: Let's give this a try. Hold <action=fac_activate_quick_bar> and press <action=fac_use_quick_item_conveyer_belt> to enter the <@gd.key>transport belt placement mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9_mb.cn: 现在就来试试吧。请先点击<@gd.key>传送带</>按钮开始放置传送带。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_start_9_mb.en: Let's give this a try. Tap the <@gd.key>transport belt</> button to start placing the transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>精炼炉</>交互，在操作面板中查看它的物流情况。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and view its logistics info shown in the control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_1.cn: 请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>，使用<@gd.key>传送带</>依次连接<@gd.key>协议储存箱、粉碎机、协议核心</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_1.en: Reference the <@gd.key>guiding line</> and connect <@gd.key>transport belts</> to the facilities in this order: <@gd.key>Protocol Stash, Shredding Unit, and PAC</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_2.cn: 非常好，看来你已经掌握了物流连接的方法。产线的运转需要一点时间，请<@gd.key>等待荞花粉末生产并运输回仓库</>。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_2.en: Congratulations for mastering the technique of laying down logistics connections. <@gd.key>Wait for the Buckflower Powder to be produced and delivered to the Depot</>.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_3.cn: 模拟目标达成了，请按下<action=common_open_watch>来完成模拟吧。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_3.en: Simulation goals achieved. Press <action=common_open_watch> to complete the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_3_mb.cn: 模拟目标达成了，请点击<@gd.key>完成模拟</>按钮来完成模拟吧 。
guide_text_blackbox_belt1_step1_3_mb.en: Simulation goals achieved. Tap the <@gd.key>End SIM</> button to complete the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_1.cn: 首先请打开<@gd.key>采种机</>，并将<@gd.key>砂叶</>放入。
guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_1.en: First, open the <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> control panel and place <@gd.key>Sandleaf</> into it.

guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_2.cn: 将采种机同时连接至<@gd.key>两台种植机</>中，并且有一台种植机<@gd.key>连接回采种机</>，即可形成自循环！
guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_2.en: Connect a Seed-Picking Unit to <@gd.key>2 Planting Units</>, and connect 1 of these Planting Units <@gd.key>back to the Seed-Picking Unit</> to create a self-feeding loop!

guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_3.cn: 高容谷地电池需要<@gd.key>钢制零件</>和<@gd.key>致密源石粉末</>在封装机中生产。
guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_3.en: HC Valley Batteries must be made with <@gd.key>Steel Part</> and <@gd.key>Dense Originium Powder</> at the Packaging Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_4.cn: 完成第一个附加奖励目标，需要同时有<@gd.key>两条蓝铁粉末产线</>输入到研磨机中。
guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_4.en: To complete the first bonus goal, the <@gd.key>2 Ferrium Powder production lines</> must be connected to the Grinding Unit input ports.

guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_5.cn: 完成第二个附加奖励目标，需要同时有<@gd.key>两条致密源石粉末产线</>输入到封装机中。
guide_text_blackbox_belt2_helper_5.en: To complete the second bonus goal, the <@gd.key>2 Dense Originium Powder production lines</> must be connected to the Packaging Unit input ports.

guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_1.cn: 使用场地内的现有设备，连接传送带搭建<@gd.key>低容谷地电池产线</>。
guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_1.en: Connect existing facilities in the area with transport belts to set up an <@gd.key>LC Valley Battery production line</>.

guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_2.cn:
使用仓库存取线与传送带搭建<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊产线</>。
搭建出产率稳定的产线还可以完成额外奖励目标！
guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_2.en: Use the Depot Bus and transport belts to set up a <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C] production line</>. Reaching a stable production yield will also complete the bonus goal for more rewards!

guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_3.cn:
灌装机的不间断生产受到紫晶质瓶的限制。
<@gd.key>提高紫晶质瓶的生产速率</>，可能是完成额外奖励目标的关键。
guide_text_blackbox_bus2_helper_3.en: Production at the Filling Unit is intermittent due to Amethyst Bottle shortage. <@gd.key>Raising the production rate of Amethyst Bottles</> is key for completing the bonus goal.

guide_text_blackbox_bus2_start_1.cn: 本次模拟中，需要使用场地中已有的设备来完成产线搭建。
guide_text_blackbox_bus2_start_1.en: This simulation requires the setting up of a production line with existing facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_bus2_start_2.cn: 现在需要生产低容谷地电池，配方的源材料是<@gd.key>源石粉末</>与<@gd.key>紫晶零件</>。
