guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2.en: First press the hotkey <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the icon to <@gd.key>open Backpack</> to check the Buckflower stockpile.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2_1_c.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，打开<@gd.key>背包</>查看荞花的库存。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2_1_c.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick, select this option and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</> to check how much Buckflower is available.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2_mb.cn: 请先点击背包按钮<@gd.key>打开背包</>，查看荞花的库存情况。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_2_mb.en: Tap the Backpack button to <@gd.key>open the Backpack</> and see how much Buckflower is in stock.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_3.cn: 生产荞愈胶囊需要用到大量的荞花，在这里可以看到目前仓库中的<@gd.key>荞花</>库存已经很低了。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_3.en: Producing Buck Capsules [C] require plenty of Buckflower. The Depot does not have a lot of <@gd.key>Buckflower</> left.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_4.cn: 想要满足更大的药品需求就需要想办法循环生产更多的<@gd.key>荞花</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_4.en: To meet the demands for producing large batches of medication, we must create a production loop for <@gd.key>Buckflowers</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_5.en: Click the button to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_6.cn: 集成工业系统已经增设了两种新设备， 用来<@gd.key>循环产出更多荞花</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_6.en: The AIC has introduced 2 new types of facilities to create a <@gd.key>high-yield Buckflower production loop</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_7.cn: <@gd.key>采种机</>可以用来提取植物的种子，由<@gd.key>荞花</>输入其中可获得<@gd.key>荞花种子</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_7.en: The <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> can extract seeds from plants. Place <@gd.key>Buckflower</> into this facility to get <@gd.key>Buckflower Seeds</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_8.cn: <@gd.key>种植机</>则可以将植物的种子快速培育为成株，由<@gd.key>荞花种子</>输入其中就可以<@gd.key>收获荞花</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_8.en: The <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> can quickly raise plant seeds into mature plants. Place <@gd.key>Buckflower Seeds</> in this facility to <@gd.key>harvest Buckflowers</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_9.cn: 将这2台设备接入到原有产线中，不仅可以提供足够的荞花来生产荞愈胶囊，还可以循环储备更多荞花。现在就来试试吧
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_start_9.en: Connect these 2 facilities to the existing production line. This will make enough Buckflowers to produce Buck Capsule [C]. A Buckflower planting loop can also be created. Time to try things out.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_1.cn: 请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>连接协议核心<@gd.key>取货口</>和<@gd.key>采种机</>，将荞花输送到采种机中以提取荞花种子。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_1.en: Refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the PAC <@gd.key>output port</> to the <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> with a transport belt. This will move Buckflower to the Seed-Picking Unit to pick and make Buckflower Seeds.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_2.cn: 请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>连接<@gd.key>采种机</>和<@gd.key>种植机</>，将荞花种子输送到种植机中再培育收获更多荞花。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_2.en: Refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</>. This will move Buckflower Seeds to the Planting Unit for growing more Buckflowers.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_3.cn: 请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>进行<@gd.key>传送带</>连接，将收获的荞花从种植机再补充回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_3.en: Refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</>. This will move Buckflowers grown by the Planting Unit to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_4.cn: 很好，现在我们就通过<@gd.key>采种机和种植机</>实现了<@gd.key>荞花的循环生产</>，可以不断补充荞花的库存了。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_4.en: Good. Now we can use the <@gd.key>Seed-Picking Unit and Planting Unit</> to set up a <@gd.key>Buckflower production loop</> and raise our Buckflower stockpile.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_5.cn: 接下来请参照<@gd.key>指示线</>连接<@gd.key>种植机</>和<@gd.key>粉碎机</>，将产出的部分<@gd.key>荞花</>送到产线中加工为<@gd.key>荞愈胶囊</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_5.en: Now refer to the <@gd.key>indicated line</> and connect the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> so part of the <@gd.key>Buckflower</> produced can be made into <@gd.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_6.cn: 非常好，下面只要<@gd.key>等待产线运转一段时间</>就可以完成荞愈胶囊的生产了。
guide_text_blackbox_planter1_step1_6.en: Excellent. Let the <@gd.key>production line work for a while</> to complete producing the Buck Capsules [C] required.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_1.cn: 非常好，现在我们就拥有了一条可以循环产出锦草的自动化锦草软饮产线。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_1.en: Excellent. Now we have an automated Jincao Drink production line with a Jincao production loop.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_2.cn: 想要完成<@gd.key>附加目标</>，我们还需要使用<@gd.key>粉碎机和反应池</>补齐<@gd.key>芽针溶液</>产线。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_2.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, we must use the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit and Reactor Crucible</> to complete the <@gd.key>Yazhen Solution</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_3.cn: 再参照刚刚的方式，放置一个新的<@gd.key>管道分流器</>以为这些设备同时供水。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extra_3.en: Refer to the steps we used. Place a new <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> and supply these facilities with Clean Water.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_1.cn: 请再放置1个<@gd.key>管道分流器</>，以支持更多分支管道的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_1.en: Place 1 more <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to provide more pipe outlets.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_2.cn: 请使用管道将水引入到新的<@gd.key>管道分流器</>，再输送到<@gd.key>种植机</>中以生产芽针。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_2.en: Use pipelines to move Clean Water to the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> and then to the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> to plant and produce Yazhen.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_3.cn: 请将背包中的<@gd.key>芽针种子</>放入<@gd.key>种植机</>并生产芽针。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_3.en: Move <@gd.key>Yazhen Seed</> from the Backpack to the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> to produce Yazhen.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_4.cn: 接下来请使用<@gd.key>粉碎机和反应池</>补齐产线，生产芽针溶液。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_4.en: Now complete the production line with <@gd.key>Shredding Unit and Reactor Crucible</> to produce Yazhen Solution.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_5.cn: 最后请使用管道连接<@gd.key>反应池</>和<@gd.key>储液罐</>并设定<@gd.key>芽针溶液</>为输出物，将其储存到储液罐中。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_extrastep_5.en: Finally, connect the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> and <@gd.key>Fluid Tank</> with pipelines. Set <@gd.key>Yazhen Solution</> as the dispensed fluid of the pipe outlet to store the fluid in the Fluid Tank.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_1.cn: 武陵地区的植物需要足够的<@gd.key>水资源</>才能生长，这就需要用到种植机的液体模式。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_1.en: Plants of the Wuling region need plenty of <@gd.key>Clean Water</> to grow. This requires Fluid Mode of the Planting Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_2.cn: 在这里可以看到，生产锦草需要用到<@gd.key>锦草种子</>和<@gd.key>清水</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_2.en: This shows that we need <@gd.key>Jincao Seed</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</> to produce Jincao.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_3.cn: <@gd.key>锦草种子</>已经通过场地预设的<@gd.key>传送带</>输送到了种植机中。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_3.en: <@gd.key>Jincao Seeds</> are already being delivered to the Planting Unit by the existing <@gd.key>transport belt</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_4.cn: 我们刚刚连接的<@gd.key>管道</>则可以将<@gd.key>清水</>也输送到设备中从而满足了生产锦草所需的所有条件。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_4.en: The <@gd.key>pipeline</> we just connected can deliver <@gd.key>Clean Water</> to the same facility to meet the requirements for growing Jincao.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_5.en: Click the button to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_6.cn: 目前场地内预设的<@gd.key>锦草软饮</>产线还缺少一部分管道的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_6.en: The <@gd.key>Jincao Drink</> production line in this area is still missing a few pipeline connections between its facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_7.cn: 接下来请使用管道连接<@gd.key>管道分流器</>到<@gd.key>反应池</>，让水输送到反应池中以生产锦草溶液。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_planter_7.en: The next step is to use a pipeline and connect the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</>, deliver Clean Water to the Reactor Crucible, and produce Jincao Solution.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_1.cn: 在本次模拟中我们需要改进原有的<@gd.key>锦草软饮</>产线，将<@gd.key>种植机</>加入进来以循环生产锦草。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_1.en: For this simulation, we must improve upon the existing <@gd.key>Jincao Drink</> production line and add a <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> to create a Jincao production loop.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_2.cn: 锦草需要足够的<@gd.key>水资源</>才能生长，在新的产线中我们需要使用管道同时为<@gd.key>种植机和反应池</>供水。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_2.en: Jincao can only grow when it has enough <@gd.key>Clean Water</>. <@gd.key>Both the Planting Unit and the Reactor Crucible</> of the new production line must be supplied with Clean Water via pipelines.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_3.cn: 不过在本次模拟中，场地内只有<@gd.key>一台水泵</>可供使用。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_3.en: However, this simulation only has <@gd.key>1 Fluid Pump</>.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_4.cn: 此时就需要用到<@gd.key>管道分流器</>来为管道拓展更多的连接方向了。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_4.en: This requires the use of the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to provide more pipe outlets.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_5.cn: 它和传送带的分流器类似，将液体由一个方向输入后，可连接分支管道再向另外的最多三个方向均匀输出。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_5.en: Like the Splitter of transport belts, the Pipe Splitter can evenly split the fluid flow of 1 incoming pipe into 2 or 3 outgoing pipelines.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_6.cn: 请先将管道从<@gd.key>水泵</>连接到<@gd.key>管道分流器</>的输入端。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_6.en: First, connect the <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> to the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> inlet with a pipeline.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_7.cn: 再从<@gd.key>管道分流器</>的任意输出端连接到<@gd.key>种植机</>，让水通过管道输送到设备中。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_start_7.en: Next, connect any <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> outlet to the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> with a pipeline to deliver Clean Water to the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_1.cn: 请参照指示线，使用管道连接<@gd.key>水泵</>和<@gd.key>管道分流器</>。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_1.en: Refer to the indicated line and connect the <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> to the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> via a pipeline.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_2.cn: 接下来请参照指示线，从<@gd.key>管道分流器</>连接管道到<@gd.key>种植机</>以为其供水。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_2.en: Refer to the indicated line and connect the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> via a pipeline for delivering Clean Water.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_3.cn: 很好，现在请与<@gd.key>种植机</>交互查看锦草的生产情况。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step0_3.en: Excellent. Now interact with the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</> to view Jincao production status.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step1_1.cn: 请从<@gd.key>管道分流器</>再拉一条管道到<@gd.key>反应池</>上，让水泵同时为两个设备供水。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step1_1.en: Now connect the <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> with another pipeline. This lets the Fluid Pump supply Clean Water to 2 facilities at once.

guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step1_2.cn: 接下来请使用<@gd.key>管道</>连接反应池和灌装机，并设定锦草溶液为输出物以将其装入蓝铁瓶中。
guide_text_blackbox_planter2_step1_2.en: Now connect the Reactor Crucible to the Filling Unit with a <@gd.key>pipeline</> and set Jincao Solution as outgoing fluid product and fill up Ferrium Bottles with it.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.cn: 在附加目标中，我们需要继续提升集成工业系统的<@gd.key>总发电功率</>以为后续的扩建做准备。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.en: For the bonus goal, we must continue to raise the <@gd.key>total power output</> of our AIC to prepare for future expansions.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.cn: <@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>同样可以用来为热能池供能，与源矿相比它消耗得更慢且可以提供更高的发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.en: <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</> can also supply power via Thermal Bank. Batteries are consumed way slower than Originium Ore and offer a higher power output at the Thermal Bank.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.cn: 接下来请放置更多<@gd.key>热能池</>，并将<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>从协议核心取货口输入到热能池中以获取发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extra_.en: Now, place more <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</> and deliver <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</> from the PAC output port to the Thermal Bank to raise power output.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extras.cn: 请将<@gd.key>低容谷地电池</>从协议核心取货口输入到<@gd.key>热能池</>中以获取更高的发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_extras.en: Move <@gd.key>LC Valley Batteries</> from the PAC output port to the <@gd.key>Thermal Bank</> to raise the power output.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 在本次模拟中，我们需要关注设备的<@gd.key>用电功率</>与集成工业系统可提供的<@gd.key>发电功率</>之间的关系。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: In this simulation, we must monitor facility <@gd.key>power consumption</> and its relationship with the <@gd.key>power output</> of the AIC.
Click close to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: <@gd.key>热能池</>是一种常用的发电设备，它可以将<@gd.key>源矿</>转化为电能从而提供一定的<@gd.key>发电功率</>。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: The <@gd.key>Thermal Bank</> is an electrical power generation facility that uses <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>. It can raise <@gd.key>power output</> of the AIC.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 请先<@gd.key>从协议核心取货口中输送源矿到热能池</>，使其开始运转并发电。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: First, move <@gd.key>Originium Ore from the PAC output port to the Thermal Bank</> to start generating power.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 再用同样的方法放置更多<@gd.key>热能池</>，继续提升集成工业系统的总发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: Refer to this method and place more <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</>. This will raise the total power output of the AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 在这里可以看到，当前场地的所有设备的<@gd.key>总用电功率</>较高，而集成工业系统可提供的<@gd.key>总发电功率</>低于当前总用电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: This shows that <@gd.key>total power consumed</> by every facility in this area is quite high, while <@gd.key>total power output</> of the AIC Factory is lower than the power consumed.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 此时就会出现<@gd.key>电力不足</>的情况。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: This will lead to a <@gd.key>power shortage</>.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 请按下<action=fac_open_hub_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击打开协议核心面板查看电力详情。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: Press <action=fac_open_hub_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click to open the PAC screen to view power details.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 请按下<action=common_toggle_group_down>打开协议核心面板查看电力详情。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: Press <action=common_toggle_group_down> to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) panel and view the electrical power details.
Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 请点击此按钮打开协议核心面板查看电力详情。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: Tap this button to open the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) panel and view the electrical power details.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 这里显示了集成工业系统电网的整体情况。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: This shows the overall situation of the AIC power grid.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 可以看到当前用电功率已经超过了发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: This shows that power consumption has exceeded power output.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 此时设备会优先消耗协议核心的<@gd.key>电能储备</>来维持运转。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: Currently, the facility will consume the PAC <@gd.key>power reserves</> to keep working.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 当储备的电能<@gd.key>全部耗尽</>后，集成工业系统中的设备就会由于电力不足而自动<@gd.key>停止运转</>。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: However, when the power reserves <@gd.key>run out</>, AIC facilities will automatically <@gd.key>switch off</> due to insufficient power.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.cn: 要想让设备恢复生产，就需要放置更多<@gd.key>发电设备</>来提升集成工业系统的发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_start_.en: To make the facilities work again, we must place more <@gd.key>power generating facilities</> to raise AIC power output.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.cn: 请从协议核心取货口中输送<@gd.key>源矿</>到热能池中以为其提供发电所需的原料。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.en: Move <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> from the PAC output port to the Thermal Banks for power generation.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.cn: 很好，集成工业系统的总发电功率已经提升了。接下来请再放置1台<@gd.key>热能池</>。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.en: Good. Total power output of the AIC has increased. Let's place 1 more <@gd.key>Thermal Bank</>.

guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.cn: 从其他取货口为新放置的热能池输送<@gd.key>源矿</>以继续提升电网的发电功率。
guide_text_blackbox_powerstation1_step1_.en: Set another output port to <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> to supply the newly placed Thermal Banks. This will raise the output of the power grid.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>塑形机</>交互，查看设备详情。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> to open its control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_10.cn: 已成功通入了<@gd.key>惰气</>，请耐心等待<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_10.en: The facility now has an input of <@gd.key>Inergen</>. Please wait for it to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_11.cn: 我们已使用<@gd.key>塑形机</>的气体模式生产出了<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_11.en: The <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> switched to Gas Mode has now produced <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_12.cn: 接下来使用<@gd.key>封装机</>完成<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_12.en: The next step is to use the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_13.cn: 向封装机通入<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>和<@gd.key>息壤</>就可以完成<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_13.en: Input <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> and <@gd.key>Xiranite</> into the Packaging Unit to produce <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_14.cn: 后续<@gd.key>分离芯</>可以对气体进行提纯，简化产线从而提高产线效率。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_14.en: <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> can be used to purify gases. They can streamline production lines and make them more efficient.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_14_.cn: 请与<@gd.key>封装机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_14_.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to view the <@gd.key>Separator Core</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_15.cn: 封装机已锁定<@gd.key>分离芯</>的配方。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_15.en: This Packaging Unit is locked to the <@gd.key>Separator Core</> formula.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_16.cn: 将<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>和<@gd.key>息壤</>通入<@gd.key>封装机</>后，便可以完成<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_16.en: Input <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> and <@gd.key>Xiranite</> into a <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to complete <@gd.key>Separator Core</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_17.cn: 目前已经将<@gd.key>息壤</>通入了<@gd.key>封装机</>，再通入刚才生产的<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，就可以完成<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_17.en: <@gd.key>Xiranite</> is now being transported to the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</>. Now input <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> to the facility to complete <@gd.key>Separator Core</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_18.cn: 请点击此处关闭设备界面。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_18.en: Click here to close the facility's control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_19.cn: 将<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>通入<@gd.key>封装机</>，完成<@gd.key>分离芯</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_19.en: Input <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> into the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</> to complete <@gd.key>Separator Core</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_1_1.cn: 当前塑形机已解锁<@gd.key>气体模式</>。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_1_1.en: This Moulding Unit already has <@gd.key>Gas Mode</> unlocked.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_2.cn: <@gd.key>气体模式</>下的<@gd.key>塑形机</>有1个<@gd.key>管道接口</>，可以通过接口通入气体。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_2.en: A <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> switched to <@gd.key>Gas Mode</> will have 1 <@gd.key>pipe fixture</>. This can be used to input gases into the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_20.cn: 成功通入了<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，请耐心等待<@gd.key>分离芯</>完成生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_20.en: The facility now has an input of <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>. Please wait for it to produce <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_3.cn: 塑形机已锁定<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的配方。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_3.en: This Moulding Unit has been locked to the <@gd.key>Cuprium Canister</> formula.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_4.cn: 向<@gd.key>塑形机</>通入<@gd.key>惰气</>和<@gd.key>赤铜块</>后，就可以进行<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_4.en: Input <@gd.key>Inergen</> and <@gd.key>Cuprium</> into the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_5.cn: 目前已经将<@gd.key>赤铜块</>通入了<@gd.key>塑形机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_5.en: <@gd.key>Cuprium</> is now being transported to the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_6.cn: 在通入<@gd.key>惰气</>后，便可以进行<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_6.en: An input of <@gd.key>Inergen</> lets the facility produce <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_7.cn: 请点击此处关闭设备界面。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_7.en: Click here to close the facility's control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_8.cn: 场地中已经预设了通入<@gd.key>惰气</>的<@gd.key>地下暗管</>，请将<@gd.key>惰气</>通入<@gd.key>塑形机</>，完成<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_8.en: This simulation has already set up <@gd.key>conduits</> for <@gd.key>Inergen</>. Use pipelines to input <@gd.key>Inergen</> into the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> so that the facility can complete <@gd.key>Cuprium Canister</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_9.cn: 请将<@gd.key>惰气</>通入<@gd.key>塑形机</>，完成<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_9.en: Supply the <@gd.key>Moulding Unit</> with an input of <@gd.key>Inergen</> to complete <@gd.key>Cuprium Canister</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_des.cn: <@gd.key>分离芯</>是一种过滤性的装置，将其通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>可以对气体材料进行<@gd.key>提纯</>。典型产物为<@gd.key>重息壤气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_shaper_2_1_step0_des.en: The <@gd.key>Separator Core</> is a type of filtering device that the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> can use to <@gd.key>purify</> input gases. Typical product: <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>管道准入口</>交互，查看设备详情。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> to open its control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 可以调节<@gd.key>限制速度</>，调整通入液气转化机<@gd.key>激活端口</>的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>传输量，提升转化效率。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature of the <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> entering the <@gd.key>Activation Port</> to improve the transmutation efficiency.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>液气转化机</>交互，查看设备的激活情况。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to check the state of facility activation.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 使用液化息壤激活<@gd.key>液气转化机</>的最低需求传输量为<@gd.key>6单位/分</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: The minimum flow rate of Liquid Xiranite for activating the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> is <@gd.key>6 units/minute</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 当前的液化息壤供给<@gd.key>平均传输量</>远大于<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>，浪费了部分<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: The current <@gd.key>average flow rate</> of Liquid Xiranite is far higher than the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate required</>. A portion of the Liquid Xiranite is actually being wasted.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 可以使用<@gd.key>管道准入口</>的<@gd.key>限制速度</>功能，对<@gd.key>激活端口</>的<@gd.key>平均传输量</>进行控制。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature of the <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> to control the <@gd.key>average flow rate</> of the <@gd.key>Activation Port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请点击此处关闭界面。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭界面。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>管道准入口</>交互，对通入<@gd.key>液气转化机</>激活输入口的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>进行限制，提升液气转化机的效率。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> to adjust the flow rate of the <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> going into the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to improve the efficiency of the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: <@gd.key>管道准入口</>当前并未开启速度限制。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: The Adjust Flow feature is not switched ON for this <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请点击此处打开<@gd.key>限制速度</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Click here to switch ON the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 打开限制速度后，管道内的传输速度被限制到了<@gd.key>6单位/分</>，恰好达到了<@gd.key>液气转化机</>激活端口的液化息壤<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Once Adjust Flow is switched ON, the pipeline is limited to <@gd.key>6 units/minute</>, which is precisely the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate</> of Liquid Xiranite required by the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> Activation Port.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>打开<@gd.key>限制速度</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch ON the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请点击此处关闭界面。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭界面。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 通过控制液化息壤的流量，<@gd.key>液气转化机</>的生产效率得到了提升。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Adjusting the flow rate of Liquid Xiranite has boosted the production efficiency of the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 除<@gd.key>管道准入口</>外，<@gd.key>物品准入口</>也增加了<@gd.key>限制速度</>功能。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: In addition to <@gd.key>Pipe Control Ports</>, <@gd.key>Item Control Ports</> also gains the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>物品准入口</>交互，查看设备详情。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> to open its control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请点击此处打开<@gd.key>物品准入口</>的<@gd.key>限制速度</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Click here to switch ON the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature of the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>打开<@gd.key>物品准入口</>的<@gd.key>限制速度</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch ON the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature of the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.cn: 打开<@gd.key>速度限制</>后，可以对传送带的物品<@gd.key>通过速度</>进行限制，帮助管理员更好的管理产线。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_1.en: Switching ON the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature allows <@gd.key>flow rate adjustments</> to make production line management easier.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_2.cn: <@gd.key>管道准入口</>当前的限制速度为<@gd.key>0</>，<@gd.key>所有流体</>都<@gd.key>无法通过</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_2.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> has been adjusted to a flow rate of <@gd.key>0 unit/s</>. <@gd.key>Fluids</> <@gd.key>cannot flow through it</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_2.cn: 在此处可以对<@gd.key>限制速度</>进行调节。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_2.en: This lets you use the <@gd.key>Adjust Flow</> feature to adjust the flow rate.
Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_3.cn: 请点击此处<@gd.key>关闭限制速度</>，使<@gd.key>液化息壤</>能够流入<@gd.key>液气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_3.en: Click here to <@gd.key>switch OFF the Adjust Flow feature</> so that <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> can flow into the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_3.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click><@gd.key>关闭限制速度</>，使<@gd.key>液化息壤</>能够流入<@gd.key>液气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_3.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch <@gd.key>Adjust Flow OFF</> so that <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> can flow into the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_4.cn: 关闭限制后，<@gd.key>液化息壤</>已能正常通入<@gd.key>液气转化机</>并生产<@gd.key>息壤气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_4.en: Switching OFF the Adjust Flow feature allows <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> to flow normally into the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_5.en: Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_6.cn: 请耐心等待<@gd.key>息壤气</>通入<@gd.key>灌装机</>完成<@gd.key>息壤气罐</>的制备。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_6.en: Please wait for the <@gd.key>Xiragen</> to enter the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> and complete the production of <@gd.key>Xiragen (Bottled)</>.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_8.cn: 我们已通过关闭<@gd.key>管道准入口</>的速度限制，让设备恢复正常工作。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_8.en: We have switched OFF the Adjust Flow feature of the <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</>. The facility is now working normally.

guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_9.cn: 但当前通入<@gd.key>激活端口</>的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>的<@gd.key>传输量</>远高于运行所需的<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>。
guide_text_blackbox_speedlimit_1_step0_9.en: A <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> is now receiving a <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> input with a <@gd.key>flow rate</> that far exceeds the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate required</>.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_helper_1.cn: 在传送带指示线分叉处放置分流器。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_helper_1.en: Place a Splitter at the intersection of the transport belt hologram.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_helper_2.cn: 将紫晶纤维取货口连接至输入口，再从取货口连接至各设备即可。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_helper_2.en: Connect the Amethyst Fiber output port to the Splitter input port, then connect the Splitter output ports to various facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_1.cn: 点击此处，即可使用<@gd.key>分流器</>。

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_2.cn: 请注意，<@gd.key>分流器</>有一个输入口和三个取货口，可以通过箭头的朝向来分辨。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_2.en: Note that each <@gd.key>Splitter</> has 1 input port and 3 output ports. These can be differentiated with the direction of their arrows.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_3.cn: 可以按下<action=fac_rotate_device>来旋转<@gd.key>分流器</>，调整输入口和取货口的朝向。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_3.en: Press <action=fac_rotate_device> to rotate the <@gd.key>Splitter</> to change the orientation of the input and output ports.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_3_mb.cn: 可点击“旋转”按键来旋转<@gd.key>分流器</>，调整输入口和取货口的朝向。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_hint_3_mb.en: Tap the "rotate" button to rotate the <@gd.key>Splitter</> and change the orientation of the input and output ports.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_1.cn: <@gd.key>分流器</>是一种物流设备，可将单一传送带分流出最多三条传送带进行运输。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_1.en: The <@gd.key>Splitter</> is a logistics unit that can split product flow of 1 transport belt to up to 3 belts.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_2.cn: <@gd.key>分流器</>有一个输入口和三个取货口，将输出产物的传送带连接至分流器的输入口，再从取货口连出传送带，即可实现分流。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_2.en: Each <@gd.key>Splitter</> has 1 input port and 3 output ports. Connect a transport belt to the Splitter input and its product flow will be evenly split to all transport belts connected to the output ports.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_3.cn: 接下来，请参考荞花产线与传送带指示线，使用分流器将紫晶纤维运输至粉碎机、配件机和塑形机中。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_3.en: Now, refer to the Buckflower production line and transport belt holograms. Then use the Splitter to move Amethyst Fiber to the Shredding Unit, Fitting Unit and Moulding Unit.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_4.cn: <@gd.key>分流器</>已放置于快捷栏中，可以直接使用。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_start_4.en: The <@gd.key>Splitter</> has been placed in the hotbar and can be used directly.

guide_text_blackbox_splitter_step2_1.cn: 放置分流器，将源矿运输至多个热能池中。
guide_text_blackbox_splitter_step2_1.en: Place the Splitter and deliver Originium Ore to multiple Thermal Banks.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_0.cn: 请参考一旁的生产线布置，利用<@gd.key>研磨机</>搭建<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>生产线。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_0.en: Refer to the production line on the other side and use <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> to set up a <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_1.cn: 想要完成附加目标的话，或许可以调整场景中<@gd.key>供电桩</>的摆放位置。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_1.en: To complete the bonus goal, try moving the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> to another position.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_2.cn: 让我们去看看<@gd.key>装备原件机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_helper_2.en: Let's view the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_1.cn: 请先点击此处，然后在空地上放置一台<@gd.key>研磨机</>，投影仅作参考。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_1.en: Click here, then place a <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> on empty ground. The hologram can be used as a reference.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_10.cn: 点击此处关闭界面，回到场景中去搭建<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>的生产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_10.en: Click here to close the screen, then return to the scene and build a <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_10.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭界面，回到场景中去搭建<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>的生产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_10.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the screen, then return to the scene and build a <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_1_.cn: 请按下<action=fac_quick_bar_controller_build>，然后在空地上放置一台<@gd.key>研磨机</>，投影仅作参考。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_1_.en: Press <action=fac_quick_bar_controller_build>, then place a <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> on empty ground. The hologram can be used as a reference.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_2.cn: 完美的摆放，请前往<@gd.key>研磨机</>并查看详情。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_2.en: Perfectly placed. Now go to the <@gd.key>Grinding Unit</> and view its details.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_3.cn: 请点击此处查看<@gd.key>配方一览</>。

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_4.cn: 这就是<@gd.key>高晶粉末</>，精炼炉可以将其熔炼为<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_4.en: This is <@gd.key>Cryston Powder</>. The Refining Unit can refine it to <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</>.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_5.cn: 看看它的合成路径，并不复杂，想必你已经胸有成竹了。动手试试吧。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_5.en: The production chain isn't very complex. I believe you have what it takes to set this up. Let's do it.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_6.cn: 不妨将配方标记，这样回到场景中可以在右侧查看。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_6.en: Pin the formulas so they can be accessed from the right side of the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_7.cn: 这就是<@gd.key>高晶装备原件</>的合成路径。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_7.en: This is the production chain for the <@gd.key>Cryston Component</>.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_8.cn: 其中<@gd.key>密制晶体</>已经在持续生产中。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_8.en: The <@gd.key>Packed Origocrust</> is already being produced.

guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_9.cn: 缺少的<@gd.key>高晶纤维</>需要我们搭建生产线来提供。
guide_text_blackbox_thickener_1_start_9.en: We must set up another production line for <@gd.key>Cryston Fiber</>, the other material we need.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 集成核心区内已经放置了一台<@gd.key>液气转化机</>，请与<@gd.key>液气转化机</>交互查看<@gd.key>息壤气</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: A <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> is already placed in the Core AIC Area. Go and interact with it to view the <@gd.key>Xiragen</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 需要<@gd.key>持续通入液化息壤</>从而激活<@gd.key>液气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: A <@gd.key>steady input of Liquid Xiranite</> is required to activate the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 请点击此处关闭设备界面。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: Click here to close the facility's control panel.
Press <action=common_cancel> to close the facility's control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 将地下暗管的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>通入<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>激活<@gd.key>液气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: To activate the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>, transport <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> from the conduit to the <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> of the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 等待<@gd.key>液化息壤</>通入激活<@gd.key>液气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> to enter the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> and activate it.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 请与<@gd.key>液气转化机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>液气转化机</>的激活情况。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to check if the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> has been activated.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 这是使用<@gd.key>液化息壤</>激活<@gd.key>液气转化机</>的<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: This is the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate</> of <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> required to activate the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 液化息壤的当前<@gd.key>平均传输量</>大于<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>，液气转化机已经<@gd.key>成功激活</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: The current <@gd.key>average flow rate</> of Liquid Xiranite is higher than the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate required</>. The Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit has been <@gd.key>successfully activated</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 激活后的液气转化机可以将<@gd.key>液化息壤</>转化为<@gd.key>息壤气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: An activated Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit can transmute <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> into <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.
Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.cn: 我们成功使用<@gd.key>液气转化机</>生产了<@gd.key>息壤气</>，接下来可以使用<@gd.key>气液模式</>的<@gd.key>灌装机</>进行灌装。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_1.en: We have successfully used the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Xiragen</>. A <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> switched to <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</> can then fill the gas in a suitable container.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 请与<@gd.key>液气转化机</>交互查看<@gd.key>息壤气</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to view the <@gd.key>Xiragen</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 请先使用管道将液气转化机转化的<@gd.key>息壤气</>通入<@gd.key>灌装机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Xiragen</> from the Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit to the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 请与<@gd.key>灌装机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>息壤气</>的灌装生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> to view the production formula for filling <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: <@gd.key>灌装机</>已解锁<@gd.key>气液模式</>，气液模式下灌装机可以对<@gd.key>液体和气体</>进行<@gd.key>灌装</>。灌装机已锁定为<@gd.key>气液模式</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: The <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</> has been unlocked for the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>. A <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> switched to Gas & Fluid Mode can <@gd.key>fill</> <@gd.key>gases and fluids</>. This Filling Unit has been locked to Gas & Fluid Mode.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 这是使用<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>对<@gd.key>息壤气</>进行灌装的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: This is the production formula for filling <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> with <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 在通入<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>后，可以对<@gd.key>息壤气</>进行灌装。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Input <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> into the facility to fill them up with <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.
Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 本次模拟空间已将<@gd.key>协议核心取货口1</>锁定为<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: This simulation has locked the product of <@gd.key>PAC output port 1</> to <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 请通过传送带向<@gd.key>灌装机</>通入<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>以完成<@gd.key>息壤气</>的灌装。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Use transport belts to move <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> into the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> to fill them up with <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 请通过传送带将<@gd.key>协议核心取货口1</>的<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>通入<@gd.key>灌装机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: Use transport belts to move <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> from <@gd.key>PAC output port 1</> to the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.cn: 现在已经成功向<@gd.key>罐装机</>通入了<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，请耐心等待<@gd.key>息壤气</>完成灌装。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_2.en: The <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> is now being supplied with <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>. Please wait for them to be filled up with <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_3.cn: <@gd.key>液气转化机</>可以在<@gd.key>气体产出</>和<@gd.key>液体产出</>模式之间进行切换，此设备已被模拟空间锁定为<@gd.key>气体产出</>模式。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_3.en: The <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can switch between <@gd.key>Gasify</> and <@gd.key>Fluidify</> modes. For the purpose of this simulation, this facility has been locked to <@gd.key>Gasify</> mode.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_4.cn: <@gd.key>气体产出</>模式的<@gd.key>液气转化机</>可以将输入的<@gd.key>液体</>转化为对应的<@gd.key>气体</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_4.en: A <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> switched to <@gd.key>Gasify</> can transmute an input <@gd.key>fluid</> into its <@gd.key>gaseous</> form.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_5.cn: 请点击此处打开配方界面进行查看。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_5.en: Click here to view the formula screen.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_5.cn: 请按下<action=fac_machine_show_formula>打开配方界面进行查看。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_5.en: Press <action=fac_machine_show_formula> to view the formula screen.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_6.cn: <@gd.key>液气转化机</>可以将<@gd.key>液化息壤</>转化为<@gd.key>息壤气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_6.en: The <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can transmute <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> into <@gd.key>Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_7.cn: 也可以将<@gd.key>沉积酸</>转化为<@gd.key>酸气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_7.en: It can also transmute <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</> to <@gd.key>Acridgen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_8.cn: 请点击此处关闭配方界面。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_8.en: Click here to close the formula screen.
Press <action=common_cancel> to close the formula screen.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_9.cn: 当前设备的<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>没有通入<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，处于<@gd.key>未激活</>状态，无法正常运行。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_1_step0_9.en: The <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> of this facility has no <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> supply. It is thus <@gd.key>inactive</> and unable to perform any production.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 前往打开目标<@gd.key>固气转化机</>的操作面板，将<@gd.key>固气转化机</>切换为<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Open the control panel of the target <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> and switch the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to <@gd.key>Solidify</> mode.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 请点击将<@gd.key>固气转化机</>模式切换为<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Press to switch the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to <@gd.key>Solidify</> mode.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>将<@gd.key>固气转化机</>模式切换为<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to <@gd.key>Solidify</> mode.
Press <action=common_controller_side_menu> to expand the facility's <@gd.key>Quick Action</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 处于<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式下的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>可以将输入的<@gd.key>气态物质</>转化为<@gd.key>固态物质</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: When switched to <@gd.key>Solidify</>, the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can transmute an input <@gd.key>gas</> into <@gd.key>solid matter</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 请将<@gd.key>储气罐</>中的<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>通过管道通入处于<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> from the <@gd.key>Gas Tank</> to the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> switched to <@gd.key>Solidify</> mode.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 请通过<@gd.key>管道分流器</>连接管道将<@gd.key>息壤气</>通入<@gd.key>固气转化机</>的<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Add a <@gd.key>Pipe Splitter</> to the pipeline and transport <@gd.key>Xiragen</> into the <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> of the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.cn: 等待处于<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>完成<@gd.key>赫铜块</>生产。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_extrast.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> switched to <@gd.key>Solidify</> mode to produce <@gd.key>Hetonite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_1.cn: 请通过管道连接<@gd.key>固气转化机</>和<@gd.key>提纯机</>，将转化的<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>中进行提纯生产。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_1.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> with pipelines to transport the transmuted <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> into the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> for purifying.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_2.cn: 请前往打开<@gd.key>提纯机</>的操作面板，查看<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>的提纯生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_2.en: Open the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> control panel to view the purification formula for <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_3.cn: 可以在此处将<@gd.key>提纯机</>切换至<@gd.key>气体模式</>以进行气体提纯，此设备已被模拟空间切换至<@gd.key>气体模式</>
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_3.en: This lets you switch the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to <@gd.key>Gas Mode</> to purify gases. This simulation has already switched this facility to <@gd.key>Gas Mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_4.cn: 本次模拟空间已锁定<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>的提纯生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_4.en: This simulation has locked this facility to the formula of <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> purification.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_5.cn: 将<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>提纯为<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>需要额外消耗<@gd.key>分离芯</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step1_5.en: Purifying <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> to <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> will consume <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_0.cn: 集成核心区内已经放置了一台处于<@gd.key>固气转化机</>，请前往查看<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>的转化生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_0.en: A <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> is already placed in the Core AIC Area. Go and interact with it to view the <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> transmutation formula.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 请前往打开<@gd.key>固气转化机</>的操作面板，查看<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>的转化生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: Open the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> control panel to view the <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> transmutation formula.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 集成工业已在另一片工厂区域完成了激活所需的<@gd.key>息壤气</>生产，并通过<@gd.key>地下暗管</>传输至当前工厂。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: A complete <@gd.key>Xiragen</> production line has been placed in another area of the AIC Factory. The gas is being transported to this area via <@gd.key>conduits</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 请通过管道将<@gd.key>息壤气</>通入<@gd.key>固气转化机</>的<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>完成激活。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: To activate the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>, connect a supply of <@gd.key>Xiragen</> to the facility's <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> using pipelines.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 等待<@gd.key>息壤气</>通入并激活<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Xiragen</> to enter the activation port and activate the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 通过<@gd.key>持续通入息壤气</>，已成功激活<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: A <@gd.key>steady input of Xiragen</> has successfully activated the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 请前往查看已激活的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: Open the control panel of the activated <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 这是激活<@gd.key>固气转化机</>所需息壤气的<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: This is the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate</> of Xiragen required to activate the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 息壤气的<@gd.key>当前平均传输量</>大于<@gd.key>最低需求传输量</>，已成功激活<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: The current <@gd.key>average flow rate</> of Xiragen is higher than the <@gd.key>minimum flow rate required</>. The <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> has been successfully activated.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.cn: 激活状态的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>可以将<@gd.key>赤铜块</>转化为<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_1.en: An activated <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can transmute <@gd.key>Cuprium</> into <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_2.cn: <@gd.key>固气转化机</>可以在<@gd.key>气体产出</>模式和<@gd.key>固体产出</>模式之间进行切换，此设备已被模拟空间切换至<@gd.key>气体产出</>模式。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_2.en: The <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can switch between <@gd.key>Gasify</> and <@gd.key>Solidify</> modes. For the purpose of this simulation, this facility has been switched to <@gd.key>Gasify</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_3.cn: <@gd.key>气体产出</>模式的<@gd.key>固气转化机</>可以将输入的<@gd.key>赤铜块</>从固态转化为气态从而生产<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_3.en: When switched to <@gd.key>Gasify</>, the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> can transmute input <@gd.key>Cuprium</> (a solid material) into <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_4.cn: 集成工业已在另一片区域完成<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的制备并已将其通入<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_4.en: A <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production line linked to a <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> has been set up in another area of the AIC Factory.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_5.cn: 当前设备的<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>没有通入<@gd.key>息壤气</>，处于<@gd.key>未激活</>状态，无法正常运行。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_5.en: The facility's <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> is not connected to a supply of <@gd.key>Xiragen</>. The facility is therefore <@gd.key>inactive</> and unable to work.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_5.cn: 需要<@gd.key>持续通入息壤气</>从而激活<@gd.key>固气转化机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step2_5.en: A <@gd.key>steady input of Xiragen</> is required to activate the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_1.cn: 本次模拟空间已将<@gd.key>协议核心取货口3</>锁定为<@gd.key>分离芯</>，请通过传送带将其通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>进行<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>制备。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_1.en: This simulation has locked the product of <@gd.key>PAC output port 3</> to <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>. Use transport belts to move the Separator Cores to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> for <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> production.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_2.cn: 请通过传送带将<@gd.key>分离芯</>从<@gd.key>协议核心</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_2.en: Use transport belts to move <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> from the <@gd.key>PAC</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_3.cn: 等待<@gd.key>分离芯</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>完成<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>提纯。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step3_3.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> to enter the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> so that the facility can perform purification and produce <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_1.cn: 现在<@gd.key>提纯机</>已成功开始将<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>提纯为<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_1.en: The <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> has successfully purified <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> into <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_2.cn: 请通过管道连接<@gd.key>固气转化机</>和<@gd.key>提纯机</>，将转化的<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>中进行提纯生产。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_2.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> with pipelines to transport the transmuted <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> into the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> for purifying.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_3.cn: 请通过管道连接<@gd.key>固气转化机</>和<@gd.key>提纯机</>，将<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>通入提纯机中进行提纯。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_3.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> with pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> into the Purification Unit for purifying.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_4.cn: 请通过管道连接<@gd.key>提纯机</>和<@gd.key>储气罐</>，将提纯机生产的<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>通入<@gd.key>储气罐</>中储存。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_4.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Gas Tank</> with pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> produced by the Purification Unit to the <@gd.key>Gas Tank</> for storage.

guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_5.cn: 等待<@gd.key>提纯机</>提纯生产的<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>通入<@gd.key>储气罐</>。
guide_text_blackbox_transmuter_2_step4_5.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> purified and produced by the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to enter the <@gd.key>Gas Tank</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_1.en: Other facilities required for the simulation's bonus goal are placed in the <@gd.key>Simulation Backpack</>. Use them to complete the bonus goal of treating the Sewage produced by the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_2.cn: 在集成核心区打开<@gd.key>背包</>，将设备从模拟仓库转移至背包。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_2.en: Open the <@gd.key>Backpack</> in the Core AIC Area, then move the facilities from the Simulation Depot to the Backpack.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_3.cn: 通过发放的<@gd.key>暗管入口</>和<@gd.key>暗管出口</>将精炼炉产生的污水运至工厂外的废水处理机完成处理。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_3.en: Use the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> and <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> provided to move the Refining Unit's Sewage byproduct to the Water Treatment Unit outside the factory area for treatment.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_4.cn: 等待<@gd.key>废水处理机</>完成污水处理。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_extra_start_4.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Units</> to completely treat the Sewage.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_1.en: A <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> is already placed in the Core AIC Area. Go and interact with it to view the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_10.cn: 当前设备未连接任何<@gd.key>暗管出口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_10.en: This facility is not connected to any <@gd.key>Conduit Outlets</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_11.cn: 点击关闭<@gd.key>暗管入口</>操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_11.en: Click to close the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_11_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> control panel.
