guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_12.en: Press <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to start connecting the underground <@gd.key>conduit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_2.cn: 请前往打开<@gd.key>精炼炉</>设备的操作面板，查看<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_2.en: Open the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> facility control panel and view the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_3.cn: 这是<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_3.en: This is the production formula for <@gd.key>Cuprium</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_4.cn: 生产<@gd.key>赤铜块</>需要消耗<@gd.key>清水</>，可以用<@gd.key>地下暗管</>将清水跨障碍传输至工厂。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_4.en: <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production needs <@gd.key>Clean Water</>. Underground pipe systems called <@gd.key>conduits</> can deliver Clean Water to the AIC Factory facilities without being impeded by various obstructions.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_6.cn: 工团工人在水源处放置了<@gd.key>暗管入口</>，并已经将其连接至水泵，请前往查看水源区域的<@gd.key>暗管入口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_6.en: UWST crew mates have placed a <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> at the water source and connected it to a Water Pump. Go and check the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> in the water source area.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_7.cn: 前往水源区打开<@gd.key>暗管入口</>操作面板，查看<@gd.key>设备详情</>。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_7.en: Go to the water source and open the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> control panel for <@gd.key>details</> of the underground conduits.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_8.cn: 按下<action=common_interact>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处查看操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_8.en: Press <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_9.cn: <@gd.key>暗管入口</>可以将液体传输至地下暗管，通过连接<@gd.key>暗管出口</>将液体传输至对应位置。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_start_9.en: <@gd.key>Conduit Inlets</> can transport fluids to underground conduits while <@gd.key>Conduit Outlets</> discharge the fluids from their locations.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step1_1.cn: 本次模拟空间已将<@gd.key>暗管出口</>放置在工厂模拟仓库，现在请前往目标点放置<@gd.key>暗管出口</>并完成地下暗管连接。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step1_1.en: For this simulation, the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> is placed in the AIC Factory Simulation Depot. Go to the target location, place the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</>, and complete the conduit connection.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step1_2.cn: 请前往目标点放置<@gd.key>暗管出口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step1_2.en: Go to the target location and place the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_1.cn: <@gd.key>暗管出口</>需通过地下暗管连接至<@gd.key>暗管入口</>才能完成液体传输。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_1.en: <@gd.key>Conduit Outlets</> must be connected to <@gd.key>Conduit Inlets</> via underground pipes (conduits) to achieve fluid transportation.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_2.cn: 按下<action=common_interact>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处开始<@gd.key>地下暗管</>连接。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_2.en: Press <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to start connecting the underground <@gd.key>conduit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_3.cn: 请靠近暗管设备，并<@gd.key>开始地下暗管连接</>，然后完成<@gd.key>暗管入口</>和<@gd.key>暗管出口</>的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_3.en: Go to the conduit to <@gd.key>start the conduit connection</>, then connect the <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> to the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</>.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_4.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>暗管入口</>或<@gd.key>暗管出口</>处查看设备详情。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step2_4.en: To check the connection, go to the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> or <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> and open its control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_1.cn: 在设备操作面板可以查看当前暗管设备的连接情况。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_1.en: Open the control panel to check the current connection of these conduit facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_2.cn: 此处可以查看当前暗管连接口在地图上的<@gd.key>位置</>，模拟空间已<@gd.key>暂时禁用</>地图功能。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_2.en: Use this to view the current <@gd.key>positions</> of conduit connections on the map. However, this Simulation has <@gd.key>temporarily disabled</> the map feature.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_3.cn: 此处可以<@gd.key>断开</>和当前暗管连接口的连接。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_3.en: Use this to <@gd.key>cut</> the connection to the current conduit.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_4.cn: 点击关闭设备操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_4.en: Click to close the facility control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_4_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭设备操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_4_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the facility control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_5.cn: 现在可以通过管道连接<@gd.key>暗管出口</>和<@gd.key>精炼炉</>，完成<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_5.en: Now, connect the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> with pipelines to complete the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_6.cn: 通过管道连接<@gd.key>暗管出口</>和<@gd.key>精炼炉</>，完成<@gd.key>赤铜块</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_6.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> with pipelines to complete the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_7.cn: 等待<@gd.key>赤铜块</>产线完成生产。
guide_text_blackbox_udpipe_step3_7.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Cuprium</> production line to do its work.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.cn: 设备需<@gd.key>完全处于气体环境</>中，才能受到环境影响，进行环境配方生产。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.en: Facilities must be <@gd.key>fully placed in a gaseous environment</> to acquire gaseous environment effects and switch to formulas specific to that gaseous environment.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.cn: 请前往指定位置放置<@gd.key>提纯机</>，使其<@gd.key>完全处于稳定环境</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.en: Place a <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> at the marked location so that it is <@gd.key>fully within the Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.cn: 请通过管道将<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>从<@gd.key>暗管出口</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> from the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.cn: 请通过传送带将<@gd.key>分离芯</>从<@gd.key>协议核心</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>，完成气态赫铜提纯。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.en: Use transport belts to move <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> from the <@gd.key>PAC</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to complete Hetonite Gas purification.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.cn: 请将提纯机提纯的<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>通入<@gd.key>固气转化机</>，完成赫铜块生产。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_extrastep1.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</> purified by the Purification Unit to the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to complete Hetonite production.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_1.cn: 集成工业已在提纯机附近放置一台<@gd.key>气体散布机</>，气体散布机可以通过<@gd.key>持续通入惰气</>制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_1.en: The AIC Factory has already placed a <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> near the Purification Unit. A <@gd.key>steady input of Inergen</> can be connected to the Gas Dispersing Unit to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_2.cn: 请前往和<@gd.key>气体散布机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>气体散布机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_2.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> and open the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_3.cn: <@gd.key>气体散布机</>可以通过<@gd.key>持续通入气体</>改变外部环境，当前气体散布机已被锁定为<@gd.key>稳定环境</>生成。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_3.en: The <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> can disperse a <@gd.key>steady input of gas</> to change the local gaseous environment. This Gas Dispersing Unit has been locked to the <@gd.key>Stable environment</> mode.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_4.cn: 制造稳定环境需要<@gd.key>持续通入惰气</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step1_4.en: Creating a Stable environment requires a <@gd.key>steady input of Inergen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_1.cn: 集成工业已经将开采的<@gd.key>惰气</>通过<@gd.key>地下暗管</>运至工厂。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_1.en: This simulation is already transporting extracted <@gd.key>Inergen</> via <@gd.key>conduits</> to the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_2.cn: 请通过管道将<@gd.key>惰气</>从<@gd.key>暗管出口</>通入<@gd.key>气体散布机</>的<@gd.key>绿色激活端口</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_2.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Inergen</> from the <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to the <@gd.key>Green Activation Port</> of the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_3.cn: 等待<@gd.key>惰气</>通入<@gd.key>气体散布机</>，制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_3.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Inergen</> to enter the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</>. The facility will then start to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_4.cn: 通过<@gd.key>持续通入惰气</>，气体散布机已成功制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_4.en: With a <@gd.key>steady input of Inergen</>, the Gas Dispersing Unit has successfully created a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_5.cn: 请前往和<@gd.key>气体散布机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>气体散布机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_5.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> and open the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_6.cn: 这是产生<@gd.key>稳定环境</>所需的惰气通入<@gd.key>最低需求</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_6.en: This is the <@gd.key>minimum input flow rate</> of Inergen required to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_7.cn: 惰气通入的<@gd.key>当前平均传输量</>大于<@gd.key>最低需求</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_7.en: The <@gd.key>current average input flow rate</> of Inergen is higher than the <@gd.key>minimum requirement</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step2_8.en: A <@gd.key>Stable environment</> has been successfully produced.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_1.cn: 请前往和<@gd.key>提纯机</>交互，查看<@gd.key>提纯机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> and open the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> control panel.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_2.cn: 当前<@gd.key>提纯机</>已锁定为<@gd.key>稳定环境提纯配方</>，进行此配方生产需要让设备处于稳定环境。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_2.en: This <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> has been locked to <@gd.key>purification formulas in a Stable environment</>. The facility must be in a Stable environment to use such formulas.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_3.cn: <@gd.key>稳定环境</>下可以消耗<@gd.key>更少分离芯</>完成<@gd.key>重息壤气提纯</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_3.en: In a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>, the process of <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen Purification</> consumes fewer <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_4.cn: 通过<@gd.key>气体散布机</>我们已经成功制造了<@gd.key>稳定环境</>，当前提纯机已处于稳定环境。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step3_4.en: We have successfully used the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_1.cn: 本次模拟空间已将<@gd.key>协议核心取货口1</>锁定为<@gd.key>分离芯</>，请通过传送带将其输入提纯机完成重息壤气提纯。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_1.en: This simulation has locked the product of <@gd.key>PAC output port 1</> to <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>. Use transport belts to move the Separator Cores to the Purification Unit for Heavy Xiragen Purification.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_2.cn: 请通过传送带将<@gd.key>分离芯</>从<@gd.key>协议核心</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_2.en: Use transport belts to move <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> from the <@gd.key>PAC</> to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_3.cn: 等待<@gd.key>分离芯</>通入<@gd.key>提纯机</>，完成<@gd.key>重息壤气</>提纯。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_3.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> to enter the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> so that the facility can perform purification and produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen</>.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_4.cn: 请将提纯机提纯的<@gd.key>重息壤气</>通入<@gd.key>固气转化机</>，完成重息壤转化。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_4.en: Use pipelines to transport <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen</> purified by the Purification Unit to the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to complete Heavy Xiragen transmutation.

guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_5.cn: 等待<@gd.key>固气转化机</>完成<@gd.key>重息壤</>转化。
guide_text_blackbox_vaporizer_step4_5.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit</> to complete <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> transmutation.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_0.cn: 很好，<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>已开始生产。

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_1.cn: 这是一份本模拟空间专用的<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件蓝图</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_1.en: This is a special <@gd.key>Amethyst Component Blueprint</> usable only in the simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处<@gd.key>查看更多功能</>。

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_2.cn: <@gd.key>装备原件</>是制造装备的原材料，因此我们需要<@gd.key>再建造一条装备原件产线</>，加快生产。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_2.en: <@gd.key>Gear components</> are raw materials for gear assembly. We must <@gd.key>set up another gear component production line</> to speed things up.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_2_mb.cn: 接下来我们可以用<@gd.key>蓝图</>加快生产，点击此处打开<@gd.key>蓝图</>界面。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_2_mb.en: Next, let's use the <@gd.key>blueprint</> to speed up our production. Tap here to open the <@gd.key>Blueprints</> screen.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3.cn: 可拖动蓝图以改变蓝图位置，使其与场景中的设备虚影<@gd.key>完全重叠</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3.en: Drag the blueprint to change its position and make sure it <@gd.key>perfectly overlaps</> with the facilities hologram shown in the scene.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3_ct.cn: 推动<action=common_leftstick>以改变蓝图位置，使其与场景中的设备虚影<@gd.key>完全重叠</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3_ct.en: Use the <action=common_leftstick> stick to change the blueprint's position and make sure it <@gd.key>perfectly overlaps</> with the facilities hologram shown in the scene.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3_mb.cn: 点击此处完成<@gd.key>蓝图</>的放置。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_3_mb.en: Tap here to complete placing the <@gd.key>Blueprint</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_4.cn: 接下来我们可以用<@gd.key>蓝图</>加快生产，按下快捷键<action=fac_open_blueprint>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开<@gd.key>蓝图</>界面。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_4.en: Next, let's use the <@gd.key>blueprint</> to speed up our production. Press the hotkey <action=fac_open_blueprint> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Blueprints</> screen.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_4_mb.cn: 点击此处退出<@gd.key>蓝图放置状态</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_4_mb.en: Tap here to exit <@gd.key>Blueprint Placement Mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_5_mb.cn: 点击此处退出俯瞰模式。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_1_5_mb.en: Tap here to exit Top View Mode

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_1.cn: 注意，<@gd.key>物品准入口</>上显示的物品图标，是提示我们应该往这条传送带上输入的<@gd.key>物品</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_1.en: Note, the item icon shown above the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> is the <@gd.key>item</> that can freely pass along this transport belt.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_2.cn: 根据两处物品准入口的提示，在<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>选择对应的物品进行输出吧。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_2.en: Reference the two Item Control Port icons and select the proper items to unload from the <@gd.key>PAC output ports</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_3.cn: 很好，成功地放置了<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件蓝图</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_3.en: Good. The <@gd.key>Amethyst Component Blueprint</> has been successfully deployed.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_5.cn: 系统蓝图放置后，根据<@gd.key>物品准入口</>显示的提示，在<@gd.key>取货口</>选择对应的物品输出至传送带上，即可使产线自动运转。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_2_5.en: After placing a system blueprint, reference the icon indicated on the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> and interact with the <@gd.key>output port</> to select the item to unload onto the transport belt, and get the automated production line to work.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_confirm.cn: 点击鼠标左键<action=fac_build_confirm>完成<@gd.key>蓝图</>的放置。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_confirm.en: Click the left mouse button <action=fac_build_confirm> to complete placing the <@gd.key>blueprint</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_1.cn: 点击<@gd.key>鼠标右键</><image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse1" scale=1.3>或按下<action=fac_build_cancel>退出蓝图放置状态。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_1.en: Click the <@gd.key>right mouse button</> <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_mouse1" scale=1.3> or click <action=fac_build_cancel> to exit Blueprint Placement mode.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_3.cn: 按下快捷键<action=fac_switch_view_mode>或点击此处退出<@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_3.en: Press the hotkey <action=fac_switch_view_mode> or click here to exit <@gd.key>Top View Mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_4.cn: 接下来，需要前往<@gd.key>4、5号协议取货口</>分别设置<@gd.key>源矿</>和<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>为输出物。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_4.en: Next, go to <@gd.key>PAC output ports 4 and 5</> and set <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the items to unload from the output ports respectively.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_5.cn: 如此一来，我们就借助<@gd.key>蓝图</>快速搭建了一条<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件产线</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_5.en: We now have successfully used a <@gd.key>blueprint</> to quickly set up an <@gd.key>Amethyst Component production line</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_6.cn: 请<@gd.key>等待紫晶装备原件</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_extra_6.en: <@gd.key>Wait for the Amethyst Components</> to be produced.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_intro_ct.cn: 接下来我们可以用<@gd.key>蓝图</>加快生产，请按下<action=common_confirm>打开<@gd.key>蓝图</>界面。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_intro_ct.en: Next, let's use the <@gd.key>blueprint</> to speed up our production. Press <action=common_confirm> to open the <@gd.key>Blueprints</> screen.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_usebtn.cn: 点击此处开始<@gd.key>放置蓝图</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_bp_usebtn.en: Click here to start <@gd.key>placing the blueprint</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_build_exit_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to exit the <@gd.key>blueprint placement mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_1.cn: 要想达成<@gd.key>附加目标</>，我们还需要再搭建一条<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>的产线。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_1.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, we must set up another <@gd.key>Amethyst Component</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_2.cn: 不妨试着参照已有的形式，在协议核心另一侧放置新的<@gd.key>精炼炉</>和<@gd.key>装备原件机</>来增设一条产线吧。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_2.en: Let's reference the existing line and set up a new production line. Start by placing a new <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> and <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> next to the PAC.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_3.cn: 注意，<@gd.key>传送带控量阀</>可以对当前允许通过传送带的物品进行限制，避免将错误的原料输送到设备中。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_3.en: <@gd.key>Belt Control Limiters</> only allow certain items to pass through the belt. They can thus prevent wrong items from entering the facility input.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_4.cn: 场地中的这2个传送带控量阀分别设定了可通过的物品为<@gd.key>源矿</>和<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_4.en: The 2 Belt Control Limiters in the area only allow the passage of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> respectively.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_5.cn: 接下来请根据此设定补齐产线，并从临近协议核心取货口选定合适的原料来进行输送吧。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_extra_5.en: Use this design feature to complete the production line. Interact with the nearby PAC output port and unload a suitable material from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_reward_pop_1.cn: 获得了一份<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件蓝图</>，<@gd.key>蓝图</>系统解锁后，可以在集成核心区域使用此蓝图，快速布置紫晶装备原件产线。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_reward_pop_1.en: An <@gd.key>Amethyst Component Blueprint</> has been acquired. Unlocking the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> system allows the use of this blueprint to quickly set up an Amethyst Component production line in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_start_1.cn: 装备原件是制造各类装备所需的必要材料，可以通用<@gd.key>装备原件机</>来进行生产。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_start_1.en: Gear components are essential for gear assembly. They are produced by the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_start_2.cn: 集成核心区中已经放置了一台<@gd.key>装备原件机</>，先与它交互来查看<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>的生产配方吧。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_start_2.en: There is already a <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> placed in the Core AIC Area. Interact with it to check the <@gd.key>Amethyst Component</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step0_1.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>装备原件机</>处查看紫晶装备原件的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step0_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> to view the Amethyst Component production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step1_1.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>协议核心取货口</>进行设置，将矿物从仓库输送到精炼炉中进行加工。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step1_1.en: Go and set up the <@gd.key>PAC output port</> to unload the mineral ores from the Depot to the Refining Unit for processing.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_0.cn: 请前往<@gd.key>3号协议取货口</>将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>设定为输出物。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_0.en: Interact with <@gd.key>PAC output port 3</> and select <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the item to unload from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_1.cn: 接下来，请使用传送带连接<@gd.key>两台精炼炉</>的取货口到<@gd.key>装备原件机</>的输入口上。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_1.en: Next, use the transport belt to connect the output ports of the <@gd.key>two Refining Units</> to the input ports of the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_2.cn: 请<@gd.key>等待</>2种原料运输到装备原件机中，并<@gd.key>开始生产紫晶装备原件</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_2.en: <@gd.key>Wait</> for the 2 types of materials to be transported to the Gearing Unit so <@gd.key>Amethyst Component production can begin</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_3.cn: 最后，请使用<@gd.key>传送带</>连接<@gd.key>装备原件机</>到<@gd.key>协议核心输入口</>，将产出的紫晶装备原件运回仓库。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_3.en: Finally, use the <@gd.key>transport belt</> to connect the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> to the <@gd.key>PAC input port</> and move the Amethyst Components produced to the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_4.cn: 非常好，现在我们就有了一条生产紫晶装备原件的自动产线了。等待产线运转就可以完成本次模拟的主要目标。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_step2_4.en: Great. Now we have an automated Amethyst Component production line. Wait for the production line to work and complete the main goal of this simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_topview_cance.en: Press and hold <action=common_cancel> to exit <@gd.key>Top View Mode</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1.cn: 协议核心取货口可以将物品从仓库输送到传送带上，每个取货口可设定一种物品进行输出。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1.en: PAC output ports can move items from the Depot to a connected transport belt. Each output port can unload one selected item from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1_1.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>进行选择。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1_1.en: Click on the <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> to select it.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1_2.cn: 现在这个取货口可以持续输出<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_1_2.en: This output port is now unloading <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> out of the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_2.cn: 请点击这里选择希望从此取货口输出的物品。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_2.en: Click here to select the item to unload from this output port.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_3.cn: 这里列出了当前协议核心仓库中的可用物品，现在需要将<@gd.key>源矿</>和<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>这2种原料分别从仓库输出。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_3.en: This is a list of items that can be unloaded from the PAC Depot. The current requirement is to unload these 2 raw materials from the Depot: <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</>.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_4.cn: 请先点击<@gd.key>源矿</>进行选择。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_4.en: First, click on the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> to select it.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_5.cn: 现在这个取货口可以持续输出源矿了，接下来我们还需将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>也从仓库中进行输出。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_5.en: This output port is now unloading Originium Ore from the Depot. The next step is to unload <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_6.cn: 请点击关闭按钮退出界面。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_6.en: Click the close button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_7.cn: 协议核心共有六个取货口，每个取货口可分别设定1种物品进行输出。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_7.en: The PAC has a total of 6 output ports. Each output port can unload 1 selected item from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_8.cn: 接下来请前往3号协议核心取货口将<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>设定为输出物，让2个精炼炉可以分别生产<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>和<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_unloader_8.en: Next, set <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> as the item to unload from PAC output port 3 so that the 2 Refining Units can produce <@gd.key>Origocrust</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</> respectively.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_1.cn: 在这里可以看到，紫晶装备原件需要用到<@gd.key>两种生产原料</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_1.en: This shows we need <@gd.key>2 materials</> for producing Amethyst Components.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_4.cn: 我们需要将这<@gd.key>两种原料</>都输送到装备原件机中以生产紫晶装备原件。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_4.en: We must move these <@gd.key>2 types of materials</> to the Gearing Unit so that the facility can produce Amethyst Components.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_5.cn: 请先点击按钮关闭界面。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_5.en: First click the button to close the panel.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_6.cn: <@gd.key>源矿</>和<@gd.key>紫晶矿</>在分别经过精炼炉加工后可以产出<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>和<@gd.key>紫晶纤维</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_6.en: <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Ore</> can be processed by Refining Units to make <@gd.key>Origocrust</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Fiber</> respectively.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_7.cn: 集成核心区中已经预先放置了生产这2种材料的所需<@gd.key>精炼炉</>。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_7.en: The <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> for producing the 2 types of products is already placed in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_8.cn: 接下来请先前往<@gd.key>1号协议取货口</>进行设置，将<@gd.key>源矿</>选为输出物。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_8.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>PAC output port 1</> and select <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> as the item to unload from the Depot.

guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_9.cn: 再参照指示线进行<@gd.key>传送带</>的连接，将精炼炉的产物运输到<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_winder_winder_9.en: Then reference the guiding line to connect the <@gd.key>transport belt</> and move the Refining Unit products to the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_extr.cn: 为了完成<@gd.key>附加目标</> ，可以使用<@gd.key>蓝图</>快速搭建<@gd.key>低容武陵电池</>产线。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_extr.en: To complete the <@gd.key>bonus goal</>, use <@gd.key>blueprints</> to quickly set up an <@gd.key>LC Wuling Battery</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_extr.cn: 根据<@gd.key>物品准入口</>的提示，在协议核心取货口选择对应的物品进行输出吧。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_extr.en: Reference the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> icons and select the proper items to unload from the PAC output ports.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_rewa.cn: 获得了一份息壤装备与电池的<@gd.key>蓝图</>，可以在集成核心区域使用此蓝图，快速布置息壤装备原件与低容武陵电池产线。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_rewa.en: A <@gd.key>blueprint</> for Xiranite Components and Batteries has been acquired. Use this blueprint in the Core AIC Area to quickly deploy production lines for Xiranite Components and LC Wuling Batteries.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_star.cn: 请先与<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>交互以查看<@gd.key>息壤</>的生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_star.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to check the production formula for <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 可以看到，<@gd.key>息壤</>由<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>稳定碳块</>生成。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: This shows that <@gd.key>Xiranite</> is produced with <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Stabilized Carbon</>.
Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: <@gd.key>稳定碳块</>已经正常输入，接下来需要输入<@gd.key>清水</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: There is now a steady input of <@gd.key>Stabilized Carbon</>. The next input to prepare is <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 接下来请将断掉的<@gd.key>管道</>连至<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，输送<@gd.key>清水</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Complete the disconnected <@gd.key>pipeline</> and connect to the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to supply it with <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 非常好，现在<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>开始生产<@gd.key>息壤</>了。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Excellent. The <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> can now produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 请<@gd.key>组合</> 2 份蓝图，完成<@gd.key>稳定碳块</>产线的搭建，并输入至<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: <@gd.key>Combine</> the 2 blueprints to complete the <@gd.key>Stabilized Carbon</> production line and input the products into the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: <@gd.key>息壤</>是非常有用的物品，因此我们需要多布置一条<@gd.key>息壤</>产线来加快生产。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: <@gd.key>Xiranite</> is extremely useful. Hence, we should set up 1 more <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line to make more.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 想要快速布置<@gd.key>息壤</>产线，请按下快捷键<action=fac_open_blueprint>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处使用<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: To quickly set up a <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line, press the hotkey <action=fac_open_blueprint> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to use the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> function.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 在本次<@gd.key>模拟空间</>中，有 2 份<@gd.key>蓝图</>可供使用。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: This <@gd.key>simulation</> has 2 <@gd.key>blueprints</> that can be used.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 这是本模拟空间专用的<@gd.key>息壤</>的产线蓝图。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: This is a special <@gd.key>Xiranite production line blueprint</> usable only in this simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 很好，已成功放置<@gd.key>息壤</>产线蓝图。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Excellent. The <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line blueprint has been placed.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 请根据<@gd.key>物品准入口</>和<@gd.key>管道准入口</>的提示，输入对应的<@gd.key>碳块</>、<@gd.key>砂叶</>和<@gd.key>清水</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Refer to the icons of the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> and <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> to input <@gd.key>Carbon</>, <@gd.key>Sandleaf</>, and <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.
Click to return to the main screen of the Blueprint function.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 正好，另外一份就是<@gd.key>碳块</>蓝图。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: The other blueprint happens to be a <@gd.key>Carbon</> production line.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 可以利用另一个<@gd.key>水泵</>，将清水引至第二个<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>内。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Use the other <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> and transport Clean Water to the second <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 请根据<@gd.key>物品准入口</>和<@gd.key>管道准入口</>的提示，输入对应的<@gd.key>碳块</>、<@gd.key>砂叶</>和<@gd.key>清水</>。管道运输清水需要<@gd.key>较长时间</>，请耐心等待清水输送至天有洪炉。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Refer to the icons of the <@gd.key>Item Control Port</> and <@gd.key>Pipe Control Port</> to input <@gd.key>Carbon</>, <@gd.key>Sandleaf</>, and <@gd.key>Clean Water</>. The pipeline will <@gd.key>take a while</> to transport Clean Water. Please wait patiently for the Clean Water to be delivered to the Forge of the Sky.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 已成功搭建第二条<@gd.key>息壤</>产线，<@gd.key>主要目标</>已全部完成。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: Second <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line is now complete. All <@gd.key>main goals</> have been completed.

guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.cn: 接下来需要向设备内输入原料。
guide_text_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_step.en: The next step is to input raw materials to the facilities.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 我们已成功生产出<@gd.key>重息壤</>，主要目标完成。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: We have successfully produced <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>. Our main goal is complete.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 将<@gd.key>提纯机</>的产物处理或重新加入反应后，<@gd.key>重息壤</>的产线就可以持续自动化生产了。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: The products of the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> can be further processed or reacted to automate a continuous production loop of <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 在生产<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>的同时，产出的<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>会造成扩容反应池的<@gd.key>阻塞</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> production also creates the byproduct <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> that can <@gd.key>clog</> the Expanded Crucible.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 可以用<@gd.key>提纯机</>将<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>转化为<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>，从而解决阻塞并获得更多的<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: Use the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> to convert <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> to <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> to resolve the clogging and produce more useful <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 因此，我们先放置一台<@gd.key>提纯机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: Hence, we must place a <@gd.key>Purification Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 请查看<@gd.key>提纯机</>的设备详情。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: Check the facility details of the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: 提纯机将<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>转化为了<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>与<@gd.key>清水</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: The Purification Unit can convert <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> into <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: <@gd.key>壤晶废液</>可以用于后续<@gd.key>重息壤</>的生产。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> can be used to produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.cn: <@gd.key>清水</>可以倾倒或重新加入反应。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_extra.en: <@gd.key>Clean Water</> can either be discharged safely or used in other AIC Factory reactions.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_mix_2.cn: 这是当前正在进行的配方，液化息壤与污水生成了<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>与<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_mix_2.en: This is the formula being used right now. Liquid Xiranite and Sewage are used to produce <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> and <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_mix_3.cn: 其中<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>是生产<@gd.key>重息壤</>需要的材料。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_mix_3.en: <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> is an important material for producing <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_mix_4.en: Click to close the formula panel.
Press <action=common_cancel> to close the formula screen.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: <@gd.key>液化息壤</>产线已经搭建完毕，请先完成<@gd.key>液化息壤</>的输送。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> production line complete. Please complete the <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> transporting pipeline.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请查看<@gd.key>反应池</>设备详情，将<@gd.key>液化息壤</>选择为输出物。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: View the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible's</> facility details and set <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> as its fluid product output.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 点击这里进行输出液体的选择。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Click here to choose the fluid to output.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>进行输出液体的选择。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to choose the fluid to output.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: <@gd.key>液化息壤</>是生产<@gd.key>重息壤</>的重要原料，点击这里选择<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> is an important raw material for producing <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>. Click here to select <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: <@gd.key>液化息壤</>是生产<@gd.key>重息壤</>的重要原料，请按下<action=common_select>选择<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> is an important raw material for producing <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>. Press <action=common_select> to select <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 点击确认完成选择
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Click Confirm to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请按下<action=common_function_btn_1>完成选择
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Press <action=common_function_btn_1> to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 我们成功输送了<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，关闭界面以进行下一步操作。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: We are outputting <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>. Close the panel to perform the next step.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 接入<@gd.key>液化息壤</>和<@gd.key>污水</>后，<@gd.key>反应池</>就可以生产<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Connect <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> and <@gd.key>Sewage</> as inputs for the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> so that the facility can produce <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 污水管道已经接好，让我们使用管道将刚才输送的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>接入<@gd.key>扩容反应池</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: The Sewage pipeline is connected. Let's also connect the pipeline for transporting <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> to the <@gd.key>Expanded Crucible</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 点击这里进行输出液体的选择。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Click here to choose the fluid to output.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>进行输出液体的选择。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to choose the fluid to output.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 我们先输送<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>以生产<@gd.key>重息壤</>
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Set the output to <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> so we can produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 点击确认完成选择
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Click Confirm to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请按下<action=common_function_btn_1>完成选择
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Press <action=common_function_btn_1> to complete the selection.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 我们成功输送了<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>，关闭界面以进行下一步操作。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: We are now outputting <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>. Close the panel to perform the next step.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 接入<@gd.key>液化息壤</>后，与<@gd.key>扩容反应池</>交互，进行<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>的输送。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: After connecting the <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> pipeline into the <@gd.key>Expanded Crucible</>, interact with the facility and set the output to <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 点击这里查看<@gd.key>重息壤</>的配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Click here to view the formula for <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请按下<action=fac_machine_show_formula>查看<@gd.key>重息壤</>的配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Press <action=fac_machine_show_formula> to view the formula for <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 这就是制造<@gd.key>更高级装备</>的材料 —— <@gd.key>重息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: This is <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>, a material for assembling <@gd.key>higher tier gear</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 制造<@gd.key>重息壤</>的原料之一是<@gd.key>息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: And <@gd.key>Xiranite</> is a key material for producing <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 另一个原料就是我们刚刚生产出来的<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> that we just produced is the other material.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 关闭配方界面以进行下一步操作。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Close the formula panel to perform the next step.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 关闭界面以进行下一步操作。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Close the panel to perform the next step.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: <@gd.key>天有洪炉</>已经接入息壤，使用<@gd.key>管道</>将刚刚导出的<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>连接至<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，请耐心等待液体的输送。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Xiranite is already being moved into the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</>. Set up a <@gd.key>pipeline</> connection to move the <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> to the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> and wait for the fluid to arrive at the facility.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请与<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>交互，查看<@gd.key>重息壤</>的配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to view the formula of <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: <@gd.key>提纯机</>能将<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>转换成<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: The <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> can process <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> into <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 为了提高<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>的产量和解决扩容反应池的<@gd.key>阻塞</>，请先在场景中放置一台提纯机。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: To increase the yield of <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> and resolve the <@gd.key>clogging</> issues at the Expanded Crucible, place a Purification Unit in the factory area.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.cn: 请将<@gd.key>扩容反应池</>中生产的<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>选择为另一个端口的输出物，并用管道接入<@gd.key>提纯机</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2_step_.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Expanded Crucible</>, set <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> as the output from an outlet, and connect that outlet to the <@gd.key>Purification Unit</> with a pipeline.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 集成核心区内已经放置了一台<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，请前往查看<@gd.key>息壤</>的新生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: A <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> is already placed in the Core AIC Area. Interact with it to view a new <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 集成工业已将新的<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>发放至本次模拟空间背包。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: The AIC Factory has placed a new <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> in the Backpack of this simulation.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请利用新发放的天有洪炉完成第二条<@gd.key>新息壤产线</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Use this new Forge of the Sky to set up a second <@gd.key>Xiranite production line</> using the new formula.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请将发放的<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>完全放置在<@gd.key>稳定环境</>中。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Place the new <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> completely in the <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 需要先将<@gd.key>协议核心取货口3</>中的<@gd.key>碳块</>通入<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: First, input <@gd.key>Carbon</> from <@gd.key>PAC output port 3</> into the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 再将<@gd.key>地下管道</>中的<@gd.key>清水</>通入<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，完成<@gd.key>息壤</>的新配方产线。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Next, input <@gd.key>Clean Water</> from the <@gd.key>conduit</> into the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to complete the <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line using the new formula.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请将<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>碳块</>通入<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，完成<@gd.key>息壤</>的新配方产线。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Input <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Carbon</> into the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to complete the <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line using the new formula.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请耐心等待<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>完成生产。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Wait for the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to complete production.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请与<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>交互查看<@gd.key>息壤</>的新生产配方。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to view the new <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production formula.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: <@gd.key>升级后</>的<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>可以在<@gd.key>稳定环境</>下通过<@gd.key>碳块</>和<@gd.key>清水</>生产<@gd.key>息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: An <@gd.key>upgraded</> <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> in a <@gd.key>Stable environment</> (a type of gaseous environment) can produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</> with <@gd.key>Carbon</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 集成工业已提前将<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>碳块</>通入天有洪炉，但还需要制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>才能开始生产。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: The AIC Factory is already inputting <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Carbon</> into the Forge of the Sky. We just need to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</> to start production.
Click here to close the screen.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 集成工业已通过气体收集泵在野外完成了<@gd.key>惰气</>收集，并通过<@gd.key>地下管道</>传输至此区域。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: The AIC Factory is already extracting <@gd.key>Inergen</> with Gas Extractors and transporting the gas to this area via <@gd.key>conduits</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 请通过管道将<@gd.key>惰气</>通入<@gd.key>气体散布机</>，制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: Use pipelines to input <@gd.key>Inergen</> into the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> to create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: 已成功制造<@gd.key>稳定环境</>，处于稳定环境中，<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>已开始生产<@gd.key>息壤</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: A <@gd.key>Stable environment</> has been successfully produced for the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</>. The facility is now producing <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.cn: <@gd.key>气体散布机</>制造的<@gd.key>气体环境</>可以同时使环境内的<@gd.key>多个设备受到影响</>。
guide_text_blackbox_xiraniteoven_3_step0.en: The <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> can create various <@gd.key>gaseous environments</> that can <@gd.key>influence multiple facilities within the area of effect</>.

guide_text_blue_print_1.cn:
我们现在可以进入<@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>来进行建设。
请按下<action=fac_switch_view_mode>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入。
guide_text_blue_print_1.en:
We can now use <@gd.key>Top View Mode</> to build our AIC Factory. 
Press <action=fac_switch_view_mode> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to enter this mode.

guide_text_blue_print_10.cn: 点击此处，即可进行蓝图放置。
guide_text_blue_print_10.en: Click here to place the blueprint.

guide_text_blue_print_10_ct.cn:
可推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆以改变蓝图位置，按下<action=fac_build_confirm_in_top_view>确认放置此蓝图所有设备。

guide_text_blue_print_10_ct.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to position the blueprint, then press <action=fac_build_confirm_in_top_view> to confirm placing every facility of the blueprint. Missing facilities will also be placed in its <@gd.key>unconstructed</> state. Submit the missing facilities to completely construct the blueprint.

guide_text_blue_print_11.cn:
可拖动蓝图以改变蓝图位置，点击左键确认放置此蓝图所有设备。
即使当前设备数量不足，也可以<@gd.key>待建造模式</>放置所有设备，后续提交设备以完成建造。
guide_text_blue_print_11.en: Drag the blueprint to change its position. Click the left mouse button to confirm placing all the facilities of the blueprint. If there are not enough facilities, the missing ones will be placed as <@gd.key>Unconstructed</> holograms.

guide_text_blue_print_11_mb.cn:
可拖动蓝图以改变蓝图位置，点击确认按键放置此蓝图所有设备。
即使当前设备数量不足，也可以<@gd.key>待建造模式</>放置所有设备，后续提交设备以完成建造。
guide_text_blue_print_11_mb.en: Drag the blueprint to change its position. Tap confirm to place all the facilities of the blueprint. If there are not enough facilities, the missing ones will be placed as <@gd.key>Unconstructed</> holograms.

guide_text_blue_print_1_ct.cn:
我们现在可以进入<@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>来进行建设。
请按下<action=fac_switch_view_mode>进入。
guide_text_blue_print_1_ct.en: We can now use <@gd.key>Top View Mode</> to build our AIC Factory. Press <action=fac_switch_view_mode> to use it.

guide_text_blue_print_1_mb.cn:
现在可以进入<@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>来进行建设。
请点击此处进入。
guide_text_blue_print_1_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Top View Mode</> is now available. Use it to build the AIC Factory. Tap here to enter Top View Mode.

guide_text_blue_print_2.cn: 在俯瞰模式下，干员会保持原位置不动，视角被固定为俯瞰视角。
guide_text_blue_print_2.en: Top View Mode uses a fixed, top-down perspective. Team operators will stay put.

guide_text_blue_print_3.cn: 可以使用下方罗列的设备进行<@gd.key>设备的制造与放置</>。
guide_text_blue_print_3.en: Use the list of facilities below to <@gd.key>construct and place</> them.

guide_text_blue_print_3_ct.cn: <@gd.key>开始设备建造</>可以在下方展开罗列各种设备，可以进行<@gd.key>设备的制造与放置</>。
guide_text_blue_print_3_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Start Construction</> button opens up a list of various facilities below to <@gd.key>construct and place</>.

guide_text_blue_print_4_mb.cn: 请点击此处，展开<@gd.key>工具箱</>。

guide_text_blue_print_5.cn: 在俯瞰模式下，可对多个设备、物流设施进行批量框选操作，包含复制、批量移动、批量收纳、保存蓝图等操作。
guide_text_blue_print_5.en: In Top View Mode, box selection can select multiple facilities and logistics units to perform group actions that include: copying, moving, stashing, and saving to a blueprint.

guide_text_blue_print_5_ct.cn: 蓝图功能可以帮助快速布置设备产线，请按下<action=common_confirm>查看。
guide_text_blue_print_5_ct.en: The blueprint function can be used to quickly place an AIC Factory production line. Press <action=common_confirm> to open the screen.

guide_text_blue_print_6.cn: <@gd.key>蓝图</>功能可以帮助快速布置设备产线，请点击此处或按下<action=fac_open_blueprint>查看。
guide_text_blue_print_6.en: The <@gd.key>blueprint</> function can be used to quickly place an AIC Factory production line. Click here or press <action=fac_open_blueprint> to view it.

guide_text_blue_print_6_ct.cn: 若后续创建了自己的蓝图，则会存放于此。
guide_text_blue_print_6_ct.en: Any blueprints created will be saved here.

guide_text_blue_print_6_mb.cn: <@gd.key>蓝图</>功能可以帮助快速布置设备产线，请点击此处查看。
guide_text_blue_print_6_mb.en: The <@gd.key>blueprint</> function can be used to quickly place an AIC Factory production line. Tap here to open the screen.

guide_text_blue_print_7.cn: 完成模拟空间获取的<@gd.key>系统蓝图</>将存放在此处。
guide_text_blue_print_7.en: <@gd.key>System blueprints</> acquired by completing simulations are placed here.

guide_text_blue_print_8.cn: 点击此处，查看<@gd.key>系统蓝图</>。

guide_text_blue_print_8_ct.cn: 这是刚才在模拟空间中获取的<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件蓝图</>，请按下<action=common_confirm>查看。
guide_text_blue_print_8_ct.en: This <@gd.key>Amethyst Component Blueprint</> is just acquired from the simulation. Press <action=common_confirm> to view it.

guide_text_blue_print_9.cn: 这是刚才在模拟空间中获取的<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件蓝图</>，请点击查看。
guide_text_blue_print_9.en: This <@gd.key>Amethyst Component Blueprint</> is just acquired from the simulation. Click to view it.

guide_text_blue_print_9_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，即可进行蓝图放置。

guide_text_blue_print_step_1.cn: <@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>与<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能已解锁。
guide_text_blue_print_step_1.en: <@gd.key>Top View Mode</> and <@gd.key>blueprints</> have been unlocked.

guide_text_blue_print_step_2.cn: 回到<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>后可使用<@gd.key>蓝图</>功能快速放置<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>产线。
guide_text_blue_print_step_2.en: Head back to the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</> and use the <@gd.key>Blueprint</> feature to quickly place an <@gd.key>Amethyst Component</> production line.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_1_1.cn: 由于当前拥有的设备不足，你刚刚放下了一组<@gd.key>待建造组</>设备。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_1_1.en: Due to the lack of facilities, a set of <@gd.key>Unconstructed</> facilities have been placed.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_2_1_desc.cn: 在放置蓝图时，如果当前拥有设备不足，允许先以<@gd.key>待建造组</>形式放置，后续提交欠缺设备<@gd.key>全部补足</>后，可一次性转化为<@gd.key>正式设备</>。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_2_1_desc.en: When placing blueprints without all of the facilities required, the missing facilities can be placed as an <@gd.key>Unconstructed Set</>. Submitting <@gd.key>all</> of the missing facilities converts the Unconstructed Set into <@gd.key>actual facilities</> with a single action.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_3_1.cn: 请与场景中黄颜色的<@gd.key>待建造组</>设备交互，以查看详情。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_3_1.en: Interact with any yellow-colored facilities in the <@gd.key>Unconstructed Set</> and view the details.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_1.cn: 这里展示了当前<@gd.key>待建造组</>还需要提交的设备列表以及进度。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_1.en: This shows the list of facilities to be submitted for the <@gd.key>Unconstructed Set</> and progress of facility submission.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_2.cn: <@gd.key>一键提交</>可以将当前拥有的设备提交，当<@gd.key>所有设备</>的提交进度都完成后，即可转化为<@gd.key>正式设备</>。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_2.en: Use <@gd.key>Submit All</> to submit all facilities currently owned. Once the <@gd.key>entire facilities submission progress</> is complete, all missing facilities will be converted to <@gd.key>actual facilities</>.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_3.cn: <@gd.key>设备制造</>可以快捷地制造<@gd.key>待提交</>的设备。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_3.en: Use the <@gd.key>Construction</> panel to quickly construct the <@gd.key>missing</> facilities.

guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_4.cn: <@gd.key>终止建造</>将拆除<@gd.key>待建造组</>所有设备，并且将已提交的设备返还。
guide_text_blueprint_ghost_4_4.en: Use <@gd.key>End Construction</> to stash all facilities in the <@gd.key>Unconstructed Set</> and return all submitted facilities.

guide_text_bomb_hint_1.cn: 靠近并按下<action=common_interact>即可使用爆炸物。
guide_text_bomb_hint_1.en: Approach and press <action=common_interact> to use the explosives.

guide_text_bomb_hint_1_mb.cn: 靠近并点击"制作爆炸物"即可使用。
guide_text_bomb_hint_1_mb.en: Approach and tap [Make explosives] to use it.

guide_text_bomb_produce_desc_1.cn: 随着集成工业系统的发展，可以在<@gd.key>封装机</>中生产<@gd.key>工业爆炸物</>。
guide_text_bomb_produce_desc_1.en: Expand the AIC Factory and research AIC technologies to produce <@gd.key>Industrial Explosives</> at the <@gd.key>Packaging Unit</>.

guide_text_bomb_produce_desc_2.cn: 使用工业爆炸物，可以破坏<@gd.key>脆弱墙体</>，打开通路。
guide_text_bomb_produce_desc_2.en: Industrial Explosives can blast apart <@gd.key>fragile walls</> to make new passages.

guide_text_bomb_wall_desc_1.cn:
探索中可能遇到一些可以使用<@gd.key>爆炸物</>爆破的墙体或者石块等物体。
这些可爆破物的表面会有红色的纹路或者可爆破的标记。
guide_text_bomb_wall_desc_1.en: Certain walls or rocks found during exploration can be destroyed with <@gd.key>explosives</>. These destructible objects exhibit red-colored cracks and are marked with icons to indicate their destructibility.

guide_text_book_dungeon_1.cn: 在发现<@gd.key>协议空间</>之后，可以在行动手册中查看。
guide_text_book_dungeon_1.en: After finding a <@gd.key>Protocol Space</>, it can be viewed from the Operational Manual.

guide_text_book_dungeon_2.cn: 请点击此处，查看<@gd.key>索引</>分页。
guide_text_book_dungeon_2.en: Click here to open the <@gd.key>Index</> tab.

guide_text_book_dungeon_2_ct.cn: 当前已为您选中<@gd.key>索引</>分页。

guide_text_book_dungeon_3.cn: 这里收录了当前发现的所有<@gd.key>协议空间</>，以及对应可以收获的素材。
guide_text_book_dungeon_3.en: This has the records of all the <@gd.key>Protocol Spaces</> discovered so far, as well as the materials that might drop from them.

guide_text_book_dungeon_4.cn: 可在此处，查看对应的<@gd.key>协议空间</>并直接进入。
guide_text_book_dungeon_4.en: This shows a list of <@gd.key>Protocol Spaces</>. They can also be directly accessed here.

guide_text_bossrush_1.cn: <@gd.key>危境再现</>解锁了，点击此处，查看<@gd.key>索引</>分页。
guide_text_bossrush_1.en: <@gd.key>RE-Crisis</> unlocked. Click here to view the <@gd.key>Index</> tab.

guide_text_bossrush_1_ct.cn: <@gd.key>危境再现</>解锁了，当前已为您选中<@gd.key>索引</>分页。
guide_text_bossrush_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>RE-Crisis</> unlocked. The <@gd.key>Index</> tab has been selected.

guide_text_bossrush_2.cn: 在战胜强敌之后，可以再次挑战。点击此处，选择<@gd.key>危境再现</>。
guide_text_bossrush_2.en: After defeating powerful enemies, they can be challenged again. Click here and select <@gd.key>RE-Crisis</>.

guide_text_bossrush_2_ct.cn: 在战胜强敌之后，可以再次挑战。请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择<@gd.key>危境再现</>。
guide_text_bossrush_2_ct.en: After defeating powerful enemies, they can be challenged again. Press <action=common_confirm> to select <@gd.key>RE-Crisis</>.

guide_text_bossrush_desc_1.cn: 可在<@gd.key>危境再现</>中重新挑战之前击败过的领袖敌人。
guide_text_bossrush_desc_1.en: At the <@gd.key>RE-Crisis</>, defeated enemy bosses can be challenged again.

guide_text_bossrush_desc_2.cn: 危境再现有不同的<@gd.key>深度等级</>，通关当前深度后可以挑战更深的深度
guide_text_bossrush_desc_2.en: RE-Crisis features different <@gd.key>Depth Levels</>. Clear the current Depth Level to unlock more challenging Depth Levels.

guide_text_build_env_hint.cn: 将<@gd.key>酸气</>通入<@gd.key>气体散布机</>可制造酸性环境。
guide_text_build_env_hint.en: Input <@gd.key>Acridgen</> into the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> to create an Acrid environment.

guide_text_build_env_hint_1.cn: 气体反应炉部分反应需在<@gd.key>特定环境</>下进行，向<@gd.key>气体散布机</>通入气体可<@gd.key>形成对应环境</>。
guide_text_build_env_hint_1.en: Some Gas Reactor Globe reaction formulas are only usable in <@gd.key>certain gas environments</>. Input the correct gases into the <@gd.key>Gas Dispersing Unit</> to create the <@gd.key>said gas environments</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_1.cn:
<@gd.key>精炼炉</>已存放于背包中。
请按下<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_build_furnance_1.en: The <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> has been placed in the Backpack. Press <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_build_furnance_1_1.cn: 由于背包已满，<@gd.key>精炼炉</>被存入了仓库，请进入集成核心区域，放置精炼炉。
guide_text_build_furnance_1_1.en: Since the Backpack is full, the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> has been stored in the Depot. Go to the Core AIC Area to place the Refining Unit.

guide_text_build_furnance_1_ct.cn:
<@gd.key>精炼炉</>已存放于背包中。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> has been placed in the Backpack. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_1_mb.cn:
<@gd.key>精炼炉</>已存放于背包中。
请点击此处打开背包。
guide_text_build_furnance_1_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> has been placed in the Backpack. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_build_furnance_2.cn: 按照提示，请将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>拖入下方快捷栏中。
guide_text_build_furnance_2.en: Follow the instructions. Drag the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the hotbar below.

guide_text_build_furnance_2_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>登录到快捷栏中。
guide_text_build_furnance_2_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to add <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> into the hotbar.

guide_text_build_furnance_2_mb.cn: 请<@gd.key>长按精炼炉</>将其拿起，再拖动到快捷栏中。
guide_text_build_furnance_2_mb.en: <@gd.key>Tap and hold the Refining Unit</> to pick it up and drag it into the hotbar.

guide_text_build_furnance_3.cn: 请将精炼炉放置于<@gd.key>虚影位置</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_3.en: Refer to the <@gd.key>hologram</> for placing the Refining Unit.

guide_text_build_furnance_3_1.cn: 请先进入集成核心区域，将仓库中的精炼炉放置于<@gd.key>虚影位置</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_3_1.en: Go to the Core AIC Area first and place the Refining Unit from the Depot in the <@gd.key>hologram</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_4.cn: 按下<@gd.key>精炼炉</>所对应的数字键或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，开始放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_4.en: Press the number key associated with the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to place the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_4_ct.en: Press <action=fac_quick_bar_controller_build> to start placing the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_4_mb.cn: 点击此处，开始放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_4_mb.en: Tap here to place the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_5.cn: 按照提示，请移动并使用鼠标<image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3>转动视角，将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>移动至<@gd.key>虚影位置</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_5.en: Follow the instructions. Move and adjust the view with the mouse <image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3> to move the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>hologram</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_5_ct.cn: 按照提示，请<@gd.key>移动并推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆转动视角</>，将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>移动至<@gd.key>虚影位置</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_5_ct.en: Follow the guide. <@gd.key>Move and adjust the view with the <action=common_rightstick> stick</> to move the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>position indicated by the hologram</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_5_mb.cn: 按照提示，请移动并转动视角，将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>移动至<@gd.key>虚影位置</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_5_mb.en: Follow the instructions to move and adjust the view, then move the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>hologram</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_6.cn: 点击鼠标左键<action=fac_build_confirm>，确认放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_6.en: Click the left mouse button <action=fac_build_confirm> to confirm the placement of the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_build_furnance_6_mb.cn: 点击此处，确认放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>。
guide_text_build_furnance_6_mb.en: Tap here to place the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_build_xiranite_oven.cn: 请在<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>放置<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>。
guide_text_build_xiranite_oven.en: Place the <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> in the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</>.

guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_1.cn: 在<@gd.key>集成管家</>处可<@gd.key>解锁</>对应集成核心区域仓库存取线<@gd.key>建造权限</>。
guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_1.en: Talk to the <@gd.key>AIC Steward</> to <@gd.key>unlock</> Depot Bus <@gd.key>construction options</> in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_2.cn: 可以在集成核心区域放置<@gd.key>仓库存取线基段</>。
guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_2.en: <@gd.key>Depot Bus Sections</> can be placed in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_3.cn: <@gd.key>仓库存取线基段</>和<@gd.key>仓库存取线源桩</>或其他生效的仓库存取线基段相连后，其上可贴靠放置仓库存货口和仓库取货口。
guide_text_bus_wuling_desc_3.en: The <@gd.key>Depot Bus Section</> must be connected to a <@gd.key>Depot Bus Port</> or other active Depot Bus Sections. Once active, Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be attached to the Depot Bus.

guide_text_bus_wuling_title_1.cn: 武陵仓库存取线 - 一

guide_text_bus_wuling_title_2.cn: 武陵仓库存取线 - 二

guide_text_bus_wuling_title_3.cn: 武陵仓库存取线 - 三

guide_text_camille_c33m1__ct.cn: 可按住<action=common_indicator_start>并<@gd.key>短按</><action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_1>，施放卡缪的<@gd.key>战技</>。
guide_text_camille_c33m1__ct.en: While holding down <action=common_indicator_start>, <@gd.key>press </><action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_1> to cast Camille's <@gd.key>battle skill</>.

guide_text_camille_c33m1_desc.cn:
卡缪感受到了仇敌的气息，在后续的剧情战斗中获得增益。
并且他的<@ba.key>重击</>将吸取一定范围内敌人身上的<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>并转化为自身攻击力。
guide_text_camille_c33m1_desc.en: Camille has sensed the presence of his sworn enemy, granting him a buff for battles of this story mission. His <@ba.key>Final Strikes</> will absorb <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> stacks from enemies within a certain range and convert them into his ATK.

guide_text_camille_c33m1_mb.cn: 可<@gd.key>点击此处</>，施放卡缪的<@gd.key>战技</>。

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_00.cn: 使用卡缪的战技，可以召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>对目标施加<@ba.fire>灼热附着</>、<@ba.key>虚弱</>和<@ba.fire>灼热脆弱</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_00.en: Use Camille's battle skill to summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> that apply <@ba.fire>Heat Infliction</>, <@ba.key>Weakness</>, and <@ba.fire>Heat Susceptibility</> on the target.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 卡缪的战技可以召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>对小范围敌人施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>并持续<@ba.key>盘桓</>目标，施加一段时间的<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_1.en: Camille's battle skill can summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> that apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> to enemies in a small area of effect, <@ba.key>hover</> around the target, and apply temporary <#ba.weak>Weakness</> and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</>.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_2.cn: <@ba.key>衔火血翼</><@ba.key>盘桓</>的目标被击败时，<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>会飞向附近的另一个敌人，再次造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>、<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_2.en: When a target with <@ba.key>hovering</> <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> is defeated, the <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> fly to another nearby enemy, dealing <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> and applying <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</>.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_3.cn: 卡缪的战技可以召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>对目标施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>、<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>并持续<@ba.key>盘桓</>一段时间。<@ba.key>衔火血翼</><@ba.key>盘桓</>的目标被击败时，<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>会飞向附近的另一个敌人，再次造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>、<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_02_3.en: Camille's battle skill can summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> that apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</>, and <@ba.key>hover</> temporarily around the target. When a target with <@ba.key>hovering</> <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> is defeated, the <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> will fly to another nearby enemy, dealing <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> and applying <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</> again.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 当有敌人被<#ba.consume>消耗</>或者<#ba.absorb>吸收</><#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>后可以发动卡缪的连携技，对敌人造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>并恢复技力。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_03_1.en: Camille's combo skill is triggered when an enemy's <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> is <#ba.consume>consumed</> or <#ba.absorb>absorbed</>. The skill deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> and recovers SP.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_03_2.cn: <@ba.key>衔火血翼</><@ba.key>盘桓</>的敌人被卡缪的连携技命中时，在短暂延迟后产生一次爆裂，对其造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_03_2.en: When Camille's combo skill hits an enemy with <@ba.key>hovering</><@ba.key> Firefang Vesperwings</>, an explosion will be set off after a short delay, dealing <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> to the said enemy.

guide_text_camille_chartrain01_04_1.cn:
卡缪的终结技可以造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>并恢复技力。
终结技施放后一段时间内战技会被替换为<@ba.key>追猎</>，<@ba.key>追猎</>视为连携技且造成更高伤害并恢复更多技力。
guide_text_camille_chartrain01_04_1.en: Camille's ultimate can deal <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</>, apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, and recover SP. Casting the ultimate also temporarily replaces the battle skill with <@ba.key>Hunter Pursuit</>. <@ba.key>Hunter Pursuit</> is regarded as a combo skill, and it deals more DMG and recovers more SP.

guide_text_camille_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 卡缪是一名灼热属性的先锋干员，他可以通过召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>对敌人施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>、<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>，还能通过连携技和终结技恢复大量技力。
guide_text_camille_chartrial01_01_1.en: Camille is a Heat element vanguard. He can summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> to apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</> on enemies, and use his combo skill and ultimate to restore lots of SP.

guide_text_camille_chartrial01_02_2.cn:
卡缪的战技可以召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>对小范围敌人施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>并持续<@ba.key>盘桓</>目标，施加一段时间的<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>。
<@ba.key>衔火血翼</><@ba.key>盘桓</>的目标被击败时，<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>会飞向附近的另一个敌人，对其造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>、<#ba.weak>虚弱</>和<#ba.firevul>灼热脆弱</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrial01_02_2.en: Camille's battle skill can summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> that apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> to enemies in a small area. The vesperwings also <@ba.key>hover</> around the target for a while to apply temporary <#ba.weak>Weakness</> and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</>. When a target with <@ba.key>hovering</> <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> is defeated, the <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> will fly to another nearby enemy, dealing <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> and applying <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, <#ba.weak>Weakness</>, and <#ba.firevul>Heat Susceptibility</> again.

guide_text_camille_chartrial01_03_2.cn:
当有敌人被<#ba.consume>消耗</>或者<#ba.absorb>吸收</><#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>后可以发动卡缪的连携技，对敌人造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>并恢复技力。
<@ba.key>衔火血翼</><@ba.key>盘桓</>的敌人被卡缪的连携技命中时，在短暂延迟后产生一次爆裂，对其造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>。
guide_text_camille_chartrial01_03_2.en: Camille's combo skill is triggered when an enemy's <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> is <#ba.consume>consumed</> or <#ba.absorb>absorbed</>. The skill deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> and recovers SP. When Camille's combo skill hits an enemy with <@ba.key>hovering</> <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</>, an explosion will be set off after a short delay, dealing <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> to the said enemy.

guide_text_camille_chartrial01_04_1.cn:
卡缪的终结技可以造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>并恢复技力。
终结技施放后一段时间内战技会被替换为<@ba.key>追猎</>，<@ba.key>追猎</>视为连携技且造成更高伤害并恢复更多技力。
guide_text_camille_chartrial01_04_1.en: Camille's ultimate can deal <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</>, apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, and recover SP. Casting the ultimate also temporarily replaces the battle skill with <@ba.key>Hunter Pursuit</>. <@ba.key>Hunter Pursuit</> is regarded as a combo skill, and it deals more DMG and recovers more SP.

guide_text_camille_chartrial01_05_1.cn: 卡缪召唤<@ba.key>衔火血翼</>后，配合可以<#ba.consume>消耗</>或者<#ba.absorb>吸收</><#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>的干员造成伤害并恢复技力，通过提供的强化效果为全队带来增益。使用终结技后继续施放强化连携技，快速恢复技力并获得连击。
guide_text_camille_chartrial01_05_1.en: After Camille summons <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</>, use operators who can <#ba.consume>consume</> or <#ba.absorb>absorb</> <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> so that Camille can deal DMG, recover SP, and grant buffs that benefit the entire team. Casting Camille's ultimate followed by the Enhanced Combo also recovers SP quickly and grants a Link buff.

guide_text_camille_ultimate_ct.cn: 可按住<action=common_indicator_start>并长按<action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_1>，施放卡缪的<@gd.key>终结技</>。
guide_text_camille_ultimate_ct.en: While holding down <action=common_indicator_start>, press and hold <action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_1> to cast Camille's <@gd.key>ultimate</>.

guide_text_camille_ultimate_mb.cn: 可<@gd.key>长按</>此处，或将战技键<@gd.key>拖动至终结技区域</>，施放卡缪的<@gd.key>终结技</>。
guide_text_camille_ultimate_mb.en: <@gd.key>Tap and hold</> this, or <@gd.key>drag the battle skill button to the ultimate zone</> to cast Camille's <@gd.key>ultimate</>.

guide_text_camp_1.cn: 成功激活<@gd.key>协议传送点</>后，即可使用该节点的各项功能。
guide_text_camp_1.en: Activating a <@gd.key>Tele-Protocol Point</> (TP Point) makes its various features accessible.

guide_text_camp_2.cn: 可使用<@gd.key>休整</>功能，使断开连接的干员恢复连接，并<@gd.key>回满编队中所有干员的生命值</>。
guide_text_camp_2.en: Use the <@gd.key>Rest</> function to resuscitate disconnected operators and <@gd.key>restore the entire team to max HP</>.

guide_text_camp_3.cn: 在<@gd.key>协议传送点</>附近，可使用<@gd.key>仓储管理</>功能，按下<action=common_interact>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处。
guide_text_camp_3.en: When near a <@gd.key>TP Point</>, the <@gd.key>storage management</> function becomes available. Press <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to use it.

guide_text_camp_3_ct.cn: 在<@gd.key>协议传送点</>附近，可使用<@gd.key>仓储管理</>功能，请按下<action=common_interact>打开。
guide_text_camp_3_ct.en: When near a <@gd.key>TP Point</>, the <@gd.key>storage management</> function becomes available. Press <action=common_interact> to open it.

guide_text_camp_3_mb.cn: 在<@gd.key>协议传送点</>附近，可使用<@gd.key>仓储管理</>功能，请点击此处打开。
guide_text_camp_3_mb.en: When near a <@gd.key>TP Point</>, the <@gd.key>storage management</> function becomes available. Tap here to use it.

guide_text_carrier_0.cn: 使用<@gd.key>便捷存取站</>可以在野外便捷地通过<@gd.key>仓库</>存取物品
guide_text_carrier_0.en: <@gd.key>Easy Stashes</> provide convenient access to the <@gd.key>Depot</> in the wilderness.

guide_text_carrier_2_1.cn: <@gd.key>便捷存取站</>可以直接连接当地的<@gd.key>仓库</>
guide_text_carrier_2_1.en: <@gd.key>Easy Stashes</> can directly access the local <@gd.key>depot</>.

guide_text_carrier_2_3.cn: 管理员可以将当地仓库的物品取到背包
guide_text_carrier_2_3.en: The Endministrator can take items from the Depot and place them in the Backpack.

guide_text_carrier_2_4.cn: 同样的，管理员也可以将背包的物品存放到仓库
guide_text_carrier_2_4.en: The Endministrator can also take items from the Backpack and place them in the Depot.

guide_text_carrier_desc_1.cn: 便捷存取站可以直接连接当地的仓库，快捷存取物品
guide_text_carrier_desc_1.en: Easy Stashes can directly access a local depot to quickly load and unload various items.

guide_text_carrier_desc_2.cn: 接入电网的便捷存取站会出现在他人的游玩环境中，也许能帮助到他人。
guide_text_carrier_desc_2.en: Easy Stashes connected to the power grid will also appear in the scenes of other players. Their contents may help them greatly.

guide_text_char_equip_1.cn:
现在可为干员穿戴和更换装备了。
请按下快捷键<action=common_open_char_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开干员信息总览。
guide_text_char_equip_1.en: Operators can now be equipped with gear. Press the hotkey <action=common_open_char_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_char_equip_1_ct.cn:
现在可为干员穿戴和更换装备了。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_char_equip_1_ct.en: Operators can now be equipped with various pieces of gear. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_char_equip_1_mb.cn:
现在可为干员穿戴和更换装备了。
请点击此处进入干员详情。
guide_text_char_equip_1_mb.en: Operators can now equip and switch their gear. Tap here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_char_equip_2.cn: 点击装备页签，查看干员当前装备的详细数据并进行装备更换。
guide_text_char_equip_2.en: Click on the Gear tab. This opens the Gear screen that shows detailed stats of currently equipped gear. It also allows the switching of operator gear.

guide_text_char_equip_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，进入装备页签，查看干员当前装备的详细数据并进行装备更换。
guide_text_char_equip_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to open the Gear tab. This opens the Gear screen that shows detailed stats of currently equipped gear. It also allows the switching of operator gear.

guide_text_char_equip_3.cn:
根据部位分类，装备共分为<@gd.key>护甲</>、<@gd.key>护手</>、<@gd.key>配件</>三种类型。
每位干员都可穿戴一件护甲、一件护手、两件配件，总共四件装备。
干员当前已穿戴的装备都会在装备栏中展示。
guide_text_char_equip_3.en: There are 3 types of gear based on the equipping part: (1) <@gd.key>Armor</>, (2) <@gd.key>Gloves</>, and (3) <@gd.key>Kit</>. Every operator can equip 4 pieces of gear: 1 suit of armor, 1 pair of gloves, and 2 kits. Gear already equipped by the operator will be displayed in the gear slots.

guide_text_char_equip_4.cn: 界面右侧展示了当前干员已穿戴的全部装备所提供的属性加成。
guide_text_char_equip_4.en: The right side of the screen shows bonuses to various stats offered by the gear equipped by the operator.

guide_text_char_equip_5.cn: 点击选择装备栏，可为干员穿戴或更换当前装备。
guide_text_char_equip_5.en: Click the gear slot to either equip a piece of gear or swap what is currently equipped on the operator.

guide_text_char_equip_5_ct.cn: 按下<action=navigation_target_click>选择装备栏，可为干员穿戴或更换当前装备。
guide_text_char_equip_5_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to select the gear slot, then either equip a piece of gear or swap what is currently equipped.

guide_text_char_equip_6.en: Click here to select this piece of gear.

guide_text_char_equip_6_ct.cn: 目前选择的装备是<@gd.key>简易护甲</>。
guide_text_char_equip_6_ct.en: <@gd.key>Basic Armor</> is the gear currently selected.

guide_text_char_equip_7.cn: 可以在此处预览穿戴该件装备后，干员各项属性的变化。
guide_text_char_equip_7.en: This shows a preview of the changes to various operator stats by equipping this gear.

guide_text_char_equip_8.cn: 装备能够提供不同的能力值，有些装备还会有一些额外的技能。
guide_text_char_equip_8.en: Gear can offer all sorts of stats. Some may even offer additional skills.

guide_text_char_equip_9.cn: 点击此处穿戴该件装备。
guide_text_char_equip_9.en: Click here to equip this piece of gear.

guide_text_char_equip_9_ct.en: Press <action=char_info_equip_put_on> to equip this piece of gear.

guide_text_char_equip_desc_1.cn:
在装备页面中，可以为干员穿戴与更换各个部件的装备。
每位干员都可穿戴一件护甲、一件护手、两件配件，总共四件装备。
不同部位的装备相互配合能够激活<@gd.key>套装效果</>。
guide_text_char_equip_desc_1.en: Use the Gear screen to equip operators with various gear. Every operator can equip 4 pieces of gear: 1 suit of armor, 1 pair of gloves, and 2 kits. Equipping multiple pieces of gear from the same set also activates <@gd.key>set effects</>.

guide_text_char_levelup_1.cn: 请记得对干员们进行培养，以增加作战能力。
guide_text_char_levelup_1.en: Remember to train the operators in order to improve their combat abilities.

guide_text_char_levelup_2.cn: 按下<action=common_open_char_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入干员详情。
guide_text_char_levelup_2.en: Press <action=common_open_char_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_char_levelup_2_1_ct.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，进入<@gd.key>干员总览</>。
guide_text_char_levelup_2_1_ct.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open operator's <@gd.key>Overview</> screen.

guide_text_char_levelup_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_char_levelup_2_mb.cn: 点击此处进入干员详情。
guide_text_char_levelup_2_mb.en: Tap here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_char_levelup_3.cn: 在干员详情页面中，可以培养干员各个方面的能力，进而更好地应对各种复杂情况。
guide_text_char_levelup_3.en: Use the Operator Overview screen to upgrade various operator abilities and improve their performance in various situations.

guide_text_char_levelup_4.cn: 点击此处，可对干员进行<@gd.key>等级提升</>。
guide_text_char_levelup_4.en: Click here to <@gd.key>level up</> the operator.

guide_text_char_levelup_4_1.cn: 当前该干员已达到当前等级上限，暂时无法继续提升等级。
guide_text_char_levelup_4_1.en: This operator has reached a level cap and cannot be upgraded further.

guide_text_char_levelup_4_2.cn: 除了击败敌人外，还可以<@gd.key>手动使用素材</>为干员提升等级。
guide_text_char_levelup_4_2.en: In addition to defeating enemies, <@gd.key>EXP materials can be manually spent</> to level up operators.

guide_text_char_levelup_4_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，对干员进行<@gd.key>等级提升</>。

guide_text_char_levelup_5.cn:
消耗<@gd.key>干员经验培养素材</>，可为干员提供大量升级经验。
可在此处批量选择多种素材。
guide_text_char_levelup_5.en: Spend <@gd.key>operator EXP materials</> to give the operator plenty of EXP for leveling up. Batch select multiple EXP materials here.

guide_text_char_levelup_6.cn: 干员升级后，<@gd.key>能力值、基础攻击力与生命值</>会得到提升。
guide_text_char_levelup_6.en: Leveled up operators will gain increased <@gd.key>attributes, Base Attack, and HP</>.

guide_text_char_levelup_7.cn: 达到等级上限后，则需要<@gd.key>激活精英化节点</>，才能继续提升等级。
guide_text_char_levelup_7.en: If an operator hits a level cap, they must be <@gd.key>promoted</> to raise their level cap and continue leveling.

guide_text_char_levelup_8.cn: 干员提升到一定等级后，<@gd.key>将会需求其他的培养素材来提升等级</>。
guide_text_char_levelup_8.en: When operators reach a certain level, <@gd.key>they must use other progression materials to level up</>.

guide_text_char_summary_desc_1.cn:
强敌当前，有多种方法增强小队的作战能力。
例如<@gd.key>提升干员等级</>和<@gd.key>激活精英化节点</>，可提升干员的综合作战能力。
guide_text_char_summary_desc_1.en: There are many ways to improve a team's combat performance to defeat powerful enemies. These include <@gd.key>leveling up</> and <@gd.key>promoting</> operators to improve their overall combat abilities.

guide_text_char_summary_desc_2.cn: 在干员的<@gd.key>能力扩延</>中，可对干员的各个<@gd.key>技能</>进行升级，可激活干员的各种<@gd.key>技能节点</>，增强干员各项战斗能力。
guide_text_char_summary_desc_2.en: The operator's <@gd.key>Ability Matrix</> includes various <@gd.key>skills</> that can be leveled up as well as <@gd.key>talent nodes</> that can be activated to enhance the operator's combat abilities.

guide_text_char_summary_desc_3.cn: 干员的武器在<@gd.key>升级</>或<@gd.key>突破</>后，性能会显著提升。请记得培养小队中干员的武器。
