guide_text_equip_formula_switch_6.cn:
可在此选择不同的制造工艺，将<@gd.key>所有金色装备</>的制造工艺进行批量替换。
每种工艺都只能兼容<@gd.key>旧有</>的制造工艺。
guide_text_equip_formula_switch_6.en: Use this to bulk switch the assembly techniques of <@gd.key>all gold quality</> gear. Each technique is only compatible with <@gd.key>older</> techniques.

guide_text_equip_formula_switch_7.cn: 使用当前版本追加的制造工艺时，可省去<@gd.key>99%</>的调度券耗费，并可<@gd.key>向下兼容旧有所有的制造工艺</>。
guide_text_equip_formula_switch_7.en: The new assembly technique added in the current version update costs <@gd.key>99%</> less stock bills. The latest technique is also <@gd.key>compatible with all lower-tier assembly techniques from past versions</>.

guide_text_equip_formula_switch_8.cn:
当前也可先行制造<@gd.key>息壤装备原件</>，以制造<@gd.key>集成实训装备组</>，从而适配不同干员，进行前期过渡。
待研究出最新的工业技术后，可再制造并使用其他套组的装备。
guide_text_equip_formula_switch_8.en: <@gd.key>Xiranite Components</> can be produced first to assemble the <@gd.key>AIC Fieldwork Gear Pack</> that offers good transition gear until the latest AIC technologies for assembling gear of other sets are researched.

guide_text_equip_formula_switch_desc_1.cn:
每件金色品质的装备除了默认工艺，还可切换为新追加的制造工艺，即对应不同的<@gd.key>装备原件</>。
可在<@gd.key>全局工艺设置</>中，将<@gd.key>所有金色装备</>的制造工艺进行批量替换。
每种工艺都只能兼容<@gd.key>旧有</>的制造工艺。
guide_text_equip_formula_switch_desc_1.en: In addition to the default technique, gold quality gear can be switched to newly added assembly techniques that use different <@gd.key>gear components</>. Use the <@gd.key>Switch All Techniques</> screen to bulk switch the assembly techniques of <@gd.key>all gold quality gear</>. Each technique is only compatible with <@gd.key>older</> techniques.

guide_text_equip_formula_switch_desc_2.cn:
可对每件金色装备进行单独的制造工艺替换。
使用当前版本最新追加的制造工艺时，可省去<@gd.key>99%</>的调度券耗费，并可<@gd.key>向下兼容旧有所有的制造工艺</>。
guide_text_equip_formula_switch_desc_2.en: The assembly technique of gold quality gear can be individually switched. The new assembly technique added in the current version update costs <@gd.key>99%</> less stock bills. The latest technique is also <@gd.key>compatible with all older gear assembly techniques</>.

guide_text_equip_formula_switch_title_1.en: Gear Assembly: Switch All Techniques Screen

guide_text_equip_new_1d4_1_desc_2.cn: 灼铜装备原件可在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中通过<@gd.key>灼铜零件</>与<@gd.key>重息壤</>生产获得。生产<@gd.key>灼铜零件</>需要使用气体相关的工业技术。
guide_text_equip_new_1d4_1_desc_2.en: Pyrrolite Components can be made at the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> (AIC Factory facility) using <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Parts</> and <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>. Gas-related AIC factory technologies will be needed to make <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Parts</>.

guide_text_equip_new_1d4_desc_1.cn:
随着新区域的开放，在装备制造列表中将会解锁新的装备。
在<@gd.key>应龙关、北部禁区</>等区域获得的装备制造模板，需要使用<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>进行制造。
guide_text_equip_new_1d4_desc_1.en: Accessing new regions and areas can unlock new gear assembly options. Gear templates acquired from the <@gd.key>Yinglung Pass and North Wuling Exclusion Zone</> areas require <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</> for gear assembly.

guide_text_equip_new_1d4_desc_2.cn:
灼铜装备原件可通过<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中生产获得。
制造<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>需要解锁并研究武陵工业三期的工业技术<@gd.key>气体散布</>和<@gd.key>气体反应</>。<@gd.key>请继续推进任务，解锁并研究相关工业技术</>。
guide_text_equip_new_1d4_desc_2.en: Pyrrolite Components for gear assembly can be made using the AIC Factory facility <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>. To make <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</>, you must first unlock and research these Wuling AIC III technologies: <@gd.key>Gas Dispersal</> and <@gd.key>Gas Reaction</>. <@gd.key>Keep progressing through the main mission to unlock these AIC technologies.</>

guide_text_equip_new_1d4_title_1.cn: 装备模板箱 - 新区域解锁

guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_1.cn:
随着新区域的开放，可以制造最新迭代投放的装备。可在装备制造列表中查看。
在<@gd.key>首墩</>等区域获得的装备制造模板，需要使用<@gd.key>赫铜装备原件</>进行制造。
guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_1.en: As new regions and areas become accessible, additional iterations of gear may appear. These can be viewed from the gear list in the Gear Assembly screen. Gear templates acquired from the <@gd.key>Marker Stone</> area require <@gd.key>Hetonite Components</> for gear assembly.

guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_2.cn:
赫铜装备原件可通过<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>与<@gd.key>重息壤</>在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中生产获得。
<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>需要研究武陵工业三期的<@gd.key>提纯技术</>。
<@gd.key>重息壤</>则需要推进主线任务并研究相关工业技术。
guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_2.en: Hetonite Components can be made using <@gd.key>Hetonite Parts</> and <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> with the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> (AIC Factory facility). <@gd.key>Hetonite Parts</> production requires <@gd.key>Purification</> (Wuling AIC III technology). <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> production requires specific main mission progression and research of the prerequisite AIC Plan technology.

guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_3.cn:
在<@gd.key>首墩</>等地获得的装备制造模板，需要使用<@gd.key>赫铜装备原件</>进行制造。
赫铜装备原件可通过<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>与<@gd.key>重息壤</>在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中生产获得。
<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>需要研究武陵工业三期的<@gd.key>提纯技术</>。
<@gd.key>重息壤</>则需要推进主线任务并研究相关工业技术。
guide_text_equip_new_2_desc_3.en: Gear templates acquired from the <@gd.key>Marker Stone</> area require <@gd.key>Hetonite Components</> for gear assembly. Hetonite Components can be made using <@gd.key>Hetonite Parts</> and <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> with the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> (AIC Factory facility). <@gd.key>Hetonite Parts</> production requires <@gd.key>Purification</> (Wuling AIC III technology). <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> production requires specific main mission progression and research of the prerequisite AIC Plan technology.

guide_text_equip_new_2_title_1.cn: 装备模板箱 - 新区域投放 - 首墩
guide_text_equip_new_2_title_1.en: Gear Template Crate: New Areas - Marker Stone

guide_text_equip_new_2_title_2.cn: 新装备的制造材料 - 赫铜装备原件
guide_text_equip_new_2_title_2.en: Gear: New Assembly Materials - Hetonite Component

guide_text_equip_new_2_title_3.cn: 首墩等区域的装备制造模板

guide_text_equip_new_4_desc_1.cn:
随着新区域的开放，在装备制造列表中将会解锁新的装备。
在<@gd.key>应龙关</>等区域获得的装备制造模板，需要使用<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>进行制造。
guide_text_equip_new_4_desc_1.en: Accessing new regions and areas can unlock new gear assembly options. Gear templates acquired from the <@gd.key>Yinglung Pass</> area require <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</> for gear assembly.

guide_text_equip_new_4_desc_2.cn:
灼铜装备原件可通过<@gd.key>灼铜零件</>与<@gd.key>重息壤</>在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中生产获得。
生产<@gd.key>灼铜零件</>需要推进主线任务，并研究武陵工业计划的<@gd.key>气体收集</>、<@gd.key>固气转化</>等相关技术。
guide_text_equip_new_4_desc_2.en: Pyrrolite Components can be made using <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Parts</> and <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</> with the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> (AIC Factory facility). To produce <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</>, you must progress through the main mission and research these Wuling AIC Plan technologies: <@gd.key>Gas Extraction</> and <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmutation</>.

guide_text_equip_new_4_title_1.cn: 装备模板箱 - 新区域解锁 - 应龙关
guide_text_equip_new_4_title_1.en: Gear Template Crate: New Area - Yinglung Pass

guide_text_equip_new_desc_1.cn: 随着新区域的开放，可以制造最新迭代投放的装备。可在装备制造列表中查看。
guide_text_equip_new_desc_1.en: As new regions and areas become accessible, additional iterations of gear may appear. These can be viewed from the gear list in the Gear Assembly screen.

guide_text_equip_new_desc_2.cn: 可通过新开放区域的<@gd.key>装备模板箱</>，以及更高等级的<@gd.key>物资调度</>获取最新迭代投放的装备制造模板。
guide_text_equip_new_desc_2.en: Collect <@gd.key>Gear Template Crates</> of newly accessible areas or level up <@gd.key>stock redistribution</> to purchase and/or acquire gear templates of the latest iterations.

guide_text_equip_new_desc_3.cn:
在不同区域的装备模板箱中获得的装备制造模板，可能会需求不同的材料进行制造。如在<@gd.key>清波寨</>获得的装备制造模板，需要使用<@gd.key>赤铜装备原件</>进行制造。
赤铜装备原件可通过<@gd.key>赤铜零件</>与<@gd.key>息壤</>在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中生产获得。<@gd.key>赤铜零件</>则需要研究武陵工业二期的<@gd.key>液辅熔炼</>工业技术。
guide_text_equip_new_desc_3.en: Gear Template Crates acquired in different regions give templates that require different materials for gear assembly. For example, template crates acquired in <@gd.key>Qingbo Stockade</> give templates that need <@gd.key>Cuprium Components</>. Cuprium Components can be made using <@gd.key>Cuprium Parts</> and <@gd.key>Xiranite</> with the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> (AIC Factory facility). And to make <@gd.key>Cuprium Parts</>, you must first research the Wuling AIC II technology of <@gd.key>Liquid Refining</>.

guide_text_equip_new_title_1.cn: 装备模板箱 - 新区域投放

guide_text_erosion_barrier_desc_1.cn:
侵蚀屏障在未消除时，无法通行。
只有<@gd.key>机芯模块</>才可以消除侵蚀屏障。
guide_text_erosion_barrier_desc_1.en: The Blight Barrier must be first eliminated to allow passage, and it can only be eliminated with a <@gd.key>core module</>.

guide_text_erosion_intro_desc_1.cn: 武陵地区也存在动态侵蚀，同样会阻塞道路，并对接触到的干员造成负面影响。在无法消除武陵地区的动态侵蚀时，请小心躲避。
guide_text_erosion_intro_desc_1.en: There are also masses of Active Blight in Wuling that block paths and exert negative effects on the operators. Avoid these Blight masses if they cannot be eliminated.

guide_text_erosion_mechanism_desc_1.cn: 被动态侵蚀影响的各类装置，需要<@gd.key>消除侵蚀</>后才能正常使用。
guide_text_erosion_mechanism_desc_1.en: Certain devices, machines, and mechanisms might be affected by Active Blight. The <@gd.key>Blight must be eliminated</> to use them properly.

guide_text_eswitch_attacked_1.cn: 受击装置在受到攻击或是爆炸冲击后，会改变运行状态，一般用来关闭<#adv.electricFence>高压阻拦网</>或启用<#adv.jumpMachine>弹射装置</>。
guide_text_eswitch_attacked_1.en: A reactive device changes its operation mode when attacked or hit by an explosion. It is often used as a switch for <#adv.electricFence>High Voltage Fences</> or <#adv.jumpMachine>Bounce Devices</>.

guide_text_ether1.cn: 在野外探索时，有时会发现闪烁着奇异光芒的物体——<@gd.key>醚质</>。
guide_text_ether1.en: <@gd.key>Aurylenes</> are mysterious entities that emit strange sparkling lights. They may be found during exploration.

guide_text_ether2.cn:
活性醚质是一种特殊醚质，具备不同的活性化特征。
有的会自主移动；有的则“善于隐蔽”——需要通过<@gd.key>扫描</>才能确认他们的位置。
guide_text_ether2.en: Active Aurylenes are forms of unstable Aurylene that exhibit a range of special properties. Some can move on their own, while others are good at "hiding" and can only be revealed by <@gd.key>scanning</>.

guide_text_ether3.cn: 将<@gd.key>醚质</>提交到<@gd.key>协议传送点</>处，可获得探索有帮助的道具，<@gd.key>增加体力上限</>。
guide_text_ether3.en: Submit <@gd.key>Aurylenes</> at any <@gd.key>TP Point</> to receive items that can support exploration and <@gd.key>increase Stamina limit</>.

guide_text_ethillu_intro.cn:
<@gd.key>表象</>在被击败后会<@gd.key>复活</>一次。
复活后攻击范围更大且能通过自爆造成高额伤害。再次击败即可彻底消灭。
guide_text_ethillu_intro.en: When defeated, the <@gd.key>Æthillu</> will <@gd.key>revive</> once. The revived entity also has a greater attack range and can detonate itself to deal massive DMG. Defeat it again to eliminate it permanently.

guide_text_ethillu_intro_2.cn: 击败<@gd.key>表象</>后，可恢复一定的<@gd.key>技力</>。

guide_text_fac_fissure_bury_desc_1.cn: 解锁工业技术<@gd.key>气体散布</>后，可解锁<@gd.key>简化的息壤生产配方</>，仅需<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>碳块</>即可生产息壤。
guide_text_fac_fissure_bury_desc_1.en: Unlocking the AIC technology of <@gd.key>Gas Dispersal</> also unlocks a <@gd.key>streamlined Xiranite production formula</> that only needs <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Carbon</>.

guide_text_fac_fissure_bury_desc_2.cn: 裂隙中和需要使用<@gd.key>给水器</>将集成工业系统生产的<@gd.key>液化息壤</>通入裂隙中，请灵活使用简化的息壤生产配方。
guide_text_fac_fissure_bury_desc_2.en: Neutralizing a rift requires the use of a <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</> to fill up the rift with <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> produced using the AIC Factory. The streamlined Xiranite production formula can be useful in this case.

guide_text_fac_gas_diffuser_desc.cn: 在侵蚀瘴中摆放气体散布机时，向气体散布机通入<@gd.key>息壤气</>，气体散布机可形成息壤环境。在息壤环境范围内，<@gd.key>侵蚀瘴耐受条不会减少</>。
guide_text_fac_gas_diffuser_desc.en: A Gas Dispersing Unit placed in the Blight Miasma and supplied it with an input of <@gd.key>Xiragen</> will create a Xiranite environment. The <@gd.key>Miasma Tolerance bar</> will not decrease while standing in a Xiranite environment.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_1.cn: 这里正在预览当前集成核心区域的状态。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_1.en: This is a preview of the current status of the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2.cn: 右侧列表是所有可供购买的<@gd.key>升级项</>，选择任意升级项查看其功能。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2.en: The list on the right shows all the <@gd.key>upgrades</> that can be purchased. Select an upgrade to check its effects.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2_1.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>区域扩大·一</>，预览它的效果。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2_1.en: Click on <@gd.key>Area Expansion I</> to preview its effects.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择<@gd.key>区域扩大·一</>，预览它的效果。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_2_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select <@gd.key>Area Expansion I</> and preview its effects.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_3.cn: 这里列举了购买升级后对集成核心区域的影响以及相关说明。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_3.en: This lists the effects on the Core AIC Area and other details of the upgrade once purchased.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_4.cn: 如果拥有足够的当前地区<@gd.key>调度券</>，则可以购买对应升级项，使得集成核心区域获得相应升级。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_4.en: Having enough regional <@gd.key>stock bills</> allows the purchasing of various upgrades to improve the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_5.cn: 调度券可以通过<@gd.key>向据点供给货物、探索地区等</>多种方式获得，当有足够调度券时记得前往升级集成核心区域，以便利集成工业系统的建设。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_5.en: Stock bills can be earned in a number of ways, including <@gd.key>supplying outposts with goods and regional exploration</>. Do not forget to upgrade the Core AIC Area after earning enough stock bills to expedite the establishment of a proper AIC Factory.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_6.cn: 集成管家可以升级<@gd.key>仓库存取线</>，对后续的工业建设有非常大的帮助，点击预览本段仓库存取线。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_6.en: The AIC Steward can upgrade the <@gd.key>Depot Bus</> and offer plenty of help for subsequent AIC Factory expansions. Click to preview the Depot Bus technology.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_6_ct.cn:
集成管家可以升级<@gd.key>仓库存取线</>，对后续的工业建设有非常大的帮助。
请按下<action=fac_region_upgrade_goto_tech_tree>，查看工业发展规划。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_6_ct.en: The AIC Steward can upgrade the <@gd.key>Depot Bus</> and offers plenty of help for subsequent AIC Factory expansions. Press <action=fac_region_upgrade_goto_tech_tree> to view the AIC Factory Plan.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_7.cn: 获取足够的基础工业点数并解锁前置项目，即可解锁<@gd.key>仓库存取线</>的升级权限。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_7.en: Earn enough Basic AIC Indices and unlock various prerequisites to gain the authorization to upgrade the <@gd.key>Depot Bus</>.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_8.cn: 点击这里前往<@gd.key>相关教学</>，学习仓库存取线的使用知识，对合理使用仓库存取线大有裨益。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_8.en: Click here to experience <@gd.key>relevant tutorials</> and master the uses of the Depot Bus. Clever use of the Depot Bus will greatly benefit the AIC Factory.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_8_ct.cn: 可按下<action=tech_tree_detail_related_blackbox>前往<@gd.key>相关教学</>，学习仓库存取线的使用知识，对合理使用仓库存取线大有裨益。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_8_ct.en: Press <action=tech_tree_detail_related_blackbox> to experience <@gd.key>relevant tutorials</> and master the uses of the Depot Bus. Clever use of the Depot Bus will greatly benefit the AIC Factory.

guide_text_fac_region_levelup_hint_1.cn: 集成核心区域附近出现了集成管家，与其交互，了解如何<@gd.key>升级集成核心区域</>。
guide_text_fac_region_levelup_hint_1.en: An AIC Steward has appeared near the Core AIC Area. Interact with the AIC Steward to learn how to <@gd.key>upgrade the Core AIC Area</>.

guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_1.cn:
可以在<@gd.key>简易制作</>的<@gd.key>种植调配</>类别中制造各种田块。
获得<@gd.key>植物</>后，自动解锁其<@gd.key>田块</>的制作工艺。
guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Planting</> section of <@gd.key>Crafting</> to craft plots that can be used for planting crops. Acquiring a <@gd.key>plant</> also unlocks the crafting formula for the <@gd.key>plot</> to grow that plant.

guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_2.cn:
拥有田块后，将其放置在特定区域，进行种植。
种植有育苗、浇水、成长、收获四个阶段。
完成后可以收获对应的植物。
guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_2.en: After acquiring a planting plot, it can be placed in special areas for planting. Planting has 4 stages: (1) Germinating, (2) Watering, (3) Growing, and (4) Harvesting. A fully grown plant can be harvested.

guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_3.cn: 部分田块只能在<@gd.key>武陵地区</>种植，比如<@gd.key>金石稻田块</>。
guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_3.en: Some planting plots can only be grown in <@gd.key>Wuling</>. An example is the <@gd.key>Amber Rice Plot</>.

guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_4.cn: 部分田块需要进行<@gd.key>多次浇水</>，利用<@gd.key>洒水机</>可实现自动化浇水。
guide_text_farm_skipchapter_desc_4.en: Some plots require <@gd.key>multiple rounds of watering</> to make the plant grow. Use <@gd.key>Sprinklers</> to automate the watering step.

guide_text_fdcentur_1.cn: 按下<action=general_ability_release>使用造裔武器打断敌人！
guide_text_fdcentur_1.en: Press <action=general_ability_release> to interrupt the enemy with the Foundite Weapon!

guide_text_fdcentur_1_mb.cn: 点击此处，使用造裔武器打断敌人！
guide_text_fdcentur_1_mb.en: Click here to interrupt the enemy with the Foundite Weapon!

guide_text_fdcentur_desc_1.cn: 当阿莱克琉斯的失衡值累积至<@ba.poise>失衡节点</>时，会短暂踉跄并在场地中定格一把造裔武器。
guide_text_fdcentur_desc_1.en: When Alleikhreos's Stagger builds up to a <@ba.poise>Stagger Node</>, he will temporarily stumble and a Foundite Weapon will appear in the battlefield.

guide_text_fdcentur_desc_2.cn:
当<@gd.key>主控干员</>来到造裔武器附近后，即可吸收并使用造裔武器。
 按下<action=general_ability_release>即可使用造裔武器攻击敌人，打断其正在施放的蓄力技能。
guide_text_fdcentur_desc_2.en: Move a <@gd.key>controlled operator</> near the Foundite Weapon to pick it up and use it. Press <action=general_ability_release> to attack the enemy with the Foundite Weapon and interrupt any charged skill he is trying to cast.

guide_text_fdcentur_desc_2_mb.cn:
当<@gd.key>主控干员</>来到造裔武器附近后，即可吸收并使用造裔武器。
点击便捷工具键，即可使用造裔武器攻击敌人，打断其正在施放的蓄力技能。
guide_text_fdcentur_desc_2_mb.en: Move a <@gd.key>controlled operator</> near the Foundite Weapon to pick it up and use it. Press the Easy Tools button to attack the enemy with the Foundite Weapon and interrupt any charge-up skill he is trying to cast.

guide_text_fdcentur_desc_3.cn:
阿莱克琉斯的蓄力技能无法使用常规手段打断，并且会对干员造成大量伤害。
 可使用造裔武器将其打断，或者跑出对应范围。
guide_text_fdcentur_desc_3.en: Alleikhreos's charged skill cannot be interrupted normally and it deals massive DMG to your operators. Use a Foundite Weapon to interrupt Alleikhreos or leave the skill's area of effect.

guide_text_fdcentur_title_3.cn: 阿莱克琉斯的蓄力技能

guide_text_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>灌装机</>可以将含有灌装标签的材料进行合成生产，可制造多种制剂或食品产品。
典型产物为<#item.bottledRecHp1>荞愈胶囊</>，由<#item.glassBottle>紫晶质瓶</>和<#item.plantMossPowder1>荞花粉末</>放入<@gd.key>灌装机</>后合成获得。
guide_text_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_1.en:
The <@gd.key>Filling Unit</> can process materials with the [Fill] tag to produce various medications or processed foods.
Typical product: <#item.bottledRecHp1>Buck Capsule [C]</>, made by placing <#item.glassBottle>Amethyst Bottle</> and <#item.plantMossPowder1>Buckflower Powder</> in the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>.

guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_1.cn: 拍一拍<@gd.key>周身萦绕光点</>的吐虫长股兽，它会吐出萤火虫，将其传递至<@gd.key>终点位置的长股兽</>吧！
guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_1.en: Pat a <@gd.key>glowing bugspitting lankybeast</> and it will spit out a glowbug, then pass that glowbug to the <@gd.key>lankybeast at the finishing position</>.

guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_2.cn: 有些长股兽不在传递位置上，可以适当地<@gd.key>驱赶</>它们，这些长股兽会在有人靠近后跳开，利用这种特性，可以让它前往<@gd.key>适合传递萤火虫的位置</>。
guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_2.en: Some lankybeasts are not at bug passing positions, but will jump away when people get close. Use this property and <@gd.key>chase</> them around to force the lankybeasts to a <@gd.key>proper bug passing position</>.

guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_3.cn: 也有些不在传递位置的长股兽会<@gd.key>跟随荷叶移动或升降</>，利用荷叶的移动规则，也可以让它们帮助传递萤火虫。
guide_text_fireflyfrogs_desc_3.en: Some lankybeasts not in the passing positions <@gd.key>move around or up and down with their lotus leaves</>. Study how the lotus leaves move and use the lankies on the leaves to pass the bugs.

guide_text_fissure_temp_handled_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>枢壤仪</>激活时可以遏制裂隙，靠近<@gd.key>裂隙</>并交互，可以开始<@gd.key>遏制裂隙</>作战。
击败所有出现的敌人，裂隙会被遏制，范围内的<@gd.key>侵蚀瘴</>会消失。
guide_text_fissure_temp_handled_desc_1.en: An activated <@gd.key>Xiranite Nexus</> can contain various rift fissures. Approach a <@gd.key>rift fissure</> and interact with it to start a <@gd.key>rift containment</> battle. Defeating every enemy that appears will contain the rift fissure and dissipate the nearby <@gd.key>Blight Miasma</>.

guide_text_fissure_temp_handled_desc_2.cn: 通过此方式，可以<@gd.key>遏制</>裂隙，但是裂隙仍需要通过后续解锁的<@gd.key>集成工业技术</>才能让其彻底消失，请继续推进主线任务。
guide_text_fissure_temp_handled_desc_2.en: The Xiranite Nexus can <@gd.key>contain</> rift fissures, but permanent removal will require the use of <@gd.key>AIC Factory technologies</> unlocked by progressing through the main mission.

guide_text_flame_desctruct_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>易燃凝胶</>是一种易燃、易爆物质，在被<#item.procBomb>工业爆炸物</>引爆后，会引发周边其他的<@gd.key>易燃凝胶</>爆炸。
guide_text_flame_desctruct_desc_1.en: <@gd.key>Flammable Gel</> is a flammable and explosive substance. It can be detonated by <#item.procBomb>Industrial Explosives</> and the resulting explosion can also detonate nearby patches of <@gd.key>Flammable Gel</> as well.

guide_text_fog_find_npc.cn: 避免与梦境中的巫术造物过多缠斗，在迷雾中<@gd.key>寻找安德烈的意识</>。
guide_text_fog_find_npc.en: Avoid being bogged down in fights against witchcraft creations. The aim is to <@gd.key>find Andre's consciousness</> in the thick fog.

guide_text_fog_find_npc_1.cn: 在迷雾中<@gd.key>寻找安德烈的意识</>。

guide_text_fog_nest_desc.cn:
使用普通的攻击手段无法摧毁小型巢雕。
只能通过<@gd.key>爆炸物</>摧毁小型巢雕。
guide_text_fog_nest_desc.en: Small denstacks cannot be damaged by operator attacks or skills. They can only be destroyed with <@gd.key>explosives</>.

guide_text_foresight_char_growth_1.cn: <@gd.key>培养总览</>功能已开放，可在此查看各项培养内容的<@gd.key>材料消耗</>与<@gd.key>获取途径</>。
guide_text_foresight_char_growth_1.en: <@gd.key>Progression Overview</> feature is now available. This shows all the <@gd.key>materials required</> for various progression goals, and the <@gd.key>sources</> of the said materials.

guide_text_foresight_char_growth_2.cn: 在培养总览中，可查看任意干员的<@gd.key>各项培养进度</>，以及培养所需材料的消耗和拥有情况。
guide_text_foresight_char_growth_2.en: The Progression Overview also shows various <@gd.key>progression statuses</> of any operators, the cost of materials for reaching progression goals, and how many materials you own.

guide_text_foresight_char_growth_3.cn: 可在此处切换<@gd.key>培养期望</>，将统一设定干员、技能和武器的目标等级，每位干员的培养期望均独立记录。
guide_text_foresight_char_growth_3.en: Use this to switch progression <@gd.key>goals</>. A goal has a set of targets for operator, skills and talents, and weapons. The goal for each operator is recorded separately.

guide_text_foresight_char_growth_4.cn: 已经满足相应培养期望的干员，将在此处展示对应的<@gd.key>养成标识</>。该标识无需设定培养期望也可生效。
guide_text_foresight_char_growth_4.en: Operators who reached progression goal targets will display matching <@gd.key>progression icons</> here, even if no progression goals have been selected for the operator.

guide_text_forklift_desc_1.cn: 交互后，叉车会将所持货物抬高。
guide_text_forklift_desc_1.en: Interact with forklifts to raise or lower their lifting forks.

guide_text_friend_1.cn: <@gd.key>好友</>系统中集成了个人名片、好友列表、添加好友等功能，可在此查看社交相关信息。
guide_text_friend_1.en: The <@gd.key>Friends</> feature includes these functions: Profile, Friends List, and Add Friend. Use it to view details related to socialization.

guide_text_friend_2.cn: 请点击此处，查看<@gd.key>个人名片</>。

guide_text_friend_3.cn: 在<@gd.key>个人名片</>中，可查看管理员的各项信息，如任务进度、干员与武器持有数量、光荣之路等。
guide_text_friend_3.en: The <@gd.key>Profile</> displays various information of the Endministrator, including mission progress, number of operators and weapons acquired, and Path of Glory (achievement medals).

guide_text_friend_4.cn:
个人名片同样可用于对其他玩家显示。
可在此处更换展示的干员。
guide_text_friend_4.en:
The Profile is also displayed to other players.
Showcased operators can be edited here.

guide_text_friend_5.cn: 可点击此处，展开更多功能，并进行个性化设置，如更改名片主题、头像、头像框等。
guide_text_friend_5.en: Click here to show more personalization options. These include changing profile themes, portraits, and portrait frames.

guide_text_friend_5_ct.cn: 可按下<action=friend_move_info>，展开更多功能，并进行个性化设置，如更改名片主题、头像、头像框等。
guide_text_friend_5_ct.en: Press <action=friend_move_info> to show more personalization options that include profile themes, portraits, and portrait frames.

guide_text_friend_6.cn: 点击此处，前往<@gd.key>添加好友</>。

guide_text_friend_7.cn: 可搜索玩家名称或UID以添加好友。
guide_text_friend_7.en: Search player name or UID to find and add friends.

guide_text_friend_8.cn: 除此之外，终末地工业还提供了一批<@gd.key>可联络者</>，可供添加好友。
guide_text_friend_8.en: Endfield Industries has also provided a list of <@gd.key>contacts</> who can be added as friends.

guide_text_furnance_hint1.cn:
<@gd.key>供电桩</>已存放于背包中。
请按下<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_furnance_hint1.en: The <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> has been placed in the Backpack. Press <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_furnance_hint1_ct.cn:
<@gd.key>供电桩</>已存放于背包中。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_furnance_hint1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> has been placed in the Backpack. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_furnance_hint1_mb.cn:
<@gd.key>供电桩</>已存放于背包中。
请点击此处打开背包。
guide_text_furnance_hint1_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> has been placed in the Backpack. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_furnance_hint2.cn: 按照提示，请将<@gd.key>供电桩</>拖入下方快捷栏中。
guide_text_furnance_hint2.en: Follow the instructions and drag the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> to the hotbar below.

guide_text_furnance_hint2_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，将<@gd.key>供电桩</>登录到快捷栏中。
guide_text_furnance_hint2_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to add <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> into the hotbar.

guide_text_furnance_hint2_2_ct.cn: 请将<@gd.key>供电桩</>放入快捷栏。
guide_text_furnance_hint2_2_ct.en: Place the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</> into the hotbar.

guide_text_furnance_hint3.cn: 靠近精炼炉并按下<action=common_interact>打开操作面板。
guide_text_furnance_hint3.en: Get close to the Refining Unit, then press <action=common_interact> to open its control panel.

guide_text_furnance_hint3_mb.cn: 靠近精炼炉并打开其操作面板。
guide_text_furnance_hint3_mb.en: Get close to the Refining Unit and open its control panel.

guide_text_furnance_hint4.cn: 将源矿拖入精炼炉，可以生产得到晶体外壳。
guide_text_furnance_hint4.en: Drag Originium Ore into the Refining Unit to process it into Origocrusts.

guide_text_furnance_hint4_ct.cn: 将源矿放入精炼炉，可以生产得到晶体外壳。
guide_text_furnance_hint4_ct.en: Place the Originium Ore in the Refining Unit to process it into Origocrusts.

guide_text_furnance_mode_desc_1.cn: 精炼炉在<@gd.key>液体模式</>下，可进行与液体相关的不同配方生产，典型产物为<@gd.key>赤铜块</>；可以在设备详情界面手动切换回<@gd.key>固体模式</>。
guide_text_furnance_mode_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</> lets the Refining Unit use fluid-related formulas for production. Typical product: <@gd.key>Cuprium</>. Use the control panel to manually switch the Refining Unit back to <@gd.key>Solid Mode</>.

guide_text_gacha_1.cn:
可通过<@gd.key>寻访</>来获得更多的干员支援。
请按下<action=common_open_gacha>或者按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进行干员寻访。
guide_text_gacha_1.en: Use <@gd.key>headhunting</> to acquire more operators for support. Press <action=common_open_gacha> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to perform headhunting.

guide_text_gacha_1_1.cn: 可通过<@gd.key>寻访</>来获得更多的干员支援。
guide_text_gacha_1_1.en: Use <@gd.key>headhunting</> to acquire more operators for support.

guide_text_gacha_1_ct.cn:
可通过<@gd.key>寻访</>来获得更多的干员支援。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_gacha_1_ct.en: Use <@gd.key>headhunting</> to acquire more operators for support. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_gacha_1_mb.cn:
可通过<@gd.key>寻访</>来获得更多的干员支援。
请点击此处进行干员寻访。
guide_text_gacha_1_mb.en: Use <@gd.key>headhunting</> to acquire more operators for support. Tap here to start headhunting.

guide_text_gacha_2.cn:
<@gd.key>启程寻访</>现已开启。
可在此处查看。
guide_text_gacha_2.en: <@gd.key>New Horizons Headhunting</> is now available. View it here.

guide_text_gacha_2_ct.cn:
<@gd.key>启程寻访</>现已开启。
请按下<action=common_confirm>查看。
guide_text_gacha_2_ct.en:
<@gd.key>New Horizons Headhunting</> is now available. 
Press <action=common_confirm> to view it.

guide_text_gacha_3.cn:
推进主线任务即可获得<@gd.key>十连启程寻访凭证</>，可用于启程寻访。
请点击此处，前往领取。
guide_text_gacha_3.en: Progress through the main mission to acquire <@gd.key>New Horizons HH-10×Permit</> that can be used in New Horizons Headhunting. Click here to go and claim it.

guide_text_gacha_3_ct.cn:
推进主线任务即可获得<@gd.key>十连启程寻访凭证</>，可用于启程寻访。
请按下<action=gacha_starter_focus_mission_node>，前往领取。
guide_text_gacha_3_ct.en: Progress through the main mission to acquire <@gd.key>New Horizons HH-10×Permit</> that can be used in New Horizons Headhunting. Press <action=gacha_starter_focus_mission_node> to go and claim it.

guide_text_gacha_5.cn: 当前已持有<@gd.key>十连启程寻访凭证</>，可在此处进行寻访。
guide_text_gacha_5.en: <@gd.key>New Horizons HH-10×Permit</> acquired. Start headhunting here.

guide_text_gacha_5_ct.cn: 当前已持有<@gd.key>十连启程寻访凭证</>，可在此处进行寻访。
guide_text_gacha_5_ct.en: <@gd.key>New Horizons HH-10×Permit</> acquired. Start headhunting here.

guide_text_gacha_8.cn: 可在此处查看并切换多种寻访，以获得不同的干员支援，可以多多尝试。
guide_text_gacha_8.en: This screen shows various headhunting banners for recruiting various operators. Switch between the banners and try them out.

guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_1.cn: <@gd.key>武陵工业计划</>中解锁了新的工业技术，请打开工业发展规划界面查看。
guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_1.en: New technologies have been unlocked in the <@gd.key>Wuling AIC Plan</>. Open the AIC Factory Plan to view them.

guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_2.cn: 已可以解锁工业技术<@gd.key>裂隙中和</>、<@gd.key>气体散布</>和<@gd.key>气体反应</>。请查看<@gd.key>裂隙中和</>。
guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_2.en: <@gd.key>Rift Neutralization</>, <@gd.key>Gas Dispersal</>, and <@gd.key>Gas Reaction</> AIC Plan technologies have been unlocked. View the details of <@gd.key>Rift Neutralization</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_3.cn: 解锁后，给水器将解锁裂隙中和功能，在裂隙旁放置<@gd.key>给水器</>可用于中和裂隙，恢复裂隙出现前的地貌。同时<@gd.key>给水器不再需要通电</>。
guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_3.en: Once unlocked, the Neutralize Rift feature will become available to the Fluid Supply Unit. Place a <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</> next to a rift fissure to neutralize it and restore the local area. This technology also lets <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Units work without a power grid connection</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_4.cn: 解锁<@gd.key>气体散布、气体反应</>两项技术可以用于生产<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>。
guide_text_gasTechtree_fissure_bury_4.en: Research the 2 AIC Plan technologies <@gd.key>Gas Dispersal and Gas Reaction</> to produce <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_1.cn: 武陵工业计划中解锁了新的工业技术，请按下快捷键<action=fac_open_tech_tree>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>查看。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_1.en: A new technology has been unlocked in the Wuling AIC Plan. Press the hotkey <action=fac_open_tech_tree> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_1_ct.cn: 武陵工业计划中解锁了新的工业技术，请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>，打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_1_ct.en: A new technology has been unlocked in the Wuling AIC Plan. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_2.cn: 在武陵各处分布着<@gd.key>惰气</>等<@gd.key>气体资源</>，请查看新解锁的与<@gd.key>气体</>相关的工业技术。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_2.en: <@gd.key>Gaseous resources</> such as <@gd.key>Inergen</> can be found in various areas of Wuling. To use them, check the <@gd.key>gas</>-related AIC technologies that have been just unlocked.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=quickMenu_left_left_onPress>选中此项，进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>查看。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_2_ct.en: Press the <action=quickMenu_left_left_onPress> to select this option and open the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_3.cn: 解锁工业技术<@gd.key>气体收集</>后，将气体收集泵放置在气体采集口处，可以自动化采集<@gd.key>惰气</>等气矿。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_3.en: Unlock the AIC technology <@gd.key>Gas Extraction</> and then place Gas Extractors over gas vents to automate the extraction of gaseous resources such as <@gd.key>Inergen</>.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_4.cn: 解锁<@gd.key>液气转化</>、<@gd.key>固气转化</>等相关工业技术，不仅可以<@gd.key>更高效</>地生产息壤，还可以生产用于制造新装备的<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_4.en: Unlocking the AIC technologies <@gd.key>Fluid-Gas Transmutation</> and <@gd.key>Solid-Gas Transmutation</> gives a <@gd.key>more efficient way</> for producing Xiranite and the means of producing <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</> required for assembling new types of gear.

guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_mb.cn: 武陵工业计划中解锁了新的工业技术，请打开<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>查看。
guide_text_gasTechtree_unlock_mb.en: A new technology has been unlocked in the Wuling AIC Plan. Open the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</> to view it.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_1.cn:
以一定速度持续通入各类气体，气体散布机可在自身周围形成对应的<@gd.key>气体环境</>。
例如通入<@gd.key>惰气</>，则可形成<@gd.key>稳定环境</>。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_1.en: When supplied with a gas at the required flow rate, the Gas Dispersing Unit can create a matching <@gd.key>gaseous environment</>. For example, inputting <@gd.key>Inergen</> lets the facility create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</>.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_2.cn: 部分工业设备的配方只有在特定气体环境下才会生效。例如提纯机完全放置在<@gd.key>稳定环境</>下，可消耗<@gd.key>更少分离芯</>进行<@gd.key>重息壤气</>的提纯。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_2.en: Some AIC Factory formulas can only be used when the facility is in the required gaseous environment. For example, a Purification Unit placed completely in a <@gd.key>Stable environment</> can purify <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen</> with a formula that consumes less <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_3.cn: 天有洪炉开放了<@gd.key>气液模式</>，可以<@gd.key>大幅简化息壤制备</>产线。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_3.en: Forges of the Sky now have the <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</> that makes a <@gd.key>greatly streamlined Xiranite production line</> possible.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_4.cn:
在解锁工业技术<@gd.key>气体散布</>后，天有洪炉开放了<@gd.key>气液模式</>。
将天有洪炉完全放置在气体散布机提供的<@gd.key>稳定环境</>下，仅需<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>碳块</>即可生产<@gd.key>息壤</>。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_desc_4.en: The AIC technology of <@gd.key>Gas Dispersal</> has been unlocked. The <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</> is now available for Forges of the Sky. A Forge of the Sky completely placed within the <@gd.key>Stable environment</> created by a Gas Dispersing Unit only needs <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Carbon</> to produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_tips_desc_1.cn: 在侵蚀瘴中摆放气体散布机时，向气体散布机通入<@gd.key>息壤气</>，气体散布机可形成息壤环境。在息壤环境范围内，<@gd.key>侵蚀瘴耐受条不会减少</>。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_tips_desc_1.en: A Gas Dispersing Unit placed in the Blight Miasma and supplied it with an input of <@gd.key>Xiragen</> will create a Xiranite environment. The <@gd.key>Miasma Tolerance bar</> will not decrease while standing in a Xiranite environment.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_tips_desc_2.cn: 气体收集泵、气体散布机<@gd.key>无需通电</>即可工作，使用气体收集泵将息壤气囤积点的息壤气通入气体散布机，即可形成安全的<@gd.key>息壤环境</>。
guide_text_gas_diffuser_tips_desc_2.en: Gas Extractors and Gas Dispersing Units <@gd.key>do not require power to work</>. Use Gas Extractors to extract Xiragen from a Xiragen reservoir, then input the gas into a Gas Dispersing Unit to create a safe zone of <@gd.key>Xiranite environment</>.

guide_text_gas_diffuser_title_3.cn: 天有洪炉 - 气液模式
guide_text_gas_diffuser_title_3.en: Forge of the Sky: Gas & Fluid Mode

guide_text_gas_diffuser_title_4.cn: 天有洪炉 - 气液模式
guide_text_gas_diffuser_title_4.en: Forge of the Sky: Gas & Fluid Mode

guide_text_gas_fill_1.cn: 惰气矿点周围弥漫着对应气体，在气体范围内，可以使用<@gd.key>盛装</>功能进行气体采集。
guide_text_gas_fill_1.en: The air around the Inergen vents are rich in the gas. Use the <@gd.key>Fill</> action to gather the gases in a suitable container.

guide_text_gas_fill_2.cn: <@gd.key>气体盛装</>已经解锁，请<@gd.key>长按</><action=general_ability_press>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>后<@gd.key>长按</>此处切换便捷工具键。
guide_text_gas_fill_2.en: The <@gd.key>Fill Gas</> action has been unlocked. <@gd.key>Long-press</> <action=general_ability_press> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and <@gd.key>long press</> this to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_gas_fill_2_ct.cn: <@gd.key>气体盛装</>已经解锁，请<@gd.key>长按</><action=general_ability_press>切换便捷工具键。
guide_text_gas_fill_2_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Fill Gas</> action has been unlocked. <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=general_ability_press> to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_gas_fill_2_ct_2.cn: <@gd.key>气体盛装</>已经解锁,请<@gd.key>长按</><action=general_ability_press_alter>切换便捷工具键。
guide_text_gas_fill_2_ct_2.en: The <@gd.key>Fill Gas</> action has been unlocked. <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=general_ability_press_alter> to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_gas_fill_2_mb.cn: <@gd.key>气体盛装</>已经解锁，请<@gd.key>长按</>此处切换便捷工具键。
guide_text_gas_fill_2_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Fill Gas</> action has been unlocked. <@gd.key>Tap and hold</> this to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_gas_fill_3_ct.cn: 请推动<action=common_rightstick>操作杆并选中此项，进入<@gd.key>盛装</>界面。
guide_text_gas_fill_3_ct.en: Use the <action=common_rightstick> stick to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Fill</> panel.

guide_text_gas_fill_4.cn: 按下<@gd.key>盛装</>，即可开始收集惰气。

guide_text_gas_fill_5.cn: 惰气需要使用<@gd.key>特定类型的容器</>收集，此处需要选择盛装惰气的容器。
guide_text_gas_fill_5.en: Inergen can only be gathered with <@gd.key>special types of containers</>. Select a suitable container that can be filled with Inergen.

guide_text_gas_fill_6.cn: <@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>可以用于收集惰气，请在此处选择<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，并尝试收集<@gd.key>10份</>惰气。
guide_text_gas_fill_6.en: <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> can be used to gather Inergen. Select <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> here and try to gather <@gd.key>10 units</> of Inergen.

guide_text_gas_fill_7.cn: 惰气需要使用特定类型的容器收集，<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>可以用于收集惰气，<@gd.key>请将赤铜耐压罐放入背包</>，用其收集10份惰气。
guide_text_gas_fill_7.en: Inergen can only be gathered with special containers such as <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>. Place the <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</> in the Backpack, and use them to gather 10 units of Inergen.

guide_text_gas_fill_tips.cn: 已切换到<@gd.key>气体盛装</>，请<@gd.key>按下</><action=general_ability_press>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>后<@gd.key>点击</>此处开始盛装气体。
guide_text_gas_fill_tips.en: Action switched to <@gd.key>Fill Gas</>. <@gd.key>Press</> <action=general_ability_press> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and <@gd.key>click</> here to start filling the gas.

guide_text_gas_fill_tips_ct.cn: 已切换到<@gd.key>气体盛装</>，请<@gd.key>按下</><action=general_ability_press>开始盛装气体。
guide_text_gas_fill_tips_ct.en: Action switched to <@gd.key>Fill Gas</>. <@gd.key>Press</> <action=general_ability_press> to start filling the gas.

guide_text_gas_fill_tips_mb.cn: 已切换到<@gd.key>气体盛装</>，请按下此处开始盛装气体。
guide_text_gas_fill_tips_mb.en: Action switched to <@gd.key>Fill Gas</>. Tap here to start filling the gas.

guide_text_gas_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_.cn: 灌装机开放了<@gd.key>气液模式</>，可将<@gd.key>气体</>灌装入气体容器（如赤铜耐压罐）。
guide_text_gas_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_.en: The Filling Unit now has the <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</>. The mode lets the facility fill gas containers (such as Cuprium Canisters) with <@gd.key>gases</>.

guide_text_gas_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_.cn: 拆解机开放了<@gd.key>气液模式</>，可对装有气体的容器进行拆解，分离气体和容器。
guide_text_gas_filling_pd_mc_intro_desc_.en: The Separating Unit now has the <@gd.key>Gas & Fluid Mode</>. The mode lets the facility separate gas containers into the gas and the container.

guide_text_gas_inert_update_desc.cn: 在<@gd.key>武陵城集成核心区域、景玉谷天王坪援建点和首墩心脏修缮站</>附近出现了新的惰气矿点，可以利用这些惰气进行工业建设。
guide_text_gas_inert_update_desc.en: New Inergen gas vents have appeared near these locations: <@gd.key>Core AIC Area (Wuling City), Sky King Flats Construction Site (Jingyu Valley), and Cardiac Remediation Station (Marker Stone)</>. You can extract Inergen from these gas vents for AIC Factory production.

guide_text_gas_mix_oven_desc_1.cn:
在气体反应炉中，通过<@gd.key>气体之间的反应</>，可生产新类型的气体。
典型配方如完全放置在<@gd.key>酸性环境</>下可生产<@gd.key>气态灼铜</>，最终用于生产<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>。
guide_text_gas_mix_oven_desc_1.en: The Gas Reactor Globe can perform <@gd.key>gas reactions</> to produce new types of gases. If the facility is completely placed in an <@gd.key>Acrid environment</>, it can produce <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Gas</>, which is a material needed for making <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</>.

guide_text_gas_pump_1_desc_1.cn: 气体收集泵可放置在<@gd.key>气体采集口处</>进行气体收集。放置后<@gd.key>无需供电</>即可运作。
guide_text_gas_pump_1_desc_1.en: Place Gas Extractors on <@gd.key>gas vents</> to extract gases. Once placed, Gas Extractors <@gd.key>do not require power to work</>.

guide_text_gas_pump_1_desc_2.cn: 世界中分布着各类气体采集口，可通过<@gd.key>气体收集泵</>收集，使用气体可生产<@gd.key>灼铜装备原件</>等工业产物。
guide_text_gas_pump_1_desc_2.en: Various types of gas vents can be found in the world. Rig them with <@gd.key>Gas Extractors</> to extract gases, which can then be used to make AIC products such as <@gd.key>Pyrrolite Components</>.

guide_text_gas_pump_location_desc_1.cn: 在武陵各处分布着不同类型的气体矿点，管理员可前往查看。在武陵工业计划中解锁<@gd.key>气体收集</>后，可自动化开采。
guide_text_gas_pump_location_desc_1.en: Different gas vents can be found scattered in certain areas of Wuling. Try to find them, Endministrator. Research the AIC Plan technology <@gd.key>Gas Extraction</> to unlock facilities to automate the gas extracting process.

guide_text_gas_purifier_1_desc_1.cn: 提纯机开放了<@gd.key>气体模式</>，可通过消耗<@gd.key>分离芯</>，将气体提纯为<@gd.key>更高纯度的气体</>，典型配方如将<@gd.key>息壤气</>提纯为<@gd.key>重息壤气</>。
guide_text_gas_purifier_1_desc_1.en: The Purification Unit switched to <@gd.key>Gas Mode</> can use <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> to purify gases to <@gd.key>higher purity</>. Typical formula: Purifying <@gd.key>Xiragen</> into <@gd.key>Heavy Xiragen</>.

guide_text_gas_purifier_1_mode.cn: 研究<@gd.key>气体提纯</>工业技术可解锁<@gd.key>提纯机 - 气体模式</>，提纯机 - 气体模式可消耗分离芯快速提纯制备<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>。
guide_text_gas_purifier_1_mode.en: Research the AIC Plan technology <@gd.key>Gas Purification</> to unlock <@gd.key>Purification Unit: Gas Mode</>. A Purification Unit switched to Gas Mode can consume Separator Cores to produce <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>.

guide_text_gas_purifier_1_mode_desc.cn: 研究<@gd.key>气体提纯</>工业技术可解锁<@gd.key>提纯机 - 气体模式</>，可通过消耗<@gd.key>分离芯</>，将气体提纯为<@gd.key>更高纯度的气体</>，如将<@gd.key>气态赤铜</>提纯为<@gd.key>气态赫铜</>。
guide_text_gas_purifier_1_mode_desc.en: Research the AIC Plan technology <@gd.key>Gas Purification</> to unlock <@gd.key>Purification Unit: Gas Mode</>. With the new mode, the Purification Unit can consume <@gd.key>Separator Cores</> to process <@gd.key>gases into higher levels of purity</>. Typical formula: Purification of <@gd.key>Cuprium Gas</> into <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>.

guide_text_gas_shaper_intro_desc_1.cn:
塑形机开放了<@gd.key>气体模式</>，可进行新的配方生产。
典型产物如<@gd.key>赤铜耐压罐</>，是生产<@gd.key>分离芯</>的原料之一。
guide_text_gas_shaper_intro_desc_1.en: The Moulding Unit switched to <@gd.key>Gas Mode</> can use new production formulas. Typical product: <@gd.key>Cuprium Canisters</>, which is a material for producing <@gd.key>Separator Cores</>.

guide_text_gas_storager_desc_1.cn: 储气罐可以储存<@gd.key>单一</>类型的<@gd.key>气体</>。
guide_text_gas_storager_desc_1.en: A Gas Tank can store a <@gd.key>single</> type of <@gd.key>gas</>.

guide_text_gem_1.cn: 可在此处进行<@gd.key>基质</>的注入。
guide_text_gem_1.en: This screen allows the infusing of <@gd.key>essences</>.

guide_text_gem_2.cn: 点击此处，选择该枚<@gd.key>基质</>。

guide_text_gem_2_ct.cn: 在这里可以查看当前所拥有的<@gd.key>基质</>。
guide_text_gem_2_ct.en: This shows all the <@gd.key>essences</> currently owned.

guide_text_gem_3.cn:
每个<@gd.key>基质</>都有若干种能够对应提升的<@gd.key>武器技能</>。
当武器注入符合的<@gd.key>基质</>后，便能够提升<@gd.key>武器技能等级</>。
guide_text_gem_3.en: Every <@gd.key>essence</> has stats that may offer <@gd.key>weapon skill</> upgrades. Infusing a weapon with the right <@gd.key>essence</> will upgrade the <@gd.key>weapon skill level</>.

guide_text_gem_4.cn: 基质与能够提升的武器技能，有着名称上的对应关系。
guide_text_gem_4.en: Essence names are associated with the weapon skills they enhance.

guide_text_gem_5.cn: 可以在此处预览注入后的武器技能效果。
guide_text_gem_5.en: This is a preview of weapon skill effects after infusing the essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_1.cn: <@gd.key>基质蚀刻</>功能已解锁，可通过消耗不需要的基质，强化现有的基质。
guide_text_gem_enhance_1.en: <@gd.key>Essence etching</> is now unlocked. It allows an essence to be enhanced by consuming other unwanted essences.

guide_text_gem_enhance_2.cn: 可在此处选择需要蚀刻的<@gd.key>无瑕基质</>，蚀刻成功后，将会强化该基质的附加技能。
guide_text_gem_enhance_2.en: Select a <@gd.key>flawless essence</> to etch from this section. Successful etching strengthens the stats of the essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_2_ct.cn: 可按下<action=common_confirm>选择需要蚀刻的<@gd.key>无瑕基质</>，蚀刻成功后，将会强化该基质的附加技能。
guide_text_gem_enhance_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select <@gd.key>flawless essence</> to etch from this section. Successful etching strengthens the stats of the essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_3.cn: 每次可对基质的三个附加技能中，选择一个进行蚀刻。
guide_text_gem_enhance_3.en: Select 1 of the 3 stats of the essence to perform the etching.

guide_text_gem_enhance_4.cn: 请点击此处，开始进行蚀刻。
guide_text_gem_enhance_4.en: Click here to begin the etching.

guide_text_gem_enhance_5.cn: 可在此处预览该基质附加技能升级后的效果。
guide_text_gem_enhance_5.en: This gives a preview of the effects after leveling up the essence stats.

guide_text_gem_enhance_6.cn: 可在此处选择一个<@gd.key>不需要</>的无瑕基质作为蚀刻耗费。
guide_text_gem_enhance_6.en: Select an <@gd.key>unwanted</> flawless essence from this section to consume for the etching process.

guide_text_gem_enhance_7.cn:
可在此处查看当前的蚀刻成功率。
该成功率与当前<@gd.key>蚀刻技能的等级</>有关。
guide_text_gem_enhance_7.en: This shows the current etching success rate. The success rate is based on the <@gd.key>level of the skill to be etched</>.

guide_text_gem_enhance_8.cn: 点击确认蚀刻，就会<@gd.key>消耗蚀刻耗费基质</>，以强化现有的基质。
guide_text_gem_enhance_8.en: Click the Etch button to <@gd.key>consume the unwanted essence</> and enhance the target essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_8_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_confirm>确认蚀刻，就会<@gd.key>消耗蚀刻耗费基质</>，以强化现有的基质。
guide_text_gem_enhance_8_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to Etch. This <@gd.key>consumes the unwanted essence</> and enhances the target essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_9.cn:
如果蚀刻成功，则基质的技能等级会获得提升；
如果蚀刻失败，则会产生一定数量的<@gd.key>冷却脂</>。
guide_text_gem_enhance_9.en: Successful etching raises the essence stats level. Failed etching attempts, on the other hand, produce a number of <@gd.key>Coolant Gel</>.

guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_1.cn:
可通过消耗不需要的基质，强化现有的基质。
每次需要消耗一个无瑕基质，对另一个无瑕基质的一个附加技能进行蚀刻。
guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_1.en: Essences can be enhanced by consuming other unwanted essences. Etching 1 stat of a flawless essence costs 1 flawless essence.

guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_2.cn:
如果蚀刻成功，则基质的附加技能等级会获得提升；
如果蚀刻失败，则会产生一定数量的<@gd.key>冷却脂</>。
guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_2.en: Successful etching levels up the essence stats. Failed etching attempts produce a number of <@gd.key>Coolant Gel</>.

guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_3.cn: 可使用一定数量的<@gd.key>冷却脂</>，进行<@gd.key>必定成功</>的基质蚀刻。
guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_3.en: Use enough <@gd.key>Coolant Gel</> to <@gd.key>guarantee the success</> of essence etching.

guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_4.cn: 可在<@gd.key>重度能量淤积点</>中，通过<@gd.key>消耗理智</>的方式，获取金色基质。
guide_text_gem_enhance_desc_4.en: Challenge <@gd.key>Severe Energy Alluvium</> and <@gd.key>spend Sanity</> to acquire gold quality essences.

guide_text_gem_enhance_hint_1.cn: <@gd.key>基质蚀刻</>功能已解锁，可在此处进入。
guide_text_gem_enhance_hint_1.en: <@gd.key>Essence etching</> is now unlocked. Access this feature here.

guide_text_gem_enhance_hint_2.cn: <@gd.key>基质蚀刻</>功能已解锁，可向下滑动列表，并从该入口进入。
guide_text_gem_enhance_hint_2.en: <@gd.key>Essence etching</> is now unlocked. Scroll down this list and access it via this portal.

guide_text_gem_wishlist_1.cn: 已解锁<@gd.key>基质愿望单</>功能，可在此处进入。
guide_text_gem_wishlist_1.en: <@gd.key>Essence Wishlist</> is now unlocked. Access this feature here.

guide_text_gem_wishlist_2.cn: 基质愿望单可用于自动标记属性与武器技能<@gd.key>“完美搭配”</>的金色基质。
guide_text_gem_wishlist_2.en: An essence <@gd.key>perfectly matches</> a weapon when it has all the stats of the said weapon. The Essence Wishlist can be used to auto-tag gold (flawless) essences with a perfect match.

guide_text_gem_wishlist_3.cn: 可在愿望单中勾选多件武器，确认保存后，贵重品库中已有的<@gd.key>“完美搭配”</>基质和新获取的<@gd.key>“完美搭配”</>基质，将<@gd.key>自动上锁</>并被特殊标记。
guide_text_gem_wishlist_3.en: After selecting multiple weapons in the Essence Wishlist and saving the selection, any <@gd.key>perfect match</> essences you already have in the Valuables Stash and any new <@gd.key>perfect match</> essences you acquire afterwards will be <@gd.key>auto-locked</> and given a special tag.

guide_text_gem_wishlist_4.cn: 通过筛选，可以定向查看特定种类或品质的武器。
guide_text_gem_wishlist_4.en: Use the filter to find weapons by type or quality.

guide_text_gem_wishlist_5.cn:
若持有当前版本的<@gd.key>六星武器</>，则会自动勾选并保存这些武器。
可在后续自行尝试勾选其他武器。
guide_text_gem_wishlist_5.en: If you have a <@gd.key>6★ weapon</> of the current version, it will be auto-selected and saved to the Essence Wishlist. Other weapons can still be selected and added to the wishlist.

guide_text_general_bomb_1.cn: 可<@gd.key>长按</><action=general_ability_press>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>后<@gd.key>长按</>此处切换便捷工具。
guide_text_general_bomb_1.en: <@gd.key>Long-press</> <action=general_ability_press> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and <@gd.key>long-press</> here to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_general_bomb_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=general_ability_press> to switch the Easy Tools action.

guide_text_hdwork_medic_hint_2_mb.en: Perform some <@gd.key>Crafting</> before battle and <@gd.key>use the items to restore HP</>. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_high_difficulty.cn:
在完成<@gd.key>影拓丰碑</>的挑战后，可解锁新挑战与已完成挑战的<@gd.key>苦难模式</>。
可在此处，切换至<@gd.key>苦难模式</>。
guide_text_high_difficulty.en:
Completing <@gd.key>Umbral Monument</> challenges unlocks its <@gd.key>Agony Mode</> as well as new challenges. 
Use this to switch to <@gd.key>Agony Mode</>.

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至目标地点。
guide_text_hint_camp_teleport.en: Press <action=common_open_map> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the map and <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the target location.

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_2.cn: 点击此处，选择<@gd.key>协议传送点</>。

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_2_1_ct.cn: 已为您选中<@gd.key>协议传送点</>的地图标记。
guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_2_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>TP Point</> map marker is already selected.

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_2_ct.cn: 可推动<action=common_leftstick>操作杆选择<@gd.key>协议传送点</>，按下<action=common_confirm>查看详情，通过<@gd.key>传送</>快速前往。
guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_2_ct.en: Use the <action=common_leftstick> stick to select the <@gd.key>TP Point</>, press <action=common_confirm> to view its details, and select <@gd.key>Teleport</> to be transported there at once.

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_ct.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至目标地点。
guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_map> to open the map and <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the target location.

guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_mb.cn: 可点击此处打开地图，并找到协议传送点，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至目标地点。
guide_text_hint_camp_teleport_mb.en: Tap here to open the map, find the TP Point, then <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the target location.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport.en: Press <action=common_open_map> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Map screen, then <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_2.cn: 可点击<@gd.key>协议核心</>，快速前往。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_2.en: Click on the <@gd.key>PAC</> to teleport there at once.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_2_ct.cn: 可推动<action=common_leftstick>操作杆选择<@gd.key>协议核心</>，按下<action=common_confirm>查看详情，通过<@gd.key>传送</>快速前往。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_2_ct.en: Use the <action=common_leftstick> stick to select the <@gd.key>Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)</>, press <action=common_confirm> to view its details, and select <@gd.key>Teleport</> to be transported there at once.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域，以前往<@gd.key>桥头工事</>。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3.en: Press <action=common_open_map> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Map screen, <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area, then head to the <@gd.key>Bridge Approach</>.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3_ct.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域，以前往<@gd.key>桥头工事</>。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_map> to open the Map screen, <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area, then head to the <@gd.key>Bridge Approach</>.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3_mb.cn: 可点击此处打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域，以前往<@gd.key>桥头工事</>。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_3_mb.en: Tap here to open the Map screen, <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area, then head to the <@gd.key>Bridge Approach</>.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_ct.cn: 可按下<action=common_open_map>打开地图，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_ct.en: Press <action=common_open_map> to open the map, then <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_mb.cn: 可点击此处打开地图，并找到协议核心，<@gd.key>快速传送</>至集成核心区域。
guide_text_hint_facarea_teleport_mb.en: Tap here to open the map, find the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC), then <@gd.key>quickly teleport</> to the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_hint_mail_lost_item.cn:
注意，您的背包已经没有多余储存格了，有物品无法获取。
请在主界面点击<@gd.key>邮箱</>按钮，在邮箱中查看刚刚遗失的物品。
guide_text_hint_mail_lost_item.en: Alert! The Backpack is out of empty storage slots and some items have been left behind. Go to the main screen and click the <@gd.key>Mail</> button (upper left row) to recover the missed items.

guide_text_hint_opminer.cn: 靠近<@gd.key>便携源石矿机</>并按下<action=common_interact>，可以打开其操作面板。
guide_text_hint_opminer.en: Get close to the <@gd.key>Portable Originium Rig</> and press <action=common_interact> to open its control panel.

guide_text_hint_opminer_mb.cn: 请靠近<@gd.key>便携源石矿机</>并打开其操作面板。
guide_text_hint_opminer_mb.en: Get close to the <@gd.key>Portable Originium Rig</> and open its control panel.

guide_text_hint_power_line.cn:
当电力运输距离<@gd.key>超过80m</>时，将无法完成电力运输。
可以通过<@gd.key>放置更多的中继器</>来完成电力运输。
guide_text_hint_power_line.en: Power transmission cables have a <@gd.key>max length of 80 meters</> and cannot form a connection if this distance is exceeded. Try <@gd.key>placing more Relay Towers</> to complete long-range power transmissions.

guide_text_hit_iron_desc_1.cn:
通过击打装置，可以让其转动起来。
需要持续击打此类装置，并将转速维持在一定区间内。转速过快或过慢都会损失进度。
guide_text_hit_iron_desc_1.en: Hit a Percussive Device to make it rotate. Continue hitting it to keep its rotation rate within a certain range. Operational progress will be lost if the rotation rate gets too high or low.

guide_text_hongs_depot_hint_1.cn: 武陵地区属于和四号谷地不同的全新地区，这里拥有独立的武陵仓库，只能对本地仓库中的物品进行管理。
guide_text_hongs_depot_hint_1.en: Wuling is a region (like Valley IV) and has its own Wuling Depot. When exploring a region, you can only manage its local depot.

guide_text_hub_des_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心</>是集成工业系统的中枢设备，承担了诸多功能，是进行工业建设的核心。
guide_text_hub_des_1.en: The <@gd.key>Protocol Automation-Core</> (PAC) is the heart of the Automated Industry Complex (AIC) and provides all sorts of functions. The AIC factory is built around it.

guide_text_hub_des_2.cn:
在集成核心区域内，可打开背包与仓库，进行仓储管理。
按下<@gd.key>一键存放</>按钮，可以将背包中的物品一键存入仓库。
guide_text_hub_des_2.en: While in the Core AIC Area, open the Backpack and Depot for storage management. Press the <@gd.key>Quick Stash</> button to move every Backpack item into the Depot with a single button.

guide_text_hub_des_3.cn: <@gd.key>协议核心</>是集成工业系统唯一的电力来源，请通过协议核心构建当前地区的电力网络。
guide_text_hub_des_3.en: The <@gd.key>Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)</> is the ultimate source of power of the Core AIC Area. It is the origin of power transmission in the regional power grid.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_1.cn: 武陵地区的协议核心已建立，可以进行<@gd.key>跨地区传输物品</>，请点击此处。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_1.en: The Wuling Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) has been built. <@gd.key>Regional transfer</> can now be used to move goods from one region to another. Start by clicking here.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_1_ct.cn: 武陵地区的协议核心已建立，可以进行<@gd.key>跨地区传输物品</>，请按下<action=fac_hub_open_transfer>查看。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_1_ct.en: The Wuling Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) has been built. <@gd.key>Regional transfer</> can now be used to move goods from one region to another. Start by pressing <action=fac_hub_open_transfer>.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2.cn: 这里可以看到不同地区之间正在进行的跨地区传输。当前我们还没有指定过跨地区传输路线。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2.en: This shows item transfer statuses between different regions. No regional transfer routes have been set up so far.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_1.cn: 四号谷地的<@gd.key>地区建设等级</>足够时，可以进行跨地区传输。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_1.en: Regional transfer becomes available once the <@gd.key>Regional Development Level</> of Valley IV is high enough.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_2.cn: 跨地区传输有两种模式：<@gd.key>库存传输</>和<@gd.key>超库存传输</>，分别在传输起点地区<@gd.key>对应建设等级</>时解锁。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_2.en: There are 2 modes of Regional Transfer: <@gd.key>Stockpile Transfer</> and <@gd.key>Metastorage Transfer</>, respectively unlocked by reaching <@gd.key>specific Regional Development Levels</> in the source region.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_3.cn: <@gd.key>库存传输</>指在传输起点地区的仓库中<@gd.key>扣除物品</>，<@gd.key>等量传输</>到终点地区。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_3.en: <@gd.key>Stockpile Transfer</> <@gd.key>deducts goods</> from the source depot and transfers the <@gd.key>same amount of goods</> to the depot of the destination region.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_4.cn: <@gd.key>超库存传输</>指<@gd.key>不扣除起点地区的仓储物品</>，终点地区可以<@gd.key>直接获得</>对应物品的传输方式，会在传输起点地区升到较高建设等级时解锁。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2_4.en: <@gd.key>Metastorage Transfer</> is the <@gd.key>direct transfer</> of goods to the destination region <@gd.key>without deducting any goods from the source region storage</>. This mode of transfer is unlocked when the source region reaches a higher Regional Development Level.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2d5.cn: 请点击此处的编辑按钮，尝试从<@gd.key>四号谷地</>向外传输。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2d5.en: Click the Edit button here to set up a regional transfer route to move items from <@gd.key>Valley IV</>.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2d5_ct.cn: 请按下<action=domain_trans_main_cell_edit>，尝试从<@gd.key>四号谷地</>向外传输。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_2d5_ct.en: Press <action=domain_trans_main_cell_edit> to set up a regional transfer route to export goods from <@gd.key>Valley IV</>.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_3.cn: 以库存传输为例，点击该地区作为传输终点。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_3.en: Refer to the Stockpile Transfer as an example and select this region as the destination region.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_3_ct.cn: 以库存传输为例，请按下<action=domain_trans_select_confirm_target>选择该地区作为传输终点。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_3_ct.en: Refer to the Stockpile Transfer as an example and press <action=domain_trans_select_confirm_target> to select this region as the destination region.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4.cn: 这里可选择希望从四号谷地仓库送往武陵仓库的物品，我们先选择一个物品。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4.en: Here, we can select the item to be moved from the Valley IV Depot to the Wuling Depot. Let's choose something first.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_1.cn: 这里标出了该物品的<@gd.key>物品价值</>。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_1.en: This marks the <@gd.key>unit value</> of this item.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_2.cn: 这里是每批传输的<@gd.key>传输总值</>，传输的物品数量乘单位物品价值无法超过当前的传输总值。传输总值取决于传输起点地区的<@gd.key>建设等级</>。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_2.en: This shows the <@gd.key>Total Transfer Value</> (TTV) allowed for each batch of regional transfer. The number of items to be moved multiplied by the unit value of the item cannot exceed the TTV. Regional transfer TTV also increases with the <@gd.key>regional development level</> of the source region.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_ct.cn: 这里可选择希望从四号谷地仓库送往武陵仓库的物品，我们先按下<action=common_confirm>选择一个物品。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_4_ct.en: Here, we can select the item to be moved from the Valley IV Depot to the Wuling Depot. Let's press <action=common_confirm> to choose an item.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5.cn: 这里设定传输的数量，请注意，跨地区传输开启后会持续不断从出发地取货送往目的地，这里选择的是<@gd.key>单批数量</>。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5.en: This sets the <@gd.key>amount to be moved in each transfer</>. Once the regional transfer route is activated, it will continuously transfer items to the destination.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5d5.cn: 库存传输模式下，设定传输数量<@gd.key>可以大于</>当前仓库中储存的数量，每次传输都会<@gd.key>尽可能取走</>设定数量的物品，物品会从出发地仓库扣除，直至扣除所有仓储。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5d5.en: In Stockpile Transfer, the amount set per transfer <@gd.key>can exceed</> the current size of the Depot stockpile. The transfer will <@gd.key>attempt to reach the set amount</> and deduct the items (or deplete the entire stockpile) in the source depot.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5d6.cn: 如果在<@gd.key>超库存传输</>模式下，物品不会从任何仓库中被扣除，只有<@gd.key>传输总值</>会限制每批传输数量。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_5d6.en: In <@gd.key>Metastorage Transfer</>, no items will be deducted from any Depot. The amount of transfer is only limited by the <@gd.key>Total Transfer Value</> (TTV).

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_6.cn: 这里是每批传输<@gd.key>所需时间</>，每隔这么久，这批物品就会到达目的地仓库，同时会从出发地仓库<@gd.key>再进行一次取货</>。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_6.en: This shows the <@gd.key>time needed</> for the items to be transferred to the destination depot. Upon arrival, another batch of <@gd.key>items will be taken out</> from the source depot to start the next regional transfer.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_6_1.cn: 若条件满足，可在此处开始传输。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_6_1.en: Once the criteria are met, use this to start the transfer.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_7.cn: 请在此处自由选择希望传输的物品。传输开启后，也可以再次进入编辑<@gd.key>手动修改或中止传输</>。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_7.en: At this section, select the items to transfer. After the transfer begins, the edit function can be used to <@gd.key>manually edit or cancel the transfer</>.

guide_text_hub_domain_transport_hint.cn: 已可以进行<@gd.key>跨地区传输物品</>，请前往协议核心，使用<@gd.key>协议管理</>进行操作。
guide_text_hub_domain_transport_hint.en: <@gd.key>Regional transfer</> is now available. Go to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and use <@gd.key>Protocol Management</> to use the new feature.

guide_text_hub_equip_1_1.cn: 请点击此处，切换至<@gd.key>基础装备制造</>。
guide_text_hub_equip_1_1.en: Click here to switch to the <@gd.key>Basic</> tab of Gear Assembly.

guide_text_hub_equip_1_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=equip_tech_tab_next>，切换至<@gd.key>基础装备制造</>。
guide_text_hub_equip_1_1_ct.en: Press <action=equip_tech_tab_next> to switch to the <@gd.key>Basic</> tab of Gear Assembly.

guide_text_hub_equip_2.cn: 制作当前装备需要两种材料——<@gd.key>谷地调度券</>和<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>。
guide_text_hub_equip_2.en: Assembling this piece of gear requires 2 materials: <@gd.key>Valley Stock Bills</> and <@gd.key>Amethyst Components</>.

guide_text_hub_equip_2_0_ct.cn: 请按下<action=equip_tech_produce_focus_item>，查看制作当前装备需要消耗的材料。
guide_text_hub_equip_2_0_ct.en: Press <action=equip_tech_produce_focus_item> to view the materials required to assemble this piece of gear.

guide_text_hub_equip_3.cn: <@gd.key>谷地调度券</>可通过击败敌人、完成<@gd.key>据点</>等玩法获取。
guide_text_hub_equip_3.en: Earn <@gd.key>Valley Stock Bills</> by defeating enemies or performing various <@gd.key>Regional Development and Outpost</> activities.

guide_text_hub_equip_5.cn: <@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>可在<@gd.key>装备原件机</>中制造。
guide_text_hub_equip_5.en: <@gd.key>Amethyst Components</> are produced by the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>.

guide_text_hub_equip_6.cn: 装备原件机需在工业发展规划中完成对应工业技术研究，并在集成核心区域内完成建造。
guide_text_hub_equip_6.en: Specific AIC technologies of the AIC Factory Plan must be researched to construct and place the Gearing Unit in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_hub_equip_desc_1.cn:
获取<@gd.key>装备制造模板</>后，即可制造对应的装备。
装备制造模板可通过提升<@gd.key>权限等阶</>获取，部分需要通过世界探索发现。
guide_text_hub_equip_desc_1.en: Acquire <@gd.key>gear template</> to assemble the specified gear. Some gear templates can be acquired by gaining <@gd.key>Authority Levels</>. Others can be found by exploring the world.

guide_text_hub_equip_desc_2.cn:
制造装备需要调度券与装备原件。
<@gd.key>谷地调度券</>可通过击败敌人、完成据点等玩法获取。
<@gd.key>装备原件</>可以通过<@gd.key>装备原件机</>制造。
装备原件机需在工业发展规划中完成对应工业技术的研究，并在集成核心区域内完成建造。
guide_text_hub_equip_desc_2.en: Gear assembly requires stock bills and gear components. <@gd.key>Valley Stock Bills</> can be earned by defeating enemies or performing Regional Development and Outpost activities. <@gd.key>Gear components</> can be produced using the AIC Factory facility: <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</>. Unlock this facility by researching specific AIC technologies in the AIC Factory Plan. The Gearing Unit must then be constructed and placed in the Core AIC Area.

guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2.cn: 按下快捷键<action=fac_open_equip_producer>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>装备制造</>界面。
guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2.en: Press the hotkey <action=fac_open_equip_producer> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Gear Assembly</> screen.

guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=fac_main_right_active>并选中此项，进入<@gd.key>装备制造</>界面。
guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2_ct.en: Press <action=fac_main_right_active> and select this to open the <@gd.key>gear assembly</> screen.

guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2_mb.cn: 点击此处进入<@gd.key>装备制造</>界面。
guide_text_hub_equip_hint_2_mb.en: Tap here to open the <@gd.key>Gear Assembly</> screen.

guide_text_hub_equip_hint_3.cn: 可选择此项，制造<@gd.key>矿场防护服</>。
guide_text_hub_equip_hint_3.en: Choose this option to assemble the gear <@gd.key>Miner Overalls</>.

guide_text_hub_link_hint_1.cn: 请从协议核心，将电力运输至<@gd.key>高光的中继器</>。
guide_text_hub_link_hint_1.en: Transmit power from the PAC to the <@gd.key>highlighted Relay Tower</>.

guide_text_hub_link_hint_2.cn: 请从<@gd.key>协议核心</>处，<@gd.key>重新开始电力运输</>，并连接至中继器。
guide_text_hub_link_hint_2.en: Go to the <@gd.key>PAC</>, <@gd.key>restart power transmission</> again, and plug in the transmission cable to the Relay Tower.

guide_text_hub_link_hint_3.cn: 请从<@gd.key>已通电的中继器</>开始电力运输，并前往目标处放置下一个中继器。
guide_text_hub_link_hint_3.en: Start power transmission from the <@gd.key>powered Relay Tower</>, then place the next Relay Tower at the target location.

guide_text_hub_link_hint_4.cn: 请在<@gd.key>虚影位置</>附近，放置中继器，并完成电力运输。
guide_text_hub_link_hint_4.en: Go close to the <@gd.key>hologram</> to place the Relay Tower, then complete power transmission.

guide_text_hub_move_hint_1.cn: 和其他设备相同，协议核心和次级核心在有需要时可以进行<@gd.key>移动</>，方便规划集成工业系统的生产。
guide_text_hub_move_hint_1.en: Just like other AIC facilities, both the PAC and Sub-PAC can be <@gd.key>moved</> to help with placing AIC production lines.

guide_text_hub_move_hint_1_ct.cn:
和其他设备相同，协议核心和次级核心在有需要时可以进行<@gd.key>移动</>，方便规划集成工业系统的生产。
可按下<action=common_controller_side_menu>打开快捷功能，选择<@gd.key>移动</>。
guide_text_hub_move_hint_1_ct.en: Just like other AIC facilities, both the PAC and Sub-PAC can be <@gd.key>moved</> to help with placing AIC production lines. Press <action=common_controller_side_menu> to open Quick Action and select <@gd.key>Move</>.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_1.cn: 请按下快捷键<action=common_interact>，或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处开始进行电力运输。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_1.en: Press the hotkey <action=common_interact> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to start power transmission.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_interact>，开始进行电力运输。

guide_text_hub_power_hint_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处开始进行电力运输。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_1_mb.en: Tap here to start power transmission.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_2.cn: 按下快捷键<action=common_interact>即可完成电力运输。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_2.en: Press the hotkey <action=common_interact> to complete power transmission.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_interact> to complete the power transmission.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_2_mb.cn: 点击此处即可完成电力运输。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_2_mb.en: Tap here to complete the power transmission.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_3.cn: 放置中继器需要在工业模式下进行，请按下<action=common_switch_mode>切换为工业模式。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_3.en: Enter AIC Mode to place Relay Towers. Press <action=common_switch_mode> to switch to AIC Mode.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_3_mb.cn: 放置中继器需要在工业模式下进行，请点击此处切换为工业模式。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_3_mb.en: Enter the AIC Mode to place Relay Towers. Tap here to switch to AIC Mode.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_4.en: Press the hotkey <action=fac_use_quick_item_1> to place the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</>.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_4_ct.cn: 请按住<action=fac_activate_quick_bar>展开快捷栏，选择<@gd.key>中继器</>，并按下<action=fac_quick_bar_controller_build>开始放置。
guide_text_hub_power_hint_4_ct.en: Press and hold <action=fac_activate_quick_bar> to expand the hotbar, select <@gd.key>Relay Tower</>, then press <action=fac_quick_bar_controller_build> to start placing the facility.

guide_text_hub_power_hint_4_mb.en: Tap here to place the <@gd.key>Relay Tower</>.

guide_text_hydrant_desc_1.cn: 连接<@gd.key>控流节点</>后，在控流节点的范围内，可使用其中的清水为<@gd.key>射流无人机</>提供液体。
guide_text_hydrant_desc_1.en: After connecting to a <@gd.key>flow control node</>, a <@gd.key>jet drone</> within range of the flow control node can be refilled with Clean Water from it.

guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 弧光的战技会造成物理伤害。
guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_02_1.en: Arclight's battle skill deals Physical DMG.

guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 目标处于<#ba.conduct>导电</>状态时，弧光的战技获得强化，会消耗<#ba.conduct>导电</>状态并进行追加攻击，同时恢复一定技力。
guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_02_2.en: Arclight's battle skill is enhanced against targets with <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>. It consumes the <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> to perform an additional attack and recovers some SP.

guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 当有敌人进入<#ba.conduct>导电</>状态或<#ba.conduct>导电</>状态被消耗时可以发动弧光的连携技。
guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_03_1.en: Arclight's combo skill can be cast when an enemy suffers <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> or when an enemy's <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> is consumed.

guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_03_2.cn: 弧光的连携技能造成多次伤害，并恢复一定技力。
guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_03_2.en: Arclight's combo skill deals multiple hits of DMG and recovers some SP.

guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 弧光的终结技会对敌人施加<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>，一段时间后再次引爆。如果引爆命中处于<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>状态的敌人，会消耗其<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>并施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>。
guide_text_ikut_chartrain01_04_1.en: Arclight's ultimate applies <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> on the enemy and detonates them after a short delay. If the explosion hits an enemy with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, it consumes the said <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> and applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>.

guide_text_inert_gas_mine_intro.cn: 附近有一处<@gd.key>惰气矿点</>，请前往收集<@gd.key>惰气</>制作<@gd.key>浮空回收器Ⅰ</>。
guide_text_inert_gas_mine_intro.en: There is an <@gd.key>Inergen vent</> nearby. Gather some <@gd.key>Inergen</> from it to craft <@gd.key>Aero-Salvager Ⅰ</>.

guide_text_inert_mine_Bottled_desc_1.cn: 使用<@gd.key>盛装</>便捷工具可对气体进行盛装。只有<@gd.key>耐压容器</>可以盛装气体。
guide_text_inert_mine_Bottled_desc_1.en: The Easy Tools action of <@gd.key>Fill</> can be used to fill gases. However, gases can only be filled in <@gd.key>canisters</>.

guide_text_inert_mine_preview_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>武陵部分地区</>分布着惰气矿点，<@gd.key>继续推进主线任务</>，解锁新的集成工业计划后，可通过工业设备自动化采集。
guide_text_inert_mine_preview_desc_1.en: Inergen vents can be found in <@gd.key>certain areas of Wuling</>. <@gd.key>Keep progressing through the main mission</> and research new AIC Factory technologies to get AIC facilities capable of automating gas extraction.

guide_text_inert_udpipe_use_hint_1.cn: 此处地形高差较大，管道无法运输惰气到悬崖上方，需要使用<@gd.key>暗管</>。可以在附近放置<@gd.key>暗管入口</>，并用管道连接气体收集泵和暗管入口。
guide_text_inert_udpipe_use_hint_1.en: Pipelines cannot reach the top of the cliff due to elevation differences. Try using <@gd.key>conduits</> instead. Place a <@gd.key>conduit inlet</> near the gas vents, then create a pipeline connection from the Gas Extractors to the conduit inlet.

guide_text_interlevel_power.cn: 如果需要开采此处的<@gd.key>矿点</>，可以从枢纽区的<@gd.key>协议核心</>，使用<@gd.key>中继器</>运输电力至此处，并使用矿机。
guide_text_interlevel_power.en: To mine this <@gd.key>mining spot</>, go to the <@gd.key>Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)</> at The Hub area, then transmit power to this place via <@gd.key>Relay Towers</> and Electric Pylons, and place an Electric Mining Rig on the mining spot.

guide_text_iron_ore_desc_1.cn:
<#item.ironOre>蓝铁矿</>可作为原料，参与制造四号谷地与武陵地区的多种产物。
采集<#item.ironOre>蓝铁矿</>需要使用<@gd.key>二型电驱矿机</>，在先行解锁后可直接使用。
若未先行解锁，则需要研究<@gd.key>基础工业计划三期</>的<@gd.key>高级矿物采掘</>工业技术。
guide_text_iron_ore_desc_1.en: <#item.ironOre>Ferrium Ore</> is a raw material for making various types of products in Valley IV and Wuling. Extracting <#item.ironOre>Ferrium Ore</> requires the use of <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs Mk II</>. Use the Early Unlock feature to construct and place these mining rigs directly. If you choose not to use the Early Unlock feature, you must then research the <@gd.key>Basic AIC Plan III</> technology <@gd.key>Mining III</> to construct and use these rigs.

guide_text_jump_machine_desc_1.cn:
可使用<@gd.key>弹射装置</>进行一次长距离的跳跃，抵达普通跳跃无法到达的高处。
弹射装置处于激活状态时，站立在其上并按下<@gd.key>跳跃键</>即可使用。
guide_text_jump_machine_desc_1.en: Use <@gd.key>Bounce Devices</> to make a long-distance jump or reach high places unreachable with normal jumping. Simply stand on a functioning Bounce Device and press the <@gd.key>jump button</> to use it.

guide_text_jump_machine_desc_2.cn:
某些弹射装置，需要激活对应的<#adv.eswitch>受击装置</>后能够使用；
还有一些弹射装置，需要传输电力至对应的<#adv.powerTerminal>供电终端</>后，才能够使用。
guide_text_jump_machine_desc_2.en: Some Bounce Devices must be first activated by striking the linked <#adv.eswitch>Reactive Device</> to become usable. Some Bounce Devices can only be activated after powering the <#adv.powerTerminal>Electric Nexus</> linked to it.

guide_text_jumpmachine_vertical_desc_1.cn: 站上去会自动触发喷气，可以抵达普通跳跃无法到达的高处。
guide_text_jumpmachine_vertical_desc_1.en: Stand on this device to automatically unleash a powerful jet that propels one to high places unreachable with normal jumping.

guide_text_kickable_ball.en: Globular Originium Slug: Back to Home

guide_text_kickable_ball_desc.cn:
踢动球形源石虫，使源石虫向着当前面向移动。
将球形源石虫踢回虫道即可完成挑战。若源石虫偏离虫道太远，则会自动回到起点。
guide_text_kickable_ball_desc.en: Globular Originium Slugs can be kicked to make them roll forward. Kick them back to the right slug tunnels to complete the challenge. If the slugs go way off course, they will be automatically returned to the starting point.

guide_text_kickable_ball_title.en: Globular Originium Slug: Back to Home

guide_text_kite_station_1.cn: 在环境监测终端中，可以通过接取并完成<@gd.key>监测委托</>，获得调度券等报酬。
guide_text_kite_station_1.en: Use the Environment Monitoring Terminal to accept and complete <@gd.key>monitoring jobs</> to earn stock bills and other rewards.

guide_text_kite_station_2.cn: 每一个<@gd.key>监测委托</>，都需要拍摄特定的图像进行记录。
guide_text_kite_station_2.en: Every <@gd.key>monitoring job</> requires photographing a special target.

guide_text_kite_station_2_1.cn: 请按下<action=mainhud_open_domain>或者按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，进入<@gd.key>地区建设</>。
guide_text_kite_station_2_1.en: Press <action=mainhud_open_domain> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Regional Development</> screen.

guide_text_kite_station_2_2.cn: 请点击此处，打开环境监测终端。
guide_text_kite_station_2_2.en: Click here to open the Environment Monitoring Terminal.

guide_text_kite_station_2_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，打开环境监测终端。
guide_text_kite_station_2_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to open the Environment Monitoring Terminal.

guide_text_kite_station_2_3.cn: 完成监测委托后，还可以获得<@gd.key>生态总录</>中的奖励，点击查看生态总录。
guide_text_kite_station_2_3.en: Completing the monitoring job also provides <@gd.key>Ecology Overview</> rewards. Click to view the Ecology Overview.

guide_text_kite_station_2_3_ct.cn: 完成监测委托后，还可以获得<@gd.key>生态总录</>中的奖励，请按下<action=kiteStation_process>查看生态总录。
guide_text_kite_station_2_3_ct.en: Completing the monitoring job also provides <@gd.key>Ecology Overview</> rewards. Press <action=kiteStation_process> to view the Ecology Overview.

guide_text_kite_station_2_4.cn: 生态总录中，可以根据累计完成的<@gd.key>不重复委托</>数量获取奖励，包含新的<@gd.key>拍照滤镜与拍照贴纸</>。
guide_text_kite_station_2_4.en: The Ecology Overview offers rewards based on the number of <@gd.key>non-repeated monitoring jobs</> completed. Rewards include <@gd.key>filters and stickers for the Camera feature</>.

guide_text_kite_station_3.cn: 例如该项委托，需要对<@gd.key>侵蚀潮中损坏的信标</>进行拍照。
guide_text_kite_station_3.en: Take this job for example. It requires the use of a camera to photograph a <@gd.key>beacon damaged in the Blight Tide</>.

guide_text_kite_station_4.cn: 点击此处，接取该<@gd.key>监测委托</>。
guide_text_kite_station_4.en: Click here to accept this <@gd.key>monitoring job</>.

guide_text_kite_station_5.cn: 点击<@gd.key>前往任务</>，可以在任务列表中看到已接取的环境监测委托。
guide_text_kite_station_5.en: Click <@gd.key>Go to Mission</>. The mission list now shows the environment monitoring job accepted.

guide_text_kite_station_5_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>，<@gd.key>前往任务</>，可以在任务列表中看到已接取的环境监测委托。
guide_text_kite_station_5_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to <@gd.key>go to the Mission screen</>. The mission list now shows the environment monitoring job accepted.

guide_text_kite_station_desc_1.cn:
在环境监测终端中，可以通过接取并完成<@gd.key>监测委托</>，获得报酬。
每个<@gd.key>监测委托</>都需要拍摄特定的图像进行记录。
guide_text_kite_station_desc_1.en: Environment Monitoring Terminals provide <@gd.key>monitoring jobs</>. Complete them to earn rewards. Every <@gd.key>monitoring job</> involves the photographing of special targets.

guide_text_kite_station_desc_2.cn:
武陵地区的环境监测终端，需要解锁后才能使用。
环境监测终端可以通过花费调度券进行升级。
guide_text_kite_station_desc_2.en: Environment Monitoring Terminals in Wuling must be unlocked before they can be used. The terminals can be upgraded by spending stock bills.

guide_text_kite_station_point_desc_1.cn:
看到光点时，进行交互可进入<@gd.key>拍照模式</>。
进入拍照模式后，当相机中出现<@gd.key>拍摄目标</>时拍下照片，即可完成委托。
guide_text_kite_station_point_desc_1.en: When a glowing light is found, interact with it to enter <@gd.key>Camera Mode</>, then take a photo when the <@gd.key>photography target</> enters the view of the camera to complete the monitoring job.

guide_text_kite_station_title_2.cn: 环境监测终端的解锁与升级
guide_text_kite_station_title_2.en: Environment Monitoring Terminal: Unlock and Upgrade

guide_text_laevat_buff_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>终结技</>能量获得了些许恢复。

guide_text_laevat_buff_desc_2.cn: 此处散落的红色能量能恢复莱万汀的状态，并灼烧周围敌人。
guide_text_laevat_buff_desc_2.en: The red energy scattered here can restore Laevatain's status and burn nearby enemies.

guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 莱万汀的战技会对敌人持续造成伤害，并获得1层<@ba.key>熔火</>。<@ba.key>熔火</>最多叠加4层。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_02_1.en: Laevatain's battle skill deals DMG over time to enemies and grants her 1 stack of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>. She can reach up to 4 stacks of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 如果莱万汀施放战技时已拥有4层<@ba.key>熔火</>，则最后会消耗所有层数，对大范围内敌人追加1次攻击并施加<#ba.burning>燃烧</>。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_02_2.en: If Laevatain already has 4 <@ba.key>Melting Flame</> stacks when casting her battle skill, then consume all the stacks, perform 1 additional attack, and apply <#ba.burning>Combustion</> to enemies within a large area of effect.
