guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>命中时，莱万汀会吸收周围敌人的<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>，每吸收一层<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>，自身获得1层<@ba.key>熔火</>。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_03_1.en: When the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> that hits an enemy, Laevatain absorbs <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> from nearby enemies. Every stack of <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> absorbed is converted to 1 stack of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</> for Laevatain.

guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 当有敌人进入<#ba.burning>燃烧</>或<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态时可以发动莱万汀的连携技。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_04_1.en: Laevatain's combo skill is triggered when an enemy suffers <#ba.burning>Combustion</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_04_2.cn: 莱万汀的连携技会对所有处于<#ba.burning>燃烧</>或<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态的敌人造成<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>，并获得1层<@ba.key>熔火</>。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_04_2.en: Laevatain's combo skill deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> to all enemies with <#ba.burning>Combustion</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, and grants 1 stack of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_05_1.cn: 莱万汀的终结技会在一段时间内强化普通攻击和战技。普通攻击的第3段会施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>。
guide_text_laevat_chartrain01_05_1.en: Laevatain's ultimate temporarily enhances her basic attacks (BATK) and battle skill. Laevatain's BATK sequence 3 also applies <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 莱万汀是一名拥有强大群体输出能力的突击干员。她可以通过重击吸收附近敌人的<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>，触发强力战技和连携技，并使用终结技横扫大量敌人。
guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_1.en: Laevatain is a striker with outstanding mass DMG skills. Her Final Strikes can absorb <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Inflictions</> from nearby enemies to trigger powerful battle skills and combo skills. She can also use her ultimate to carve and burn her way through mobs of enemies.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_2.cn: 莱万汀在场时，主控角色的<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>会吸收目标附近的<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>，每吸收一层获得一层<@ba.key>熔火</>。当莱万汀拥有满层<@ba.key>熔火</>时，战技会获得强化，让大范围内敌人进入<#ba.burning>燃烧</>。能施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>的干员可以和莱万汀形成配合。
guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_2.en: When Laevatain is in battle, <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strikes</> performed by the controlled operator will absorb <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> stacks near the target and grant Laevatain 1 stack of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</> per stack absorbed. At maximum stacks of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>, Laevatain's battle skill is enhanced and applies <#ba.burning>Combustion</> to enemies in a large area. Team up Laevatain with operators who can apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</> to maximize her effectiveness.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_3.cn: 当有敌人进入<#ba.burning>燃烧</>或<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>状态时，可以发动莱万汀的连携技：对所有<#ba.burning>燃烧</>或<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>的敌人造成大量伤害。
guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_3.en: Laevatain's combo skill is triggered when an enemy suffers <#ba.burning>Combustion</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>. Her combo skill deals massive DMG to all enemies with <#ba.burning>Combustion</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_4.cn: 莱万汀召唤烈焰魔剑，普通攻击获得强化，可以对大范围内敌人造成伤害。普通攻击第3段还会造成<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>。
guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_4.en: Laevatain summons the greatsword, Sviga Lævi, and her basic attacks become enhanced and deal DMG to enemies in a large area. Basic attack sequence 3 also applies <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_5.cn: 能施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>的干员可以和莱万汀形成配合。施加<#ba.fireinflict>灼热附着</>后，用主控干员的<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>吸收，让莱万汀获得<@ba.key>熔火</>。莱万汀获得满层<@ba.key>熔火</>后，施放强化战技造成<#ba.burning>燃烧</>，就可以直接发动连携技。
guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_01_5.en: Team up Laevatain with operators who can apply <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>. After applying <#ba.fireinflict>Heat Infliction</>, use the controlled operator's <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strikes</> to absorb it and grant Laevatain stacks of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>. Once Laevatain is at maximum stacks of <@ba.key>Melting Flame</>, cast her enhanced battle skill to apply <#ba.burning>Combustion</>, which then directly triggers her combo skill.

guide_text_laevat_chartrial01_title2.en: Laevatain: Battle Skill and Melting Flame

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 主控干员为别礼时，施放别礼的战技不会中断普通攻击。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_02_1.en: When Last Rite is the controlled operator, casting her battle skill does not reset her basic attack sequence.

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 进行<@ba.key>低温灌注</>后，主控干员接下来的1次<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>会对目标进行追击，造成伤害并施加<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_02_2.en: After performing <@ba.key>Hypothermic Perfusion</>, the next <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> performed by the controlled operator also unleashes an additional attack on the target, dealing DMG and applying <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</>.

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 别礼战技的追击可以对敌人施加<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_03_1.en: Last Rite's battle skill includes an additional attack that can apply <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> to enemies.

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 当有敌人进入3层及以上<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>状态时，可以发动别礼的连携技。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_04_1.en: Last Rite's combo skill is triggered when an enemy reaches 3 or more stacks of <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</>.

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_04_2.cn: 别礼的连携技<#ba.consume>消耗</>敌人身上的所有<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>，对其造成基于其<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>层数的<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_04_2.en: Last Rite's combo skill <#ba.consume>consumes</> all the enemy's <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> stacks, and deals <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</> based on the number of <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> stacks consumed.

guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_05_1.cn: 别礼的终结技会造成大量寒冷伤害。
guide_text_lastrite_chartrain01_05_1.en: Last Rite's ultimate deals massive Cryo DMG.

guide_text_leader_butterfly_desc_1.cn: 蝴蝶会将人们<@gd.key>引向附近的储藏箱</>。即使追不上也没关系，它们有时也会等待步速慢的旅人。
guide_text_leader_butterfly_desc_1.en: Butterflies can <@gd.key>lead travelers to nearby storage crates</>. Don't worry about them flying too fast. Some of them will slow down and wait for ponderous travelers.

guide_text_leader_butterfly_desc_2.cn: 贪玩的蝴蝶们有时会在<@gd.key>半路散开</>，等找回<@gd.key>所有蝴蝶</>后，它们就会继续引路。
guide_text_leader_butterfly_desc_2.en: The playful butterflies will sometimes <@gd.key>scatter halfway through</> their flight. Regroup <@gd.key>all the scattered butterflies</> and they will continue to lead the way again.

guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 黎风的战技可以对敌人造成<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>，并对之前不处于<#ba.noguard>破防</>状态的敌人施加<#ba.physicalvul>物理脆弱</>。
guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_02_1.en: Lifeng's battle skill applies <#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</> on the enemy. If the enemy is not <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, the skill also applies <#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</> to the enemy.

guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_02_2.cn:
<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>：对敌人造成<#ba.noguard>破防</>，如果敌人已经<#ba.noguard>破防</>，则会叠加1层<#ba.noguard>破防</>层数并累积<@ba.poise>失衡值</>。
<#ba.physicalvul>物理脆弱</>：使目标受到的物理伤害提高。
guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_02_2.en:
<#ba.knockdown>Knock Down</>: Applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> on an enemy. If the enemy is already <#ba.noguard>Vulnerable</>, then add 1 <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> stack and deal <@ba.poise>Stagger</>.
<#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</>: A target with this debuff takes more Physical DMG.

guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 处于<#ba.physicalvul>物理脆弱</>状态或<#ba.fracture>碎甲</>的敌人受到主控干员的<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时可以发动黎风的连携技。
guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_03_1.en: Lifeng's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> on an enemy with <#ba.physicalvul>Physical Susceptibility</> or <#ba.fracture>Breach</>.

guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_03_2.cn: 黎风的连携技会造成物理伤害，并获得<#ba.combo>连击</>，使全队下一次战技或终结技的伤害提高。
guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_03_2.en: Lifeng's combo skill deals Physical DMG and grants a <#ba.combo>Link</> buff to the entire team that increases the DMG dealt by the next battle skill or ultimate cast.

guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 黎风的终结技能对敌人造成2次<#ba.knockdown>倒地</>，如果消耗了<#ba.combo>连击</>，则会再追加1次伤害。
guide_text_lifeng_chartrain01_04_1.en: Lifeng's ultimate applies 2 <#ba.knockdown>Knock Downs</> to enemies. If the ultimate consumes the <#ba.combo>Link</> buff, it deals 1 additional hit of DMG.

guide_text_lifter_for_boxgame_desc_1.cn: 可以运输悬浮箱子的电梯。
guide_text_lifter_for_boxgame_desc_1.en: An elevator that can transport floating crates.

guide_text_liino_chartrain01_02_1.cn:
梨诺的战技仅消耗<@ba.vup>25</>技力。使用战技后，梨诺可以对敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，随后进入长时间<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>，期间如附近有敌方目标，则每隔一段时间追加攻击，对目标造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
 <@ba.key>演唱姿态</>：持续期间提升友方干员攻击力，并在进战后持续<@ba.heal>治疗</>范围内友方干员。
guide_text_liino_chartrain01_02_1.en:
Liino's battle skill only costs <@ba.vup>25</> SP. After casting her battle skill, Liino deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies and enters a <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> that lasts for a while. While the stance is active, Liino performs additional attacks on nearby enemies on a regular basis that deal <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to the target. 
<@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>: While active, the stance grants allied operators an ATK Boost and, after entering battle, continuously provides <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> to allied operators within the area of effect.

guide_text_liino_chartrain01_03_1.cn:
<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>期间，当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>时可以发动梨诺的连携技，造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，治疗主控干员，并额外获得终结技能量。
 连携技施放期间不打断<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>，攻击结束后根据<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>剩余时间返场，继续演唱。
guide_text_liino_chartrain01_03_1.en:
Liino's combo skill is triggered when she is in her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> and an <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reaction</> is applied on an enemy. Her combo skill deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>, grants HP Treatment to the controlled operator, and gives additional Ultimate Energy.
Casting the combo skill does not interrupt <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>. When the attack ends, Liino returns to the battle and continues her performance based on the remaining duration of her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>.

guide_text_liino_chartrain01_04_1.cn: <@ba.key>演唱姿态</>期间，当有敌人的<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>被<#ba.consume>消耗</>时也可以发动梨诺的连携技。
guide_text_liino_chartrain01_04_1.en: Liino's combo skill is also triggered when she is in her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> and an enemy's <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reaction</> is <#ba.consume>consumed</>.

guide_text_liino_chartrain01_05_1.cn:
梨诺的终结技可以治疗全体友方干员，造成大范围<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，并对敌人强制施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>，随后进入<@ba.key>高歌姿态</>，<@ba.key>高歌姿态</>取代<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>，持续期间提升友方干员攻击力，并施加受意志提升的<#ba.pulseenhance>电磁增幅</>和<#ba.naturalenhance>自然增幅</>，对范围内的敌人持续造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，并持续<@ba.heal>治疗</>范围内的友方干员。
 <@ba.key>高歌姿态</>结束时，<@ba.heal>治疗</>全体友方干员，并对范围内敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
guide_text_liino_chartrain01_05_1.en:
Liino's ultimate provides HP Treatment to all allied operators, deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to a large area of effect (AOE), forcibly applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> to enemies, and activates her <@ba.key>Cosmovoice Stance</> (replacing her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>). While active, the stance grants allied operators <#ba.pulseenhance>Electric Amp</> and <#ba.naturalenhance>Nature Amp</> (effects influenced by the attribute of Will) as well as an ATK Boost. It also continuously deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies in the AOE, and continuously provides <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> to allied operators in the AOE. 
When <@ba.key>Cosmovoice Stance</> ends, Liino provides <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> to all allied operators and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies in the AOE.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01.cn: 请尝试使用梨诺的战技，获得长时间持续治疗和全队攻击力提升效果
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01.en: Use Liino's battle skill to grant continuous HP Treatment and ATK buffs for the entire team over a long period of time.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 梨诺是一名<@ba.pulse>电磁</>属性的辅助干员，她可以通过低技力消耗的战技为友方干员提供持续的输出增益和治疗。开启终结技后还能大幅强化增益和治疗效果，为依赖法术输出的干员提供强大的助力。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_1.en: Liino is an <@ba.pulse>Electric</> supporter. Her battle skill costs less SP to cast and grants allied operators continuous DMG buffs and HP Treatment. Her ultimate greatly improves the buffs and HP Treatment as well, making her an effective supporter for operators who deal Arts DMG.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_2.cn:
梨诺的战技仅消耗<@ba.vup>25</>技力。使用战技后，梨诺进入长时间<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>。
 <@ba.key>演唱姿态</>：每隔一段时间对附近敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，持续期间提升友方干员攻击力，并在进入战斗后持续<@ba.heal>治疗</>范围内友方干员。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_2.en:
Liino's battle skill only costs <@ba.vup>25</> SP. After casting her battle skill, Liino enters a <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> that lasts for a while. 
<@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>: While active, Liino deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to nearby enemies on a regular basis, grants allied operators an ATK Boost, and, after entering battle, continuously provides <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> to allied operators in the area of effect.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_3.cn:
<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>期间，当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>或<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>被<#ba.consume>消耗</>时可以发动梨诺的连携技，造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，治疗主控干员，并额外获得终结技能量。
连携技施放期间不打断<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>，攻击结束后继续<@ba.key>演唱姿态</>。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_3.en:
Liino's combo skill is triggered when she is in her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> and an <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reaction</> is <#ba.consume>consumed</> or applied on an enemy. Her combo skill deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>, grants HP Treatment to the controlled operator, and gives additional Ultimate Energy.
Casting the combo skill does not interrupt <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</>, and Liino remains in her <@ba.key>Vocalist Stance</> after the attack ends.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_4.cn:
梨诺的终结技可以治疗全体友方干员，造成大范围<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，并对敌人强制施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>，随后进入<@ba.key>高歌姿态</>。
<@ba.key>高歌姿态</>：持续期间提升友方干员攻击力，并施加<#ba.pulseenhance>电磁增幅</>和<#ba.naturalenhance>自然增幅</>，并持续对范围内的敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，<@ba.heal>治疗</>友方干员。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_4.en:
Liino's ultimate gives HP Treatment to all allied operators, deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>, forcibly applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> to enemies in a large area of effect (AOE), and activates her <@ba.key>Cosmovoice Stance</>. 
<@ba.key>Cosmovoice Stance</>: While active, the stance grants allied operators an ATK Boost, <#ba.pulseenhance>Electric Amp</>, and <#ba.naturalenhance>Nature Amp</>, and deals continuous <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to enemies and grants continuous <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> to allied operators in the AOE.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_5.cn: 梨诺施放战技为队友施加长时间的增益，配合能施加或消耗<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>的干员高频打出连携技。在合适的时机施放梨诺的终结技，获得高额的治疗和伤害增幅，配合友方干员造成巨量伤害。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_01_5.en: Liino's battle skill grants a rather long buff to her teammates. Cooperate with operators who can apply or consume <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reactions</> to trigger Liino's combo skill, and cast her ultimate at the right timing to provide massive HP Treatment as well as DMG Amp that lets allied operators deal massive DMG.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_02.cn: 按下<action=battle_switch_char_next>，切换至庄方宜作为主控干员。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_02.en: Press <action=battle_switch_char_next> to switch to Zhuang Fangyi as the controlled operator.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_02_mb.cn: 请点击此处，切换至庄方宜作为主控干员。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_02_mb.en: Tap here to switch to Zhuang Fangyi as the controlled operator.

guide_text_liino_chartrial01_03.cn: 使用梨诺的终结技，获得高额的增幅和治疗效果。可以配合庄方宜终结技，打出更高的输出。
guide_text_liino_chartrial01_03.en: Use Liino's ultimate to grant powerful buffs and HP Treatment. Use Zhuang Fangyi's ultimate to deal even more DMG.

guide_text_liino_mission_1.cn: 请按下<action=battle_switch_char_next>，切换至管理员作为主控干员。
guide_text_liino_mission_1.en: Press <action=battle_switch_char_next> to switch to the Endministrator as the controlled operator.

guide_text_liino_mission_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处，切换至管理员作为主控干员。
guide_text_liino_mission_1_mb.en: Tap here to switch to the Endministrator as the controlled operator.

guide_text_liino_mission_2.cn: 请尝试使用梨诺的<@gd.key>战技</>，通过消耗较少技力，获得长时间持续的<@ba.heal>治疗</>和<@gd.key>全队攻击力提升</>效果。
guide_text_liino_mission_2.en: Use Liino's <@gd.key>battle skill</> for a low SP cost to grant continuous <@ba.heal>HP Treatment</> and <@gd.key>ATK buffs for the entire team</> over a long period of time.

guide_text_liino_mission_3.cn: 请尝试使用管理员的<@gd.key>战技</>，消耗敌人的<@ba.phy>破防</>层数，造成大量伤害。
guide_text_liino_mission_3.en: Use the Endministrator's <@gd.key>battle skill</> to consume the enemy's <@ba.phy>Vulnerability</> stacks and deal massive DMG.

guide_text_liino_mission_desc.cn:
在管理员的激励下，梨诺赌上了身为偶像的一切全力应战。
因此在后续的剧情战斗中，梨诺战技与终结技的歌声会额外使敌人累积<@ba.phy>破防</>层数。
而当管理员发动<@ba.phy>猛击</>时，也会触发她的连携技。
guide_text_liino_mission_desc.en: With the Endministrator's encouragement, Liino decides to fight with everything she's got as a starlet idol. In this mission battle, the beats of Liino's songs in her battle skill and ultimate will also apply <@ba.phy>Vulnerability</> stacks on enemies. Liino's combo skill is also triggered when the Endministrator applies <@ba.phy>Crush</>.

guide_text_limit_marker_e1m4_desc_1.cn: 在探索进行到一定阶段后，会出现他人留下的<@gd.key>留言信标</>。
guide_text_limit_marker_e1m4_desc_1.en: After reaching certain phases of exploration, <@gd.key>Memo Beacons</> left by other explorers may start to appear.

guide_text_limit_marker_e1m4_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>留言信标</>会留下一些图标和文字内容，记录了他人在这里想传达的信息。
guide_text_limit_marker_e1m4_desc_2.en: <@gd.key>Memo Beacons</> may include icons and messages that other explorers wish to convey about the location.

guide_text_limit_usb_loader_unloader_int.cn: 仓库取货口与仓库存货口

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业二期</>，请按下<action=fac_open_tech_tree>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC II</> can now be unlocked. Press <action=fac_open_tech_tree> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1_ct.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业二期</>，请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>，打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>，并进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC II</> can now be unlocked. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</> to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1_mb.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业二期</>，请点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_1_mb.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC II</> can now be unlocked. Tap here to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_2.cn: 当前已获得<@gd.key>武陵拓展核心</>，可在此处，解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业二期</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_2.en: <@gd.key>Wuling Expansion Core</> acquired. Use it to unlock <@gd.key>Wuling AIC II</> here.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_3.cn: 研究<@gd.key>水辅矿物采掘</>工业技术后，可制造<@gd.key>水驱矿机</>，能够进行<@gd.key>赤铜矿</>等更稀有矿藏的开采。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_3.en: Research the AIC factory technology <@gd.key>Hydro Mining</> to construct <@gd.key>Hydro Mining Rigs</> that can be used to mine rare minerals such as <@gd.key>Cuprium Ore</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_4.cn: 研究<@gd.key>暗管</>工业技术后，可制造<@gd.key>暗管入口</>和<@gd.key>暗管出口</>，能够更方便的进行远距离的液体和气体输送。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_4.en: Research the AIC factory technology <@gd.key>Conduits</> to construct <@gd.key>Conduit Inlets</> and <@gd.key>Conduit Outlets</> to facilitate long-distance transportation of fluids and gases.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_1.cn: 水驱矿机在通入<@gd.key>清水</>后无需通电即可工作，能够进行<@gd.key>赤铜矿</>等更稀有矿藏的开采。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_1.en: The Hydro Mining Rig can start working when supplied with <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and does not require power. It can extract rarer minerals such as <@gd.key>Cuprium Ore</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_2.cn: 使用暗管，可将液体或气体自动从<@gd.key>暗管入口</>输送到对应的<@gd.key>暗管出口</>，能够更方便的进行远距离的液体和气体输送。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_2.en: Underground pipes such as conduits can transport fluids or gases from a <@gd.key>Conduit Inlet</> to a corresponding <@gd.key>Conduit Outlet</> to facilitate long-distance transportation of fluids and gases.

guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_3.cn: 通过研究<@gd.key>武陵工业二期</>中的工业技术，可生产<@gd.key>赤铜装备原件</>，从而制造最新迭代投放的装备。
guide_text_liquidTechTree2_desc_3.en: Research <@gd.key>Wuling AIC II</> factory technology to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium Components</> and assemble gear using the latest released gear templates.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业三期</>，请按下<action=fac_open_tech_tree>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC III</> can now be unlocked. Press <action=fac_open_tech_tree> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1_ct.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业三期</>，请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>，打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>，并进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC III</> can now be unlocked. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</> and enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1_mb.cn: 当前可解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业三期</>，请点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_1_mb.en: <@gd.key>Wuling AIC III</> can now be unlocked. Tap here to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_2.cn: 当前已获得<@gd.key>武陵拓展核心</>，可在此处，解锁<@gd.key>武陵工业三期</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_2.en: <@gd.key>Wuling Expansion Core</> acquired. Use it to unlock <@gd.key>Wuling AIC III</> here.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_3.cn: 研究<@gd.key>耐酸技术</>工业技术后，可制造<@gd.key>二型耐酸水泵</>，能够进行<@gd.key>沉积酸</>的自动化采集。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_3.en: Research the AIC Factory technology <@gd.key>Acid Resistance</> to construct <@gd.key>Acid Resistant Pumps MK II</> that can automate the extraction of <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_4.cn: 研究<@gd.key>提纯技术</>工业技术后，可制造<@gd.key>提纯机</>，能够提纯溶液至更高纯度，从而生产赫铜溶液等材料。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_4.en: Research the AIC Factory technology <@gd.key>Purification</> to construct <@gd.key>Purification Units</> that can purify solutions and provide fluid products like Hetonite Solution.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_1.cn: 二型耐酸水泵在通电后，可在液体源附近进行液体抽取。可以用于抽取<@gd.key>沉积酸</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_1.en: Once powered, Acid Resistant Pumps Mk II can extract fluids from a nearby source. It can be used to extract <@gd.key>Precipitation Acid</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_2.cn: 提纯机能够提纯溶液至更高纯度，比如将<@gd.key>赤铜溶液</>提纯为<@gd.key>赫铜溶液</>。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_2.en: Purification Units can purify solutions. For example, it can purify <@gd.key>Cuprium Solution</> into <@gd.key>Hetonite Solution</>.

guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_3.cn:
通过研究<@gd.key>武陵工业三期</>中的工业技术，可生产<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>。
<@gd.key>赫铜零件</>可用于据点供货、设备制造、制造更高级的装备原件等。
guide_text_liquidTechTree3_desc_3.en: Research <@gd.key>Wuling AIC III</> factory technologies to produce <@gd.key>Hetonite Parts</>, which can be used in outpost trading, facility construction, and assembly of advanced pieces of gear.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_1.cn: 可在<@gd.key>净水节点</>的<@gd.key>产物排出口</>中，查看产出的<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>byproduct outlet</> of the <@gd.key>Purification Node</> to view the production of <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_2.cn: <@gd.key>污水</>的处理总速率越高，对应产出<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>的速率越高。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_2.en: Increasing overall <@gd.key>Sewage</> treatment rate also speeds up the production of <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_3.cn: 即使<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>排出口的产物达到上限，也不影响<@gd.key>净水节点</>本身的污水处理。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_3.en: Even if the <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> product outlet is completely full, Sewage treatment by the <@gd.key>Purification Node</> will not be affected.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>净水节点</>可对污水进行处理。
通过管道将污水运输至<@gd.key>净水节点</>的污水接入口，即可对污水进行快速无害化处理。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Purification Node</> can treat Sewage. Use pipelines to deliver Sewage into the sewage inlet of the <@gd.key>Purification Node</> to quickly treat the Sewage into harmless discharge.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_2.cn:
可使用<@gd.key>武陵调度券</>对<@gd.key>净水节点</>进行升级。
<@gd.key>净水节点</>在升至更高等级后，还可对污水进行再利用。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_2.en: <@gd.key>Purification Nodes</> can be upgraded by spending <@gd.key>Wuling Stock Bills</>. An upgraded <@gd.key>Purification Node</> can treat and recycle Sewage for further use.

guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_3.cn:
<@gd.key>净水节点</>在升级后,还可根据当前污水处理的速率，产出<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>。
可使用管道连接产物排出口来运出产物。产物达到上限不会影响<@gd.key>净水节点</>本身的污水处理。
guide_text_liquid_clean_node_desc_3.en: An upgraded <@gd.key>Purification Node</> also produces <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</> based on the current Sewage treatment rate. Connect the byproduct outlet with pipelines to transport Xircon Effluent to other facilities. Even if the Xircon Effluent product outlet is completely full, Sewage treatment by the <@gd.key>Purification Node</> will not be affected.

guide_text_liquid_cleaner_desc_1.cn: 废水处理机可以以<@gd.key>较慢的速度</>对产生的<@gd.key>污水、壤晶废液与惰性壤晶废液</>进行分解处理，不对环境造成污染。
guide_text_liquid_cleaner_desc_1.en: The Water Treatment Unit can <@gd.key>slowly</> remediate and purify <@gd.key>Sewage, Xircon Effluent, and Inert Xircon Effluent</> to make the AIC Factory pollution-free.

guide_text_liquid_cleaner_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>废水处理机</>可以以较慢的速度对产生的<@gd.key>污水、壤晶废液与惰性壤晶废液</>进行分解处理，不对环境造成污染。
guide_text_liquid_cleaner_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> can slowly remediate and purify <@gd.key>Sewage, Xircon Effluent, and Inert Xircon Effluent</> to make the AIC Factory pollution-free.

guide_text_liquid_cleaner_intro_desc_2.cn: 如果不处理<@gd.key>污水、壤晶废液与惰性壤晶废液</>，可能会导致设备的阻塞。
guide_text_liquid_cleaner_intro_desc_2.en: <@gd.key>Sewage, Xircon Effluent, and Inert Xircon Effluent</> must be treated or these fluids will clog the facility.

guide_text_liquid_connector_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>管道桥</>可以使得两条相交的管道各自独立得运输液体而互不影响。
guide_text_liquid_connector_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Bridge</> allows a pipeline to go over another without disrupting the flow of fluids in both pipelines.

guide_text_liquid_connector_intro_desc_2.cn: 在<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面中选择<@gd.key>管道桥</>，直接进行放置或拖入快捷栏使用。
guide_text_liquid_connector_intro_desc_2.en: Use the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel to select and place the <@gd.key>Pipe Bridge</> directly, or drag it into the hotbar and place it with hotkeys.

guide_text_liquid_converger_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>管道汇流器</>可以使得多条管道上的液体汇流到单一管道上，最多支持三条管道汇流。
guide_text_liquid_converger_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Converger</> can converge up to 3 pipelines into a single pipeline.

guide_text_liquid_converger_intro_desc_2.cn: 在<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面中选择<@gd.key>管道汇流器</>，直接进行放置或拖入快捷栏使用。
guide_text_liquid_converger_intro_desc_2.en: Use the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel to select and place the <@gd.key>Pipe Converger</> directly, or drag it into the hotbar and place it with hotkeys.

guide_text_liquid_filling_pd_mc_intro_de.cn:
<@gd.key>灌装机</>解锁液体模式后，可进行与液体相关的不同配方生产。
典型产物为<@gd.key>装有芽针溶液的蓝铁瓶</>，由<@gd.key>芽针溶液</>和<@gd.key>蓝铁瓶</>放入<@gd.key>灌装机</>合成获得。
guide_text_liquid_filling_pd_mc_intro_de.en:
After unlocking Fluid Mode for the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>, the facility can produce with fluid-related formulas. 
Typical product: <@gd.key>Yazhen Solution in Ferrium Bottles</>, made by placing <@gd.key>Yazhen Solution</> and <@gd.key>Ferrium Bottles</> in the <@gd.key>Filling Unit</>.

guide_text_liquid_furnance_intro_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>精炼炉</>解锁液体模式，可进行与液体相关的不同配方生产。
典型产物为<@gd.key>赤铜块</>，由<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>赤铜矿</>放入<@gd.key>精炼炉</>合成获得。
guide_text_liquid_furnance_intro_desc_1.en:
After unlocking Fluid Mode for the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>, the facility can produce with fluid-related formulas. 
Typical product: <@gd.key>Cuprium</>, made by placing <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Cuprium Ore</> in the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_liquid_mix_2_desc_1.cn: 扩容反应池比反应池有更多的反应缓存，同一时间可<@gd.key>进行更多配方反应</>。
guide_text_liquid_mix_2_desc_1.en: The Expanded Crucible has more reaction caches than the Reactor Crucible, allowing it to <@gd.key>carry out more formula reactions</> at the same time.

guide_text_liquid_planter_intro_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>种植机</>解锁液体模式后，可产出依赖液体的新植物成株。
典型产物为<@gd.key>锦草</>，由<@gd.key>清水</>和<@gd.key>锦草种子</>在<@gd.key>种植机</>中种植获得。
guide_text_liquid_planter_intro_desc_1.en:
After unlocking Fluid Mode for the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</>, the facility can grow crops that require fluids. 
Typical product: <@gd.key>Jincao</>, grown by placing <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and <@gd.key>Jincao Seed</> in the <@gd.key>Planting Unit</>.

guide_text_liquid_purifier_1_desc_1.cn: 提纯机可以将溶液提纯至更高纯度溶液，典型产物为<@gd.key>赫铜溶液</>。
guide_text_liquid_purifier_1_desc_1.en: The Purification Unit can purify solutions into purer products such as <@gd.key>Hetonite Solution</>.

guide_text_liquid_storager_desc_1.cn: 储液罐可储存管道输入的<@gd.key>单一类型液体</>。
guide_text_liquid_storager_desc_1.en: A Fluid Tank can store <@gd.key>a single type of fluid</> delivered to it via pipelines.

guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_1.cn: 管道分流器可将单一管道<@gd.key>分流出最多三条管道</>进行传输。
guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_1.en: Pipe Splitters can <@gd.key>split 1 pipeline into 2 or 3 pipelines</> to divide fluid flow.

guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>管道汇流器</>可以使得多条管道上的液体汇流到单一管道上，最多支持三条管道汇流。
guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_2.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Converger</> can converge up to 3 pipelines into a single pipeline.

guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_3.cn: <@gd.key>管道桥</>可以使得两条相交的管道各自独立得运输液体而互不影响。
guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_3.en: The <@gd.key>Pipe Bridge</> allows a pipeline to go over another without disrupting the flow of fluids in both pipelines.

guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_4.cn: 在<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面中选择<@gd.key>管道物流设备</>，直接进行放置或拖入快捷栏使用。
guide_text_liquid_transport_intro_desc_4.en: Use the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel to select and place a <@gd.key>pipeline logistics unit</> directly, or drag it into the hotbar and place it with hotkeys.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_1.cn: <@gd.key>反应池</>可用于制造<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。请点击此处查看。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_1.en: The <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> can produce <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>. Click here for details.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_1_ct.cn: <@gd.key>反应池</>可用于制造<@gd.key>液化息壤</>。请按下<action=fac_machine_show_formula>查看。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> can produce <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>. Press <action=fac_machine_show_formula> for details.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_2.cn: <@gd.key>液化息壤</>可由<@gd.key>息壤</>和<@gd.key>清水</>在<@gd.key>反应池</>中批量制造。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_2.en: <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> is mass produced using <@gd.key>Xiranite</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</> at the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</>.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_3.cn: 使用<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，即可方便地武陵地区进行<@gd.key>动态侵蚀</>的消除。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_3.en: Use <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> to easily eliminate <@gd.key>Active Blight</> in the region of Wuling.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_4.cn: 请点击此处，关闭配方一览。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_4.en: Click here to close the Formulas panel.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_4_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the Formulas panel.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_5.cn: 在反应池中，需要在此处<@gd.key>手动选择</>输出产物。选择后，产物会从对应的<@gd.key>液体输出口</>中输出。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_5.en: At the Reactor Crucible panel, products must be <@gd.key>manually selected</> here. After selecting a product, it will be released through the matching <@gd.key>fluid outlet</>.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_desc.cn: 可使用<@gd.key>息壤</>和<@gd.key>清水</>在<@gd.key>反应池</>中批量制造<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，方便在武陵地区进行动态侵蚀的消除。
guide_text_liquid_xiranite_desc.en: Use <@gd.key>Xiranite</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</> at the <@gd.key>Reactor Crucible</> to mass produce <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</>. This product can easily clean up Active Blight in the region of Wuling.

guide_text_liquid_xiranite_title.cn: 使用液化息壤消除侵蚀

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_1.cn: 点击此处可以将精炼炉切换回<@gd.key>固体模式</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_1.en: Click here to switch the Refining Unit back to <@gd.key>Solid Mode</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_1_ct.en: Press <action=common_controller_side_menu> to expand the facility's <@gd.key>Quick Action</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>将精炼炉切换回<@gd.key>固体模式</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_1_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch the Refining Unit back to <@gd.key>Solid Mode</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_2.cn: 精炼炉已变为<@gd.key>固体模式</>，可以生产固体模式下的配方产物了。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_2.en: This Refining Unit is switched to <@gd.key>Solid Mode</> and can use Solid Mode production formulas.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_3.cn: 将取货口处的传送带连接至刚放好的精炼炉，并放置供电桩为其<@gd.key>供电</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_3.en: Connect the transport belt from the output port to the newly placed Refining Unit, and place an Electric Pylon to <@gd.key>power</> it.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_4.cn: 等待固体模式的精炼炉完成一次生产即可。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_4.en: Wait for the Solid Mode Refining Unit to complete its production.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_5.cn: 可以看到，<@gd.key>赤铜块</>已经成功生产。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_5.en: This shows that <@gd.key>Cuprium</> has been successfully produced.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_6.cn: 但同时产生了<@gd.key>污水</>，如果不处理，此处的液体缓存区满了之后会<@gd.key>阻塞</>工作。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_furnance_6.en: However, the process also produced <@gd.key>Sewage</>. If left untreated, it will fill up the fluid cache, <@gd.key>clog</> the facility, and stop it from working.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_1.cn: 将岸边的水泵，通过管道连向<@gd.key>液体模式</>的精炼炉吧。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_1.en: Connect the Fluid Pump near the water body to the <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</> Refining Unit via a pipeline.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_2.cn: 接下来，让我们打开精炼炉的操作面板
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_2.en: Now, let's open the Refining Unit control panel.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_3.cn: 我们成功使用<@gd.key>液体模式</>的精炼炉生产了<@gd.key>赤铜块</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_3.en: We have successfully used <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</> Refining Unit to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_3_1.cn: 我们还可以将精炼炉<@gd.key>切换回固体模式</>，用来生产其他基础材料。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_3_1.en: The Refining Unit can also be <@gd.key>switched back to Solid Mode</> for producing other basic materials.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_4.cn: 请在对应位置放置<@gd.key>精炼炉</>以便开展后续生产。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_4.en: Place a <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> at the specified location for subsequent production.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_5.cn: 接下来请打开刚放下的<@gd.key>精炼炉</>的操作面板。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_helper_5.en: Next, open the control panel of the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> we just placed.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.cn: 接下来，请打开<@gd.key>废水处理机</>的操作面板。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.en: Now open the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> control panel.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.cn: 废水处理机会规律性地将污水<@gd.key>处理完毕而不产生污染</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.en: The Water Treatment Unit will regularly <@gd.key>clean up Sewage and other polluted fluids into harmless discharge</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.cn: 请点击此处查看<@gd.key>废水处理机</>的配方。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.en: Click here to view the formulas of the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.cn: 请按下<action=fac_machine_show_formula>查看<@gd.key>废水处理机</>的配方。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.en: Press <action=fac_machine_show_formula> to view the formulas of the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.cn: 除了污水，废水处理机还可以无害化处理<@gd.key>壤晶废液</>与<@gd.key>惰性壤晶废液</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_liquidcleaner.en: The Water Treatment Unit can process Sewage, <@gd.key>Xircon Effluent</>, and <@gd.key>Inert Xircon Effluent</> to render them harmless.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_1.cn: 赤铜块已经开始生产，但如果不处理污水，精炼炉缓存区满了之后会阻塞。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_1.en: Cuprium production has begun. However, if the Sewage is not treated, the Refining Unit cache will be clogged by it.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_2.cn: 管道连接后，<@gd.key>精炼炉</>的污水就可以流向<@gd.key>废水处理机</>
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_2.en: Connecting a pipeline moves the Sewage from the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_3.cn: <@gd.key>废水处理机</>可以将污水清理干净，不生成其他产物。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_3.en: The <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> can treat and clean the sewage. No other products will be produced.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_4.cn: 请使用<@gd.key>管道</>将<@gd.key>精炼炉</>连向<@gd.key>废水处理机</>。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_start_4.en: Place a <@gd.key>pipeline</> to connect the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</>.

guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_wait_1.cn: 请等待几秒，清水将会输送至<@gd.key>液体模式</>的<@gd.key>精炼炉</>中。
guide_text_liquidcleaner_1_wait_1.en: Wait for a few seconds for the Clean Water to be delivered to the <@gd.key>Fluid Mode</> <@gd.key>Refining Unit</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_02_1.cn: <@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，诀的战技可以施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，并造成大量<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_02_1.en: <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Arcane's battle skill applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> and deals massive <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_03_1.cn: <@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，当有敌人被施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>时，诀可以发动连携技。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_03_1.en: <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Arcane's combo skill is triggered when <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> is applied on the enemy.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_03_title.cn: 诀的连携技 - 阵诀·智

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_04_1.cn: <@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，当有敌人进入两层及以上<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>时，诀也可以发动连携技。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_04_1.en: <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Arcane's combo skill is also triggered when an enemy has 2 or more stacks of <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_04_title.cn: 诀的连携技 - 阵诀·智

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_05_1.cn: <@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，处于<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态的敌人被诀的战技命中时，<#ba.return>返还</>一定技力，提前结束<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态，并再次施加<#ba.spellvul>法术脆弱</>，短暂延迟后，造成多段额外伤害。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_05_1.en: <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Hitting an enemy under <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> with Arcane's battle skill <#ba.return>returns</> some SP, ends the <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> early, applies another instance of <#ba.spellvul>Arts Susceptibility</>, and deals multiple hits of bonus DMG after a short delay.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_05_title.cn: 诀的连携技 - 阵诀·智

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_06_1.cn:
<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，诀的终结技能构建<@ba.key>破晦阵</>，对范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>并强制施加<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>。
处于<@ba.key>破晦阵</>中的敌人被处决或受到主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时，<@ba.key>破晦阵</>将对其发动<@ba.key>集束打击</>，造成范围伤害，最多触发2次。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_06_1.en:
<@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Arcane's ultimate creates a <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> that deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> and forcibly applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> to enemies within the area of effect (AOE).
When hitting an enemy within the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> with a Finisher or a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> performed by the controlled operator, the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> unleashes a <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> that deals Area DMG to the said enemy. This effect triggers up to 2 times.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_06_2.cn: 当<@ba.key>集束打击</>触发2次后，终结技切换为<@ba.key>破晦诀明</>：对前方大范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_06_2.en: After triggering <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> 2 times, the ultimate is switched to <@ba.key>Gloompurge Arcana</>: Deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> to enemies within a large AOE.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_06_title.cn: 诀的终结技 - 阵诀·智

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_07_1.cn: 当诀的意志值>智识值时，她的技能形态切换为<@ba.key>阵诀·意</>，可以通过连携技施加任意<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>来辅助队友。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_07_1.en: When Arcane's Will ≥ Intellect, she switches to <@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type and her combo skill can apply <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> of any element to support her teammates.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_08_1.cn: <@ba.key>阵诀·意</>形态下，诀的战技可以施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，<@ba.key>牵引</>目标附近的敌人并造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_08_1.en: <@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type: Arcane's battle skill applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>, <@ba.key>pulls in</> enemies near the target, and deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_09_1.cn:
<@ba.key>阵诀·意</>形态下，当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>时可以发动诀的连携技。对其及范围内目标再次施加该<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>、<#ba.naturalvul>自然脆弱</>和<#ba.crystvul>寒冷脆弱</>，并使其进入<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态。
<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态下，敌人的时间流速会被减缓。<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态结束时，<@ba.key>战术分身</>向其攻击，并造成爆炸伤害。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_09_1.en:
<@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type: Arcane's combo skill is triggered when an <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> is applied on an enemy. The combo skill applies another <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> of the same element, <#ba.naturalvul>Nature Susceptibility</>, and <#ba.crystvul>Cryo Susceptibility</> to the said enemy and targets nearby, and also applies the <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> debuff on the said enemy. 
An enemy under <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> will experience a slower flow of time. When <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> ends, Arcane's <@ba.key>Tactical Doubles</> will attack the said enemy to deal Explosion DMG.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_09_title.cn: 诀的连携技 - 阵诀·意

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_10_1.cn:
<@ba.key>阵诀·意</>形态下，诀的终结技能构建<@ba.key>破晦阵</>，对范围内处于<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>状态的敌人再次施加该<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>并造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
处于<@ba.key>破晦阵</>中的敌人被处决或受到主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时，<@ba.key>破晦阵</>将对其发动<@ba.key>集束打击</>，造成范围伤害，最多触发2次。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_10_1.en:
<@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type: Arcane's ultimate creates a <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> that targets enemies with <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> in the array's area of effect (AOE) to apply an <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stack of the same element and also deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>.
When hitting an enemy within the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> with a Finisher or a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> performed by the controlled operator, the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> unleashes a <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> that deals Area DMG to the said enemy. This effect triggers up to 2 times.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_10_2.cn: 当<@ba.key>集束打击</>触发2次后，终结技切换为<@ba.key>破晦诀明</>：对前方大范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_10_2.en: After triggering <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> 2 times, the ultimate is switched to <@ba.key>Gloompurge Arcana</>: Deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> to enemies within a large AOE.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_10_title.cn: 诀的终结技 - 阵诀·意

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_11_1.cn: 诀是一名能够切换<@ba.key>技能形态</>的自然属性术师干员。当诀的智识值≥意志值时，她的技能形态切换为<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>，可以通过高频施放自身连携技和战技，造成大量伤害。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_11_1.en: Arcane is a Nature element caster with <@ba.key>switchable skill types</>. When her Intellect ≥ Will, she switches to the <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type. This allows Arcane to cast her combo skill and battle skill more frequently to deal massive DMG.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_black01.cn: 当前诀的意志值>智识值，技能形态会切换为[阵诀·意]。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_black01.en: When Arcane's Will > Intellect, her skills are switched to [Array Arcana: WILL].

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_black02.cn: 当前诀的智识值≥意志值，技能形态会切换为[阵诀·智]。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrain01_black02.en: When Arcane's Intellect ≥ Will, her skills are switched to [Array Arcana: INT].

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01.cn: 尝试使用诀的战技牵引敌人
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01.en: Use Arcane's battle skill to pull in enemies

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 诀是一名能够切换<@ba.key>技能形态</>的自然属性术师干员。<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，她可以高频施放连携技，打出大量伤害。<@ba.key>阵诀·意</>形态下，她可以通过连携技施加任意<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_1.en: Arcane is a caster who deals Nature DMG and has <@ba.key>switchable skill types</>. When <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type is active, she can cast combo skills more frequently and deal massive DMG. When <@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type is active, she can use her combo skill to apply <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> of any element.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_2.cn: 诀的战技可以施加<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，<@ba.key>牵引</>目标附近的敌人并造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_2.en: Arcane's battle skill applies <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>, <@ba.key>pulls in</> enemies near the target, and deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_3.cn:
当有敌人被施加<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>时可以发动诀的连携技，对其及范围内目标再次施加该<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>、<#ba.naturalvul>自然脆弱</>和<#ba.crystvul>寒冷脆弱</>，并使其进入<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态。
<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态下，敌人的时间流速会被减缓。<@ba.key>囹圄</>状态结束时，<@ba.key>战术分身</>向其攻击，并造成爆炸伤害。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_3.en:
Arcane's combo skill is triggered when an <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> is applied on an enemy. The combo skill applies another <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> of the same element, <#ba.naturalvul>Nature Susceptibility</>, and <#ba.crystvul>Cryo Susceptibility</> to the said enemy and targets nearby, and also applies the <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> debuff on the said enemy. 
An enemy under <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> will experience a slower flow of time. When <@ba.key>Imprisonment</> ends, Arcane's <@ba.key>Tactical Doubles</> will attack the said enemy to deal Explosion DMG.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_4.cn:
诀的终结技能构建<@ba.key>破晦阵</>，对范围内处于<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>状态的敌人再次施加该<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>并造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
处于<@ba.key>破晦阵</>中的敌人被处决或受到主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时，<@ba.key>破晦阵</>将对其发动<@ba.key>集束打击</>，造成范围伤害，最多触发2次。
当<@ba.key>集束打击</>触发2次后，终结技切换为<@ba.key>破晦诀明</>：对前方大范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_4.en:
Arcane creates a <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> that deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</>. Against enemies with <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> in the array's area of effect (AOE), the array applies another <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> stack of the same element.
When hitting an enemy within the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> with a Finisher or a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> performed by the controlled operator, the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> unleashes a <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> that deals Area DMG to the said enemy. This effect triggers up to 2 times.
After triggering <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> 2 times, the ultimate is switched to <@ba.key>Gloompurge Arcana</>: Deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> to enemies within a large AOE.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_5.cn:
诀能够施加长时间的<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>效果来提升全队的伤害。
<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，诀可以通过高频施放自身连携技和战技，造成大量伤害。
<@ba.key>阵诀·意</>形态下，诀可以灵活按需提供各种<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>，以提升队伍战斗效率。
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_01_5.en:
Arcane can apply <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> for extended periods of time so that the entire team can deal more DMG.
<@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> skill type: Arcane can cast her combo skill and battle skill frequently to deal massive DMG. 
<@ba.key>Array Arcana: WILL</> skill type: Arcane can apply <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> of various elements accordingly to boost the team's overall performance in battle.

guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_02.cn: 尝试对敌人施加任意法术附着，触发诀的连携技使敌人进入囹圄状态
guide_text_lizhiyan_chartrial01_02.en: Try to apply any Arts Infliction on an enemy to trigger Arcane's combo skill. The combo skill applies Imprisonment on the enemy

guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_1.cn: 身受重伤的诀背水一战，在接下来的战斗中，她的终结技能量充能效率提升至五倍。
guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_1.en: Arcane is severely injured but has nothing else left to lose. In this battle, her Ultimate Gain Efficiency is increased to 5 times.

guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_2.cn:
诀是一名能够切换<@ba.key>技能形态</>的自然属性术师干员。<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，诀可以通过高频施放自身连携技和战技，造成大量伤害。
本次行动中，诀为<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态。
guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_2.en:
Arcane is a Nature element caster with <@ba.key>switchable skill types</>. When her skills are switched to <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</>, she can cast her combo skill and battle skill more frequently to deal massive DMG.
For this operation, Arcane's skills are switched to <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</>.

guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_3.cn:
<@ba.key>阵诀·智</>形态下，诀的终结技能构建<@ba.key>破晦阵</>，对范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>并强制施加<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>。
处于<@ba.key>破晦阵</>中的敌人被处决或受到主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时，<@ba.key>破晦阵</>将对其发动<@ba.key>集束打击</>，造成范围伤害，最多触发2次。
当<@ba.key>集束打击</>触发2次后，终结技切换为<@ba.key>破晦诀明</>：对前方大范围内敌人造成<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>
guide_text_lizhiyan_mission_desc_3.en:
When <@ba.key>Array Arcana: INT</> is active, Arcane's ultimate creates a <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> that deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> and forcibly applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</> to enemies within its area of effect (AOE). 
When an enemy within the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> suffers a Finisher or a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> performed by the controlled operator, the <@ba.key>Gloompurger Array</> unleashes a <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> that deals Area DMG to the said enemy. This effect triggers up to 2 times. 
After triggering <@ba.key>Cluster Strike</> 2 times, the ultimate is switched to <@ba.key>Gloompurge Arcana</>: Deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> to enemies within a large AOE.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_1.cn: 界面上展示了<@gd.key>仓库中存放的物品</>，请点击仓库中的<@gd.key>源矿</>。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_1.en: The panel displays <@gd.key>items stored in the Depot</>. Click on the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> in the Depot.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_1.cn: 协议核心/次级核心的每个取货口都可以选定一个物品作为输出的目标，<@gd.key>点击空白的物品栏</>。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_1.en: Each output port of the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) / Sub-PAC can choose to unload 1 item. <@gd.key>Click on the now empty item slot.</>

guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_1_ct.cn: 协议核心/次级核心的每个取货口都可以选定一个物品作为输出的目标，请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择<@gd.key>空白的物品栏</>。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_1_ct.en: Each output port of the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) / Sub-PAC can choose to unload 1 item. Press <action=common_confirm> and select the <@gd.key>empty item slot</>.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_ct.cn: 界面上展示了<@gd.key>仓库中存放的物品</>，请按下<action=common_confirm>，选择仓库中的<@gd.key>源矿</>。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_1_ct.en: The panel displays <@gd.key>items stored in the Depot</>. Press <action=common_confirm> and select <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> in the Depot.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_2.cn: 这样<@gd.key>源矿</>就被设为这个取货口的<@gd.key>输出物品</>了。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_2.en: This sets the <@gd.key>Originium Ore</> as the <@gd.key>item to be moved out</> of this output port.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_3.cn: 关闭界面，接下来我们尝试如何利用传送带配合取货口自动取出物品。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_3.en: Close the panel. Time to learn how to use a transport belt with an output port to automatically unload items from the Depot.

guide_text_loader_e1m6_3_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭界面，接下来我们尝试如何利用传送带配合取货口自动取出物品。
guide_text_loader_e1m6_3_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the panel. Time to learn how to use a transport belt with an output port to automatically unload items from the Depot.

guide_text_locked_box_desc_1.cn: 塔卫二上分布着一些<@gd.key>锁闭储藏箱</>，只有找到分散在周围的三个<@gd.key>锁闭醚质</>后，才能将其解锁。
guide_text_locked_box_desc_1.en: Many <@gd.key>Sealed Crates</> can be found in the world of Talos-II. To unlock a Sealed Crate, gather 3 <@gd.key>Sealing Aurylenes</> scattered nearby.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_1.cn: 晶体外壳数量已充足。请按照提示，点击<@gd.key>设备制造</>来制造设备。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_1.en: There are now enough Origocrusts. Click the <@gd.key>Construct</> button to construct the facility.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_2.cn: 晶体外壳数量已充足。请按照提示，点击<@gd.key>设备制造</>来制造设备。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_2.en: There are now enough Origocrusts. Click the <@gd.key>Construct</> button to construct the facility.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_3.cn: 请选择<@gd.key>4号取货口</>，按下<action=common_interact>打开取货口界面。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_3.en: Select <@gd.key>output port 4</>, then press <action=common_interact> to open the output port panel.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_3_mb.cn: 请选择<@gd.key>4号取货口</>，并打开取货口界面。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_3_mb.en: Select <@gd.key>output port 4</>, then open the output port panel.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4.cn: 请靠近并按下<action=common_interact>，打开精炼炉的操作面板。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4.en: Get close to the Refining Unit, then press <action=common_interact> to open its control panel.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4_ct.cn: 请打开精炼炉的操作面板。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4_ct.en: Open the control panel of the Refining Unit.

guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4_mb.cn: 请打开精炼炉的操作面板。
guide_text_logistic_e1m6_hint_4_mb.en: Open the control panel of the Refining Unit.

guide_text_logistic_furnance_1.cn: 在操作面板中可以直观查看物流的运转情况。
guide_text_logistic_furnance_1.en: The control panel shows the current logistics data of the facility.

guide_text_logistic_furnance_2.cn: 左侧显示了设备的<@gd.key>传送带输入口</>，展示了输入材料的信息。
guide_text_logistic_furnance_2.en: The LEFT side shows the <@gd.key>transport belt input port</> and data of the facility's input materials.

guide_text_logistic_furnance_2_1.cn:
左侧是由传送带输入的待精炼的源矿。
右侧是由设备加工完成的晶体外壳。
从左到右，设备正在自动精炼已输入的源矿，并输出已加工完成的晶体外壳。
guide_text_logistic_furnance_2_1.en: The LEFT side shows Originium Ore transport belt moving materials into the facility for refining. The RIGHT side shows the Origocrusts produced by the facility. The CENTER shows the Refining Unit auto-processing the incoming Originium Ore into Origocrust.

guide_text_logistic_furnance_3.cn: 右侧显示了设备的各<@gd.key>传送带取货口</>，可查看输出产物的信息。
guide_text_logistic_furnance_3.en: The RIGHT side shows the <@gd.key>transport belt output ports</> and data of the products leaving the facility.

guide_text_logistic_furnance_4.cn:
这就是由传送带和设备组成的自动化产线。
请关闭精炼炉的操作面板，等待晶体外壳方便地自动化生产吧！
guide_text_logistic_furnance_4.en: This is an automated production line comprising transport belts and processing facilities. Close the Refining Unit control panel, then wait for the production line to auto-produce Origocrusts!

guide_text_logistic_furnance_4_ct.cn:
这就是由传送带和设备组成的自动化产线。
请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭精炼炉的操作面板，等待晶体外壳方便地自动化生产吧！
guide_text_logistic_furnance_4_ct.en: This is an automated production line comprising transport belts and processing facilities. Press <action=common_cancel> to close the Refining Unit control panel, then wait for the production line to auto-produce Origocrusts!

guide_text_lsm_controlled_switch_desc_1.cn: 若要激活它，需要打开平衡总控开关，按照<@gd.key>演示顺序</>激活周围的<@gd.key>压力板</>。
guide_text_lsm_controlled_switch_desc_1.en: To turn the main balance switch on, activate the nearby <@gd.key>pressure plates</> according to the <@gd.key>demonstrated sequence</>.

guide_text_lsm_controlled_sword_desc_1.cn: 选剑局内特殊的平衡总控开关，如果要激活它，需要按照<@gd.key>演示顺序</>激活周围的<@gd.key>压力板</>，升起小剑桩。
guide_text_lsm_controlled_sword_desc_1.en: Sword pells are special main balance switches in the Bureau of Swordmancers. To switch one on, activate the nearby <@gd.key>pressure plates</> according to the <@gd.key>demonstrated sequence</>.

guide_text_lsm_fog_lost_desc_1.cn: 雪松林中分布的<@gd.key>浓雾</>，进入后会<@gd.key>迷失方向</>，并<@gd.key>自动传送</>到未知地点。
guide_text_lsm_fog_lost_desc_1.en: There are masses of <@gd.key>thick fog</> in the Snowy Forest. You will be <@gd.key>lost</> if you walk into them and be <@gd.key>automatically teleported</> to an unknown location.

guide_text_lumber_intro_1.cn: 尝试攻击源矿石，可以获得源矿。
guide_text_lumber_intro_1.en: Attack and smash the Originium Ore formation to gather Originium Ore.

guide_text_lumber_intro_2.cn: 进行攻击，即可破坏障碍物。

guide_text_magic_missile_desc_1.cn:
寒雾之息会<@gd.key>自动追踪</>目标，被寒雾之息击中会导致<@gd.key>前进受阻</>。
使用<@gd.key>提弗洛斯的弓箭</>可以<@gd.key>清除</>寒雾之息。
guide_text_magic_missile_desc_1.en: The Breath of Hoarfrost will <@gd.key>automatically track down</> its target and <@gd.key>impede the progress</> of the target it hits. Use <@gd.key>Typhoeus's arrows</> to <@gd.key>dispel</> the Breath of Hoarfrost.

guide_text_magic_missile_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>林中寒雾</>会<@gd.key>持续产生</>寒雾之息，需要<@gd.key>借助提弗洛斯的弓箭</>才能通过。
guide_text_magic_missile_desc_2.en: The <@gd.key>Hoarfrost of the Woods</> will continuously create the <@gd.key>Breath of Hoarfrost</>. Use <@gd.key>Typhoeus's arrows</> to gain passage.

guide_text_magic_missile_rune_desc_1.cn: 符文是维持林中寒雾的核心，<@gd.key>击破符文</>可以<@gd.key>清除林中寒雾</>。
guide_text_magic_missile_rune_desc_1.en: The rune is the core that sustains the Hoarfrost of the Woods. <@gd.key>Shatter the runes</> to dispel the <@gd.key>Hoarfrost of the Woods</>.

guide_text_magic_pumice2_desc_1.cn: 雪松林空中的部分浮石需要先用提弗洛斯的弓箭<@gd.key>击破符文</>，才能自行移动。
guide_text_magic_pumice2_desc_1.en: Some floating rocks in the Snowy Forest can only move after <@gd.key>shattering certain runes</> with Typhoeus's arrows.

guide_text_magic_pumice_desc_1.cn: 雪松林空中<@gd.key>飘浮的巨石</>，走上去后浮石会开始<@gd.key>自行移动</>。
guide_text_magic_pumice_desc_1.en: There are <@gd.key>giant, floating rocks</> in the Snowy Forest. They will <@gd.key>start moving</> when someone steps on them.

guide_text_magic_shield_monster_desc_1.cn:
巫术造物拥有<@gd.key>层叠护盾</>期间，<@gd.key>免疫</>一切伤害、<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>、<#ba.spellstatus>法术异常</>、<#ba.noguard>破防</>和<#ba.physicalstatus>物理异常</>。
<@gd.key>重击或技能</>命中可以削减护盾层数，每次最多只能削减1层。
guide_text_magic_shield_monster_desc_1.en: When witchcraft creations have <@gd.key>shield stack(s)</>, they are <@gd.key>immune</> to all forms of DMG, <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Inflictions</>, <#ba.spellstatus>Arts Reactions</>, <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, and <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Statuses</>. Hitting them with <@gd.key>Final Strikes or skills</> can remove shield stacks. Each Final Strike or skill can only remove 1 shield stack.

guide_text_magic_shield_monster_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>层叠护盾</>层数削减到0后，借助<@gd.key>提弗洛斯的弓箭</>消除巫术造物的护盾覆盖状态，并恢复一定技力。
guide_text_magic_shield_monster_desc_2.en: After reducing <@gd.key>shield stacks</> to ZERO, use <@gd.key>Typhoeus's arrows</> to dispel the witchcraft creation's Stacked Shields status and recover some SP.

guide_text_magic_shield_monster_hint_1.cn:
巫术造物拥有<@gd.key>层叠护盾</>期间，<@gd.key>免疫</>一切伤害、法术附着、法术异常和破防。
<@gd.key>重击或技能</>命中可以削减护盾层数，每次最多只能削减1层。
guide_text_magic_shield_monster_hint_1.en: While witchcraft creations have <@gd.key>shield stack(s)</>, they are <@gd.key>immune</> to all forms of DMG, Arts Inflictions, Arts Reactions, and Vulnerability. Hitting them with <@gd.key>Final Strikes or skills</> can remove shield stacks. Each Final Strike or skill can only remove 1 shield stack.

guide_text_mail_lost_item_1.cn: 因物品储存空间已满未能获取到的物品，回收小组已帮您回收并发送至<@gd.key>邮箱缓存区</>，请点击主界面的<@gd.key>邮箱</>按钮查看。
guide_text_mail_lost_item_1.en: Items that could not be collected due to full storage will be recovered by the field recovery team and sent to the <@gd.key>Mail Cache</>. Click the <@gd.key>Mail</> button in the main screen (upper left row) to view the Mail Cache.

guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_1.cn: 您刚才收到了因各种原因遗失的物品，请进入邮箱查看。
guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_1.en: The Mail Cache has received items lost and/or missed due to various reasons. Open the Mail screen for a look.

guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_2.cn: 可在此处打开遗失物品的暂存区。
guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_2.en: This opens the cache for the missed items.

guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_3.cn: 可在此处尽快领取遗失的物品。
guide_text_mail_lost_item_cbt2_3.en: This quickly claims the missed items.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_0_mb.cn: 请点击此处，展开<@gd.key>工具箱</>。

guide_text_make_battle_turret_1.cn: 晶体外壳数量已充足，接下来可以制造作战设备了。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_1.en: There are now enough Origocrusts. The next step is to construct combat facilities.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_1_ct.cn: 晶体外壳数量已充足，接下来可以制造作战设备了。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_1_ct.en: There are now enough Origocrusts. The next step is to construct combat facilities.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_1_mb.cn: 点击此处进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_1_mb.en: Tap here to enter the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_2.cn: 请按下<action=fac_open_devices_list>或者按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_2.en: Press <action=fac_open_devices_list> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_3.cn: 点击此处，选择<@gd.key>战斗辅助</>分页。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_3.en: Click here to select the <@gd.key>COMBAT</> tab.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_3_mb.en: Tap here to select the <@gd.key>Gun Tower</>.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_4.cn: <@gd.key>铳械塔</>是一种简单有效的作战设备，可以自动攻击附近的敌人。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_4.en: The <@gd.key>Gun Tower</> is a simple yet effective combat facility that can automatically attack enemies within range.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_5.cn: 点击此处，可以切换到设备制造模式。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_5.en: Click here to switch to facility construction mode.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_5_ct.cn: 按下<action=fac_build_list_switch_mode>，可以切换到设备制造模式。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_5_ct.en: Press <action=fac_build_list_switch_mode> to switch to facility construction mode.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_6.cn:
这里显示了制造铳械塔所消耗的材料类型与数量。
刚才加工的<@gd.key>晶体外壳</>就是制造铳械塔的所需材料。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_6.en: This shows the types and quantities of materials needed to construct the Gun Tower. The <@gd.key>Origocrust</> we just made is required for construction.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_7.cn: 当材料充足时，可在这里自定义选择数量对设备进行批量制造。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_7.en: As long as there are enough materials, use this to select the number of facilities to construct at one go.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_8.cn: 请<@gd.key>长按</>此处，制造<@gd.key>3座</>铳械塔，以准备开始抵御敌人。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_8.en: <@gd.key>Long-press</> this to construct <@gd.key>3</> Gun Towers and defend the area against the enemy.

guide_text_make_battle_turret_8_ct.cn: 请<@gd.key>长按</><action=common_num_add>，制造<@gd.key>3座</>铳械塔，以准备开始抵御敌人。
guide_text_make_battle_turret_8_ct.en: <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=common_num_add> to construct <@gd.key>3</> Gun Towers and defend the area against the enemy.

guide_text_make_dumper_2.en: Click here to select <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</>.

guide_text_make_dumper_2_ct.cn: 还需要制造<@gd.key>给水器</>，已为您选中。
guide_text_make_dumper_2_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</> is next. It has already been selected.

guide_text_make_dumper_3.cn: 点击即可制造一个给水器。
guide_text_make_dumper_3.en: Click to construct a Fluid Supply Unit.

guide_text_make_dumper_3_1.cn: 材料充足后，可在此处制造给水器。
guide_text_make_dumper_3_1.en: Once there are enough materials, construct the Fluid Supply Unit here.

guide_text_make_dumper_3_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_confirm>即可制造一个给水器。
guide_text_make_dumper_3_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to construct a Fluid Supply Unit.

guide_text_make_dumper_4.cn: 请点击此处，关闭<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_dumper_4.en: Click here to close the <@gd.key>Facility List</> screen.

guide_text_make_dumper_4_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_dumper_5.cn: 请前往此处，放置<@gd.key>水泵</>与<@gd.key>给水器</>，进行液体运输。
guide_text_make_dumper_5.en: Go here to place the <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> and <@gd.key>Fluid Supply Unit</> and start transporting the fluid.

guide_text_make_grinder_0_ct.en: Press <action=fac_main_right_active> to view <@gd.key>other AIC Factory actions</>.

guide_text_make_grinder_1.cn: 请按下快捷键<action=common_switch_mode>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，切换为<@gd.key>工业模式</>。
guide_text_make_grinder_1.en: Press the hotkey <action=common_switch_mode> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to switch to <@gd.key>AIC Mode</>.

guide_text_make_grinder_10.cn: 点击此处，即可进入设备放置状态。
guide_text_make_grinder_10.en: Click here to enter facility placement mode.

guide_text_make_grinder_10_ct.cn: 按下<action=fac_build_list_place_confirm>，即可进入设备放置状态。
guide_text_make_grinder_10_ct.en: Press <action=fac_build_list_place_confirm> to enter facility placement mode.

guide_text_make_grinder_11.cn: 请在<@gd.key>供电桩</>范围内放置<@gd.key>粉碎机</>。
guide_text_make_grinder_11.en: Place a <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</> within the power-supply radius of the <@gd.key>Electric Pylon</>.

guide_text_make_grinder_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处，切换为<@gd.key>工业模式</>。
guide_text_make_grinder_1_mb.en: Tap here to switch to <@gd.key>AIC Mode</>.

guide_text_make_grinder_2.cn: 可按下<action=fac_open_devices_list>或者按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面，进行工业设备制造。
guide_text_make_grinder_2.en: Press <action=fac_open_devices_list> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel, and use it to construct AIC Factory facilities.

guide_text_make_grinder_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面，进行工业设备制造
guide_text_make_grinder_2_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel, and use it to construct AIC Factory facilities.

guide_text_make_grinder_2_mb.cn: 请点击此处，展开<@gd.key>工具箱</>。

guide_text_make_grinder_3.cn: 在左侧列表中，可以看到当前已解锁的设备模板。
guide_text_make_grinder_3.en: The list on the left side shows facility templates already unlocked.

guide_text_make_grinder_3_mb.cn: 请点击此处进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面，进行工业设备制造。
guide_text_make_grinder_3_mb.en: Tap here to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel, and use it to construct AIC Factory facilities.

guide_text_make_grinder_4.en: Click here to select the <@gd.key>Shredding Unit</>.

guide_text_make_grinder_5.cn: 当前设备数量不足，点击此处即可切换至<@gd.key>设备制造</>。
guide_text_make_grinder_5.en: If more facilities are needed, click here to switch to the <@gd.key>Construction</> panel.

guide_text_make_grinder_5_1_ct.cn:
已为您选中<@gd.key>粉碎机</>。

guide_text_make_grinder_7.cn: 当前原材料充足，点击即可制造设备。

guide_text_make_grinder_9_ct.en: Facility construction complete. Press <action=fac_build_list_switch_mode> to switch to <@gd.key>facility placement</>.

guide_text_make_pump_4.cn: 点击此处，切换至<@gd.key>设备制造</>。

guide_text_make_pump_5_1.cn: 材料充足后，可在此处制造水泵。
guide_text_make_pump_5_1.en: Once there are enough materials, construct the Fluid Pump here.

guide_text_make_pump_5_ct.cn: 当前材料已充足，按下<action=common_confirm>即可制造水泵。
guide_text_make_pump_5_ct.en: There are enough materials. Press <action=common_confirm> to construct the Fluid Pump.

guide_text_make_xiranite_hint_1.cn: 可通过<@gd.key>水泵</>获取稳定的清水，并使用<@gd.key>管道</>输送至天有洪炉中。
guide_text_make_xiranite_hint_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> to acquire a steady supply of Clean Water, then use <@gd.key>pipelines</> to transport it to the Forge of the Sky.

guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1.cn: 请按下<action=fac_open_devices_list>或者按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1.en: Press <action=fac_open_devices_list> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=fac_main_right_active>并按<action=common_confirm>选择此项，进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1_ct.en: Press <action=fac_main_right_active> and press <action=common_confirm> to select this option and open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处，展开工具箱，并进入<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面。
guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_1_mb.en: Tap here to expand the Toolkit and open the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel.

guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_3.cn: 点击此处，选择<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>进行制造。
guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_3.en: Click here to select <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> for construction.

guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_3_ct.cn: 当前已选择<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>，请进行制造。
guide_text_make_xiranite_oven_3_ct.en: <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> is already selected. Construct it.

guide_text_map_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议同步器权限已开放</>，请按下<action=common_open_watch>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开协议同步器。
guide_text_map_1.en: <@gd.key>Protocol Synchronizer (Protosync) authority level unlocked</>. Press <action=common_open_watch> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Protosync.

guide_text_map_1_ct.cn: <@gd.key>协议同步器权限已开放</>，请按下<action=common_open_watch>打开协议同步器。
guide_text_map_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>Protocol Synchronizer (Protosync) authority level unlocked</>. Press <action=common_open_watch> to open the Protosync.

guide_text_map_1_mb.cn: <@gd.key>协议同步器权限已开放</>，请点击此处，打开协议同步器。
guide_text_map_1_mb.en: <@gd.key>Protocol Synchronizer (Protosync) authority level unlocked</>. Tap here to open the Protosync.

guide_text_map_2.cn: 协议同步器上集成了探索中会用到的各项功能。
guide_text_map_2.en: The Protocol Synchronizer (Protosync) has integrated various functions useful for exploration.

guide_text_map_3.cn: 比如可以在<@gd.key>百科</>中查看各项物品、敌人与教学信息。
guide_text_map_3.en: The <@gd.key>Database</> can be used to view details of various items, enemies, and tutorials.

guide_text_map_4.cn: 此处则会展示当期的寻访、武库交易所等热点信息。
guide_text_map_4.en: This section highlights Headhunting and Arsenal Exchange events currently available.

guide_text_map_5.en: Click here to open the map.

guide_text_map_5_1.cn: 这里展示了<@gd.key>四号谷地</>的地区总览，点击此处，进入<@gd.key>枢纽区</>的地图。
guide_text_map_5_1.en: This area shows the <@gd.key>Valley IV</> Region Overview. Click here to open the map of <@gd.key>The Hub</>.

guide_text_map_5_1_ct.cn: 这里展示了<@gd.key>四号谷地</>的地区总览，请按下<action=common_confirm>，进入<@gd.key>枢纽区</>的地图。
guide_text_map_5_1_ct.en: This area shows the <@gd.key>Valley IV</> Region Overview. Press <action=common_confirm> to open the map of <@gd.key>The Hub</>.

guide_text_map_6.cn: 可在<@gd.key>枢纽区</>地图中查看该区域的地形与各项信息。
guide_text_map_6.en: The map of <@gd.key>The Hub</> shows the terrain and various information of this area.

guide_text_map_7.cn: 可以点击地图上的各种图标来查看具体内容，比如点击任务追踪点，即可查看当前任务详情。
guide_text_map_7.en: Click various map markers to get more details about them. For example, clicking a mission tracking point opens up the mission details.

guide_text_map_7_1_ct.cn: 比如，您可以在<@gd.key>任务追踪点</>处查看当前任务详情。
guide_text_map_7_1_ct.en: For example, <@gd.key>mission tracking points</> can give more details on the mission.

guide_text_map_7_ct.cn: 可以推动<action=common_leftstick>操作杆选择地图上的各种图标，并按下<action=common_confirm>来查看具体内容。
guide_text_map_7_ct.en: Use the <action=common_leftstick> stick to select various markers on the map, then press <action=common_confirm> to view the details.

guide_text_map_8.cn: 已为您选中<@gd.key>协议核心</>的地图标记。
guide_text_map_8.en: The <@gd.key>PAC</> map marker is already selected.

guide_text_map_8_ct.cn: 已为您选中<@gd.key>协议核心</>的地图标记。
guide_text_map_8_ct.en: The <@gd.key>PAC</> map marker is already selected.

guide_text_map_9.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>传送</>按钮，快速返回<@gd.key>协议核心</>。
guide_text_map_9.en: Click the <@gd.key>Teleport</> button to quickly return to the <@gd.key>PAC</>.

guide_text_map_9_ct.cn: 请按下<action=map_detail_common_right_btn_click>进行<@gd.key>传送</>，可以快速返回<@gd.key>协议核心</>。
guide_text_map_9_ct.en: Press <action=map_detail_common_right_btn_click> to <@gd.key>teleport</> and quickly return to the <@gd.key>PAC</>.

guide_text_map_filter_1.cn: 可点击此处，进行<@gd.key>标记显示管理</>，以快捷定位<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>。
guide_text_map_filter_1.en: Click here to manage <@gd.key>Marker Tags display</>, and use the hotkey to locate <@gd.key>Protocol Dataloggers</>.

guide_text_map_filter_2.cn:
这里是<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>的地图标记，可在地图中找到对应的标记点。
或者在下方点击<@gd.key>清空选中</>后，再选中该<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>的标记。
guide_text_map_filter_2.en: This is the map marker for the <@gd.key>Protocol Datalogger</>. These markers can also be found on the map. Alternatively, click on the <@gd.key>Clear All</> button at the bottom, then select the marker for the <@gd.key>Protocol Datalogger</>.

guide_text_marker_desc_1.cn: 放置<@gd.key>留言信标</>后，首先需要选择标记内容。可以根据想要表达的内容拼接短语，在确认标记内容后会进入建造状态。
guide_text_marker_desc_1.en: After selecting the Place option of the <@gd.key>Memo Beacon</>, you can select various icons to create a short phrase you wish to convey. When you are done, select Confirm to finish constructing the Memo Beacon.

guide_text_marker_desc_3.cn: 放置下的留言信标会出现在他人的游玩环境中，向他人传达你特别的信息吧
guide_text_marker_desc_3.en: Once placed, the Memo Beacon will appear in other players' maps to convey your message.

guide_text_matrix_center_desc_1.cn: 过载的阵列核心会以一定频率释放能量攻击，请注意躲避。干员被击中时会受到伤害并被击飞。
guide_text_matrix_center_desc_1.en: Overloaded Array Cores will unleash energy attacks at a certain frequency. Dodge the attacks as operators hit by them will take damage and get knocked off their feet.

guide_text_matrix_center_desc_2.cn: 损坏的天师桩会以一定频率释放震波，请注意躲避。干员被击中时会受到伤害并被击飞。
guide_text_matrix_center_desc_2.en: Damaged Tianshi Pillars will unleash shockwaves at a certain frequency. Dodge the shockwaves as operators hit by them will take damage and get knocked off their feet.

guide_text_matrix_center_desc_3.cn:
请前往损坏的天师桩，并使用<@gd.key>重息壤</>进行修复。
天师桩被修复后，便不会再释放震波。
当所有的天师桩被修复后，阵列核心也会停止攻击。
guide_text_matrix_center_desc_3.en: Go to damaged Tianshi Pillars and repair them with <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>. Repaired Tianshi Pillars will no longer unleash shockwaves. Once all Tianshi Pillars are repaired, the Array Core will stop attacking as well.

guide_text_mazemarker_desc_1.cn: 武陵城外的迷踪林中，乱动的竹子会给本地居民带来困扰。当人们<@gd.key>被困迷踪林</>时，可通过附近的引导灯<@gd.key>寻找前路</>。
guide_text_mazemarker_desc_1.en: The randomly moving bamboo thickets of the Stragglers Grove have caused quite a bit of trouble for locals of Wuling outskirts. Those who find themselves <@gd.key>lost in the grove</> are advised to use guiding lights nearby to <@gd.key>find the proper path</>.

guide_text_mazemarker_desc_2.cn: 引导灯可以暂时驱散附近的少数竹林虫。<@gd.key>部分特定的区域引导灯会成组设置，需要按一定顺序点亮</>。这些成组的引导灯附近通常存在<@gd.key>提示点亮顺序的石柱</>。
guide_text_mazemarker_desc_2.en: Guiding lights can temporarily dispel a number of grovenymphs nearby. <@gd.key>Certain areas have sets of guiding lights that must be activated in the right sequence</>. <@gd.key>Stone pillars with clues to the correct sequence</> are often found near these sets of guiding lights.

guide_text_medic_hint_1.cn:
记得在战斗前进行<@gd.key>装备</>和<@gd.key>战术物品</>的更换。
按下<action=common_open_char_panel>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入干员详情。
guide_text_medic_hint_1.en:
Don't forget to equip and change <@gd.key>gear</> and <@gd.key>tacticals</> before battle. 
Press <action=common_open_char_panel> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_medic_hint_1_ct.cn:
记得在战斗前进行<@gd.key>装备</>和<@gd.key>战术物品</>的更换。
请按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>并进入干员总览。
guide_text_medic_hint_1_ct.en: Don't forget to equip and change <@gd.key>gear</> and <@gd.key>tacticals</> before battle. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to expand the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</> and open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_medic_hint_1_mb.cn:
记得在战斗前进行<@gd.key>装备</>和<@gd.key>战术物品</>的更换。
点击此处进入干员详情。
guide_text_medic_hint_1_mb.en: Don't forget to equip and change <@gd.key>gear</> and <@gd.key>tacticals</> before battle. Tap here to open the Operator Overview screen.

guide_text_medic_hint_2.cn: 可在此处，更换干员的<@gd.key>装备</>与<@gd.key>战术物品</>，以更好地应对敌人。
guide_text_medic_hint_2.en: Use this screen to change the operator's <@gd.key>gear</> and <@gd.key>tacticals</> to better deal with the enemy.

guide_text_medic_sta_intro_desc_1.cn: 医疗塔通过供电或电池获得充能后，可将充能转换为治疗量，为范围内当前小队干员回复<@gd.key>生命值</>。
guide_text_medic_sta_intro_desc_1.en: When charged by the power grid or batteries, Medical Towers can convert their charges into treatment for restoring the <@gd.key>HP</> of team operators nearby.

guide_text_medic_use_3.cn: 可在这里为每名干员分别装备一种战术物品。
guide_text_medic_use_3.en: Here, each operator can be equipped with 1 tactical.

guide_text_medic_use_4.cn: 装备战术物品之后，干员会在战斗中符合生效条件的情况下，<@gd.key>自动使用物品</>。
guide_text_medic_use_4.en: Once equipped, tacticals are <@gd.key>automatically used</> by the operator when the criteria are met during battle.

guide_text_medic_use_desc_1.cn:
可以在装备页面为每名干员装备一种战术物品。
每种战术物品都有<@gd.key>不同的生效条件</>及<@gd.key>使用次数上限</>。
guide_text_medic_use_desc_1.en: Equip tacticals on the Gear screen. Each operator can be equipped with 1 tactical. Every tactical has <@gd.key>different activation criteria</> and <@gd.key>usage limits</>.

guide_text_medic_use_desc_2.cn:
装备战术物品之后，干员会在战斗中符合生效条件的情况下，<@gd.key>自动使用物品</>。
战术物品拥有多种功能，能够帮助您适应多种战斗环境。
guide_text_medic_use_desc_2.en: Once equipped, tacticals are <@gd.key>automatically used</> by the operator when the criteria are met during battle. Tacticals offer plenty of properties useful in various combat scenarios.

guide_text_miasma_guideline_desc.cn: 侵蚀瘴中的<@gd.key>指引线</>指出了前进的方向，跟随<@gd.key>指引线</>，可以找到侵蚀瘴的源头<@gd.key>裂隙</>。
guide_text_miasma_guideline_desc.en: The <@gd.key>guiding line</> in the Blight Miasma points the way to go. Follow the <@gd.key>guiding line</> to find the source <@gd.key>rift fissure</> of the Blight Miasma.

guide_text_miasma_safe_guideline_desc.cn:
在<@gd.key>应龙桩</>处<@gd.key>开启指引</>后，会出现通往下一个目标处的<@gd.key>指引线</>。
<@gd.key>在侵蚀瘴中迷路时，可以尝试寻找应龙桩并开启指引</>。
guide_text_miasma_safe_guideline_desc.en: Use the <@gd.key>Activate Guide</> feature of an <@gd.key>Yinglung Pillar</> to show a <@gd.key>guiding line</> to the next objective. <@gd.key>When lost in the Blight Miasma, look for an Yinglung Pillar and use its Activate Guide feature.</>

guide_text_miasma_tips_1.cn: 在<@gd.key>侵蚀瘴</>中的行动会受到<@gd.key>侵蚀瘴耐受值</>的限制。
guide_text_miasma_tips_1.en: <@gd.key>Blight Miasma Tolerance</> determines the length of time you can spend in the <@gd.key>Blight Miasma</>.

guide_text_miasma_tips_2.cn: 身处侵蚀瘴区域，侵蚀瘴耐受值会持续减少，耐受值为零后将无法继续行动，并会返回至最近的应龙桩。
guide_text_miasma_tips_2.en: Standing in Blight Miasma areas will gradually lower Blight Miasma Tolerance. When the tolerance drops to zero, the team can no longer continue and will be forced to retreat to the nearest Yinglung Pillar.

guide_text_miasma_tips_3.cn: <@gd.key>携带</>并<@gd.key>激活</>枢壤仪，可以<@gd.key>增加侵蚀瘴耐受值上限</>，在侵蚀瘴中停留更长时间。
guide_text_miasma_tips_3.en: <@gd.key>Bring a Xiranite Nexus</> and <@gd.key>activate</> it to <@gd.key>raise Blight Miasma Tolerance</>. This will let the team stay in the Blight Miasma longer.

guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5.cn: 可<@gd.key>连续短按</><action=battle_use_char_skill_1>，施放弭弗的<@gd.key>多段战技</>。
guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5.en: <@gd.key>Keep pressing</> <action=battle_use_char_skill_1> to perform the <@gd.key>different moves of Mi Fu's battle skill</>.

guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_ct.cn: 可按住<action=common_indicator_start>并<@gd.key>连续短按</><action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_2>，施放弭弗的<@gd.key>多段战技</>。
guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_ct.en: Press and hold <action=common_indicator_start> and <@gd.key>keep pressing</> <action=battle_use_char_skill_hint_2> to perform the <@gd.key>different moves of Mi Fu's battle skill</>.

guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_desc.cn: 弭弗和管理员救人心切。在后续的剧情战斗中，主控干员的<@ba.key>重击</>将会对目标施加<@ba.key>4层破防</>。
guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_desc.en: The Endministrator and Mi Fu are eager to save the VIP. For battles of this story mission, the controlled operator's <@ba.key>Final Strike</> will apply <@ba.key>4 Vulnerability stacks</> on the target.

guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_mb.cn: 可<@gd.key>连续点击此处</>，施放弭弗的<@gd.key>多段战技</>。
guide_text_mifu_c31m1d5_mb.en: <@gd.key>Keep tapping here</> to perform the <@gd.key>different moves of Mi Fu's battle skill</>.
