guide_text_show_electric_out_1.cn: 目前集成工业系统的发电功率严重不足！
guide_text_show_electric_out_1.en: The AIC power output is too low!

guide_text_show_electric_out_2.cn:
请尽快放置<@gd.key>热能池</>并接入电网，提升集成工业系统的发电功率。
也可以临时关闭部分设备，降低耗电功率。
guide_text_show_electric_out_2.en: Please place <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</> and connect them to the power grid to raise AIC power output. Certain facilities can be switched off to reduce power consumption.

guide_text_signal_tower_desc.cn:
当<@gd.key>塔塔</>接入源石研究园的<@gd.key>协议通讯信号塔</>后，该区域的<@gd.key>所有侵蚀核心</>都会暴露出来。
若在后续区域遇到动态侵蚀，则也需要<@gd.key>塔塔再次接入协议通讯信号塔</>进行解析。
请破坏暴露出的侵蚀核心，消除侵蚀。
guide_text_signal_tower_desc.en:
Connecting <@gd.key>Tata</> to the <@gd.key>Protocom Signal Tower</> of the Originium Science Park has exposed <@gd.key>all Blight Cores</> in this area.
<@gd.key>Connecting Tata to the local Protocom Signal Tower</> will be necessary to decrypt other Active Blight masses in subsequent areas.
Destroy the exposed Blight Cores and eliminate the Blight.

guide_text_simulation_traning_1.cn: 演武平台已启动，现在可以进行演算了。
guide_text_simulation_traning_1.en: The Arena has been activated. The Trial may begin.

guide_text_simulation_traning_10.cn: 每次演算共有<@gd.key>5次</>抽取机会，可以随时停手开始演算挑战。
guide_text_simulation_traning_10.en: You can make <@gd.key>5</> draws per Trial. You can also stop drawing and challenge the Trial anytime you want.

guide_text_simulation_traning_11.cn: 进入演算挑战后还可以进行编队替换，现在请按下此处<@gd.key>开始挑战</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_11.en: Once a Trial begins, you can also change your team composition. Press this to <@gd.key>start the challenge</>.

guide_text_simulation_traning_11_ct.cn: 进入演算挑战后还可以进行编队替换，现在请按下<action=simulation_training_main_start_challenge><@gd.key>开始挑战</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_11_ct.en: Once a Trial begins, the team composition can still be changed. Press <action=simulation_training_main_start_challenge> to <@gd.key>start the challenge</>.

guide_text_simulation_traning_12.cn: 数据铭牌上的所有敌人会同时发起进攻，将他们全部击败后，即可获得奖励。
guide_text_simulation_traning_12.en: Every enemy listed on the Dataplate(s) will attack at once. Defeat them all to earn the rewards.

guide_text_simulation_traning_13.cn: 数据溢出后，演算奖励回滚，并且开启惩罚使得挑战难度增加
guide_text_simulation_traning_13.en: Data Overflow will roll back Trial rewards and apply a penalty that makes the battle more difficult.

guide_text_simulation_traning_2.cn: 请先按下此处，从牌库中抽取一张<@gd.key>数据铭牌</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_2.en: Press here to draw a <@gd.key>Dataplate</> from the deck.

guide_text_simulation_traning_2_ct.cn: 请先按下<action=simulation_training_main_draw>，从牌库中抽取一张<@gd.key>数据铭牌</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_2_ct.en: Press <action=simulation_training_main_draw> to draw a <@gd.key>Dataplate</> from the deck.

guide_text_simulation_traning_3.cn: 每张数据铭牌上都包含一组敌人，以及敌人对应的<@gd.key>战力点</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_3.en: Every Dataplate includes an enemy set and its matching <@gd.key>Battle Points</>.

guide_text_simulation_traning_4.cn: 数据铭牌的<@gd.key>战力点数之和</>，决定了本次演算成功后获取的奖励数额。
guide_text_simulation_traning_4.en: The <@gd.key>sum of Battle Points</> on the Dataplates determines the amount of rewards earned from a successfully completed Trial.

guide_text_simulation_traning_5.cn: 当战力点数达到<@gd.key>10点</>时，奖励数额最高！
guide_text_simulation_traning_5.en: Rewards are maxed at <@gd.key>10</> Battle Points!

guide_text_simulation_traning_6.cn: 但请注意，铭牌上的战力点数之和超过10点时，会触发<@gd.key>数据溢出</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_6.en: Be warned: <@gd.key>Data Overflow</> happens when total Dataplate Battle Points exceeds 10.

guide_text_simulation_traning_7.cn: 数据溢出后战力点数回滚，不仅会导致奖励数额减少，还会增加惩罚，使得战斗难度大幅上升。
guide_text_simulation_traning_7.en: Data Overflow will roll back the Battle Points, reduce the amount of rewards that can be earned, and apply a penalty that makes the battle a lot more difficult.

guide_text_simulation_traning_8.cn: 所以请谨慎判断，是否要进行下一张数据铭牌的抽取。
guide_text_simulation_traning_8.en: So think carefully before drawing the next Dataplate.

guide_text_simulation_traning_9.cn: 当前的战力点之和还远不到溢出的状态，请再按下此处进行一次抽取。
guide_text_simulation_traning_9.en: Current sum of Battle Points is far from the Data Overflow limit. Press this to draw again.

guide_text_simulation_traning_9_ct.cn: 当前的战力点之和还远不到溢出的状态，请再按下<action=simulation_training_main_draw>进行一次抽取。
guide_text_simulation_traning_9_ct.en: Current sum of Battle Points is far from the Data Overflow limit. Press <action=simulation_training_main_draw> to draw again.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_1.cn: 升级演武平台操作等级到2级后，可以使用<@gd.key>“奖励翻倍”</>使得该局演算的奖励翻倍。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_1.en: Upgrading the Trial Arena to operations level 2 adds the <@gd.key>Rewards Doubling</> feature that can double the rewards of a Trial attempt.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_2.cn: “奖励翻倍”次数每日有限，在抽取至少一张铭牌后可开启，且仅能在<@gd.key>第三次抽取铭牌前</>调整，请管理员仔细思考判断使用时机，最大化收益。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_2.en: There is a daily usage limit for "Rewards Doubling". It can be activated after drawing at least 1 Dataplate, and activation can be adjusted <@gd.key>before drawing the 3rd Dataplate</>. Think carefully on its use to maximize the rewards.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_3.cn: 对抽牌结果不满意时，也可以按下此处<@gd.key>放弃</>当前抽出的数据铭牌。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_3.en: If the draw is unsatisfactory, click <@gd.key>Abandon</> to abandon the current Dataplate(s) drawn.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_3_c.cn: 对抽牌结果不满意时，也可以按下<action=simulation_training_main_give_up><@gd.key>放弃</>当前抽出的数据铭牌。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_3_c.en: If the draw is unsatisfactory, press <action=simulation_training_main_give_up> to <@gd.key>abandon</> the current Dataplate(s) drawn.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_4.cn: “放弃”次数每日有限，使用后再次放弃将会<@gd.key>消耗本日的奖励演算次数</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_4.en: There is a daily usage limit for "Abandon". Once used up, abandoning again will <@gd.key>consume your daily rewarded trial attempts</>.

guide_text_simulation_traning_double_5.cn: 每日的奖励演算次数用完后，会进入<@gd.key>自由演算模式</>。
guide_text_simulation_traning_double_5.en: Using up daily rewarded trials activates <@gd.key>Free Trial Mode</>.

guide_text_simulation_traning_unlimited.cn: 每日的奖励演算次数用完后，会进入<@gd.key>自由演算模式</>。该模式无调度券演算奖励，可无限次游玩。
guide_text_simulation_traning_unlimited.en: Using up daily rewarded trials activates <@gd.key>Free Trial Mode</>. There is no limit for attempting Free Trial Mode but it rewards no stock bills upon successful completion.

guide_text_simulationtraining_tower_1.cn: 这片高台区域已经过处理，可放置作战设备，请试试使用作战设备辅助战斗吧。
guide_text_simulationtraining_tower_1.en: This elevated area has been engineered to accommodate combat facilities. Try placing them to support the battle.

guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_1.cn:
在进行先行解锁后，为您开放了一批<@gd.key>先行解锁设备</>的使用权限。
部分<@gd.key>基础工业计划</>中涉及的工业设备，已可在<@gd.key>武陵</>地区提前使用。
并且同步也发放了一定数量的工业设备与<@gd.key>工业产物</>，便于进行工业生产。
guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_1.en: After selecting Early Unlock, you will gain the authority level for using <@gd.key>Early Unlock Facilities</> (that includes several AIC Factory facilities of the <@gd.key>Basic AIC Plan</>) in the <@gd.key>Wuling</> region. You will also receive a number of AIC Factory buildings and <@gd.key>AIC factory products</> to expedite the setting up of your factory.

guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_2.cn:
<@gd.key>先行解锁设备</>目前只能在<@gd.key>武陵</>地区放置。
只有当解锁<@gd.key>基础工业计划</>中对应的工业技术后，才可以在<@gd.key>四号谷地</>地区放置。
guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_2.en: <@gd.key>Early Unlock Facilities</> can only be placed in the <@gd.key>Wuling</> region. The corresponding AIC technology of the <@gd.key>Basic AIC Plan</> must be unlocked before these facilities can be placed in the <@gd.key>Valley IV</> region.

guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_3.cn:
可在<@gd.key>武陵</>地区正常使用和分享包含<@gd.key>先行解锁设备</>的蓝图。
同时，所有<@gd.key>先行解锁设备</>涉及的<@gd.key>模拟空间</>都已解锁，可前往学习相关工业知识。
guide_text_skipchapter_building_desc_3.en: You can use and share blueprints containing <@gd.key>Early Unlock Facilities</> normally in the <@gd.key>Wuling</> region. All <@gd.key>simulations</> related to the <@gd.key>Early Unlock Facilities</> have been unlocked as well. Use these simulations to learn how to setup your AIC Factory.

guide_text_skipchapter_building_title_2.cn: 先行解锁设备 - 放置限制

guide_text_skipchapter_building_title_3.cn: 先行解锁设备 - 蓝图与模拟空间
guide_text_skipchapter_building_title_3.en: Early Unlock Facilities: Blueprints and Simulations

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1.cn: 已解锁<@gd.key>素材转化</>功能，可按下快捷键<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1.en: The <@gd.key>Transmute</> feature has been unlocked. Press the hotkey <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1_ct.cn: 已解锁<@gd.key>素材转化</>功能，可按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>，并打开<@gd.key>背包</>。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1_ct.en: The <@gd.key>Transmute</> feature has been unlocked. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</> and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</>.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1_mb.cn: 已解锁<@gd.key>素材转化</>功能，可点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_1_mb.en: The <@gd.key>Transmute</> feature has been unlocked. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_2.cn: 请点击此处，进入简易制作系统，查看<@gd.key>素材转化</>。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_2.en: Click here to open the Crafting screen, then open the <@gd.key>Transmute</> tab.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=inv_enter_craft>，进入简易制作系统，查看<@gd.key>素材转化</>。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_2_ct.en: Press <action=inv_enter_craft> to open the Crafting screen, then open the <@gd.key>Transmute</> tab.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_3.cn: 请点击此处，选中<@gd.key>素材转化</>。

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_3_ct.cn: 当前已为您选中<@gd.key>素材转化</>。

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_4.cn: 在<@gd.key>素材转化</>中，可将较高等级的培养素材转化为更低等级的对应素材。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_4.en: <@gd.key>Transmute</> is a feature that transmutes higher tier progression materials into lower tier counterparts.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_5.cn: 可在此处选择是否消耗理智以提高产量。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_5.en: Here, you can choose whether to consume Sanity and boost the yield.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_6.cn: 可使用该功能，快速获取较低等级的培养素材，帮助进行干员和武器的养成。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_6.en: Use this feature to quickly acquire lower tier progression materials for your operators and weapons.

guide_text_skipchapter_convert_7.cn: 在此处选择消耗理智后，可提高素材转化的产量。
guide_text_skipchapter_convert_7.en: Select this to consume sanity to boost the materials yield from the Transmute action.

guide_text_snapshot_formation_1.cn: 在拍照模式中，可在此处查看并编辑<@gd.key>合影站位</>。
guide_text_snapshot_formation_1.en: Camera mode has various <@gd.key>group poses</> that can be used and edited.

guide_text_snapshot_formation_1_1_ct.cn: 请按下<action=snapshot_tab_next>，在此处查看并编辑<@gd.key>合影站位</>。
guide_text_snapshot_formation_1_1_ct.en: Press <action=snapshot_tab_next> to view and edit various <@gd.key>group poses</>.

guide_text_snapshot_formation_1_ct.cn: 在拍照模式中，可以按下<action=snapshot_confirm_focus_menu>展开列表，查看更多功能。
guide_text_snapshot_formation_1_ct.en: In Camera mode, press <action=snapshot_confirm_focus_menu> to expand a list of various photography options.

guide_text_snapshot_formation_2.cn: 可在此处切换<@gd.key>站位类型</>。

guide_text_sns_1.cn: Baker是塔卫二常用的聊天软件，许多人使用Baker进行日常通讯。
guide_text_sns_1.en: Baker is a popular chat application of Talos-II. Many people use Baker to send (toast) messages to each other.

guide_text_sns_2.cn: 点击联系人列表，可以查看特定联系人或群组的消息。
guide_text_sns_2.en: Click on the contact list to view the Baker contacts or chat groups (Bakeries).

guide_text_sns_3.cn: 您可以多多注意各类通讯。
guide_text_sns_3.en: Keep an eye out for incoming toasts and Bakery invitations.

guide_text_soil_liquid_plant_desc_1.cn: 部分田块只能在<@gd.key>武陵地区</>种植，比如<@gd.key>金石稻田块</>。
guide_text_soil_liquid_plant_desc_1.en: Some planting plots can only be grown in <@gd.key>Wuling</>. An example will be the <@gd.key>Amber Rice Plot</>.

guide_text_soil_liquid_plant_desc_2.cn: 部分田块需要进行<@gd.key>多次浇水</>，利用<@gd.key>洒水机</>可实现自动化浇水。
guide_text_soil_liquid_plant_desc_2.en: Some plots require <@gd.key>multiple rounds of watering</> to make the plant grow. Use <@gd.key>Sprinklers</> to automate the watering step.

guide_text_spaceship_build_1.cn: 在帝江号中，我们可以建造各类<@gd.key>功能舱室</>来辅助塔卫二的探索。
guide_text_spaceship_build_1.en: We can construct various <@gd.key>functional cabins</> aboard Dijiang to support our exploration of Talos-II.

guide_text_spaceship_build_2.cn: <@gd.key>制造舱</>可以生产培养干员的重要材料，为干员提供稳定的经验成长。
guide_text_spaceship_build_2.en: The <@gd.key>Manufacturing Cabin</> can produce important operator progression materials to give operators a steady source of EXP.

guide_text_spaceship_build_3.cn: 这里显示了建造制造舱的所需材料，这些<@gd.key>航天建材</>可以在塔卫二的<@gd.key>资源回收站</>中获得。
guide_text_spaceship_build_3.en: These are the materials needed to construct the Manufacturing Cabin. <@gd.key>Aerospace Materials</> can be acquired from <@gd.key>Recycling Stations</> of Talos-II.

guide_text_spaceship_build_4.cn: 拥有足够的建设材料后，点击<@gd.key>建造</>按钮就可以建造舱室了。
guide_text_spaceship_build_4.en: After acquiring enough construction materials, click the <@gd.key>Construct</> button to build the cabin.

guide_text_spaceship_build_4_ct.cn: 拥有足够的建设材料后，按下<action=common_confirm>就可以建造舱室了。
guide_text_spaceship_build_4_ct.en: After acquiring enough construction materials, press <action=common_confirm> to build the cabin.

guide_text_spaceship_build_des_1.cn: 在探索时，可以从<@gd.key>资源回收站</>获得航天建材。
guide_text_spaceship_build_des_1.en: During exploration, we might find <@gd.key>Recycling Stations</> that provide us with Aerospace Materials.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_1.cn: 您可以在总控中枢的<@gd.key>中控台</>查看帝江号的整体信息，并进行所有舱室的进驻管理。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Central Dashboard</> of the Control Nexus to get an overview of Dijiang and manage operator assignments of various cabins.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_2.cn: 将来，您还可以通过提升总控中枢的等级来解锁帝江号更多的功能舱室。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_2.en: The Control Nexus can be upgraded in the future to unlock more functional cabins aboard Dijiang.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_3.cn: 总控中枢承担着帝江号的管理职能，进驻在这里的干员会随时间持续提升与干员之间的<@gd.key>信赖度</>。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_3.en: The Control Nexus is responsible for managing the entirety of Dijiang. Assign operators here to build their <@gd.key>trust</> in the Endministrator.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_4.cn: 当您不在帝江号时，<@gd.key>信赖度</>也会持续累积，并在您下次返回帝江号时获取。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_4.en: Even if the Endministrator is not aboard Dijiang, <@gd.key>trust</> will continue to build up. Accumulated trust will be added when the Endministrator visits Dijiang again.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_5.cn: 离开前，请别忘了将空闲的干员进驻到此处来提升信赖。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_5.en: Before leaving the ship, don't forget to assign idle operators to the Control Nexus to build up their trust.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_6.cn: 在总控中枢进驻的干员同样会随时间消耗<@gd.key>心情</>。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_6.en: Operators assigned to the Control Nexus will also slowly lose <@gd.key>mood</> over time.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_7.cn: 当心情<@gd.key>耗尽</>后干员会自行前往中心大厅进行<@gd.key>休息</>，且期间不会获得进驻效果。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_7.en: An operator with <@gd.key>zero</> mood will automatically head to the Central Ring to <@gd.key>rest</>, and will not receive any assignment effects during rest.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_8.cn: 休息中的干员会随时间恢复心情，干员在心情<@gd.key>完全恢复</>后会<@gd.key>自动返回工作</>。与干员交互也可以让其提前返回。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_8.en: Operators will slowly regain their mood when resting. Once <@gd.key>mood is fully restored</>, the operator will <@gd.key>automatically return to work</>. The Endministrator may interact with operators and ask them to get back to work earlier.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_9.cn: 请点击此处，为总控中枢进驻干员。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_9.en: Click here to assign operators to the Control Nexus.

guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_9_ct.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>为总控中枢进驻干员。
guide_text_spaceship_controlcenter_9_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to assign operators to the Control Nexus.

guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1.cn: 已解锁了多个地区仓库，在帝江号上可以在此处手动切换当前连接的地区仓库进行管理。
guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1.en: Multiple regional depots have been unlocked. When aboard Dijiang, use this to manually switch between these depots and manage them accordingly.

guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1_1_ct.cn: 长按<action=inv_open_depot_switch>进行仓库切换，手动切换当前连接的地区仓库进行管理。
guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1_1_ct.en: Press and hold <action=inv_open_depot_switch> to switch between depots. Manually switch and connect to a regional depot to manage it.

guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1_ct.cn: 已解锁了多个地区仓库，请按下<action=common_switch_area_prev ignoreOverrideIcon=true>切换到仓库。
guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_1_ct.en: Multiple regional depots have been unlocked. Press <action=common_switch_area_prev ignoreOverrideIcon=true> to switch to Depot.

guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_2.cn: 选择希望与帝江号相连的仓库，按下确定按钮即可切换。
guide_text_spaceship_depot_switch_2.en: Select the depot to connect to Dijiang and use the Confirm button to switch.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_1.cn: 旅途中收集到的各类<@gd.key>陈列品</>可以放置在行迹高塔中进行展示。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_1.en: Various <@gd.key>display items</> may be collected during exploration. These can be showcased at the Tower of Trails.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_2.cn: 点击展位按钮或两侧的箭头可以切换查看不同的展位，每个展位可放置一个陈列品。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_2.en: Click the display slot button or the arrows on two sides to switch between display slots. A display item can be placed in each display slot.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_2_ct.cn: 使用<action=common_toggle_group_previous_include_pc>和<action=common_toggle_group_next_include_pc>可以切换查看不同的展位，每个展位可放置一个陈列品。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_2_ct.en: Use <action=common_toggle_group_previous_include_pc> and <action=common_toggle_group_next_include_pc> to switch between display slots. A display item can be placed in each display slot.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_3.cn: 请点击按钮来为当前展位设定要展示的陈列品。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_3.en: Click the button to select a display item for this slot.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_3_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_confirm>为当前展位设定要展示的陈列品。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_3_ct.en: Press <action=common_confirm> to select a display item for this slot.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_4.cn: 这里可以看到当前拥有的所有陈列品，点击陈列品可查看其详细说明并预览放置的效果。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_4.en: This shows all display items currently owned. Click on a display item for details and preview the display effects when placed in a display slot.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_4_ct.cn: 这里可以看到当前拥有的所有陈列品，切换至陈列品可查看其详细说明并预览放置的效果。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_4_ct.en: This shows all the display items you have. Switch to the display item to look at their details and preview the placement effects.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_5.cn: 陈列品没有实际的加成效果，标签只影响不同爱好的干员在查看此陈列品时可能的差异表现。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_5.en: Display items offer no tangible bonuses. Their tags would only affect operator reactions when operators of different hobbies look at the display items.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_6.cn: 选择陈列品后点击确认按钮即可进行保存。收集到新的陈列品后别忘了来此放置展示，来访的好友也可以看到哦。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_6.en: Select the display item and click the Confirm button to save the selection. Do not forget to edit the showcase when new display items are collected. Display items being showcased can also be admired by friends.

guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_6_ct.cn: 选择陈列品后按下<action=common_confirm>即可进行保存。收集到新的陈列品后别忘了来此放置展示，来访的好友也可以看到哦。
guide_text_spaceship_exhibition_6_ct.en: Select the display item and press <action=common_confirm> to save the settings. When you acquire new display items, do not forget to showcase them here. Visitors will also see your showcase as well.

guide_text_spaceship_gender_change1_desc.cn: 前往帝江号<@gd.key>静滞核心</>，触摸协议奇点，可以切换管理员的身份。
guide_text_spaceship_gender_change1_desc.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Stasis Core</> aboard Dijiang and touch the Protocol Singularity to switch the Endministrator's identity.

guide_text_spaceship_gender_change2_desc.cn: 触摸<@gd.key>协议奇点，可以切换管理员的身份</>。
guide_text_spaceship_gender_change2_desc.en: Touch the <@gd.key>Protocol Singularity to switch the Endministrator's identity</>.

guide_text_spaceship_gender_change2_desc.cn: 进行一次身份切换后，协议奇点的这一功能需要一段时间后才能再次使用。
guide_text_spaceship_gender_change2_desc.en: After using the identity switching function of the Protocol Singularity, the function cannot be used again until its cooldown ends.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_1.cn: <@gd.key>培养舱</>可以生产干员突破、技能提升、武器进阶等培养素材。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_1.en: The <@gd.key>Growth Chamber</> can be used to grow progression materials for operator promotions, skill upgrades, and weapon tuning.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_10.cn: 您刚刚已获得了一些<@gd.key>基核</>，请点击栏位开始进行培养吧。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_10.en: <@gd.key>Seeds</> acquired. Click on a slot to start growing them.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_10_ct.cn: 您刚刚已获得了一些<@gd.key>基核</>，请按下<action=ss_open_detail_navi>开始进行培养吧。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_10_ct.en: <@gd.key>Seeds</> acquired. Press <action=ss_open_detail_navi> to start growing them.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_2.cn: 与制造舱相同，培养舱也需要进驻干员才可以运转，在界面左侧可安排<@gd.key>干员进驻</>。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_2.en: Like the Manufacturing Cabin, assign operators to the Growth Chamber to start work. Use the left side of the screen to <@gd.key>assign operators</>.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_3.cn: 进驻的干员可以为培养带来额外的效能提升，但会随时间消耗<@gd.key>心情</>。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_3.en: Assign operators to improve growth performance. However, these operators will slowly lose <@gd.key>mood</> over time.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_4.cn: 当心情<@gd.key>耗尽</>后干员会自行前往中央环厅进行<@gd.key>休息</>，且期间将无法提供进驻效果。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_4.en: An operator with <@gd.key>zero</> mood will automatically head to the Central Ring to <@gd.key>rest</>, and will not provide any assignment effects during resting.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_5.cn: 休息中的干员会随时间恢复心情，当干员心情<@gd.key>回满</>后也会<@gd.key>自动返回舱室进行工作</>。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_5.en: Operators will slowly regain their mood when resting. Once <@gd.key>mood is maxed</>, the operator will <@gd.key>automatically return to the cabin to work</>.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_6.cn: 界面右侧显示了当前的培养情况，点击各栏位可进行方案选择。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_6.en: The right side of the screen shows the current Growth Chamber status. Click on each slot to select the growing options.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_6_ct.cn: 界面右侧显示了当前的培养情况，按下<action=ss_open_detail_navi>可选择各栏位并设定培养方案。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_6_ct.en: The right side of the screen shows the current Growth Chamber status. Press <action=ss_open_detail_navi> to choose each slot and select the growing options.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_7.cn: 请注意，在培养舱进行培养还需用到一种特殊材料——<@gd.key>基核</>。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_7.en: Note that growing materials at the Growth Chamber also requires special <@gd.key>seed</> materials.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_8.cn: <@gd.key>基核</>可以从原有材料中提取获得，但同时也会消耗掉原有材料。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_8.en: <@gd.key>Seeds</> can be extracted from existing materials, but this also consumes the original material.

guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_9.cn: 在材料耗尽前，请别忘了多提取一些基核用于持续培养。
guide_text_spaceship_growcabin_9.en: Don't forget to extract more seeds before the materials run out so that more materials can be grown.

guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_1.cn: 与正在帝江号上活动的干员互动，可以与干员对话或送礼给干员。
guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_1.en: Interact with operators aboard Dijiang to talk to them or offer them gifts.

guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_2.cn: 赠送礼物可以提升干员对管理员的<@gd.key>信赖度</>。注意干员只会接受符合其爱好的礼物。
guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_2.en: Gifts will build the operators' <@gd.key>trust</> in the Endministrator. Operators will only accept gifts that match their hobbies.

guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_3.cn: 礼物可在<@gd.key>物资调度</>中购买获得，赠送符合干员产地偏好的礼物能提升更多信赖度。
guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_3.en: Gifts can be purchased from <@gd.key>Stock Redistribution</>. Offer gifts that operators prefer to build trust with them.

guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_4.cn: 想要快速找到某位干员，还可在中央环厅的<@gd.key>干员联络台</>处将其直接召集到身边。
guide_text_spaceship_interaction_des_4.en: To find an operator quickly, use the <@gd.key>Operator Contact Panel</> at the Central Ring to contact and summon them to the Endministrator's side.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_1.cn: 与制造舱内的<@gd.key>控制台</>交互可以使用该舱室的功能或对舱室进行升级。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_1.en: Interact with the <@gd.key>control panel</> of the Manufacturing Cabin to upgrade it or use its functions.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_10.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>确定</>按钮完成进驻。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_10.en: Click the <@gd.key>Confirm</> button to complete the assignment.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_11.cn: 现在制造舱的进驻人员已就绪，可以安排生产了。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_11.en: The Manufacturing Cabin now has an assigned operator. Manufacturing can now be arranged.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_12.cn: 接下来，请点击<@gd.key>选择方案</>按钮来设定生产内容。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_12.en: Next, click the <@gd.key>Select Plan</> button to set up manufacturing.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_12_ct.cn: 接下来，请按下<action=common_confirm>设定生产内容。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_12_ct.en: Next, press <action=common_confirm> to set up manufacturing.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_13.cn: 我们可以在制造舱中生产<@gd.key>干员培养素材</>和<@gd.key>武器培养素材</>来提供额外的<@gd.key>经验</>成长。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_13.en: We can manufacture <@gd.key>operator progression materials</> and <@gd.key>weapon progression materials</> at the Manufacturing Cabin. These items can give operators and weapons <@gd.key>EXP</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_14.cn: 这里显示了生产所需的时间，在舱室中进驻更多干员可缩短此时间。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_14.en: This shows the time needed for manufacturing. Assign more operators to the cabin to shorten this time.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_15.cn: 在这里可以选择要本次要制造的数量。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_15.en: Use this section to select the amount to manufacture.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_16.cn: 注意单次可设定的最大数量与制造舱的总<@gd.key>生产载荷</>以及当前方案每个物品的占用载荷有关。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_16.en: Note the <@gd.key>MFG Load</> of the cabin. This determines the maximum amount of items that can be made at once. Different items also use up different amounts of the MFG Load.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_17.cn: 请点击此处将数量设为<@gd.key>最大</>。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_17.en: Click here to set the amount to <@gd.key>max</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_17_ct.cn: 按下<action=common_num_add>可以增加生产的数量。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_17_ct.en: Press <action=common_num_add> to increase the amount to manufacture.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_18.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>确认</>按钮完成设定。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_18.en: Click the <@gd.key>Confirm</> button to complete the setup.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_19.cn: 现在制造舱已经开始生产了。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_19.en: The Manufacturing Cabin is now manufacturing.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_2.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>查看制造</>按钮打开制造舱界面。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_2.en: Click the <@gd.key>view manufacturing</> button to open the Manufacturing Cabin panel.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_20.cn: 在这里可以看到，进驻在制造舱中的干员可以为生产带来额外的效能提升，但会随时间消耗<@gd.key>心情</>。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_20.en: Here we can see that operators assigned to the Manufacturing Cabin will improve its performance. However, these operators will slowly lose <@gd.key>mood</> over time.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_21.cn: 当心情<@gd.key>耗尽</>后干员会自行前往中央环厅进行<@gd.key>休息</>并恢复心情，且期间将无法提供进驻效果。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_21.en: An operator with <@gd.key>zero</> mood will automatically head to the Central Ring to <@gd.key>rest</> and restore their mood. A resting operator will not provide any assignment effects.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_22.cn: 不过别担心，在干员心情<@gd.key>完全恢复</>后也会<@gd.key>自动返回舱室进行工作</>。与干员交互也可让其提前返回。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_22.en: Don't worry. When mood is <@gd.key>fully restored</>, the operator will <@gd.key>automatically return to the cabin and continue their work</>. The Endministrator may also choose to interact with resting operators and tell them to head back to work early.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_23.cn: 制造还需要花费一点时间，我们稍后再回到这里进行收取吧。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_23.en: Manufacturing will take a while. Let's come back here after a while to collect the items.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_3.cn: <@gd.key>制造舱</>可以随时间生产干员培养素材，为干员提供经验。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_3.en: The <@gd.key>Manufacturing Cabin</> can produce operator progression materials when given enough time.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_4.cn: 界面左侧显示了制造舱当前的进驻信息，注意功能舱室<@gd.key>至少要进驻1名干员才能正常运转</>。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_4.en: The left side of the screen shows the current operator assignment of the Manufacturing Cabin. Note that functional cabins must have <@gd.key>at least 1 operator assigned to start working</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_5.cn: 界面右侧显示了制造舱当前的生产情况，干员进驻后将自动按照<@gd.key>选定的方案和数量</>开始生产。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_5.en: The right side of the screen shows the manufacturing status of the Manufacturing Cabin. Once at least an operator has been assigned, work will start on the <@gd.key>specified manufacturing plan</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_6.cn: 请点击此处选择要<@gd.key>进驻</>的干员。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_6.en: Click here to select the operators to <@gd.key>assign</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_6_ct.en: Press <action=ss_occupancy_manage> to select the operators to <@gd.key>assign</>.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_7.cn: 我们可以安排已获得的干员进驻到帝江号中以获取对应的效果。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_7.en: We can assign operators available to Dijiang to acquire various bonuses and effects.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_8.cn: 在<@gd.key>制造舱</>进驻的每个干员都可以提升舱室的<@gd.key>生产效能</>，从而<@gd.key>缩短</>生产培养素材所需的时间。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_8.en: Every operator assigned to the <@gd.key>Manufacturing Cabin</> will raise its <@gd.key>productivity</> and <@gd.key>shorten</> the time needed to manufacture the progression materials.

guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_9.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>干员头像</>进行选择。
guide_text_spaceship_manufacturing_9.en: Click on the <@gd.key>operator's portrait</> to select the operator.

guide_text_spaceship_present_1.cn: 给干员赠送礼物可以提升干员对管理员的<@gd.key>信赖度</>。
guide_text_spaceship_present_1.en: Gifts will raise the operators' <@gd.key>trust</> in their Endministrator.

guide_text_spaceship_present_2.cn: 在这里可以查看干员的<@gd.key>爱好</>。礼物也会有带有此类标签。注意干员<@gd.key>只会接受符合其爱好的礼物</>。
guide_text_spaceship_present_2.en: These tags indicate what the operator <@gd.key>likes</>. Gifts will also carry these tags. Note that operators will <@gd.key>only accept gifts that match their hobbies</>.

guide_text_spaceship_present_3.cn: 这里显示了干员的礼物<@gd.key>偏好类型</>，赠送符合干员偏好的礼物可提供<@gd.key>更多信赖度</>。
guide_text_spaceship_present_3.en: This shows the operator's <@gd.key>preferences</> for gifts. Offering gifts that match the operator's preferences will earn <@gd.key>more trust</> with them.

guide_text_spaceship_present_4.cn: 每天给同一位干员赠送礼物可提升的信赖度有上限。
guide_text_spaceship_present_4.en: There is a limit to the amount of trust that can be earned to an operator by gifting.

guide_text_spaceship_present_5.cn: 且当天提升的信赖度每达到一档，继续送礼的收益也会逐渐减少，请注意合理分配。
guide_text_spaceship_present_5.en: Once the daily trust increase reaches a certain tier, the amount of trust earned by additional gifts will decrease. Given these diminishing returns, try to spread the gifts to maximize trust building.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_1.cn: 会客室的<@gd.key>传送台</>已经开启了，有空不妨去好友的飞船转转。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_1.en: The <@gd.key>TP Platform</> in the Reception Room is now active. Try using it to visit a friend's ship.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_2.cn: 为好友的舱室提供<@gd.key>生产助力</>还可以获得<@gd.key>信用</>奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_2.en: Provide <@gd.key>Production Assists</> to a friend's cabins to get rewarded with <@gd.key>credits</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_3.cn: 在<@gd.key>信用交易所</>中，可使用<@gd.key>信用</>兑换干员养成材料、武器养成材料、<@gd.key>武库配额</>等重要资源。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_3.en: <@gd.key>Credits</> can be spent at the <@gd.key>Credit Store</> to buy key resources that include operator progression materials, weapon progression materials, and <@gd.key>Arsenal Tickets</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_4.cn: 请按下<action=common_open_watch>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开协议同步器。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_4.en: Press <action=common_open_watch> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the Protosync.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_4_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_open_watch>打开协议同步器。

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_4_mb.cn: 请点击此处打开协议同步器。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_4_mb.en: Tap here to open the Protosync.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_5_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to go to the <@gd.key>Acquisition Center</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_6.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>信用交易所</>页签。

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_6_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_toggle_group_previous>前往<@gd.key>信用交易所</>页签。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_6_ct.en: Press <action=common_toggle_group_previous> to go to the <@gd.key>Credit Store</> tab.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 在会客室情报区可进行<@gd.key>线索收集</>并获取<@gd.key>信用奖励</>。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Use the Reception Room Intel Section to <@gd.key>collect clues</> and earn <@gd.key>credits</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 线索共有<@gd.key>7种类型</>，在<@gd.key>集齐所有类型线索</>并放入对应的栏位后可开展<@gd.key>情报交流</>并立刻获得大量信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: There are <@gd.key>7 types</> of clues. <@gd.key>Collect clues of every type</> and place them in the proper slots to start <@gd.key>Clue Exchange</> and immediately get a large sum of credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 情报交流本身也会<@gd.key>持续一段时间</>，期间有<@gd.key>好友参与</>还可提供更多额外的信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Clue Exchange will <@gd.key>last for a while</>. Having <@gd.key>friends participate</> in the Clue Exchange will provide additional credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 好友之间可通过线索的传递来互取所需，更快完成所有线索的收集。<@gd.key>接收和赠予线索</>也都可以获得信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Friends can also send and receive clues from each other to complete their clue collections quickly. Credits can also be earned by <@gd.key>sending or receiving clues</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 好友赠予的线索会存入<@gd.key>接收线索库</>，不占用自有线索库的容量，但有<@gd.key>生效期限</>。获取后可在线索库中进行查看。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Clues received from friends will be placed in the <@gd.key>incoming clue library</> and will not take up space of the local clue library. However, received clues will <@gd.key>expire</>. Check the clue library for more details.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 与其他舱室相同，会客室也需要<@gd.key>进驻干员</>才可以运转。在界面左侧可安排进驻。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Like other cabins, operators must be <@gd.key>assigned</> to the Reception Room to start work. Use the left side of the screen to assign operators.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 进驻的干员会为线索收集提供效能或概率加成，并随时间消耗心情。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Operators assigned to the Reception Room will grant clue collecting efficiency or rate ups for certain clues, but they will also slowly lose mood over time.
Press <action=ss_confirm> to view the clues collected.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 干员进驻并开始工作后会随时间自动进行线索的收集。每次进度满后即可随机获得一张<@gd.key>线索</>。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Once assigned, operators will start working and automatically collect clues with time. Every time the collection progress is full, 1 random <@gd.key>clue</> is acquired.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 干员收集到的线索会自动放入<@gd.key>自有线索库</>中，无需手动收取，当容量到达上限后收集将暂停。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: Clues collected by operators are automatically placed in the <@gd.key>local clue library</>. No manual claiming is required. Collection will pause when this library is at full capacity.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 我们可以将<@gd.key>重复的线索</>回收掉或赠送给好友来给自有线索库留出更多的空间，<@gd.key>回收和赠予</>线索也可获取少量信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: <@gd.key>Duplicate clues</> can be recycled or gifted to friends to make space in the local clue library. <@gd.key>Recycling and gifting</> of clues also provide small sums of credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 在有干员进驻的情况下，会客室每天<@gd.key>固定时间</>也会产出一张线索，需要在此处<@gd.key>手动领取</>。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: With operators assigned, the Reception Room will also collect <@gd.key>1 clue</> at a fixed time every day. This auto-collected clue must be <@gd.key>manually claimed</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.cn: 此外<@gd.key>每获取一张新线索</>，无论是干员收集的还是会客室产出的，都可获得一定的<@gd.key>信用奖励</>。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clue_.en: <@gd.key>Credits</> are earned whenever <@gd.key>1 new clue is collected</>, whether by assigned operators or the Reception Room itself.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.cn: 通过会客室情报区的线索板或总控中枢可打开会客室线索收集界面。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.en: Use the Reception Room Intel Section clue board or Control Nexus to open the Reception Room clue collection screen.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.cn: 将干员进驻在会客室中即可随时间收集线索并获取信用奖励，集齐所有类型线索可开展情报交流。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.en: Operators assigned to the Reception Room will collect clues and earn credits as time passes. Collect clues of every type to initiate Clue Exchange.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.cn: 赠予和接收好友线索，前往好友飞船参与情报交流，还可获得更多信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_clueu.en: Clues can be sent to friends, or received from them. Visit a friend's ship to take part in Clue Exchange to earn more credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 在<@gd.key>信用交易所</>中，可使用<@gd.key>信用</>兑换干员养成材料、武器养成材料、<@gd.key>武库配额</>等重要资源。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: <@gd.key>Credits</> can be spent at the <@gd.key>Credit Store</> to buy key resources that include operator progression materials, weapon progression materials, and <@gd.key>Arsenal Tickets</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 这里列出了当前可兑换的所有商品，选择商品即可查看详情并选择兑换数量。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: This is a list of items that can be exchanged currently. Selecting an item opens up its details and options for choosing the amount to exchange.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 信用交易所的商品每天固定时间会自动刷新。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: Items sold at the Credit Store refresh daily at a fixed schedule.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 此外也可以通过<@gd.key>立即刷新</>按钮手动对商品进行刷新，但手动刷新每天有次数上限且花费的信用递增。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: Use the <@gd.key>Refresh Now</> button to manually refresh the items. However, there is a limit to manual refreshes and every refresh costs increasingly more credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 另外需要注意信用有缓存上限，<@gd.key>溢出的部分每日会被清空</>，请及时使用。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: There is a storage limit for the credits cache. <@gd.key>Credits that exceed this limit will be cleared on the following day</>, so try to spend them on time.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 每天可在信用交易所中领取一次基础信用奖励，当有好友在飞船出售地区货品时还可提供额外的信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: A basic credits reward can be claimed every day at the Credit Store. Earn additional credits when a friend sells regional goods at the ship.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 拜访好友飞船时，对其舱室进行<@gd.key>生产助力</>可获取信用。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: Earn credits by visiting a friend's ship and providing <@gd.key>Production Assists</> to their cabins.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.cn: 后续还可通过线索收集、情报交流以及帮好友完成运送委托等更多方式获得信用。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_credi.en: Other means to earn credits will become available, such as clue collection, clue exchange, and helping friends complete delivery jobs.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.cn: 进驻干员到会客室可开展线索收集和情报交流，并获得信用等奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.en: Operators assigned to the Reception Room can start collecting clues and engage in Clue Exchange to earn credits and other rewards.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.cn: 收集到的蚀刻章、干员履历和武器可在会客室中进行展示，供来访的好友参观。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.en: All engraved medals, operator CVs, and weapons acquired can be showcased at the Display Section of the Reception Room. They can be viewed by visiting friends.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.cn: 在访客终端可查看最近来访的好友信息及其参与的行动（如生产助力等）。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.en: Use the Guest Terminal to view records of friends who visited recently and the activities they took part in (such as production assists).

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.cn: 可通过传送台前往好友飞船进行参观、生产助力等行动，并获得信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_desc_.en: Use the TP Platform to visit a friend's ship and engage in various activities such as production assists and acquire credits by doing so.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 管理员编辑好的蚀刻章排布在会客室的蚀刻章展示墙中会同步展出。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Engraved medal showcase edited and saved by the Endministrator will be displayed at the Medal Display Wall in the Reception Room.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 您也可以通过蚀刻章展示墙对蚀刻章排布再次进行编辑。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: The Medal Display Wall can also be used for arranging and editing engraved medal displays.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 管理员可自由选择希望展示在<@gd.key>干员履历墙</>上的干员。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Endministrator, the <@gd.key>Operator CV Wall</> can be used to showcase various operators in our employment.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 保存编辑后，<@gd.key>干员履历墙</>上会显示对应干员的展示信息。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Once the operator showcase is edited and saved, the <@gd.key>Operator CV Wall</> will display the information of the specified operators.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 管理员可自由选择希望展示在<@gd.key>武器展示墙</>上的武器。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Endministrator, the <@gd.key>Weapon Display Wall</> can be used to showcase various weapons we have.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 点击切换分区按钮，可以快速前往编辑下一类型的武器展示分区。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Click the Switch Area button to quickly go and edit the display area of the next weapon type.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 按下<action=ss_previous_toggle>和<action=ss_next_toggle>可切换分区，快速前往编辑下一类型的武器展示分区。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Press <action=ss_previous_toggle> and <action=ss_next_toggle> to switch between weapon type display areas and edit them accordingly.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 保存编辑后，<@gd.key>武器展示墙</>上会显示对应武器的展示信息。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: Once the weapon showcase is edited and saved, the <@gd.key>Weapon Display Wall</> will display the information of the specified weapons.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.cn: 打开不同类型的武器展示分区，能够快速编辑对应类型的武器展示信息。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_displ.en: The Weapon Display Wall is divided into areas for different weapon types. Each area can be opened to quickly edit the showcase for that weapon type.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 在帝江号会客室的物资调度终端处也可打开物资调度界面。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: You can also access the Stock Redistribution screen through the Stock Redistribution Terminal in the Reception Room of Dijiang.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 在'物资调度终端中可快速查看各地区的弹性需求物资价格并出售库存货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Use the Stock Redistribution Terminal to quickly view the prices of elastic goods at various regions and sell goods in the storage to earn profits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 升级并扩大物资调度的调度范围到等级2即可解锁<@gd.key>弹性需求物资</>。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Raise stock coverage of Stock Redistribution to level 2 to unlock <@gd.key>elastic goods</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 解锁<@gd.key>弹性需求物资</>后还可前往好友飞船，使用物资调度终端并以对方的价格出售自身的库存货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: After unlocking <@gd.key>elastic goods</>, you can visit a friend's ship and use their Stock Redistribution Terminal to sell goods from your storage at their prices.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 弹性需求物资的价格每天会发生波动，好友飞船上的价格与本地也会存在差异。可通过低买高卖以获取利润。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: The prices of elastic goods fluctuate on a daily basis. Prices aboard a friend's ship may also differ from local prices. Buy low and sell high to earn profits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 当有其他好友前来拜访并使用此终端出售货品时，也将根据货品总价值为您提供信用奖励。可通过好友售卖记录进行查看。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Earn credit rewards when a visiting friend sells goods at this terminal. The amount of credits earned is based on the total value of the goods. View the details in the Visitor Sales Log.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 拜访好友，使用好友飞船上的物资调度终端，还可查看<@gd.key>对方的弹性需求物资价格</>，并以该价格出售自身的库存货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: When visiting a friend's ship, use their Stock Redistribution Terminal to view the <@gd.key>prices of elastic goods in their areas</> and even sell goods at their prices.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 在好友飞船上出售货品时，对方还可获得一定的信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Selling goods at a friend's ship also rewards them with credits.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 请点击<@gd.key>好友售卖记录</>按钮。

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Press <action=open_friend_record_panel> to open the <@gd.key>Visitor Sales Log</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 当有其他好友前来拜访并使用此终端出售货品时，也将根据货品总价值为您提供信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: Earn credit rewards when a visiting friend sells goods at this terminal. The amount of credits earned is based on the total value of the goods.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 好友出售货品提供的信用奖励每天有上限且最多保留2天，可前往采购中心-信用交易处进行收取。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: There is a daily limit on the amount of credits earned from friendly sales of goods. Unclaimed credits will only be kept for only 2 days. These rewards can be claimed at Acquisition Center - Credit Store.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.cn: 当弹性需求物资价格高涨的时候，不妨多多邀请好友提醒他们前来出售货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_shops.en: When elastic goods reach high prices, try inviting friends to visit and sell their goods.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 会客室开启后，我们可以通过传送台或好友界面前往<@gd.key>拜访好友飞船</>了。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Once the Reception Room is available, the TP Platform or the Friends screen can be used to <@gd.key>visit a friend's ship</>.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 除了参观外，还可以向好友进行生产助力、出售地区货品等行动来获得<@gd.key>信用</>奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: In addition to touring a friend's ship, a visitor can also provide Production Assists, sell regional goods, and engage in other activities to earn <@gd.key>credit</> rewards.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 每日可进行助力的次数有上限，可在此处查看。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: There is a daily limit to Production Assists. It is shown here.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 当好友飞船有舱室可进行助力时，拜访按钮旁也会有相应的标注。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: When Production Assist can be provided to a cabin of a friend's ship, the Visit button will also be marked accordingly.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 多多添加好友，通过拜访按钮前往对方飞船进行参观和助力吧。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Add some friends, then use the Visit button to visit their ships and offer them assistance.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在好友的飞船中，可进行游览参观、生产助力、出售货品等活动。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Visit a friend's ship for a tour, provide Production Assists, sell various goods, or engage in various activities.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 点击<@gd.key>打开访客终端</>按钮可查看好友飞船各舱室的情况并进行生产助力。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Click the <@gd.key>Guest Terminal</> button to view the statuses of various cabins on the friend's ship and offer Production Assist.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 按下<action=ss_open_visitor_center>可以<@gd.key>打开访客终端</>查看好友飞船各舱室的情况并进行生产助力。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Press <action=ss_open_visitor_center> to <@gd.key>open the Guest Terminal</> and view the statuses of various cabins on the friend's ship and offer Production Assist.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 参与生产助力、情报交流等社交玩法还可获得<@gd.key>信用</>奖励，并为好友提供特定增益。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Social actions such as Production Assists and Clue Exchanges also give <@gd.key>credit</> rewards while giving the recipient friend special buffs.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在好友飞船上可参观查看对方展示的干员留影、蚀刻章、干员履历、武器以及陈列品等内容。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Visit a friend's ship to see the friend's snapshots, engraved medals, operator CVs, weapons, and other display items that they have decided to showcase.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 使用好友飞船上的物资调度终端，可查看对方的弹性需求物资价格并以该价格出售自身的库存货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Use the Stock Redistribution Terminal aboard a friend's ship to check their prices of elastic goods and sell stockpiled goods at their prices.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在访客终端界面中查看好友的舱室情况并进行生产助力、情报交流等活动可获得信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: The Guest Terminal screen shows the statuses of various cabins aboard a friend's ship. Use it to engage in Production Assist, Clue Exchange, and other social activities to earn credit rewards.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 参观游览
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Ship Visits: Touring

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 物资调度终端
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Stock Redistribution Terminal

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 访客终端
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Guest Terminal

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在访客终端界面中可查看好友的舱室情况，进行<@gd.key>生产助力</>、情报交流等活动并获得<@gd.key>信用</>奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: The Guest Terminal screen shows the statuses of various cabins aboard a friend's ship. Use it to engage in <@gd.key>Production Assist</>, Clue Exchange, and other social activities to earn <@gd.key>credit</> rewards.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 这里显示了当前好友飞船中各舱室的情况，当舱室可被助力时会出现<@gd.key>生产助力</>按钮，点击即可进行助力。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: This shows the statuses of various cabins aboard a friend's ship. When a cabin can receive Production Assist, the <@gd.key>Production Assist</> button will appear. Click on it to provide assistance.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 这里显示了当前好友飞船中各舱室的情况，当舱室可被助力时会出现<@gd.key>生产助力</>按钮，按下<action=ss_help_friend_room>即可进行助力。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: This shows the statuses of various cabins aboard a friend's ship. When a cabin can receive Production Assist, the <@gd.key>Production Assist</> button will appear. Press <action=ss_help_friend_room> to provide assistance.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 为好友舱室助力可获得<@gd.key>信用</>奖励，同时使好友获得特定加成效果。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Providing assistance to a friend's cabin offers <@gd.key>credit</> rewards and grants the friend special bonuses.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 每日可进行生产助力的次数有限。在这里可以查看刷新的剩余时间。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: There is a daily limit to Production Assists. This shows the timer for the daily refresh.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在好友飞船的物资调度终端处，可查看<@gd.key>对方的弹性需求物资价格</>，并以该价格出售自身的库存货品。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Use the Stock Redistribution Terminal aboard a friend's ship to <@gd.key>check their prices of elastic goods</> and sell stockpiled goods at their prices.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 在好友飞船出售货品还可为对方提供一定的信用奖励。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Selling goods aboard a friend's ship also provides them with credit rewards.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 通过传送台或访客主界面都可以打开此界面来离开当前好友飞船。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: Use the TP Platform or main screen of the visitor system to open this screen and leave the friend's ship.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 如果希望<@gd.key>继续拜访其他好友</>，可在此列表中进行选择。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: To <@gd.key>visit other friends</>, simply select them from this list.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 如果希望<@gd.key>继续拜访其他好友</>，可在此列表中选择好友再按下<action=friend_cell_select>前往好友飞船。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: To <@gd.key>visit other friends</>, simply select them from this list, then press <action=friend_cell_select> to visit their ship.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 如果希望离开好友的飞船，则可以直接点击<@gd.key>结束拜访</>或<@gd.key>返回帝江号</>按钮。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: To leave a friend's ship, either click the <@gd.key>End Visit</> button or the <@gd.key>Return to Dijiang</> button.

guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.cn: 如果希望离开好友的飞船，则可以直接按下<@gd.key>结束拜访</>或<@gd.key>返回帝江号</>按钮。
guide_text_spaceship_receptionroom_visit.en: To leave a friend's ship, either press the <@gd.key>End Visit</> button or the <@gd.key>Return to Dijiang</> button.

guide_text_spaceship_recyclestation_desc.cn: 建造和升级“帝江号”中的功能舱室都需要使用<@gd.key>航天建材</>。
guide_text_spaceship_recyclestation_desc.en: <@gd.key>Aerospace Materials</> are needed to construct or upgrade functional cabins aboard Dijiang.

guide_text_spaceship_recyclestation_desc.cn: 航天建材可在各地的<@gd.key>资源回收站</>中定期收取获得。
guide_text_spaceship_recyclestation_desc.en: Periodically visit <@gd.key>Recycling Stations</> throughout Talos-II to gather Aerospace Materials.

guide_text_spaceship_unlockarea_desc_1.cn: 随着总控中枢等级的提升，帝江号中的预留区会逐步开放，为建造舱室提供更多可用的空间。
guide_text_spaceship_unlockarea_desc_1.en: Leveling up the Control Nexus also gradually opens up the under maintenance area aboard Dijiang. This frees up more space for constructing more cabins.

guide_text_spaceship_unlockarea_desc_2.cn: 预留区中会有更多可用的<@gd.key>待建舱室</>，拥有足够的航天材料后前往舱门位置即可进行建造。
guide_text_spaceship_unlockarea_desc_2.en: The under maintenance area includes spaces for <@gd.key>unconstructed cabins</>. When there are enough Aerospace Materials, interact with the cabin door and initiate construction.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_1.cn: 请与中控台交互，提升<@gd.key>总控中枢等级</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_1.en: Interact with the Central Dashboard to level up the <@gd.key>Control Nexus</>.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_2.cn: 请按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>并点击此处的<@gd.key>升级</>按钮。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_2.en: Hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click the <@gd.key>Upgrade</> button here.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_interact>对总控中枢进行<@gd.key>升级</>。

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_3.cn: 提升<@gd.key>总控中枢等级</>可以解锁帝江号<@gd.key>更多的功能舱室</>并提升现有舱室<@gd.key>等级上限</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_3.en: Level up the <@gd.key>Control Nexus</> to unlock <@gd.key>more functional cabins</> aboard Dijiang and raise the <@gd.key>level cap</> of existing ones.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_4.cn: 在升级预览中可以看到，将总控中枢升到2级可以解锁<@gd.key>培养舱</>，并提升制造舱的<@gd.key>等级上限</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_4.en: The upgrade preview shows that leveling the Control Nexus to level 2 unlocks the <@gd.key>Growth Chamber</> and raises the <@gd.key>level cap</> of the existing Manufacturing Cabin.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_5.cn: 您已获得了升级总控中枢所需的特殊材料——<@gd.key>扩容演算芯片</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_5.en: <@gd.key>Algorithm Expansion Chip</> acquired. It is a special material needed to upgrade the Control Nexus.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_6.cn: 当其他升级材料满足所需时，可点击“升级”按钮提升<@gd.key>总控中枢等级</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_6.en: When all upgrade materials have been acquired, click the [Upgrade] button to level up the <@gd.key>Control Nexus</>.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_6_ct.cn: 当其他升级材料满足所需时，可按下<action=common_confirm>提升<@gd.key>总控中枢等级</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenter_6_ct.en: When all upgrade materials have been acquired, press <action=common_confirm> to level up the <@gd.key>Control Nexus</>.

guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenterhint_1.cn: 与中控台交互，选择<@gd.key>升级</>可提升总控中枢等级。
guide_text_spaceship_upgradecenterhint_1.en: Interact with the Central Dashboard to <@gd.key>level up</> the Control Nexus.

guide_text_spaceship_upgraderoom_desc_1.cn: 总控中枢等级升级后可提升特定舱室的等级上限，升级这些舱室可提升<@gd.key>进驻干员数量</>并解锁更多<@gd.key>生产内容</>。
guide_text_spaceship_upgraderoom_desc_1.en: Upgrading the Control Nexus also makes some cabin upgrades available. An upgraded cabin can have more <@gd.key>operators assigned</> and more <@gd.key>production options</> unlocked.

guide_text_spaceship_upgraderoom_desc_2.cn: 升级舱室所需的航天建材可在各地的<@gd.key>资源回收站</>中定期收取获得。
guide_text_spaceship_upgraderoom_desc_2.en: Cabin upgrades require Aerospace Materials. These can be regularly gathered from <@gd.key>Recycling Stations</> scattered throughout Talos-II.

guide_text_splitter_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>分流器</>可以将一条传送带上的物品平均分拣到多条传送带上，最多可支持分流成三条传送带。
guide_text_splitter_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Splitter</> can split the product flow of 1 transport belt to up to 3 transport belts.

guide_text_splitter_intro_desc_2.cn: 可在<@gd.key>设备列表</>界面中选择<@gd.key>分流器</>，直接进行放置或放入快捷栏来使用。
guide_text_splitter_intro_desc_2.en: Select the <@gd.key>Splitter</> from the <@gd.key>Facility List</> panel, drag it directly into the hotbar, and place it with hotkeys.

guide_text_spot_difference_desc.cn: 开启后，会出现多个由三层结构组成的图案，连续选出其中一层结构<@gd.key>与其他图案皆不同</>的图案，即可成功解开百相仪。
guide_text_spot_difference_desc.en: Activating this device generates a puzzle of multiple images each comprising 3 parts (corners, frame, and center). <@gd.key>One of the images includes a part that differs from all the rest</>. Keep finding all the images with a unique part to complete the Kaleidograph challenge.

guide_text_spot_difference_desc_1.cn: 遇到百相仪时，可上前与之交互，开启挑战。
guide_text_spot_difference_desc_1.en: Interact with a Kaleidograph to start its challenge.

guide_text_spot_difference_desc_2.cn: 百相仪开启后，会出现多个<@gd.key>三层结构</>组成的图案，选出其中一层结构<@gd.key>与其他图案皆不同</>的图案并与之交互，即可成功完成一次挑战。
guide_text_spot_difference_desc_2.en: Activating the Kaleidograph generates multiple images each comprising <@gd.key>3 parts</> (corners, frame, and center). One of the images includes <@gd.key>a part that differs from the rest</>. Interact with it to complete one stage of the challenge.

guide_text_spot_difference_desc_3.cn: 连续完成全部挑战后，可解开百相仪，获得相应奖励。
guide_text_spot_difference_desc_3.en: Complete all challenge stages to solve the Kaleidograph and acquire rewards.

guide_text_squirter_connect_1.cn: 洒水机是需要同时<@gd.key>通电</>和<@gd.key>供水</>的设备。
guide_text_squirter_connect_1.en: The Sprinkler is a facility that must be supplied with both <@gd.key>power</> and <@gd.key>Clean Water</>.

guide_text_squirter_connect_2.cn: 所以请先用<@gd.key>管道</>将<@gd.key>水泵</>连向<@gd.key>洒水机</>。
guide_text_squirter_connect_2.en: Place a <@gd.key>pipeline</> to connect the <@gd.key>Fluid Pump</> to the <@gd.key>Sprinkler</>.

guide_text_squirter_final_1.cn: <@gd.key>锦素炒饭</>的材料已齐全，可以在<@gd.key>简易制作</>中制作了。
guide_text_squirter_final_1.en: All <@gd.key>Garden Fried Rice</> ingredients have been acquired. The dish can now be made by accessing the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen.

guide_text_squirter_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>洒水机</>在接入水源后可为需要浇灌的目标进行液体喷洒。
guide_text_squirter_intro_desc_1.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Sprinkler</> to a source of water to sprinkle water on the target.

guide_text_squirter_intro_desc_2.cn: 如果对应目标没有浇灌需求，<@gd.key>洒水机</>会智能停止喷洒。
guide_text_squirter_intro_desc_2.en: The <@gd.key>Sprinkler</> is smart and will automatically stop sprinkling the target if it no longer needs watering.

guide_text_squirter_manual_1.cn: 材料已齐，请打开背包并前往<@gd.key>简易制作</>界面，制作一份<@gd.key>正本补元汤剂</>。
guide_text_squirter_manual_1.en: We now have all the materials required. Go to the Backpack and open the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen to make 1 serving of <@gd.key>Fortifying Infusion</>.

guide_text_squirter_manual_2.cn: 首先，需要打开<@gd.key>简易制作</>界面。
guide_text_squirter_manual_2.en: First, we need to open the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen.

guide_text_squirter_manual_3.cn: 然后，选中<@gd.key>精制食药</>类别。
guide_text_squirter_manual_3.en: Then select the <@gd.key>Fine Food and Medicine (Fine F&M)</> category.

guide_text_squirter_manual_4.cn: 接着，选中<@gd.key>正本补元汤剂</>配方。
guide_text_squirter_manual_4.en: Next, select the formula for <@gd.key>Fortifying Infusion</>.

guide_text_squirter_mention_1.cn: 可以建造更多<@gd.key>水泵</>或利用<@gd.key>管道分流器</>，来为多个<@gd.key>洒水机</>供水。
guide_text_squirter_mention_1.en: Build more <@gd.key>Fluid Pumps</> or use <@gd.key>Pipe Splitters</> to supply multiple <@gd.key>Sprinklers</> with Clean Water.

guide_text_squirter_mention_2.cn: 材料已齐，还记得如何用<@gd.key>简易制作</>制作食物吗？动手试试吧！
guide_text_squirter_mention_2.en: Materials acquired. Remember how to use the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen to make food? Go ahead and give it a try!

guide_text_squirter_pic_1.cn: 在模拟空间中，存在<@gd.key>模拟琼叶参田块</>等<@gd.key>模拟田块</>。它们的<@gd.key>成长速度</>等属性与正常田块有所差异。
guide_text_squirter_pic_1.en: This simulation has <@gd.key>simulation plots</> for growing <@gd.key>Redjade Ginseng</>. The <@gd.key>growth rates</> and other properties of these plots differ from the actual farming plots in the real world.

guide_text_squirter_pic_2.cn: 有些田块在成长中需要<@gd.key>多次浇水</>，利用<@gd.key>洒水机</>可以提高效率。
guide_text_squirter_pic_2.en: Some plots require <@gd.key>multiple rounds of watering</> to cultivate the plant. Use <@gd.key>Sprinklers</> to improve farming efficiency.

guide_text_squirter_soil_1.cn: 洒水机已就绪，我们可以先去对田块进行<@gd.key>育苗</>。
guide_text_squirter_soil_1.en: The Sprinkler is now ready. Let's go to the plot and <@gd.key>germinate</> the plants first.

guide_text_squirter_soil_3.cn: 当田块需要<@gd.key>浇水</>时，洒水机开始自动工作了。
guide_text_squirter_soil_3.en: When the plot needs water, the Sprinkler will automatically <@gd.key>sprinkle</> it with water.

guide_text_squirter_soil_4.cn: 让我们稍作等待，当田块上的琼叶参成熟时，就可以将其采集。
guide_text_squirter_soil_4.en: Let's wait for a while for the Redjade Ginseng in the plot to grow to maturity for harvesting.

guide_text_squirter_soil_5.cn: 琼叶参已成熟，可以进行采集了。
guide_text_squirter_soil_5.en: The Redjade Ginseng is now mature and ready for harvest.

guide_text_squirter_soil_6.cn: 去<@gd.key>简易制作</>查看缺少的材料，找到对应的田块重复刚才学会的步骤吧。
guide_text_squirter_soil_6.en: Open the <@gd.key>Crafting</> screen to check the materials required, then repeat what we just did at the respective plots.

guide_text_star_collection_tips.cn: 探索收集的塔晶，可在<@gd.key>塔晶集换</>兑换物品，此处可进入塔晶集换。
guide_text_star_collection_tips.en: The Talosites gathered during exploration can be exchanged for items at the <@gd.key>Talosite Exchange</>. Access the Talosite Exchange here.

guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_1.cn:
<@gd.key>爆炸物</>可在<@gd.key>源石材料桶</>处制作。
可参照瞄准线提示，并转动视角进行瞄准，按下攻击键即可扔出。
爆炸物在接触任何物体后，即会发生爆炸，能够爆破某些石块与墙体，并对敌方造成伤害，但<@gd.key>不会</>对友方单位造成伤害。
guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_1.en: <@gd.key>Explosives</> can be made by interacting with the <@gd.key>Barrel of Originium</>. Use the aiming guide and adjust the view to aim, then press the attack key to throw the bomb. Thrown explosives detonate upon impact and can demolish certain rocks or walls. They can also deal DMG to enemies but will <@gd.key>not damage</> friendly units.

guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_1_ct.cn:
<@gd.key>爆炸物</>可在<@gd.key>源石材料桶</>处制作。
可参照瞄准线提示，并转动视角进行瞄准，按下<action=general_ability_press>即可扔出。
爆炸物在接触任何物体后，即会发生爆炸，能够爆破某些石块与墙体，并对敌方造成伤害，但<@gd.key>不会</>对友方单位造成伤害。
guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_1_ct.en: <@gd.key>Explosives</> can be made by interacting with the <@gd.key>Barrel of Originium</>. Use the aiming guide and adjust the view to aim, then press <action=general_ability_press> to throw the bomb. Thrown explosives detonate upon impact and can demolish certain rocks or walls. They can also deal DMG to enemies but will <@gd.key>not damage</> friendly units.

guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_2.cn:
由于<@gd.key>源石材料桶</>制作的爆炸物稳定性有限，需要在一定范围内才可使用。
当爆炸物远离源石材料桶一定距离，则会挥发消失。
消失之后可等待片刻，则可以在源石材料桶处重新制作。
guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_2.en: The <@gd.key>Barrel of Originium</> only gives unstable explosives. Such explosives must be used within a short range of the barrel and will disappear if taken too far away. If that happens, just wait for a while and make another explosive by interacting with the Barrel of Originium again.

guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_3.cn: 随着集成工业系统的发展和工业技术的研究，可通过协议设备进行批量制造便携的<@gd.key>爆炸物</>。
guide_text_start_bomb1_desc_3.en: As the AIC Factory expands and more AIC technologies are researched, AIC Factory facilities can be used to mass produce portable <@gd.key>explosives</>.

guide_text_start_bomb2.cn: 接近源石材料桶制作爆炸物，按下<action=common_interact>制作。
guide_text_start_bomb2.en: Approach the Barrel of Originium and press <action=common_interact> to make an explosive.

guide_text_start_bomb2_mb.cn: 靠近源石材料桶并点击"制作爆炸物"即可使用。
guide_text_start_bomb2_mb.en: Approach the Barrel of Originium and tap [Make Explosives] to use it.

guide_text_start_bomb3.cn: <image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3>移动视角进行瞄准，按下<action=battle_attack_start>扔出爆炸物。
guide_text_start_bomb3.en: Move the view and aim with <image="KeyIcon/icon_pc_rotate_mouse2" scale=1.3>. Press <action=battle_attack_start> to throw the explosive.

guide_text_start_bomb3_mb.cn: 转动视角进行瞄准，按下攻击键扔出爆炸物。
guide_text_start_bomb3_mb.en: Adjust the view to aim, then tap the attack button to throw the explosive.

guide_text_start_techtree_1.cn: 请按下快捷键<action=fac_open_tech_tree>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_start_techtree_1.en: Press the hotkey <action=fac_open_tech_tree> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_start_techtree_13.cn: 点击此处关闭工业发展规划。
guide_text_start_techtree_13.en: Click here to close the AIC Factory Plan.

guide_text_start_techtree_13_ct.cn: 请按下<action=common_cancel>关闭工业发展规划。
guide_text_start_techtree_13_ct.en: Press <action=common_cancel> to close the AIC Factory Plan.

guide_text_start_techtree_1_mb.cn: 请点击此处进入<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>。
guide_text_start_techtree_1_mb.en: Tap here to enter the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_start_techtree_2.cn:
<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>详细地展示了工业技术的发展路线。
从上到下，每个节点代表一项<@gd.key>工业技术</>。
guide_text_start_techtree_2.en: The <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</> gives a detailed display of AIC technology and development tree. The tree goes from top to bottom, with every node representing an <@gd.key>AIC technology</>.

guide_text_start_techtree_3.cn:
<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>共分为三期计划。
只有推进主线任务获得<@gd.key>拓展核心</>后，才可开启下一期计划。
guide_text_start_techtree_3.en: <@gd.key>The AIC Factory Plan</> is divided into 3 phases. Progress through the main mission and acquire <@gd.key>Expansion Cores</> to unlock the next phase.

guide_text_start_techtree_4.cn: 根据工业技术功能的不同，<@gd.key>工业发展规划</>还分为多个系列工业技术。
guide_text_start_techtree_4.en: The <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</> is also divided into different AIC technology series based on their functions.

guide_text_start_techtree_5.cn:
目前工业发展规划已经完成一部分<@gd.key>基础工业技术</>的研究。
您可以结合工厂的发展需要，决定后续的工业技术研究方向。
guide_text_start_techtree_5.en: We have currently researched some <@gd.key>Basic AIC</> technologies in the AIC Factory Plan. Check what the AIC Factory needs to choose the AIC technology to research next.

guide_text_start_techtree_6.cn: 先预览一下之后的目标，研究<@gd.key>中级矿物采掘</>工业技术后，可以制造<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>。
guide_text_start_techtree_6.en: Let's take a look at our next goals. Researching the <@gd.key>Mining II</> AIC technology can let us construct <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</>.

guide_text_start_techtree_6_ct.cn:
先预览一下之后的目标，研究<@gd.key>中级矿物采掘</>工业技术后，可以制造<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>。
请按下<action=common_confirm>选中。
guide_text_start_techtree_6_ct.en: Let's take a look at our next goals. Researching the <@gd.key>Mining II</> AIC technology lets us construct <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</>. Press <action=common_confirm> to select it.

guide_text_start_techtree_7.cn: <@gd.key>电驱矿机</>可以采集更高级的矿物，并在野外将矿物<@gd.key>无线传输</>至仓库。
guide_text_start_techtree_7.en: The <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rig</> can mine higher tier minerals. In the wilderness, the rig can use <@gd.key>belt-free transfer</> to move the mined minerals from its cache to the Depot directly.

guide_text_start_techtree_8.cn: 研究<@gd.key>中级矿物采掘</>工业技术需要<@gd.key>基础工业点数</>，可通过激活<@gd.key>协议采录桩</>获得。
guide_text_start_techtree_8.en: Researching the AIC technology <@gd.key>Mining II</> needs <@gd.key>Basic AIC Index</>. Activate <@gd.key>Protocol Dataloggers</> to get more Indices.

guide_text_steam_blocker_desc_1.cn: 蒸汽以高压能形成<@gd.key>无法肉身逾越的阻挡</>。被蒸汽冲刷时不会受到伤害，但会被<@gd.key>击退</>。
guide_text_steam_blocker_desc_1.en: Pressurized steam can create <@gd.key>impassable barriers</>. Though the steam inflicts no damage, it can <@gd.key>knock people back</>.

guide_text_steam_blocker_desc_2.cn: 借助旧式传送带上的货物箱，能避免蒸汽的冲刷，安全到达终点。
guide_text_steam_blocker_desc_2.en: Use cargo crates on the old conveyor belts to block the venting steam and acquire safe passage to the destination.

guide_text_steam_blocker_title_2.en: Hot Steam: Cargo Crate and Cover

guide_text_storage_filter_hint_1.cn: 使用<@gd.key>筛选</>功能，可自定义选择需要一键存放的物品类别
guide_text_storage_filter_hint_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>filter</> function to customize the types of items to move via the Quick Stash button.

guide_text_storage_hint_1.cn: 在详情页中，可以直接将物品存放入仓库，或者将仓库中物品直接放入缓存区。
guide_text_storage_hint_1.en: When the panel is open, items in the facility can be directly placed in the Depot. Items in the Depot can also be placed in the facility cache.

guide_text_storage_mode_1.cn: 在仓储管理模式下，可使用<@gd.key>一键存放</>功能将背包中的所有物品一键存入仓库，以获得更大的背包容量。
guide_text_storage_mode_1.en: Storage management includes a <@gd.key>Quick Stash</> feature that moves Backpack items to the Depot, freeing up Backpack space.

guide_text_storage_mode_2.cn:
一键存放配备了<@gd.key>筛选</>功能，可自定义选择需要一键存放的物品类别。
请点击此处查看。
guide_text_storage_mode_2.en: Quick Stash also includes a <@gd.key>filter</> function to customize the type of items to be moved via Quick Stash. Click here to view the filter options.

guide_text_storage_mode_2_ct.cn:
一键存放配备了<@gd.key>筛选</>功能，可自定义选择需要一键存放的物品类别。
请<@gd.key>长按</><action=inv_quick_stash>查看。
guide_text_storage_mode_2_ct.en: Quick Stash also includes a <@gd.key>filter</> function to customize the type of items to be moved via Quick Stash. <@gd.key>Press and hold</> <action=inv_quick_stash> to view it.

guide_text_storage_mode_hint_1.cn: 在<@gd.key>协议传送点</>的安全区范围内，可以按下<action=common_open_inventory>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处同时打开背包与仓库。
guide_text_storage_mode_hint_1.en: While in the <@gd.key>TP Point</> safe zone, press <action=common_open_inventory> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open both the Backpack and Depot.

guide_text_storager_intro_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>协议储存箱</>可存放物品，并在通电后可以将储存物品以一定间隔传输回仓库。
guide_text_storager_intro_desc_1.en: The <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> can store items. When powered, the Protocol Stash can also deliver stored items to the Depot on a regular basis.

guide_text_storager_intro_desc_2.cn: <@gd.key>协议储存箱</>也可以通过连接<@gd.key>传送带</>来运输储存的物品。
guide_text_storager_intro_desc_2.en: The <@gd.key>Protocol Stash</> can also be connected to <@gd.key>transport belts</> to move stored items into the AIC.

guide_text_subhub_hint2_1.cn: 请按照指示标记，靠近<@gd.key>协议核心取货口4</>，打开取货口界面。
guide_text_subhub_hint2_1.en: Follow the indication marker and approach <@gd.key>PAC output port 4</>, then open the output port panel.

guide_text_subhub_hint_1.cn:
<@gd.key>次级核心</>需要<@gd.key>接入电网</>后才可正常运转。
请从其他<@gd.key>中继器</>开始向次级核心完成电力运输。
guide_text_subhub_hint_1.en: The <@gd.key>Sub-PAC</> must be <@gd.key>connected to the power grid</> to work properly. Hence, power must be transmitted from a <@gd.key>Relay Tower</> to a Sub-PAC for it to work.

guide_text_super_pressure_board_desc_1.cn: 使用<@gd.key>下落攻击</>击打压力板凸起部分时，可将其激活。
guide_text_super_pressure_board_desc_1.en: Perform a <@gd.key>dive attack</> to hit the protruding part of a pressure plate and activate it.

guide_text_super_pressure_board_desc_2.cn: 有些环境中，压力板的周围会存在控制它们的<@gd.key>平衡总控开关</>，需要先触摸平衡总控开关<@gd.key>观察压力板的点亮顺序</>，再依次<@gd.key>按顺序激活</>全部压力板。
guide_text_super_pressure_board_desc_2.en: Certain areas have <@gd.key>main balance switches</> near pressure plates. Interact with the switch first. The pressure plates will light up in a particular sequence. <@gd.key>Memorize this sequence</> and <@gd.key>hit the plates accordingly</> to activate the switch.

guide_text_supply_box_desc_1.cn: 武陵地区分布着一些物资箱，与其交互后，即可获取<@gd.key>盛装有清水或液化息壤的容器</>，供射流无人机等使用。
guide_text_supply_box_desc_1.en: Various crates can be found throughout the region of Wuling. Open them to acquire <@gd.key>containers filled with Clean Water or Liquid Xiranite</> that can then be used by the jet drone.

guide_text_switch_general_ability.cn: <@gd.key>长按</><action=general_ability_press>，可进行便捷工具的切换，比如切换为<@gd.key>拍照</>拍摄管理员喜欢的景色。
guide_text_switch_general_ability.en: <@gd.key>Long-press</> <action=general_ability_press> to switch the Easy Tools action. An example would be <@gd.key>Camera</> for taking photos of various beautiful scenes, Endministrator.

guide_text_switch_general_ability_mb.cn: <@gd.key>长按</>此处，可进行便捷工具的切换，比如切换为<@gd.key>拍照</>拍摄管理员喜欢的景色。
guide_text_switch_general_ability_mb.en: <@gd.key>Tap and hold</> here to switch the Easy Tools action. An example would be <@gd.key>Camera</> for taking photos of various beautiful scenes, Endministrator.

guide_text_switch_hint.en: Press <action=battle_switch_char_next> or <action=battle_switch_char_1>-<action=battle_switch_char_4> to switch the controlled operator.

guide_text_switch_hint_ct.cn: 可按下<action=battle_switch_char_next>或者按住<action=common_indicator_start>并按下<action=common_navigation_4_dir_up>切换主控干员。
guide_text_switch_hint_ct.en: Press <action=battle_switch_char_next> or hold <action=common_indicator_start> and press <action=common_navigation_4_dir_up> to switch the controlled operator.

guide_text_switch_hint_mb.cn: 可通过点击干员头像，切换主控干员。
guide_text_switch_hint_mb.en: Tap the operator's portrait to switch the controlled operator.

guide_text_switch_mode_1.cn: 可以按下快捷键<action=common_switch_mode>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，切换回<@gd.key>探索模式</>，便于进行探索与战斗。
guide_text_switch_mode_1.en: Press the hotkey <action=common_switch_mode> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to switch to <@gd.key>Explore Mode</> that is more conducive for world exploration or fighting enemies.

guide_text_switch_mode_1_mb.cn: 可以点击此处，切换回<@gd.key>探索模式</>，便于进行探索与战斗。
guide_text_switch_mode_1_mb.en: Tap here to switch to <@gd.key>Explore Mode</> that is more conducive for world exploration or fighting enemies.

guide_text_switch_storage_1.cn: 请点击此处，切换至<@gd.key>四号谷地仓库</>。
guide_text_switch_storage_1.en: Click here to switch to the <@gd.key>Valley IV Depot</>.

guide_text_switch_techtree.cn: 如果需要查看其他工业发展规划，可点击此处进行切换。
guide_text_switch_techtree.en: To view another AIC Factory Plan, click here to switch.

guide_text_switch_techtree_ct.cn: 如果需要查看其他工业发展规划，可<@gd.key>长按</><action=tech_tree_open_package>进行切换。
guide_text_switch_techtree_ct.en: To view another AIC Factory Plan, <@gd.key>press and hold</> <action=tech_tree_open_package> to switch.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_0.cn: 完成<@gd.key>模拟空间</>后解锁的系统蓝图会在此展示。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_0.en: The system blueprint unlocked by completing the <@gd.key>simulation</> is shown here.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_1.cn: 可在此处查看系统蓝图<@gd.key>息壤装备与电池</>。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_1.en: This shows the system blueprint for making <@gd.key>Xiranite Components and Batteries</>.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_2.cn: 该系统蓝图可用于自动生产<@gd.key>息壤</>、<@gd.key>息壤装备原件</>和<@gd.key>低容武陵电池</>，并自动<@gd.key>发电</>。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_2.en: This blueprint can auto-produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>, <@gd.key>Xiranite Components</>, and <@gd.key>LC Wuling Batteries</>, while <@gd.key>auto-generating electrical power</> at the same time.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.cn: 在武陵地区的天有洪炉数量达到上限后，若需放置更多的天有洪炉，可通过研究<@gd.key>洪炉扩容</>等工业计划以提升天有洪炉数量上限，或收纳已放置的天有洪炉。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.en: There is a limit to the number of Forges of the Sky you can place in Wuling. Research AIC Plan technologies such as <@gd.key>Forge Expansion</> to raise this limit and place more Forges of the Sky. You can also stash forges in areas that no longer need them so you can place them elsewhere.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.cn: 该系统蓝图可在武陵地区的集成核心区域中围绕<@gd.key>协议核心</>进行放置。可根据<@gd.key>物品准入口</>和<@gd.key>管道准入口</>的提示，输入对应物品以实现自动生产。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.en: This blueprint can be placed around a <@gd.key>Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)</> in the Wuling Core AIC Area. Refer to the icon tips provided by the <@gd.key>Item Control Ports</> and <@gd.key>Pipe Control Ports</> and input the right materials to start production.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.cn: <@gd.key>息壤装备与电池</>的自动生产依赖于稳定的<@gd.key>源矿</>产出，需要在<@gd.key>武陵地区</>的源矿矿点上放置<@gd.key>电驱矿机</>，并将电驱矿机接入电网以支持自动生产。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_des.en: Auto-production of <@gd.key>Xiranite Components and Batteries</> is dependent on a stable yield of <@gd.key>Originium Ore</>. Place <@gd.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> on Originium Ore mining spots in the <@gd.key>Wuling region</>, and ensure the Electric Mining Rigs are connected to the power grid to automate Originium Ore mining.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_tit.en: Forge of the Sky: Placement Limit

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_tit.cn: 系统蓝图 - 息壤装备与电池
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_hint_tit.en: System Blueprint: Xiranite Components and Batteries

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_ava.cn: 可前往<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>，尝试放置该蓝图。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_ava.en: Go to the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</> and try placing the blueprint.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.cn: 当前存在科技欠缺，可点击此处，前往研究该蓝图所需的工业计划。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.en: Some AIC Plan technologies required by the blueprint are missing. Click here to start researching them.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.cn: 在研究包括<@gd.key>洪炉扩容Ⅰ</>在内的工业计划后，即可前往<@gd.key>集成核心区域</>，尝试放置该蓝图。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.en: After researching AIC Plan technologies such as <@gd.key>Forge Expansion Ⅰ</>, go to the <@gd.key>Core AIC Area</> and try placing the blueprint.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.cn: 可在武陵地区<@gd.key>激活协议采录桩</>以获取<@gd.key>武陵工业点数</>。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.en: <@gd.key>Activate Protocol Dataloggers</> in Wuling to acquire <@gd.key>Wuling AIC Indices</>.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.cn: 当前存在科技欠缺，可按下<action=fac_blueprint_use_blueprint>，前往研究该蓝图所需的工业计划。
guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.en: Some AIC Plan technologies required by the blueprint are missing. Press <action=fac_blueprint_use_blueprint> to start researching them.

guide_text_sysbp_wuling_starter_tech_lac.cn: 当前存在科技欠缺，可点击此处，前往研究该蓝图所需的工业计划。
