guide_text_xiranite_ppole_intro_1_ct.cn: 背包里已经放有<@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>，可以按下<action=common_open_quick_menu_start>打开<@gd.key>系统功能轮盘</>，并进入<@gd.key>背包</>界面。
guide_text_xiranite_ppole_intro_1_ct.en: The Backpack already has a <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylon</>. Press <action=common_open_quick_menu_start> to open the <@gd.key>System Feature Wheel</> and open the <@gd.key>Backpack</> panel.

guide_text_xiranite_ppole_intro_1_mb.cn: 背包里已经放有<@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>，请点击此处，打开背包。
guide_text_xiranite_ppole_intro_1_mb.en: The Backpack already has a <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylon</>. Tap here to open the Backpack.

guide_text_xiranite_ppole_put_1.cn: 点击此处选中<@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>。

guide_text_xiranite_ppole_put_2.cn: 点击此处开始放置<@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>。
guide_text_xiranite_ppole_put_2.en: Click here to place the <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylon</>.

guide_text_xiranite_ppole_put_3.cn: <@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>放下后会<@gd.key>自动</>与<@gd.key>附近的电力设备</>或协议核心连电。
guide_text_xiranite_ppole_put_3.en: Once placed, <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylons</> will <@gd.key>automatically</> form power connections with nearby <@gd.key>power facilities</> or the PAC.

guide_text_xiranite_radar_desc_1.cn: <@gd.key>侵蚀瘴扫描插件</>激活时，<@gd.key>枢壤仪扫描时的识别范围会扩大</>。能有力帮助在侵蚀瘴中的探索。
guide_text_xiranite_radar_desc_1.en: Activating the <@gd.key>Blight Miasma Scanner Plugin</> can <@gd.key>expand the Xiranite Nexus scanning radius</>. This can be helpful when exploring the Blight Miasma.

guide_text_xiranite_radar_use_hint_1.cn: 在<@gd.key>随身装置格装配</>侵蚀瘴扫描插件后，可以<@gd.key>大幅提升枢壤仪扫描的范围</>。
guide_text_xiranite_radar_use_hint_1.en: Place the Blight Miasma Scanner Plugin in the <@gd.key>personal device slot</> to <@gd.key>greatly expand the Xiranite Nexus scanning range</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_0.cn: 随着息壤蓝图方案已经与集成工业系统整合完毕，我们解锁了全新的工业技术系列。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_0.en: The proposed Xiranite blueprint is completely integrated with the AIC Factory system. We have unlocked a new series of AIC technologies.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_1.cn: 请按下快捷键<action=fac_open_tech_tree>或按住<image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3>点击此处，打开工业发展规划。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_1.en: Press the hotkey <action=fac_open_tech_tree> or hold <image="KeyIcon/icon_key_alt" scale=1.3> and click here to open the AIC Factory Plan.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_1.cn: 请点击此处，进行<@gd.key>工业发展计划</>的切换。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_1.en: Click here to switch the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_1_ct.cn: 请长按<action=tech_tree_open_package>，进行<@gd.key>工业发展计划</>的切换。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_1_ct.en: Press and hold <action=tech_tree_open_package> to switch the <@gd.key>AIC Factory Plan</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_2.cn: 请点击此处，切换至<@gd.key>武陵工业计划</>。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_2.en: Click here to switch to the <@gd.key>Wuling AIC Plan</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_2_ct.cn: 请按下<action=navigation_target_click>，切换至<@gd.key>武陵工业计划</>。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_1_2_ct.en: Press <action=navigation_target_click> to switch to the <@gd.key>Wuling AIC Plan</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_2.cn: 现已解锁<@gd.key>息壤工业</>系列。可研发<@gd.key>息壤</>相关的科技。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_2.en: The <@gd.key>Xiranite</> AIC Plan series is now unlocked. <@gd.key>Xiranite</>-related technologies can now be researched.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_3.cn: 当前已研发完成了<@gd.key>息壤生成</>工业技术，请点击此处查看。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_3.en: The AIC Plan technology <@gd.key>Xiranite Forging</> has been researched. Click here for details.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_3_ct.cn: 当前已研发完成了<@gd.key>息壤生成</>工业技术，请按下<action=common_confirm>查看。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_3_ct.en: The AIC Plan technology <@gd.key>Xiranite Forging</> has been researched. Press <action=common_confirm> for details.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_4.cn: 可使用<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>这一设备，制造<@gd.key>息壤</>这一产物。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_4.en: Use the AIC facility <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> to produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_5.cn: <@gd.key>天有洪炉</>作为武陵地区特有的设备，只能在<@gd.key>武陵地区</>放置，并且有放置数量的限制。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_5.en: The <@gd.key>Forge of the Sky</> is a special Wuling AIC facility. It can only be placed in the <@gd.key>Wuling region</>, and only a limited number of these forges can be placed.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_6.cn: 通过研究后续的工业技术，能够放置更多的<@gd.key>天有洪炉</>。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_6.en: Additional AIC Plan technologies can be researched to allow the placement of more <@gd.key>Forges of the Sky</>.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_7.cn: 当前也研发完成了<@gd.key>武陵电力</>工业技术，可以制造并使用<@gd.key>息壤中继器</>和<@gd.key>息壤供电桩</>。在武陵地区更方便地<@gd.key>自动连电</>。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_7.en: The AIC technology of <@gd.key>Wuling Power</> has been researched. This allows the construction of <@gd.key>Xiranite Relays</> and <@gd.key>Xiranite Pylons</> that can <@gd.key>automatically form power transmitting connections</> for greater convenience. These power facilities can be used in the region of Wuling.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_desc_1.cn: 天有洪炉作为武陵地区特殊的设备，只能在武陵地区放置。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_desc_1.en: The Forge of the Sky is a special Wuling AIC facility and can only be placed in the Wuling region.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_desc_2.cn: 天有洪炉具有放置数量的限制，可通过研究后续的工业技术，来增加能够放置的数量上限。
guide_text_xiranite_tech_desc_2.en: Only a limited number of Forges of the Sky can be placed. Research certain AIC technologies to place more Forges.

guide_text_xiranite_tech_title_1.en: Forge of the Sky: Regional Limit

guide_text_xiranite_tech_title_2.en: Forge of the Sky: Placement Limit

guide_text_xiranite_track_desc.cn: 操作<@gd.key>射流无人机</>，瞄准<@gd.key>息壤滑块</>喷射<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，将其逐步引导进入<@gd.key>导流扣</>中，从而修复<@gd.key>息壤导流轨道系统</>。
guide_text_xiranite_track_desc.en: To restore the <@gd.key>Xiranflow Track System</>, use the <@gd.key>jet drone</> to aim and spray <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> at the <@gd.key>Xiranite Sliding Block</>, and slowly push it into the <@gd.key>Block Slot</> to complete the repairs.

guide_text_xiranite_trail_desc.cn:
使用<@gd.key>射流无人机</>对<@gd.key>息壤滑块</>喷洒<@gd.key>液化息壤</>，将其逐步推入<@gd.key>导流扣</>，从而复位<@gd.key>息壤导流轨道系统</>。
息壤滑块的运动方向，由它与主控干员之间的<@gd.key>相对位置</>决定。
guide_text_xiranite_trail_desc.en: Use the <@gd.key>jet drone</> to spray <@gd.key>Liquid Xiranite</> on the <@gd.key>Xiranite Sliding Block</>, push it slowly into the <@gd.key>Block Slot</>, and restore the <@gd.key>Xiranflow Track System</>. The direction of the Xiranite Sliding Block's movement is determined by its <@gd.key>position relative</> to that of the controlled operator.

guide_text_xiranite_trail_hint.cn: 息壤滑块的运动方向，由它与主控干员之间的<@gd.key>相对位置</>决定；发现滑块无法推动，不妨走到滑块的另一侧试试。
guide_text_xiranite_trail_hint.en: The direction of the Xiranite Sliding Block's movement is based on the <@gd.key>relative position</> of the controlled operator. If the block does not move, walk to the other side of the Xiranite Sliding Block and spray again.

guide_text_xiranite_trail_hint_2.cn: 某些息壤导流轨道两端都有导流扣，不妨尝试将停在轨道一端导流扣中的滑块<@gd.key>再次推出</>。
guide_text_xiranite_trail_hint_2.en: If the Xiranflow Track has Block Slots on both ends, try spraying the Xiranite Sliding Block already at one of the Block Slots to <@gd.key>push it out</>.

guide_text_xiranite_trail_title.cn: 复位息壤导流轨道系统

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 伊冯的战技可以<#ba.consume>消耗</>掉目标身上所有的<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>和<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，对其强制施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>，并基于<#ba.consume>消耗</>的层数造成<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_02_1.en: Yvonne's battle skill can <#ba.consume>consume</> all <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> and <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> stacks from the target, forcibly apply <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, and deal <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</> based on the number of stacks <#ba.consume>consumed</>.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_03_1.cn: 伊冯解锁天赋<@ba.key>科技连击</>后，战技触发<#ba.frozen>冻结</>时，下一次普通攻击会直接施放<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_03_1.en: With the talent <@ba.key>Barrage of Technology</> unlocked, when Yvonne's battle skill triggers <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, her next basic attack will be a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> instead.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 伊冯的连携技持续造成伤害，并在结束时对敌人施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_04_1.en: Yvonne's combo skill deals continuous DMG and applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</> on enemies when it ends.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_1.cn: 伊冯的终结技会强化普通攻击。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_1.en: Yvonne's ultimate enhances her basic attacks (BATK).

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_2.cn: 伊冯的终结技持续时间结束前的最后一次普通攻击会变为<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>，并造成大量<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_2.en: Yvonne's last basic attack before her ultimate ends will be a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> that deals massive <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</>.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_3.cn: 如果敌人处于<#ba.frozen>冻结</>状态，最后一击还会造成额外<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>并<#ba.consume>消耗</>其<#ba.frozen>冻结</>状态。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrain01_05_3.en: If the enemy is <#ba.frozen>Solidified</>, the final hit also deals additional <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</> and then <#ba.consume>consumes</> the said enemy's <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 伊冯是一名通过暴击造成大量输出的干员。她可以通过技能持续施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>，施放终结技后，能获得强力的单体输出能力。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_1.en: Yvonne is a DMG dealer who leverages her critical hits. Her skills can continuously apply <#ba.frozen>Solidification</> and her ultimate makes her a powerful single-target DMG dealer.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_2.cn: 伊冯的战技能够<#ba.consume>消耗</>掉目标身上所有的<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>和<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>并强制施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>。当伊冯的战技成功施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>后，会获得天赋<@ba.key>科技连击</>的加成，使下次普通攻击直接施放<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_2.en: Yvonne's battle skill can <#ba.consume>consume</> all of the target's <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> and <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</> stacks, and forcibly apply <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>. When Yvonne's battle skill successfully applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, she gains a bonus from her talent <@ba.key>Barrage of Technology</> that converts her next basic attack into a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</>.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_3.cn: 当主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>处于<#ba.frozen>冻结</>状态的敌人时，可以发动伊冯的连携技：部署速冻仔，持续攻击并<@ba.key>牵引</>周围敌人，速冻仔自爆时还会对周围敌人强制施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_3.en: Yvonne's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> on an enemy with <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>. Her combo skill deploys the robot Frost-e-Bytee that continuously attacks and <@ba.key>pulls-in</> nearby enemies. When Frost-e-Bytee detonates itself, the explosion also forcibly applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</> on nearby enemies.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_4.cn:
当敌人陷入被动，抓住时机施放伊冯的终结技，用强化普通攻击对其连续射击。
每次连续的射击会提高自身造成的伤害。
如果敌人处于<#ba.frozen>冻结</>状态，最后一击还会造成额外<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</>并<#ba.consume>消耗</>其<#ba.frozen>冻结</>状态。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_4.en:
When the moment is right to deal major DMG on the enemy, cast Yvonne's ultimate and unleash a continuous stream of bullets with her enhanced basic attacks.
Every shot fired during the ultimate increases the DMG she deals.
If the enemy is <#ba.frozen>Solidified</>, the last attack of the ultimate deals an additional hit of <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</> and <#ba.consume>consumes</> the enemy's <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_5.cn: 让其他干员先于伊冯施加<#ba.crystinflict>寒冷附着</>和<#ba.naturalinflict>自然附着</>，再施放伊冯的战技，可以迅速激活天赋<@ba.key>科技连击</>，并高效触发<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>和连携技。尽可能让伊冯的战技和连携技施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>来提升作战效率。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_5.en: Use another operator to apply <#ba.crystinflict>Cryo Infliction</> and/or <#ba.naturalinflict>Nature Infliction</>, then cast Yvonne's battle skill to quickly activate her talent <@ba.key>Barrage of Technology</> to efficiently trigger her <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> and combo skill. Improve combat performance by applying <#ba.frozen>Solidification</> with Yvonne's battle skill and combo skill.

guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_6.cn: 先施放<@ba.key>埃特拉战技</>，再施放<@ba.key>伊冯战技</>，以触发伊冯需要的<@ba.frozen>冻结</>状态。
guide_text_yvonne_chartrial01_01_6.en: First cast <@ba.key>Estella's battle skill</>, then cast <@ba.key>Yvonne's battle skill</> to trigger the <@ba.frozen>Solidification</> that Yvonne needs.

guide_text_zero_power_desc_1.cn: 当协议核心<@gd.key>存电</>耗尽时，可通过建设更多<@gd.key>热能池</>来恢复存电，也可以通过关闭设备来减少用电功率。
guide_text_zero_power_desc_1.en: When the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) runs out of <@gd.key>power reserves</>, build more <@gd.key>Thermal Banks</> to generate power and build up the power reserves again. Facilities can also be switched OFF to reduce power consumption.

guide_text_zero_power_desc_2.cn: 也可以在<@gd.key>俯瞰模式</>下使用<@gd.key>批量操作</>，将当前大量设备进行<@gd.key>批量关闭</>，以减少用电功率。
guide_text_zero_power_desc_2.en: Switch to <@gd.key>top view mode</> and use <@gd.key>bulk actions</> to select multiple facilities. The selected facilities can be <@gd.key>switched OFF with a bulk action</> to reduce power consumption more quickly.

guide_text_zero_power_title.cn: 协议核心存电耗尽的应对方式

guide_text_zero_power_title_1.cn: 协议核心存电耗尽的应对方式 - 一

guide_text_zero_power_title_2.cn: 协议核心存电耗尽的应对方式 - 二

guide_text_zfy_skill_1.cn: 按下<action=general_ability_release>，协同庄方宜使用<@gd.key>惊霆诀</>，大范围攻击附近敌人！
guide_text_zfy_skill_1.en: Press <action=general_ability_release> to team up with Zhuang Fangyi and cast <@gd.key>Mantra of Sundering</> that attacks nearby enemies in a large area!

guide_text_zfy_skill_1_mb.cn: 点击此处，协同庄方宜使用<@gd.key>惊霆诀</>，大范围攻击附近敌人！
guide_text_zfy_skill_1_mb.en: Tap here to team up with Zhuang Fangyi and cast <@gd.key>Mantra of Sundering</> that attacks nearby enemies in a large area!

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_1.cn: 庄方宜的战技会在附近位置生成1柄<@ba.key>青霆剑</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_1.en: Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill creates 1 <@ba.key>Sunderblade</> nearby.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_2.cn: 庄方宜的战技会引导目标周围一定范围内的<@ba.key>青霆剑</>依次雷击目标。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_2.en: Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill will channel <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> within range and unleash one Thunder Strike after another upon the target.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_3.cn: 庄方宜的战技会消耗目标的<#ba.conduct>导电</>，使战技伤害提升，并基于消耗的<#ba.statuslevel>异常等级</>额外生成<@ba.key>青霆剑</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_02_3.en: Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill consumes the target's <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> to increase DMG dealt by the battle skill. It also creates <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> based on the <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> of the Electrification consumed.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_04_1.cn: 主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>或处决命中处于<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>的目标后可以触发庄方宜的连携技。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_04_1.en: Zhuang Fangyi's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> or Finisher on a target with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_04_2.cn: 庄方宜的连携技会造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>，<#ba.consume>消耗</>敌人的<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>并强制施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_04_2.en: Zhuang Fangyi's combo skill deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>, <#ba.consume>consumes</> the enemy's <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, and forcibly applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_1.cn: 庄方宜的终结技会进入<@ba.key>天理合真</>状态，普通攻击获得强化，自身行动更不容易被打断。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_1.en: Zhuang Fangyi's ultimate transforms her into the <@ba.key>Empyrean of Truth</> that enhances her Basic Attacks. All her actions also become harder to interrupt.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_2.cn: <@ba.key>天理合真</>状态下强化战技<@ba.key>惊霆诀</>，并在最后一击命中时施加<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>。首次施放战技不消耗技力并生成3柄<@ba.key>青霆剑</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_2.en: As the <@ba.key>Empyrean of Truth</>, Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill <@ba.key>Mantra of Sundering</> becomes enhanced and its last hit applies <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>. The first casting of her battle skill after transformation also costs no SP and is guaranteed to create 3 <@ba.key>Sunderblades</>.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_3.cn: <@ba.key>天理合真</>状态下强化连携技<@ba.key>一息万变</>，且冷却恢复速度提升。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrain01_05_3.en: As the <@ba.key>Empyrean of Truth</>, Zhuang Fangyi's combo skill <@ba.key>Breath of Transformation</> is enhanced and gains a faster cooldown.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_1.cn: 庄方宜是一名能持续造成大量<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>的突击干员。她可以通过战技不断生成<@ba.key>青霆剑</>雷击敌人，使用终结技后，还能大幅提升战斗性能。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_1.en: Zhuang Fangyi is a striker who can deal continuous and massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>. Her battle skills can create <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> that unleash Thunder Strikes on the enemy. Her ultimate also greatly enhances her combat capabilities.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_2.cn: 庄方宜的战技会生成<@ba.key>青霆剑</>并引导<@ba.key>青霆剑</>依次雷击目标，如果战技<#ba.consume>消耗</>了目标的<#ba.conduct>导电</>，还会增加<@ba.key>青霆剑</>的数量并提升伤害。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_2.en: Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill can create <@ba.key>Sunderblades</>. The <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> can then be channeled to unleash Thunder Strikes on enemy targets. If the battle skill <#ba.consume>consumes</> a target's <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, it creates more <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> and deals more DMG.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_3.cn: 主控干员<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>或处决命中处于<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>的目标后可以发动庄方宜的连携技，庄方宜的连携技会<#ba.consume>消耗</>敌人的<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>并强制施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_3.en: Zhuang Fangyi's combo skill is triggered when the controlled operator performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> or Finisher on a target with <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>. Her combo skill <#ba.consume>consumes</> the enemy's <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</> and forcibly applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_4.cn:
庄方宜使用终结技后会进入<@ba.key>天理合真</>状态，强化自身攻击和技能。除伤害和范围外，战技最后一击命中时还会施加<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>，连携技冷却恢复速度提升。
<@ba.key>天理合真</>状态下首次施放战技<@ba.key>惊霆诀</>不消耗技力，且必定生成3柄<@ba.key>青霆剑</>。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_4.en:
Zhuang Fangyi can cast her ultimate to transform into the <@ba.key>Empyrean of Truth</>. In addition to enhanced DMG and range, the last hit of her battle skill applies <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, while her combo skill gains a faster cooldown.
After transforming into the <@ba.key>Empyrean of Truth</>, the first casting of the battle skill <@ba.key>Mantra of Sundering</> costs no SP and is guaranteed to create 3 <@ba.key>Sunderblades</>.

guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_5.cn:
将队伍施加的<#ba.pulseinflict>电磁附着</>转化为<#ba.conduct>导电</>，再利用战技生成<@ba.key>青霆剑</>持续对敌人造成<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>。
使用终结技，利用强化后的连携技和战技高效生成<@ba.key>青霆剑</>，造成大量伤害。
guide_text_zhuangfy_chartrial01_01_5.en:
Use the team to apply <#ba.pulseinflict>Electric Infliction</>, trigger <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, then cast Zhuang Fangyi's battle skill to create <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> that deal continuous <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</> to the enemy.
Cast Zhuang Fangyi's ultimate and use her enhanced combo skill and battle skill to create <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> more effectively and deal massive DMG.

m1m10_desc_001.cn: 一批援助工团的物资在运输途中滞留，似乎是负责运输的Delta型多功能机器人陷入了故障。前往现场查看情况，完成故障机器人的修理。
m1m10_desc_001.en: A batch of supplies for the UWST has been delayed. The Delta general-purpose robots delivering the supplies appear to have malfunctioned. Investigate the site and fix the malfunctioning Deltas.

m1m24_desc_001.cn: 为了能通过集成工业系统生产工业爆炸物，还需要做些准备，先采集一些原材料吧。
m1m24_desc_001.en: You need to prepare your AIC Factory for producing Industrial Explosives. The first step is to find the raw materials.

m1m26_desc_001.cn: 一处被侵蚀潮损坏的探测信标。需要收集信标当前的状态信息，协助天师府学院进行研究与改进工作。
m1m26_desc_001.en: There is a detection beacon damaged by the Blight Tide. An update to the beacon's current status is required. Help the Tianshi Bureau Academy perform its research and improvement tasks.

m1m26_name.cn: 拍摄侵蚀潮中损坏的信标

m1m27_desc_001.cn: 蓄水源石虫在不同生态环境下，或独行或群聚。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院完善对这一现象的研究。
m1m27_desc_001.en: Cistern Originium Slugs either live independently or in groups depending on the local ecology or environment. Additional information is required by the Tianshi Bureau Academy to learn more about such phenomena.

m1m28_desc_001.cn: 动力竹筏上装有避免惊扰水中生物的调试器。需要收集动力竹筏行驶时七彩鳞的反应，协助天师府学院改进调试器。
m1m28_desc_001.en: Powered bamboo rafts have been furnished with modulators to avoid disturbing aquatic organisms. Actual responses by rainbow fins towards a working bamboo raft are still required to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy make improvements to the modulators.

m1m29_desc_001.cn: 室内试验田的观测设备因维修无法使用。需要收集试验田作物的当前状态信息，协助天师府学院进行数据分析。
m1m29_desc_001.en: The indoor testing plot video cameras are down for maintenance. Gather information on the current status of the test plots to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy analyze their data.

m1m30_desc_001.cn: 古树最近发出了一些很奇怪的声响。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对该区域进行生态监测。
m1m30_desc_001.en: Strange noises have been recently heard near the Ancient Tree. More information is required to help the monitoring center keep track of the local ecology.

m1m30_name.cn: 拍摄生长在小水潭上的古树

m1m31_desc_001.cn: 一个被弃用的天师桩。需要收集生长在倒塌天师桩上的植被信息，协助对“是否有必要搬移倒塌天师桩”的调查评估。
m1m31_desc_001.en: There is an abandoned Tianshi Pillar. Information is required about epiphytes growing on the collapsed structure to help determine the "necessity in removing the collapsed Tianshi Pillar".

m1m32_desc_001.cn: 一棵长在亭子中间，有着粉色叶子的树木。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对“栖霞驻影”突然大量落叶的调查。
m1m32_desc_001.en: There is a pink-leafed tree growing in a certain pavilion. More information is needed to help the monitoring center determine the cause behind the sudden leaf drop of the "Eternal Sunset".

m1m32_name.cn: 拍摄生长在亭子中间的“栖霞驻影”

m1m33_desc_001.cn: 一棵长在石柱侧面，有着白色叶子的树木。需要进行信息收集，协助观测站对“‘漱玉’是否会垮塌”进行的调查。
m1m33_desc_001.en: There is a white-leafed tree growing from the sides of a stone pillar. More information is required to help the monitoring center determine if "the 'Cleansing Jade' is falling off".

m1m33_name.cn: 拍摄在石柱上侧向生长的“漱玉”

m1m34_desc_001.cn: 蓄水源石虫在充满活力时会做出一些摇头晃脑的动作，但没有影像留存。需要收集影像资料，协助天师府学院完善记录。
m1m34_desc_001.en: When filled with vigor, Cistern Originium Slugs are said to actively shake and bob their heads. To date, we still have zero photographic evidence that proves this behavior. Help the Tianshi Bureau Academy document this activity and complete our records.

m1m34_name.cn: 拍摄充满活力的蓄水源石虫

m1m35_desc_001.cn: 吐虫长股兽会吐出发光的飞虫。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院研究吐虫长股兽的生理结构。
m1m35_desc_001.en: Bugspitting lankybeasts can spit glowing bugs. More information is required about these creatures to help the Tianshi Bureau Academy learn more about their anatomy and physiology.

m1m35_name.cn: 拍摄肚子鼓气后发光的吐虫长股兽

m1m36_desc_001.cn: 黑腹雉羽兽普遍采用人工养殖的方式。需要收集它们在田中的状态信息，协助天师府学院对当前田兽共作模式的研究评估。
m1m36_desc_001.en: The sable-chested fowlbeast is commonly raised in farms. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs field data of their activities to study the effectiveness of the current integrated cropland-fowlbeast farming approach.

m1m36_name.cn: 拍摄农田中东张西望的黑腹雉羽兽

m1m37_desc_001.cn: 根据从储备站递交的报告，储备站周边生态环境遭到了破坏，但具体情况未知。需要进行信息收集，协助天师府学院进行调查。
m1m37_desc_001.en: Reports submitted by the Field Logistics Depot described damages to the ecology around the facility. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs field data to investigate.

m1m37_name.cn: 拍摄储备站周围的生态环境

m1m38_desc_001.cn: 水灯虫是一种水栖昆虫。需要收集水灯虫露出腹腔时的影像信息，协助天师府学院对它的生理结构进行研究。
m1m38_desc_001.en: Waterlamps are aquatic insects. The Tianshi Bureau Academy needs photographic data of waterlamps exposing their abdomens to help study its physiological structure.

m1m39_desc_001.cn: 枢壤仪项目进展顺利。需要收集枢壤仪当前的状态数据，反馈给天师府学院，帮助其继续进行项目完善工作。
m1m39_desc_001.en: The Xiranite Nexus project is progressing smoothly. Collect data of its current status and share it with the Tianshi Bureau Academy. This will help the Academy carry out the project to its completion.

m1m40_desc_001.cn: 清波寨的水车有利于水中鳞兽的栖息繁衍，请将它的运作状态拍摄下来，以便学生们研究学习。
m1m40_desc_001.en: The waterwheels of Qingbo Stockade provide habitats conducive for local populations of aquatic fins. Please photograph a working waterwheel for the disciples to study and learn from.

m1m41_desc_001.cn: 清波寨的寨民荆芥请求管理员帮他采集一些药材。
m1m41_desc_001.en: Jing Jie of Qingbo Stockade needs your help to collect some herbs.

m1m42_desc_001.cn: 天师学徒沐奚给管理员发来消息，请求管理员帮忙定位实验用天桩的准确位置。
m1m42_desc_001.en: Tianshi disciple Mu Xi has sent you a message. She wonders if you can give her precise locations of experimental sky pole drones.

m1m43_desc_001.cn: 运输环境监测样本的Delta型多功能机器人似乎陷入了故障，样本无法被顺利回收。前往现场查看情况，完成故障机器人的修理。
m1m43_desc_001.en: Some environment monitoring samples cannot be recovered as the Delta general-purpose robots transporting them have broken down. Investigate the site and help repair the robot.

m1m56_desc_001.cn: 有传言称，当小壳兽因靠近而缩进壳里时，它会发出仅用相机才能捕捉到的光，请协助宏山科学院验证这一现象。
m1m56_desc_001.en: Rumors say that when a mini shellbeast adopts its defensive posture and withdraws into its shell, it emits a glow that could only be captured with a camera. Hongshan Academy of Sciences needs someone who can help verify this claim.

m1m56_name.cn: 拍摄缩进壳中的小壳兽

m1m57_desc_001.cn: 祖泉附近的战斗或许会对环形瀑布造成影响。出于安全考虑，请拍下它的现状，帮助天师府学院完成分析。
m1m57_desc_001.en: The battle near the Ancestral Spring may have affected the structure of the local annular waterfall. For safety considerations, please photograph its current state so that the Tianshi Bureau Academy can complete its analysis.

m1m57_name.cn: 拍摄祖泉周边的环形瀑布

m1m58_desc_001.cn: 清波寨古书中关于净水的模糊记录，不知是否与阶梯状石台及水竹铃有关。请拍下水竹铃，协助观测站完成分析。
m1m58_desc_001.en: Ancient records and writings from Qingbo Stockade include vague mentions of water purification. The staircase-shaped stone formation and bamboo water chimes may provide more leads. Please photograph the bamboo water chimes to help the monitoring center complete its analysis.

m1m59_desc_001.cn: 阮一的枯枝可能导致祖泉周边植物进入异常的枯萎状态，请拍摄枯枝与其周边景象，协助观测站进行环境监测。
m1m59_desc_001.en: The withered branches created by Ruan Yi may have caused anomalous desiccation and senescence of flora near the Ancestral Spring. Please photograph the withered branches and include the immediate surroundings in the shot to help the monitoring center analyze the local environment.

m1m60_desc_001.cn: 某位写生者称自己发现了谜之危险生物存在的证据，请将其拍摄下来，观测站将调查这一生物的来龙去脉。
m1m60_desc_001.en: A sketcher has claimed to have found evidence of a mysterious and potentially dangerous cryptid. Please photograph this evidence so that the monitoring center can investigate the true identity and origins of this creature.

m1m61_desc_001.cn: 它移植自北部禁区，从十年前的事故开始见证了太多悲欢离合，观测站会定期确认其生长状况，请协助拍摄。
m1m61_desc_001.en: This particular tree once grew in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. After being transplanted to its current location ten years ago, it has witnessed many events ranging from the joyful to the tragic. The monitoring center regularly assesses its growth, so please help take a photograph of it.

m1m62_desc_001.cn: 完成任务「致后来人」后可到达拍摄地。关注到蓄水站顶部的垂藤近日出现了过度生长的问题，请拍下它的现状，交由观测站分析。
m1m62_desc_001.en: Complete the mission [To Posterity] to reach the site of photography. The hanging vines atop the Reservoir Station seem to exhibit signs of excessive growth. Please photograph its current state so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

m1m63_desc_001.cn: 蓄水站工作人员搭设了这处植物观察点，只为培养生命力更强的植物。请将其拍摄下来，以便学生们研究学习。
m1m63_desc_001.en: Reservoir Station personnel have established this Flora Observation Point to cultivate and raise more resilient plants. Please photograph this location for the disciples to study and learn from.

m1m64_desc_001.cn: 栖云林地一直是观测站的定期监测目标之一，请将其现状拍摄下来，以供分析。
m1m64_desc_001.en: Cloudrest Woods is one of the many target areas regularly observed by the monitoring center. Please photograph its current state for analysis.

m1m65_desc_001.cn: 除去监测环境，观测站也需准备一些风景照，其主要用于修饰向宏科院本部发送的定期报告。
m1m65_desc_001.en: The monitoring center must provide photographs of the natural landscape in addition to its regular job of environmental monitoring. These photos are primarily used to embellish the center's regular reports for the Hongshan Academy of Sciences.

m1m66_desc_001.cn: 种下这棵桃树的人们，已为武陵献出了自己的生命。请拍摄桃树的现状，交由观测站记录。
m1m66_desc_001.en: The people who planted and nurtured the tree gave their lives for Wuling. Please photograph the peach tree so that the monitoring center can record its current state.

m1m66_name.en: Photo: Peach Tree at Babbles's Home

m1m67_desc_001.cn: 城建馆附近的水体出现了温度异常现象。请拍摄温控装置，交由观测站分析。
m1m67_desc_001.en: Abnormal temperature readings have been detected at water bodies near the Urban Development Hall. Please photograph the water temperature controller so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

m1m68_desc_001.cn: 长时间的雨打风吹似乎让安思园天师桩出现了一些故障。请拍摄安思园的天师桩，交由观测站分析。
m1m68_desc_001.en: Extended exposure to the elements has caused the Serenity Garden Tianshi Pillar to malfunction. Please photograph this facility so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

m1m69_desc_001.cn: 小叶荷花在武陵往往生长状态不佳，但保卫科附近的荷花却生机勃勃，请将之拍摄下来，以便观测站分析。
m1m69_desc_001.en: Bowl lotuses do not grow very well in Wuling, but those near the Security Section look remarkably hale and strong. Please photograph the lotuses so that the monitoring center can analyze them.

m1m6_desc_001.cn: 菲奥娜提醒附近有一处即将失控的能量淤积点，建议前去探查情况。
m1m6_desc_001.en: Fiona tells you about an Energy Alluvium going out of control and advises you to investigate it.

m1m70_desc_001.cn: “金秋时”是祭奠用的献花，其生命力较旺盛，最近出现了大量开放的状况，请将之拍摄下来，以便观测站分析。
m1m70_desc_001.en: "Autumn Gold" is a flower known for its hardiness and is typically used as an offering during remembrance rites. Recently, people have reported a blooming spree of these flowers. Please photograph the plants so that the monitoring center can analyze them.

m1m71_desc_001.cn: 首墩周边深度读数存在异常起伏，疑似与巨兽心脏有关。请拍摄巨兽心脏，交由观测站分析。
m1m71_desc_001.en: Depth readings near the Marker Stone have exhibited abnormal fluctuations. This may be related to the Feranmut Heart. Please photograph the structure so that the monitoring center can analyze it.

m1m72_desc_001.cn: 这些身影与超域息息相关，不知会对首墩环境造成怎样的影响，请将之拍摄下来，交由观测站分析。
m1m72_desc_001.en: These entities are closely linked to the Æther and we are uncertain how they might affect the environment of the Marker Stone. Please photograph them so that the monitoring center can investigate.

m1m73_desc_001.cn: 蟠兽群又把武陵城的居民区弄得一团糟，环卫职工陈平安发来求救信息，请求协助清理。
m1m73_desc_001.en: Once again the pantailbeasts have made a mess of the Residential Area. Urban sanitation worker Chen Ping'an has issued a call for help.

m1m74_desc_001.cn: 武陵天师府学院计划研究首墩区域的表象，寻找彻底将其清除的方法。奚墨天师的学生沈迟白发来请求，需要拍几张异常区域的照片以供研究。
m1m74_desc_001.en: The Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy is planning to study the Æthillu at the Marker Stone and figure out a way to permanently remove them. Shen Chibai, a disciple of Tianshi Xi Mo, asks if you can photograph a few anomalous areas for the research.

m1m75_desc_001.cn: 将物资送往藏剑谷的运输机器人频频失踪。林瑚发来请求，希望管理员能帮忙找到运输机器人和丢失的物资。
m1m75_desc_001.en: Many logistics robots delivering supplies to Sword Vault Dale have went missing. Lin Hu asks you to help find the missing logistics robots and the lost supplies.

m1m77_desc_001.cn: 武陵天师府学院计划研究首墩区域的表象，寻找彻底将其清除的方法。奚墨天师的学生沈迟白发来请求，需要拍几张异常区域的照片以供研究。
m1m77_desc_001.en: The Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy is planning to study the Æthillu at the Marker Stone and figure out a way to permanently remove them. Shen Chibai, a disciple of Tianshi Xi Mo, asks if you can photograph a few anomalous areas for the research.

m1m78_desc_001.cn: 武陵天师府学院计划研究首墩区域的表象，寻找彻底将其清除的方法。奚墨天师的学生沈迟白发来请求，需要拍几张异常区域的照片以供研究。
m1m78_desc_001.en: The Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy is planning to study the Æthillu at the Marker Stone and figure out a way to permanently remove them. Shen Chibai, a disciple of Tianshi Xi Mo, asks if you can photograph a few anomalous areas for the research.

m1m79_desc_001.cn: 武陵天师府学院计划研究首墩区域的表象，寻找彻底将其清除的方法。奚墨天师的学生沈迟白发来请求，需要拍几张异常区域的照片以供研究。
m1m79_desc_001.en: The Wuling Tianshi Bureau Academy is planning to study the Æthillu at the Marker Stone and figure out a way to permanently remove them. Shen Chibai, a disciple of Tianshi Xi Mo, asks if you can photograph a few anomalous areas for the research.

m1m80_desc_001.cn: 已收集到塔晶，看看它能在塔晶集换中兑换些什么。
m1m80_desc_001.en: Talosite acquired. Visit the Talosite Exchange and see what you can trade the crystals for.

rewardshow_tips.en: Engage in World Exploration, challenge Protocol Spaces, and take part in various activities to earn rich rewards such as <@activitybenefits.originium>Origeometries</> and <@activitybenefits.originium>Oroberyls</>.

scene_dg002_start.cn: 少女模样的佩丽卡：“你来了。”两人看向天空中的<@gd.key>巨大源石</>，幻影说那便是我们的目标。
scene_dg002_start.en: "You've arrived," said a young Perlica. Both looked upon the <@gd.key>giant Originium</> in the sky. The phantom illusion told us that would be our target.

scene_indie_dg007_layer_tips_2.en: Marker Stone Middle Floor, Main Section

scene_indie_dg007_layer_tips_5.en: Marker Stone Middle Floor, Secondary Section

scene_map01_lv001_sub02_tips_1.cn: 发现了落在列车上的货物，然而列车卡在了一个无法攀爬上去的位置
scene_map01_lv001_sub02_tips_1.en: Found some cargo left on the carriage, but it's stuck at a place inaccessible by climbing

scene_map01_lv001_sub02_tips_2.cn: 尝试联系物流人员并说明了情况
scene_map01_lv001_sub02_tips_2.en: Try contacting the logistics staff and describe the situation

scene_map01_lv005_sub01_tips_1.en: Access Card required to activate this

scene_map02_lv001_submit_e5m1_yujian2.cn: 拥有玉键不足，修复失败
scene_map02_lv001_submit_e5m1_yujian2.en: Not enough Jade Keys to repair

scene_map02_lv002_submit_gm02m8_2.cn: 未注入足量的息壤，符文组件激活失败。
scene_map02_lv002_submit_gm02m8_2.en: Insufficient Xiranite infused. Rune activation failed.

settlement_td_battle_desc_1.cn: 保护所有指挥核心并击败全部入侵的敌人
settlement_td_battle_desc_1.en: Protect all Command Cores and defeat all enemies

settlement_td_prepare_desc_1.cn: 在据点中布置作战设备，做好防守准备
settlement_td_prepare_desc_1.en: Prepare your defenses by placing combat facilities in the outpost

settlement_td_prepare_desc_2.cn:
在据点中布置作战设备，做好防守准备
<@gd.key>自动防御模式干员无法参战</>
settlement_td_prepare_desc_2.en:
Prepare your defenses by placing combat facilities in the outpost 
<@gd.key>Operators cannot intervene in Auto-Defense mode</>

sm1l1m10_desc_001.cn: 集成工业研究所的分管负责人希茜疑似失踪。前往求援信息指示地点，确保人员安全。
sm1l1m10_desc_001.en: Cynthia, our AIC Research Center (AIC-RC) Manager, is missing. You must find her and ensure her safety.

sm1l1m10_desc_003.cn: 灾害发生时，集成工业研究所的分管负责人希茜正在前往停车场。前去该位置查看，展开搜救。
sm1l1m10_desc_003.en: AIC-RC Manager Cynthia was heading to the parking lot when the Ankhorfall took place. Go to the parking lot and start your search and rescue mission.

sm1l1m10_desc_006.cn: 管理员顺利清理了停车场区域的天使，救出了集成工业研究所的分管负责人希茜。不过，异常聚集的天使引起了众人的注意。
sm1l1m10_desc_006.en: You clear out the Aggeloi in the parking lot and save AIC-RC Manager Cynthia. The unusual gathering of Aggeloi in this place has attracted a rather unhealthy attention.

sm1l1m10_desc_007.cn: 人们仍在顾虑终末地工业对天使的“研究”。与秦茳尺一起前去解释原委，争取信任。
sm1l1m10_desc_007.en: The locals are worried about the pulse generator and its ability to attract the Aggeloi. Work with Director Qin to calm the people and earn their trust.

sm1l1m11_desc_001.cn: 管理员在枢纽区基地帮助解决了许多问题，是时候再去和秦茳尺聊聊了。
sm1l1m11_desc_001.en: You have solved many issues at the Hub Base. Time to talk to Director Qin again.

sm1l1m1_desc_001.cn: 裂地者画下的无色涂鸦引起了一名基地警卫的注意，管理员决定设法探明这些印记隐藏的讯息。
sm1l1m1_desc_001.en: Invisible Landbreaker graffiti have attracted the attention of a security officer. You decide to uncover the truth behind these cryptic messages.

sm1l1m1_desc_002.cn: 管理员夺回了工团在袭击中失去的物资。返回源石副产物中心，将物资交给萨特。
sm1l1m1_desc_002.en: You successfully reclaim the lost UWST supplies. Return to the Originium BPPC and give them to Satyr.

sm1l1m2_desc_001.cn: 发现碾骨印记的警卫乔斯特给管理员发来了新消息，称自己的调查已有进展。
sm1l1m2_desc_001.en: Security officer Jouster who found the invisible Bonekrusher glyphs has sent you some messages. His investigation has made some progress.

sm1l1m2_desc_002.cn: 警卫乔斯特从朋友那里得到了更多关于“碾骨印记”的知识。管理员决定对这些印记展开进一步的调查。
sm1l1m2_desc_002.en: Security officer Jouster's friend has given him more information about "Bonekrusher glyphs". You decide to follow the lead.

sm1l1m2_desc_003.cn: 管理员根据涂鸦的指引发现了裂地者的营地，以及一处被封锁的山洞。观察四周，寻找开启山洞大门的方法。
sm1l1m2_desc_003.en: You follow the LB glyphs and find an LB stronghold and a sealed cave. Look around for a way to open the gate to the cave.

sm1l1m2_desc_004.cn: 找到乔斯特了解下事情的详细
sm1l1m2_desc_004.en: Find Jouster to learn more about the situation.

sm1l1m4_desc_001.cn: 枢纽区基地的物流主管莎曼已经忙得焦头烂额，也许管理员能帮她做些什么。
sm1l1m4_desc_001.en: The director of the Hub Base is overwhelmed with work. Perhaps you can help her out, Endministrator.

sm1l1m4_desc_002.cn: 哈特曼不慎将合同落在了车上。前往枢纽区基地，与哈特曼会合。
sm1l1m4_desc_002.en: Hartmann accidentally left the contract in his car. Head to the Hub Base to meet up with him.

sm1l1m4_desc_003.cn: 哈特曼的认证密钥被可疑的“裂地者”夺去。为哈特曼建立档案，等待他重新准备交易。
sm1l1m4_desc_003.en: Hartmann's verification key was stolen by suspicious "Landbreakers". Create a file on Agent Hartmann and wait for his company to resume negotiations.

sm1l1m5_desc_001.cn: 埃里克松商贸再次发来消息。查看消息，了解具体情况。
sm1l1m5_desc_001.en: Erikssohn Trading House has news again. Read their message for more information.

sm1l1m5_desc_002.cn: 新业务员亚历山大称哈特曼是“诈骗犯”。为了防止不法之徒影响业务，必须厘清个中真相。
sm1l1m5_desc_002.en: The new agent Aleksandr called Hartmann a fraud. You must find out the truth behind this incident to prevent frauds from getting into this deal.

sm1l1m5_desc_003.cn: 小小一桩业务竟有多方插手，眼下掌握的情报还不足以支持判断。更新业务员们的档案，等待事态继续发展。
sm1l1m5_desc_003.en: Multiple companies are competing for a small Endfield contract. You lack the intel to make up your mind. Update the agents' files and see how the negotiations unfold.

sm1l1m6_desc_001.cn: 真假业务员的问题仍然阻碍着交易的顺利进行。为了避免被骗，仍需展开进一步的调查。
sm1l1m6_desc_001.en: Negotiations have stalled as you now have to deal with agent identity theft. You decide to further your investigations to reveal the truth behind the fraud.

sm1l1m6_desc_002.cn: 管理员通过调查厘清了事件经过。接下来，该和两位真正的业务员合影，并更新档案信息了。
sm1l1m6_desc_002.en: You have investigated the entire incident. Take a group photograph of the 2 dedicated agents and update their files.

sm1l1m6_desc_003.cn: 真相终于水落石出。现在，是时候决定业务的合作对象了。
sm1l1m6_desc_003.en: The truth has been revealed. You must now decide who to sign the contract with.

sm1l1m7_desc_001.cn: 四号谷地的重建工程已经启动。秦茳尺希望向管理员介绍相关工作的进展。
sm1l1m7_desc_001.en: The Valley IV Rebuilding Project has begun. Director Qin hopes to give you an update of her work.

sm1l1m8_desc_004.cn: 管理员协助莱雅与莱科关闭了旧工厂区的精炼炉。化险为夷之后，该与坚持完成了使命的两人聊一聊了。
sm1l1m8_desc_004.en: You help Laeya and Lykor shut down the Old Factory Refining Unit and successfully avert a potential disaster. The team has accomplished their mission. Talk to Laeya and Lykor again.

sm1l1m8_desc_005.cn: 秦茳尺有许多来不及处理的工作需要分担。前往旧工厂区，协助处理灾害导致的问题。
sm1l1m8_desc_005.en: Qin Jiangchi is overwhelmed with pending operations. Go to the Old Factory and assist with post-disaster relief.

sm1l1m8_desc_006.cn: 为了清除旧工厂区的安全隐患，管理员需要帮助莱雅与莱科关闭不稳定的源石精炼炉。
sm1l1m8_desc_006.en: You need to help Laeya and Lykor shut down an unstable Refining Unit in the Old Factory to prevent a potential disaster.

sm1l1m9_desc_001.cn: 工人之家有人需要帮助，管理员决定前去查看情况。
sm1l1m9_desc_001.en: Someone needs help at the Worker Dorms. You decide to investigate.

sm1l1m9_desc_002.cn: 工人们不仅缺少物资，士气也很低落，埃里克希望管理员帮助改善这一局面。
sm1l1m9_desc_002.en: The workers are low on supplies and morale. Eric hopes that you can help improve the situation.

sm1l1m9_desc_007.cn: 与管理员一起为工人们送完物资之后，埃里克似乎有话要说。
sm1l1m9_desc_007.en: Having delivered supplies to the crew mates with you, Eric seems to have something to say.

sm1l2m1_desc_001.cn: 众生长地的弧光正在请求终末地的帮助。管理员决定前往谷地通道，与佩丽卡等人会合。
sm1l2m1_desc_001.en: Arclight of the Hannabit Circuit is requesting help from Endfield. You decide to head to the entrance of the Valley Pass and meet up with Perlica.

sm1l2m1_desc_002.cn: 弧光已经动身前去寻找米娅。根据卡贾的说法，米娅涂改过的裂地者涂鸦或许能成为一种线索。
sm1l2m1_desc_002.en: Arclight has gone ahead to look for Mia. According to what Karja said, the LB graffiti modified by Mia can be used to track them down.

sm1l2m1_desc_003.cn: 山洞里有一道暗门。管理员一行需要找到开启暗门的方法，前往被它封锁的区域。
sm1l2m1_desc_003.en: The Landbreaker "lab" has a secret door. You must open it and explore the hidden area.

sm1l2m2_desc_001.cn: 洞窟的铁牢中有数位受困者，必须尽快将他们解救出来。
sm1l2m2_desc_001.en: You enter the cave and see several people locked up in metal cages. You must rescue them immediately.

sm1l2m2_desc_003.cn: 管理员一行成功开启了山洞里的暗门。前方也许能找到有关米娅去向的线索。
sm1l2m2_desc_003.en: You successfully open the secret door of the Landbreaker "lab". You hope you can find clues of Mia's whereabouts.

sm1l2m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员在裂地者的囚笼中发现了一名伤痕累累的神秘人物。将他解救出来，了解在他身上发生的事。
sm1l2m3_desc_001.en: You find a heavily wounded warrior in a Landbreaker cage. He seems to be in need of help.

sm1l2m3_desc_002.cn: 瓦茨打算自行寻找丢失的剩余货物。跟上瓦茨，为他提供帮助。
sm1l2m3_desc_002.en: Waitz is determined to track down the missing cargo alone. Follow and provide backup.

sm1l2m3_desc_003.cn: 谷地要塞似乎还有需要帮助的人，也许可以前去确认实际情况。
sm1l2m3_desc_003.en: Someone at Valley Fort seems to be in need of help. Go there and investigate.

sm1l2m3_desc_004.cn: 瓦茨的行李被裂地者夺走了。调查周围地点，寻找瓦茨丢失的行李。
sm1l2m3_desc_004.en: Waitz's belongings were seized by the Landbreakers. Scout the perimeter and recover the missing supplies.

sm1l2m3_name.en: In for a Penny, In for a Pound

sm1l2m4_desc_001.cn: 管理员在谷地通道发现了碾骨氏族的“藏宝地”。探索四周，寻找进入山洞的方法。
sm1l2m4_desc_001.en: You find a Bonekrusher loot cave at the Valley Pass. Look around and find a way to get inside.

sm1l3m1_desc_001.cn: 菲奥娜收到了来自阿伯莉采石场的一条求援讯号。前往阿伯莉采石场，了解现场状况。
sm1l3m1_desc_001.en: Fiona has received a distress call from the Aburrey Quarry. Go to the Quarry and assess the situation.

sm1l3m2_desc_001.cn: 为了前往阿伯莉采石场的其他区域，管理员一行人需要寻找修复大型起重机的方法。
sm1l3m2_desc_001.en: To reach other areas of the Aburrey Quarry, you must find a way to repair the super crane.

sm1l3m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人顺利修复了大型起重机，继续向阿伯莉采石场的其他区域前进。
sm1l3m2_desc_002.en: You successfully repair the super crane and continue your way to other areas of the Aburrey Quarry.

sm1l3m2_desc_003.cn: 管理员一行人经过老工人佩妮的指点，顺利通过采石作业区，准备前往深层管理区开展救援工作。
sm1l3m2_desc_003.en: You follow veteran Penny's advice and successfully make your way through the Quarry Site. You are now ready to continue your search and rescue work at the Deep Management Post.

sm1l3m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员一行人顺利到达了深层管理区。继续深入，寻找失联的工团成员。
sm1l3m3_desc_001.en: You successfully reach the Deep Management Post. Head in and try to find the missing UWST crew mates.

sm1l3m3_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人设法修复了电梯，成功救出了被困在深层管理区的工人们。是时候返回吊运中枢，向各位报告好消息了。
sm1l3m3_desc_002.en: You repair the elevator and successfully rescue the UWST crew mates trapped at the Deep Management Post. Time to return to Lifter Central and share the good news.

sm1l5m1_desc_001.cn: 在收到法比安·柯林斯发来的信息后，管理员为了进一步了解他所说的意外状况，决定前去与他会合。
sm1l5m1_desc_001.en: You have received messages from Fabian Collins. To learn more about the "unexpected sitch" he mentioned, you decide to meet up with him.

sm1l5m2_desc_001.cn: 得知拉奎尔逃走的消息，管理员决定先与艾维文娜会合。
sm1l5m2_desc_001.en: Raquel has escaped. You decide to meet Avywenna first.

sm1l5m3_desc_001.cn: 得知工团的基建前站建设遭遇了困境，管理员一行打算前往基建前站工地提供帮助并在那里投放次级核心。

sm1l5m3_desc_002.cn: 附近还有很多人，去向他们打探一下消息。

sm1l5m3_desc_003.cn: 帮大潘给基建前站工地的工人们送食物，顺便和他们聊聊。

sm1l5m3_desc_004.cn: 大潘似乎有些话没说明，再去找他聊聊。

sm1l5m3_desc_005.cn: 为方便工人通行，在峡谷的两侧建造滑索架。

sm1l5m3_desc_006.cn: 大潘有一批食材留在了源石实验园区的大楼附近，去那边帮他取回来。

sm1l5m3_desc_007.cn: 将取回的食材送还给大潘。

sm1l5m4_desc_001.cn: 得知基建前站即将完工，管理员一行决定再次前往基建前站工地了解情况。

sm1l5m4_desc_002.cn: 找诺夫曼详细了解一下基建前站工程的进展情况。

sm1l5m4_desc_003.cn: 大潘似乎有话说，听一听他的看法。

sm1l5m4_desc_004.cn: 把大潘模仿卡尔写的笔记交给诺夫曼。

sm1l5m4_desc_006.cn: 收集备用零件，交给大潘。

sm1l5m4_desc_007.cn: 总控中心的设备已经修好了，和大潘聊聊。

sm1l5m4_desc_008.cn: 返回基建前站工地，把桂花糕交给诺夫曼。

sm1l6m1_desc_001.cn: 得知了终末地发往矿区营地的药物丢失的消息，管理员决定前往矿区营地了解情况。
sm1l6m1_desc_001.en: You learn about a missing batch of Endfield medical supplies en route to the Mining Camp. You decide to go to the Mining Camp to investigate.

sm1l6m2_desc_001.cn: 为了解救莫莉，管理员一行决定深入探索气候监测站。
sm1l6m2_desc_001.en: To rescue Molly, you decide to infiltrate and search the meteorological station.

sm1l6m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员从阿丽娅处得知詹娜的病况，决定前往矿区医疗站探望她。
sm1l6m3_desc_001.en: Endmin learns about Jenner's situation from Alia, and decides to visit her at the Mining Area Clinic.

sm1l6m4_desc_001.cn: 管理员收到阿丽娅的信息，得知詹娜再次失踪，决定前往矿区营地了解详情。
sm1l6m4_desc_001.en: Endmin receives a message from Alia saying Jenner has once again gone missing, and decides to go to the Mining Camp.

sm1l7m1_desc_001.cn: 克劳的学徒安格鲁发来消息，似乎是需要管理员一行帮什么忙。
sm1l7m1_desc_001.en: Crowe's apprentice, Angro sends you a message. It seems they need your assistance.

sm1l7m1_desc_002.cn: 目前的线索暂不能断定尤莉娅有泄密行为，管理员一行决定从她的上司季米特里查起。
sm1l7m1_desc_002.en: Current evidence remains inconclusive regarding Yulia's involvement in any data breach. The Endmin's team shift focus to her immediate superior, Dmitry, for the next phase of the investigation.

sm1l7m1_desc_003.cn: 无论格奥尔基是否叛变，储藏点的异常损耗都是实证，管理员一行决定和他当面对质。
sm1l7m1_desc_003.en: Regardless of Georgi's allegiance, the storage depot discrepancies remain indisputable, prompting the Enministrator's team to confront him directly.

sm1l7m1_desc_004.cn: 虽然不是安格鲁指定的嫌疑人，但阿尔乔姆的异常行迹十分可疑。管理员一行决定顺藤摸瓜，继续查下去。
sm1l7m1_desc_004.en: Though not originally flagged by Angro, Artyom's aberrant movements now burn red across the investigation board. The Endministrator's team follows this fresh trail, wherever its coils may lead.

sm1l7m1_desc_005.cn: 调查有了一定进展，是时候找安格鲁和肖娜聊聊目前的进度了。
sm1l7m1_desc_005.en: The investigation has made some progress, and it's time to talk to Angro and Shawna about the current progress.

sm1l7m1_desc_006.cn: 收到安格鲁发来的消息，似乎是工人们得知了目前调查的内容，得加快调查进程以稳定局势。
sm1l7m1_desc_006.en: You receive a message from Angro. It seems the workers have found out about the current investigation. Speed up the investigation process to stabilize the situation.

sm1l7m1_desc_007.cn: 肖娜发来了消息，她似乎想和管理员当面聊聊。
sm1l7m1_desc_007.en: Shawna seems to want to chat with the Endmin face-to-face.

sm1l7m2_desc_001.cn: 管理员接到菲奥娜的消息，得知工团投放在供能高地的运输机器人出现了神秘的大范围故障。为了调查问题根源，管理员决定前往源石发电站获取更多情报。
sm1l7m2_desc_001.en: You receive a message from Fiona and learn that the fleet of logistics robots deployed by the UWST at the Power Plateau has suffered a large-scale breakdown. The causes are still unknown. To get to the bottom of this issue, you decide to go to the Originium Power Plant to gather more intel.

sm2l1m1_desc_001.cn: 受弭弗所托，管理员一行人前往清波寨外寨北面，查看巡卫的情况。
sm2l1m1_desc_001.en: Following Mi Fu's request, you head to the north of Qingbo Bailey to check on the watchguard.

sm2l1m1_desc_002.cn: 迷踪林似乎真的出现了异常，管理员一行人打算深入竹林，继续调查。
sm2l1m1_desc_002.en: Something really does seem off in the Stragglers Grove. You decide to venture deeper into the bamboo grove to investigate.

sm2l1m2_desc_001.cn: 管理员一行人决定跟随脚印，往西边前进，继续搜寻失踪人员。
sm2l1m2_desc_001.en: You decide to follow the footprints westward, continuing the search for the missing people.

sm2l1m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人前往修复西壹号核心。
sm2l1m2_desc_002.en: You proceed to fix Core W1.

sm2l1m3_desc_001.cn: 为了寻找失踪的天师，管理员一行人决定乘竹筏前往南山。
sm2l1m3_desc_001.en: To find the missing Tianshi, you decide to take a bamboo raft to South Hill.

sm2l1m3_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人前往修复南叁号核心。
sm2l1m3_desc_002.en: You proceed to fix Core S3.

sm2l1m4_desc_001.cn: 三个核心都修复完成后，迷踪林中似乎产生了一些变化。
sm2l1m4_desc_001.en: All three cores have been fixed. It seems that some changes have occurred in the Stragglers Grove.

sm2l1m5_desc_001.cn: 踩道南边有动静，也许是有人需要帮助。
sm2l1m5_desc_001.en: Sounds of activity come from the south side of the Treadway, perhaps someone needs your help.

sm2l1m5_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人找到了逃跑的长耳兽，它被大桨关了起来。
sm2l1m5_desc_002.en: You find Woolsey, she's been locked up by Da Jiang.

sm2l1m5_desc_003.cn: 长耳兽再次逃离，管理员一行人不得不再次踏上寻兽之路。
sm2l1m5_desc_003.en: Woolsey runs off again. You have no choice but to set out once more on the hunting journey.

sm2l1m5_desc_004.cn: 在管理员一行人的鼓励下，阿土决定继续寻找长耳兽。
sm2l1m5_desc_004.en: With your encouragement, Ah Tu resolves to keep looking for Woolsey.

sm2l2m1_desc_001.cn: 应黎风的请求，管理员前往工农生产单位，参加驮兽科学饲养交流会。
sm2l2m1_desc_001.en: At Lifeng's request, you head to the industrial and agricultural production unit to join the Burdenbeast Care Workshop.

sm2l2m1_desc_002.cn: 工农生产单位的职农们都是饲养驮兽的高手，听听他们对此的独到见解。
sm2l2m1_desc_002.en: The farmers at the industrial and agricultural production unit are all experts at raising burdenbeasts. Listen to their unique insights.

sm2l2m1_desc_003.cn: 名叫小武的牧童前来求助，希望管理员能帮忙寻找丢失的老驮兽。
sm2l2m1_desc_003.en: Little Wu, a herdsboy, comes seeking your help, hoping you can find his Old Burdenbeast.

sm2l2m1_desc_004.cn: 找到老驮兽后，它请求管理员帮自己寻找年轻时耕作的田地。
sm2l2m1_desc_004.en: After finding the Old Burdenbeast, he asks you to help him find the farm he used to work in when he was young.

sm2l2m1_desc_005.cn: 老驮兽愤怒离去，管理员和小武需要赶紧追上它。
sm2l2m1_desc_005.en: The Old Burdenbeast leaves angrily. You and Little Wu must quickly follow him.

sm2l2m1_desc_006.cn: 应老驮兽要求，管理员为市民广场上的众人拍一张合照。
sm2l2m1_desc_006.en: At the Old Burdenbeast's request, you take a photo of the entire crowd in the Citizen Square.

sm2l2m1_desc_007.cn: 老驮兽从市民广场消失后，管理员和小武跟着照片中的脚印前往城郊寻找。
sm2l2m1_desc_007.en: After the Old Burdenbeast disappears from the Citizen Square, you and Little Wu follow the footprints in the photo to the outskirts of the city.

sm2l2m1_desc_008.cn: 老驮兽混在了驮兽群当中，想办法找出它。
sm2l2m1_desc_008.en: The Old Burdenbeast has blended in with the herd. Figure out a way to identify him.

sm2l2m1_desc_009.cn: 受到老驮兽的“胁迫”，管理员不得不前往息流总闸为它打一壶清水。
sm2l2m1_desc_009.en: Under the Old Burdenbeast's "pressure," you have no choice but to go to the main Xiranflow sluice to draw a pot of fresh water for him.

sm2l2m1_desc_010.cn: 与神秘地出现在息流总闸的老驮兽对话。
sm2l2m1_desc_010.en: Talk to the Old Burdenbeast that mysteriously appeared at the main Xiranflow sluice.

sm2l2m1_desc_011.cn: 管理员和小武闻到一股奇怪的味道，这是老驮兽留下的线索。
sm2l2m1_desc_011.en: You and Little Wu smell a strange scent left behind by the Old Burdenbeast. This might be a clue.

sm2l2m1_desc_012.cn: 清除出现在城郊的水灯虫。

sm2l2m1_desc_013.cn: 前往老驮兽真正耕作过的田地。
sm2l2m1_desc_013.en: Go to the farm where the Old Burdenbeast actually worked at.

sm2l2m1_desc_014.cn: 管理员收到了黎风发来的消息，看看他想说什么。
sm2l2m1_desc_014.en: You've received a message from Lifeng. Read what he says.

sm2l2m1_desc_016.cn: 前往市民广场寻找老驮兽。
sm2l2m1_desc_016.en: Go to the Citizen Square to find the Old Burdenbeast

sm2l2m1_desc_017.cn: 老驮兽突然消失，也许能从照片中找到一些线索。
sm2l2m1_desc_017.en: The Old Burdenbeast suddenly disappears. Perhaps the photo you took can offer some clues.

sm2l2m1_desc_018.cn: 从梦中苏醒，管理员眼前只剩下黎风。
sm2l2m1_desc_018.en: Awakening from a dream, you find only Lifeng before you.

sm2l2m2_desc_001.cn: 管理员接受了陈千语的邀请，决定前往方兴衢体验武陵生活。
sm2l2m2_desc_001.en: The Endministrator accepts Chen Qianyu's invitation and decides to visit Fangxing Avenue for a proper experience of life in Wuling.

sm2l2m2_desc_003.cn: 在方兴衢，管理员一行人被一处围观人群吸引，前去查看。
sm2l2m2_desc_003.en: The Endministrator's team notices a crowd at Fangxing Avenue. The Endfielders decide to investigate.

sm2l2m2_desc_004.cn: 管理员一行人前去帮助阿仔准备比赛。
sm2l2m2_desc_004.en: The Endministrator's team goes to Ah Zai to help him prepare for the competition.

sm2l2m2_desc_018.cn: 管理员一行人前去帮助田阿姨准备比赛。
sm2l2m2_desc_018.en: The Endministrator's team goes to Aunt Tian to help her prepare for the competition.

sm2l2m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员一行人受尹冬所托，寻找他失踪的老师——莫天师。有人曾目击莫天师在侵蚀潮来袭时冲出了城外。待修缮区附近曾被侵蚀破坏，需要利用扫描功能来搜索四周遗留的线索。
sm2l2m3_desc_001.en: Yin Dong asks the Endministrator's team to help find his missing mentor, Tianshi Mo. Someone witnessed Tianshi Mo rushing out of Wuling when the Blight Tide surged against the city. The areas near the Maintenance Zone have been damaged by the Blight. Scan the area to find clues.

sm2l2m3_desc_002.cn: 线索直到侵蚀潮前便戛然而止，莫天师依然生死未卜。管理员一行人决定先把目前的情报告诉尹冬。
sm2l2m3_desc_002.en: The leads suddenly end right before the Blight Tide. The Endministrator's team is uncertain if Tianshi Mo is still alive, so they decide to share what they have learned so far with Yin Dong.

sm2l2m3_desc_003.cn: 管理员一行人均不想就此放弃，决定前往莫天师曾待过的城区医疗点查看情况。
sm2l2m3_desc_003.en: The Endministrator's team has no intent to give up. They decide to go to the City Medical Clinic where Tianshi Mo was hospitalized and continue their investigations.

sm2l2m3_desc_004.cn: 得知莫天师曾多次离开城区医疗点，前往技术生产办公室的试验田，管理员一行人决定前去寻找线索。
sm2l2m3_desc_004.en: The Endministrator's team learns that Tianshi Mo has left the City Medical Clinic on multiple occasions for the Technological Production Office test fields. The team thus decides to continue their investigations there.

sm2l2m3_desc_005.cn: 技术生产办公室的试验田受损严重。管理员一行人决定帮助天师清理试验田内的侵蚀，同时寻找莫天师留下的痕迹。
sm2l2m3_desc_005.en: The test fields of the Technological Production Office have been severely polluted. The Endministrator's team decides to help the Tianshi clean up the Blight while searching for clues to Tianshi Mo's whereabouts.

sm2l2m3_desc_006.cn: 尹冬告诉众人他有了新的线索。管理员一行人决定去材料研究所，看看那里有没有新的发现。
sm2l2m3_desc_006.en: Yin Dong tells the Endministrator's team about his new findings. The team decides to visit the Institute of Materials Science and look for new leads.

sm2l2m3_desc_008.cn: 莫天师曾经在材料研究所进行过极为危险的“打潮鞭”项目研究。管理员一行人决定在研究所内再找找，看看是否还有其他与莫天师或与其研究相关的信息。
sm2l2m3_desc_008.en: Tianshi Mo once worked at the Institute of Materials Science on an extremely dangerous project titled "Tide Flayer". The Endministrator's team decides to investigate the Institute and look for additional data on Tianshi Mo and his project.

sm2l2m3_desc_009.cn: 资料室内的材料上记载了莫天师的旧居。管理员一行人决定顺着线索前往莫天师的家，看看他是否回到过那里。
sm2l2m3_desc_009.en: The data room has information on Tianshi Mo's old residence. The Endministrator's team decides to follow the leads, visit the place, and check if the Tianshi has recently returned there.

sm2l2m3_desc_010.cn: 管理员一行人来到莫天师的旧居，发现有人来过此处，一行人决定在此处进行调查。
sm2l2m3_desc_010.en: The Endministrator's team arrives at Tianshi Mo's old residence and finds out that someone has already paid a visit. The team then decides to investigate the location.

sm2l2m3_desc_011.cn: 尹冬想到了莫天师可能会在安思园，管理员一行人与他相约前往。
sm2l2m3_desc_011.en: Yin Dong believes that Tianshi Mo might be at Serenity Garden. The Endministrator's team promises to meet him there.

sm2l2m3_name.en: The Old Man and the Tide I

sm2l2m4_desc_001.cn: 尹冬发来了讯息，表示想在安思园见一见那位与莫天师有约的友人。
sm2l2m4_desc_001.en: Yin Dong has toasted a few messages. He intends to meet the friend who has agreed to meet Tianshi Mo.

sm2l2m4_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人准备前往安思园，与尹冬会合，看看与莫天师约好的是什么人。
sm2l2m4_desc_002.en: The Endministrator's team prepares to head to Serenity Garden, meet with Yin Dong, and see the people who promised to meet Tianshi Mo.

sm2l2m4_desc_003.cn: 庄方宜和大潘推断莫天师没能放下执念，决定带众人前往观测站，那里是给莫天师留下仇恨的侵蚀潮所在的地方。
sm2l2m4_desc_003.en: Zhuang Fangyi and Da Pan deduce that Tianshi Mo never abandoned his obsession and decide to lead everyone to the monitoring center. The Blight Tide at the site is the source of Tianshi Mo's grievance and hatred.

sm2l2m4_desc_004.cn: 弃剑台附近的侵蚀潮出现异状，尹冬担心与莫天师有关，管理员一行人决定前往查看。
sm2l2m4_desc_004.en: The Blight Tide near Qijian Dais is behaving strangely. Yin Dong is worried that Tianshi Mo is the cause of this, and so the Endministrator's team decides to take a look.

sm2l2m4_desc_005.cn: 抵达弃剑台，管理员一行人决定在岛上搜索，看看能不能找到与莫天师有关的线索。
sm2l2m4_desc_005.en: The Endministrator's team arrives at Qijian Dais and decides to search the island for Tianshi Mo or any clues he left behind.

sm2l2m4_name.en: The Old Man and the Tide II

sm2l2m6_desc_001.cn: 管理员一行得知田阿姨家遭到意外入侵，决定前往调查。
sm2l2m6_desc_001.en: The Endministrator's team learns of a break-in at Aunt Tian's home and decides to investigate.

sm2l2m6_desc_003.cn: 管理员一行发现田阿姨家遭闯一事或与阿仔有关，遂前去寻找阿仔问询。
sm2l2m6_desc_003.en: The Endministrator's team discovers that Ah Zai might be involved in the break-in at Aunt Tian's home. The team decides to find Ah Zai and ask him a few questions.

sm2l2m6_desc_007.cn: 从阿仔处了解缘由后，管理员一行决定返回田阿姨家，再次询问情况。
sm2l2m6_desc_007.en: After learning the entire story from Ah Zai, the Endministrator's team decides to return to Aunt Tian's home and ask her for details.

sm2l2m7_desc_001.cn: 田阿姨与阿仔的比赛即将开始。前往方兴衢，观看比赛。
sm2l2m7_desc_001.en: Aunt Tian and Ah Zai's competition is about to start. Go to Fangxing Avenue and watch the contest.

sm2l2m7_desc_003.cn: 在摊位附近逛逛，看看田阿姨和阿仔比赛的情况。
sm2l2m7_desc_003.en: Hang around the stalls and see how Aunt Tian and Ah Zai are doing for the competition.

sm2l2m7_desc_004.cn: 田阿姨为阿仔准备了一碗“特制烂肉面”，并拜托管理员一行递交。
sm2l2m7_desc_004.en: Aunt Tian prepares a bowl of "special braised meat noodles" for Ah Zai and asks the Endministrator's team to deliver the food to him.

sm2l2m7_desc_005.cn: 比赛结果揭晓，管理员一行人寻找田阿姨和阿仔讨论后续事宜。
sm2l2m7_desc_005.en: The results are revealed. The Endministrator's team must find Aunt Tian and Ah Zai to talk about subsequent matters.

sm2l3m1_desc_001.cn: 在祖泉附近，管理员等人听到了断断续续的呼救声，打算找到声音的源头。
sm2l3m1_desc_001.en: The Endministrator's team hear cries for help near the Ancestral Spring. They decide to look for the source.

sm2l3m1_desc_002.cn: 救出杜鸣后，管理员一行人了解了他的情况，决定护送他前往祖泉。
sm2l3m1_desc_002.en: After saving Du Ming, the Endmin's team listens to his story and decides to escort him to the Ancestral Spring.

sm2l3m1_desc_003.cn: 由于杜鸣突然失踪，管理员一行人决定寻找他的踪迹。
sm2l3m1_desc_003.en: Du Ming suddenly disappeared. The Endmin's team decides to track him down.

sm2l3m2_desc_001.cn: 为了找到杜鸣，管理员等人前往清波寨，打算向汤汤求助。
sm2l3m2_desc_001.en: To find Du Ming, the Endmin's team decide to visit Qingbo Stockade and ask Tangtang for help.

sm2l3m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人得知了杜鸣的行踪，决定前往祖泉附近寻找杜鸣。
sm2l3m2_desc_002.en: The Endmin's team finds Du Ming's trail, and decides to go to the Ancestral Spring to find the youth.

sm2l3m2_desc_003.cn: 为了追回杜鸣，管理员一行人决定前往祖泉深处。
sm2l3m2_desc_003.en: To chase down Du Ming, the Endmin's team decides to head deeper into the Ancestral Spring.

sm2l3m3_desc_001.cn: 事情告一段落，管理员等人返回地面，打算跟汤汤会合。
sm2l3m3_desc_001.en: The incident has finally ended. The Endmin's team returns to the surface to meet up with Tangtang.

sm2l3m4_desc_001.cn: 在清波寨内寨附近，自称“天师”的青年皮奥特似乎遇到了麻烦，管理员打算帮助他。
sm2l3m4_desc_001.en: A young self-proclaimed "Tianshi" named Piot has run into problems near the Qingbo Stockade fort. The Endministrator decides to help.

sm2l3m4_name.en: Seekers of the Lost Treasure I

sm2l3m5_name.en: Seekers of the Lost Treasure II

sm2l3m6_desc_001.cn: 为了找到留下暗语的人，管理员一行前往暗语中提及的“山洞”。
sm2l3m6_desc_001.en: To find the one who left the secret messages, the Endministrator's team decides to enter the "cave" mentioned in one of them.

sm2l3m6_name.en: Seekers of the Lost Treasure III

sm2l4m1_desc_001.cn: 弭弗拜托管理员前往城建馆一处地下空间。
sm2l4m1_desc_001.en: Mi Fu asks the Endministrator to visit an underground area of the Urban Development Hall.

sm2l4m1_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人前往城区医疗点，继续先前有关无名遗体的调查。
sm2l4m1_desc_002.en: The Endministrator's team goes to the City Medical Clinic to continue their investigation of the unidentified corpse.

sm2l4m2_desc_001.cn: 与弭弗一同前往安思园，继续调查。
sm2l4m2_desc_001.en: Go to Serenity Garden with Mi Fu and continue your investigations there.

sm2l4m2_desc_002.cn: 管理员一行人在功绩石前找到了线索。返回城建馆，与弭弗会合。
sm2l4m2_desc_002.en: The Endministrator's team finds some clues in front of the merit stone. They return to the Urban Development Hall to meet with Mi Fu.

sm2l4m2_desc_003.cn: 管理员一行人前往城区医疗点，询问苏醒的巡卫贾班。
sm2l4m2_desc_003.en: The Endministrator's team goes to the City Medical Clinic to talk to watchguard Jia Ban who regained consciousness.

sm2l4m3_desc_001.cn: 管理员一行人与铁锚子在永垂壁下见面，准备参加追悼仪式。
sm2l4m3_desc_001.en: The Endministrator's team meets Iron Boatswain below the Eternal Wall and prepare to attend the memorial service.

sm2l4m4_desc_001.cn: 弭弗拜托管理员一行人前往城建馆，维修天师桩。
sm2l4m4_desc_001.en: Mi Fu asks the Endministrator's team to come to the Urban Development Hall and help repair the Tianshi Pillar.

sm2l4m5_desc_001.cn: 庄方宜请求管理员去一趟首墩，帮助奚墨完成首墩修复工作。
sm2l4m5_desc_001.en: Zhuang Fangyi asks the Endministrator to head to the Marker Stone and help Xi Mo complete its repairs.

sm2l4m6_desc_001.cn: 追上巨兽心脏能量化成的蟠兽，探究并解决首墩出现的问题。
sm2l4m6_desc_001.en: Catch up to the pantailbeast formed by Feranmut Heart energy, then investigate and solve the problems of the Marker Stone.

sm2l5m1_desc_001.cn: 试验园区外，一位天师学徒和一名巡卫似乎正在争执什么。管理员一行人决定前去查看情况。
sm2l5m1_desc_001.en: A Tianshi disciple and a watchguard are arguing about something outside the Test Area. The Endministrator's team decides to find out more.

sm2l5m2_desc_001.cn: 丙型天师桩出现了异状。管理员一行人决定跟随天师学徒陆令香，前往它的操作台处查看情况。
sm2l5m2_desc_001.en: The Type-C Tianshi Pillar has malfunctioned. The Endministrator's team decides to follow Tianshi disciple Lu Lingxiang to another control panel and check on the problem.

sm2l5m3_desc_001.cn: 即将离开试验园区之际，管理员一行人在污水处理区看到了一个熟悉的身影。跟随陆令香，前去查看情况。
sm2l5m3_desc_001.en: The Endministrator's team is just about to leave the Test Area when they notice a familiar figure near the Water Treatment Sector. Follow Lu Lingxiang to find out what is going on.

sm2l6m1_desc_001.cn: 连晓雾忽然请管理员到武陵城的选剑局见一面。
sm2l6m1_desc_001.en: Lian Xiaowu has suddenly requested to meet the Endministrator at the Bureau of Swordmancers in Wuling City.

sm2l6m1_desc_003.cn: 管理员和陈千语答应帮连晓雾寻找被埋藏的炎国科技遗产，二人向藏剑谷出发。
sm2l6m1_desc_003.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu agree to help Lian Xiaowu find buried Yanese relics and technologies. The two set off for Sword Vault Dale.

sm2l6m1_desc_004.cn: 一道封闭的门拦住了去路，要打开它，似乎要解开眼前的机关。
sm2l6m1_desc_004.en: A sealed door bars the way. You may need to fix the mechanism in order to open it.

sm2l6m1_desc_005.cn: 管理员和陈千语看到了藏剑谷中的旧日遗迹，勘察地形后，决定先前往第一座遗迹剑桩。
sm2l6m1_desc_005.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu see the ancient ruins hidden within Sword Vault Dale. After surveying the surroundings, they decide to head to the first Ancient Sword Stele.

sm2l6m1_desc_006.cn: 管理员和陈千语到达了第一座遗迹剑桩处，但前进的道路被挡住了。需要从附近的机关上想想办法。
sm2l6m1_desc_006.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu arrive at the first Ancient Sword Stele but the path forward has been blocked. The nearby mechanisms may offer a solution.

sm2l6m1_desc_007.cn: 在解开第一座遗迹剑桩的机关之后，管理员和陈千语继续向第二座遗迹剑桩前进。
sm2l6m1_desc_007.en: After solving the mechanisms of the first Ancient Sword Stele, the Endministrator and Chen Qianyu continue toward the second Ancient Sword Stele.

sm2l6m1_desc_009.cn: 一群凶猛的山犼兽，正在欺负之前见过的那只红色小山犼兽。管理员和陈千语决定搭救它。
sm2l6m1_desc_009.en: A fearsome rockhowler pack is bullying the little red rockhowler that the Endministrator and Chen Qianyu encountered before. They decide to rescue it.

sm2l6m1_desc_010.cn: 搭救了红色的小山犼兽后，在它的陪伴下，管理员和陈千语继续前往第二座遗迹剑桩。
sm2l6m1_desc_010.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu rescue the little red rockhowler. Together, the three of them continue toward the second Ancient Sword Stele.

sm2l6m1_desc_011.cn: 管理员和陈千语驱散了凶猛的山犼兽。找到躲藏起来的沃尔顿，询问情况。
sm2l6m1_desc_011.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu chase out the fearsome rockhowler and find Walton cowering in his hiding spot. They ask him about the situation.

sm2l6m1_desc_012.cn: 在与沃尔顿达成合作后，管理员和陈千语在第二座遗迹剑桩处，又被拦住了去路。看来要想办法解开这里的机关，才能继续前进。
sm2l6m1_desc_012.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu agree to work with Walton. Together, they reach the second Ancient Sword Stele and find the way blocked again. The mechanisms nearby must be used to open up a way forward.

sm2l6m1_desc_013.cn: 离开第二座遗迹剑桩后，管理员和陈千语在山犼兽“小机灵”的陪伴下，继续向山谷深处前进。
sm2l6m1_desc_013.en: After leaving the second Ancient Sword Stele, the Endministrator, Chen Qianyu, and "Smartie" the Rockhowler make their way deeper into the dale.

sm2l6m1_desc_014.cn: 作为必经之路的山洞被猛兽盘踞，必须打败它们才能继续前进。
sm2l6m1_desc_014.en: Fearsome beasts have blocked the cave and it is the only way. Defeat them to keep going.

sm2l6m1_desc_015.cn: 告别了“小机灵”之后，管理员和陈千语继续向第三座遗迹剑桩前进。
sm2l6m1_desc_015.en: After saying goodbye to "Smartie", the Endministrator and Chen Qianyu continue to make their way toward the third Ancient Sword Stele.

sm2l6m1_desc_016.cn: 管理员和陈千语需要穿过危险地带，才能继续前往最后一座遗迹剑桩。
sm2l6m1_desc_016.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu must traverse a dangerous area to reach the last Ancient Sword Stele.

sm2l6m1_desc_017.cn: 在最后一座遗迹剑桩，管理员和陈千语需要设法解开这里的机关，以前往谷底。
sm2l6m1_desc_017.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu must solve the mechanism of the final Ancient Sword Stele to reach the bottom of the dale.

sm2l6m1_desc_018.cn: 遗迹剑桩的机关均已解开，通向谷底的道路出现在眼前，前往探查藏剑谷深处的秘密。
sm2l6m1_desc_018.en: All Ancient Sword Stele mechanisms have been solved. The path to the bottom of the dale has been revealed. Now, go and reveal the secrets at the heart of Sword Vault Dale.

sm2l6m1_desc_019.cn: 管理员和陈千语在谷底发现了炎国留下的宝库，但一只巨大的山犼兽忽然出现，挡在面前。
sm2l6m1_desc_019.en: The Endministrator and Chen Qianyu discover a Yanese vault at the bottom of the dale, but a giant rockhowler suddenly leaps out and blocks the way.

sm2l6m1_desc_021.cn: 进入宝库，一窥泰拉留给塔卫二人们的遗产。
sm2l6m1_desc_021.en: Enter the vault to gaze upon the relics that the Terrans have left for the people of Talos-II.

sm2l6m1_desc_024.cn: 发现了宝库里真正藏着的“宝藏”之后，管理员和陈千语走出这里，向连晓雾、沃尔顿说明情况。
sm2l6m1_desc_024.en: After discovering the actual "treasure" buried in the vault, the Endministrator and Chen Qianyu leave the facility and relate the discovery to Lian Xiaowu and Walton.

sm2l7m1_desc_001.cn: 一位应龙特勤队的队员似乎正在苦恼着什么。前往北部禁区，了解情况。
sm2l7m1_desc_001.en: An Yinglung seems to be troubled with something. Go to the North Wuling Exclusion Zone to learn what is going on.

sm2l7m1_desc_002.cn: 根据线索，寻找宏南戏班成员，将乐器归还给他们。
sm2l7m1_desc_002.en: Follow the lead, find the thespians of South Hongshan Troupe, and return their instruments.

sm2l7m1_desc_003.cn: 参与突发的搜救行动，寻找失踪的天师轻竹。
sm2l7m1_desc_003.en: Join the emergency SAR operation and find the missing Tianshi named Qingzhu.

sm2l7m1_desc_004.cn: 回到悬崖上方，了解宏南戏班的过往。
sm2l7m1_desc_004.en: Return to the top of the cliff and learn more about the past of the South Hongshan Troupe.

sm2l8m1_desc_001.cn: 北部禁区的事件已告一段落，诀向你发来消息，希望你能去帮黎风一个忙。
sm2l8m1_desc_001.en: Things at North Wuling Exclusion Zone have settled down for a bit. Arcane sends you a message asking if you could help out Lifeng.

sm2l8m1_desc_002.cn: 前往息壤研究所找到黎风，了解他的情况如何。
sm2l8m1_desc_002.en: Go to the Xiranite Research Labs and find Lifeng. Talk to him and see how he is doing.

sm2l8m1_desc_003.cn: 陪黎风进入息壤研究所，寻找他和伙伴们亲人的遗物。
sm2l8m1_desc_003.en: Follow Lifeng into the Xiranite Research Labs and find the belongings of his family, as well as those of his friends' families.

sm2l8m1_desc_004.cn: 使用扫描功能，寻找白霜父亲的遗物。
sm2l8m1_desc_004.en: Scan the place and look for belongings of Bai Shuang's father.

sm2l8m1_desc_009.cn: 和黎风一起进入选剑局器物库。
sm2l8m1_desc_009.en: Enter the Bureau Arsenal with Lifeng.

sm2l8m1_desc_010.cn: 在选剑局器物库中寻找小然母亲的遗物。
sm2l8m1_desc_010.en: Look around the Bureau Arsenal and find the belongings of Xiao Ran's mother.

sm2l8m1_desc_013.cn: 前往旧居民区，寻找遗物的线索。
sm2l8m1_desc_013.en: Go to the Old Residential Area and find clues and other personal belongings.

sm2l8m1_desc_014.cn: 进入旧居民区，继续寻找遗物。
sm2l8m1_desc_014.en: Enter the Old Residential Area and look for more personal belongings.

sm2l8m1_desc_016.cn: 在旧居民区搜寻黎风父母的线索。
sm2l8m1_desc_016.en: Look around the Old Residential Area and find clues about Lifeng's parents.

sm2l8m1_desc_017.cn: 和黎风一道，前往谈剑堂北侧的锈器堆。
sm2l8m1_desc_017.en: Head to the Rust Mound north of Tanjian Hall together with Lifeng.

sm2l8m1_desc_018.cn: 在这里寻找黎风父母的痕迹。
sm2l8m1_desc_018.en: Find traces of Lifeng's parents in the vicinity.

sm2l8m1_desc_023.cn: 跟随黎风，搜寻与他父母相关的线索。
sm2l8m1_desc_023.en: Follow Lifeng and search for clues about his parents.

sm2l8m1_desc_024.en: Defeat the Blightshades and save the Tianshi.

sm2l8m1_desc_025.cn: 找到黎风，倾听他内心关于他父母的想法。
sm2l8m1_desc_025.en: Find Lifeng and listen to him talk about his parents.

sm2l8m1_desc_026.cn: 与黎风一同，祭奠他的父母。
sm2l8m1_desc_026.en: Join Lifeng and honor the memory of his parents.

sm2l8m1_desc_027.cn: 将找到的遗物，带给白霜。
sm2l8m1_desc_027.en: Give the personal belongings you found to Bai Shuang.

sm2l8m1_desc_028.cn: 在选剑局器物库中寻找阿生和黎风亲人的遗物。
sm2l8m1_desc_028.en: Look around the Bureau Arsenal and find the belongings of Ah Sheng and Lifeng's families.

sm2l8m1_desc_029.cn: 和黎风一起，听听连晓雾的倾诉。
sm2l8m1_desc_029.en: Listen to Lian Xiaowu's story with Lifeng.

sm2l9m1_desc_001.cn: 查看提弗洛斯发来的消息，确认发生了什么。
sm2l9m1_desc_001.en: Read Typhoeus's messages to find out what happened.

sm2l9m1_desc_002.cn: 应提弗洛斯邀请，前往约定地点与她会合。
sm2l9m1_desc_002.en: Accept Typhoeus's invitation and meet her at the rendezvous point she mentioned.

sm2l9m1_desc_003.cn: 与提弗洛斯会合后，跟随她观察四周，准备和她再次进入梦境。
sm2l9m1_desc_003.en: You meet up with Typhoeus. Observe the surroundings and prepare to enter the dreamscape with her.

sm2l9m1_desc_004.cn: 查看过石碑上的信息后，与提弗洛斯对话，举行仪式进入梦境中。
sm2l9m1_desc_004.en: The messages on the stone tablets have been read. Talk to Typhoeus to start the ritual and enter dreamscape.

sm2l9m1_desc_005.cn: 进入梦中梦后，继续深入，于其中探索。
sm2l9m1_desc_005.en: This is the dream within dreams. Head deeper and explore this place.

sm2l9m1_desc_006.cn: 进入梦境前，仔细查看石碑上的信息。
sm2l9m1_desc_006.en: Before entering the dreamscape, read the messages on the stone tablet carefully.

sm2l9m1_desc_007.cn: 与提弗洛斯一起进入梦境后，向更深处探索。
sm2l9m1_desc_007.en: Enter dreamscape with Typhoeus and explore its depths.

sm2l9m1_desc_008.en: Having gone deeper into dreamscape, try to reach an elevated position.

sm2l9m1_desc_009.cn: 抵达高处的途中，触碰看到的石碑。
sm2l9m1_desc_009.en: While ascending to an elevated position, touch the stone tablet you see.

sm2l9m1_desc_010.cn: 深入梦境后，搜集老雪祀留下的密文。
sm2l9m1_desc_010.en: You have reached the deep parts of dreamscape. Look around and gather runes left behind by the old Snowpriestess.

sm2l9m1_desc_011.cn: 老雪祀留下的密文并不完整，需要补全。
sm2l9m1_desc_011.en: The runes left behind by the old Snowpriestess are incomplete. Find the missing parts.

sm2l9m1_desc_012.cn: 深入梦境，继续寻找前往高处的路。
sm2l9m1_desc_012.en: Head deeper into dreamscape and keep looking for a path to an elevated position.

sm2l9m1_desc_013.cn: 深入梦境的途中，破除出现的符文。
sm2l9m1_desc_013.en: You are heading deeper into the dreamscape. Shatter the runes that appear.

sm2l9m1_desc_014.cn: 深入梦境的途中，击败遇到的巫术造物。
sm2l9m1_desc_014.en: You are heading deeper into the dreamscape. Defeat the witchcraft creations that you encounter.

sm2l9m1_desc_015.cn: 根据石碑上的提示，回头寻找最后一个密文。
sm2l9m1_desc_015.en: Use the clues provided by the stone tablet. Retrace your steps and find the last rune.

sm2l9m1_desc_016.cn: 集齐全部密文后，将其放置在对应的石碑上。
sm2l9m1_desc_016.en: All the runes have been gathered. Place them on the matching stone tablets.

sm2l9m1_desc_017.cn: 补全石碑上的密文后，触碰石碑，进入梦中梦。
sm2l9m1_desc_017.en: All the runes of the stone tablets are now complete. Touch the stone tablet to enter the dream within dreams.

sm2l9m1_desc_018.cn: 深入梦中梦，查看老雪祀留下的东西。
sm2l9m1_desc_018.en: Go deeper into the dream within dreams, and search the belongings of the old Snowpriestess.

sm2l9m1_desc_020.cn: 进入梦中梦，继续深入，于其中探索，寻找老雪祀留下的线索。
sm2l9m1_desc_020.en: Head deeper in the dream within dreams. Explore it and look for clues left behind by the Old Snowpriestess.

sm2l9m1_desc_024.cn: 见证了老雪祀的结局，离开梦境，回到雪松林。
sm2l9m1_desc_024.en: Having witnessed the conclusion of the Snowpriestess's journey, it is time to leave dreamscape and return to the Snowy Forest.

target_blackbox_transmuter_2_main_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Purification Unit switched to Gas Mode</> to produce <@gd.key>Hetonite Gas</>×2 and store the products in a Gas Tank

target_blackbox_udpipe_1_extra_1.en: Connect the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to the <@gd.key>Water Treatment Unit</> to keep the production line working

target_blackbox_udpipe_1_main_1.cn: 将清水接入<@gd.key>精炼炉</>使其生产<@gd.key>赤铜块</>
target_blackbox_udpipe_1_main_1.en: Deliver Clean Water to the <@gd.key>Refining Unit</> to produce <@gd.key>Cuprium</>

target_blackbox_vaporizer_1_extra_1.cn: 利用<@gd.key>稳定环境</>，完成<@gd.key>高效赫铜块产线</>
target_blackbox_vaporizer_1_extra_1.en: Create a <@gd.key>Stable environment</> and complete an <@gd.key>efficient Hetonite production line</>

target_blackbox_winder_1_extra_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>blueprint</> and produce Amethyst Components with <@gd.key>2 Gearing Units</> at the same time

target_blackbox_winder_1_main_1.cn: 使用<@gd.key>装备原件机</>生产紫晶装备原件
target_blackbox_winder_1_main_1.en: Use the <@gd.key>Gearing Unit</> to produce Amethyst Components

target_blackbox_winder_1_main_2.cn: 在协议核心处使用装备原件生产装备
target_blackbox_winder_1_main_2.en: Use Gear components to assemble pieces of gear at the PAC

target_blackbox_winder_1_main_3.cn: 在仓库中储备一批<@gd.key>紫晶装备原件</>
target_blackbox_winder_1_main_3.en: Store a batch of <@gd.key>Amethyst Components</> in the Depot

target_blackbox_xiranite_oven_1_main_2.en: Use the <@gd.key>blueprint</> to set up 1 <@gd.key>Xiranite</> production line
